dzo———snyesnye————snye—nd+raguljond+rarwarwaskyand+ra/——————————byudape skrun gsal bshad/gangs ri dkar bos mtha' nas yongs su bskor ba'i bsil ldan kha ba can gyi ljongs su sngon byon chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams kyi sku drin la brten nas byung ba'i bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas ni/ deng gi dus 'dir yang 'dzam gling du snyan grags kyi ba dan dkar bo ma nyams par gnas yod/ khyad par gso ba rig pa'i gzhung 'di ni lo ngo gnyis stong lhag gi lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i 'gros dang bstun te rgyun ma bstungs par brgyud 'dzin dang dar spel du btang /rig pa 'di nyid kyi mnga' bdag tu gyur ba'i sngon byon mkhas dbang rim byon ni bgrang gis mi lang ba zhig byung yod pa dang / der bstun khong rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gso dpyad kyi gzhung la'ang po ti grangs las 'das pa zhig yod pa las da skabs kha shas la shing par yod pa dang / kha shas ni nye ba'i lo 'ga'i ring la par skrun byas yod kyang / da dung ches gal 'gangs che ba'i gna' dpe bris ma khag gcig dang dpe rgyun shin tu dkon pa'i gzhung tshad ldan mi nyung 1

———snye—snyedzotram̐1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdind+radzisdutram̐sprisdutram̐sprisnye/snyebhesnye——ba zhig yod stabs/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung la slob sbyong dang zhib 'jug gi las ka byed mkhan gyi spobs pa dang ldan pa'i blo gsal gzhon nu lhag bsam don gnyer can rnams la mjal ba'i go skabs dang bral zhing / kho tsho'i las ka'i cha rkyen du med mi rung ba zhig yin 'dug pas/ nye char nga tshos gong rim gyi bkod 'doms ltar—/ gso rig bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan 'tsho byed 'bum rams pa 7rje bstan 'dzin don grub mchog gis/ lo ngo bcu phrag bzhi'i ring du nyar tshags byas pa'i ches shin tu dkon pa'i gna' dpe tshad ldan dang / khong gis snum par du btab zin pa'i gna' dpe kha shas/de min rje nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsang rtsom gyi skor sogs 'tsho byed ༄las dang bo ba rnams la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung phran ches dkon mo kha shas sogs lo rer deb re gnyis par skrun bya rgyur zhing chen dang khul mi rigs don gcod khang gis/ mi rigs srol rgyun rig gnas dar spel gyi ched du dgongs 'char dang mthun rkyen bzang bo gnang ba ltar/ nged cag mdzod dge rdzong bod lugs sman khang /rdzong bod sman zhib 'jug su'u yis/ gong gi 'char 'god de dag la dmigs nas mdzod dge bod lugs sman khang thi/ gso rig dpe tshogs zhes pa'i dpe cha zhig par sgrun bya rgyur gra sgrig byas te/ zi 2

dzo—snye—snyesnye———snye—snyend+raguljorjorwarjiskya2/———————snyebhe——khron mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis dngos su dpe skrun dang 'grems spel bya rgyu yin/ de ltar gso rig dpe tshogs kyi deb dang bo'i nang /1 yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo rje dmu dge bsam gtan mchog gis mdzad pa'i sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i bun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam bshad pa dang /2 yang khong gis mdzad pa'i g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar/3 rje kun dga' grol mchog gis mdzad pa'i rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rnam par thar ba rab bsngags snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba/4sman rtsis bstan pa'i mnga' bdag zur mkhar blo gros rgyal bos mdzad pa'i drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po bcas bzhugs/gong gi gzhung de rnams mkhas pa'i dbang bo kha shas la spyan 'bebs zhus te zhu dag thengs re gnyis byas nas mngon gsal dod po'i yig nor rnams snga ma'i gzhung la khungs gtugs te bcos pa las gdam nga can sogs khungs lung gsal bo ma rnyed pa'i the tshom dang bcas pa rnams rang sor bzhag yod/dpe cha'i ma yig ni snum par dang bskyar par byas pa sogs 3

————sne——dzorwasprusngasdund+rarjotsho2sdind+raXrwasdusprisdutram̐sprige/ge——snye—yin pas thig phreng kha shas dang yi ge re gnyis mi gsal ba dang /ma dpe de dag gi nang du yig nor yang shin tu mang / nga tsho'i las yun gyi dus ha cang thung zhing las ka de nyid 'char gzhi ltar dus nges can zhig gi nang du 'grub dgos pa'i rkyen gyis zhu dag mthar phyin pa ma byung ba'i rigs la mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo dang brtse ldan gyi glog pa bo rnams kyis dag bcos dang dgongs 'char gnang bar zhu lags/de min dpe tshogs 'di nyid phyogs bsgrigs bya ba'i las ka la zhing chen dang khul mi rigs don gcod khang gis 'gro gron gyi dngul btang ba/ rdzong u'u dang rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung / rdzong 'phrod bsten cus bcas kyi rgyab skyor dang rogs ram tshad med gnang ba dang / lhag par slob dpon rin po che mchog dang /rig pa 'di la skyes sbyangs gyi yon tan mi dman pa'i 'tsho byed mi nyung ba zhig gis zhu dag dang legs bsgrigs gnang ba bcas la phran gyis rtsom sgrig tshan chung gi tshab byas nas snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu zhu zhu lags/4
zhes mdzod dge bod sman khang gi yon krang ming 'dzin phran 'tsho byed thogs med kyis bris pa'o/ /spyi lo2005lo'i zla 12pa'i tshes 21nyin la/

————————gesnyege——snyend+rapar— 2—snye————————skesnye—dkar chagasman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i thun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam bshad pa/ (1)g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar/ (31)rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rnam par thar ba rab bsngags snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba/ (97)gang rigs dang 'brel ba khungs kyi lo rgyus/ (105)bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid sku bltams tshul/ (127)bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas gdams pa gsan tshul/ (154)rten dang gsung rab bzhengs tshul/ (162)gsung gi bdud jis yongs su smin pa'i slob brgyud spel tshul (181)bstod pa sogs gsung rtsom spel tshul/ (200)jis kyi bstan bcos sogs mdzad tshul/ (202)gso ba rig pa'i gsung rtsom mdzad tshul/ (209)mthar gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshul/ (218)mjug bsdus pa'i don gyi phreng ba spel ba/ (222)1

———snyebhe—skyarwa1dzirwand+rarjotshond+rasdirwamatharwasdusprisdutram̐skyasne/ snye————drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po/ (245)dang bo/ rigs rus cho 'brang gi tshul rags tsam brjod pa/ (252)gnyis pa/ 'das pa'i dus kyi mdzad pa'i cha shas tsam brjod pa/ (262)gsum pa/ 'ga' zhig the tshom dang bral ba'i slad du lung tshig gsal bor brjod pa/ (265)bzhi ba/ mkhas pa'i bya ba dang grub pa'i khyad par cha tsam brjod pa/ (269)lnga ba/ sku tshe de nyid kyi gdul bya mthar phyin par mdzad tshul/ (281)drug pa/ gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul brjod pa/ (303)
༄gi /sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i thun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam bshad pa bzhugs so/ /rje bsam gtan rgya mtshos brtsams/

dzo—dze—snyebhe—skyardzu1dzirwand+rarjotsho3sdind+ratshirwaṇasprisdutram̐spri—/———snye—༄gi /gnyis med ye shes sgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i rims nad dgra sde'i tshogs/ /yongs su 'joms pa'i rgyal thabs la rol ba/ /gnyen gcig drang srong de yis shis pa stsol//de la 'dir sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed gzhon nu zhes yongs sa ༄grags pa de nyid kyi thun mong gi rnam par thar ba mdo tsam zhig brjod par bya ste/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus tsam na 'phags yul gyi yul ma ga dhā'i rgyal bo bzo sbyangs gzugs can snying bo la sras gsum yod de/ khab kyi btsun mo las btsas pa rgyal bu ma skyes dgra/ yangs pa can gyi ar ma skyong ma las btsas pa rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med/ rgyal bo'i khab kyi khyim bdag zhig gi chung ma las btsas pa rgyal bu 'tsho byed gzhon nu ste gsum mo/ /rgyal bu gzhon nu 'jigs med dang 'tsho byed gzhon nu gnyis chen por gyur pa na/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus/gzhon nu 'jigs med la smras pa/ bdag cag gi nu bo rgyal bu ma skyes dgra ni rgyal bor 'gyur gyi/ bdag cag gis bzo cung zad bslabs na/ bdag cag gi phyi dus kyi 'tsho bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de gnyis kyis de ltar gros byas pa las/ gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis shing rta bzo mkhan dag mthong ba'i rkyen byas/ bdag gis yab la 2

——snye——snyebhe—sdusbyind+rasdusdugudzotram̐nd+ra1spyond+ragusbyisdurwa/——snye————zhus nas shing rta bzo ba bslab snyam nas/ yab gzugs can snying bo la zhus pas/ rgyal bos bkas gnang ste/ shing rta bzo ba bslab par brtsams so/ /'tsho byed gzhon nus/ sman pa gos dkar bo gon pa/mi gos dkar bo gon pa rnams kyis bskor te rgyal bo'i pho brang du zhugs pa mthong nas/ gzhan dag la dris pa/ 'di su zhig red/ de dag gis sman pa red zer/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus bsams par bdag gis sman dpyad bslab par bya snyam nas/ de pha'i gam du song ste—/ lha gnang bar mdzod cig bdag gis sman dpyad bslab lags so—/ /zhes zhus/ rgyal bos smras pa/ khyod rgyal bo'i sras yin na sman dpyad kyis ci bya/ 'tsho byed gzhon nus/ rgyal bo'i bus ni bzo thams cad bslab par bgyi lags so zhus pas/ phas bu gal te de lta na slobs shig ces bka' thob ste des sman dpyad slob par brtsams te bslab pa na sman dpyad lobs nas mkhas par gyur na'ang —/ des klad pa'i thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad ma shes/ des yul rdo 'jog na sman pa'i rgyal bo rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bya ba yod pa des klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad shes so/ /zhes thos nas/ de yab rgyal bo'i drung du song ste smras pa/ lha rdo 'jog tu mchi'o/ /rgyal bos ci zhig gi phyir/ des yul de na sman pa'i rgyal bo rgyun shes kyi bu zhes 3

dzosnyesnyesnye———dzotram̐1sngarwand+rarjosdurwasdind+raskyasdusdusprisdutram̐skyage/ —bhege——bgyi ba mchis te/ des klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad 'tshal bas de slob tu mchi'o/ /rgyal bos smras pa/ bu khyod 'dis 'tsho'am zer—/ des lha yang na ni dpyad mi bslab/ yang na ni legs par bslab par bgyi'o/ /rgyal bos bu gal te de lta na songs shig ces dgongs pa bstsal nas yul rdo 'jog gi rgyal bo padma'i snying bo la yi ge spring ba/ bdag gi ba 'di sman dpyad slob tu rgyun shes kyi ba'i ri gi ri gi drung du 'ong gis/ 'di'i dgos pa thams cad khyod kyis sbyor cigaces bris/ 'tsho byed gzhon nu rim gyis yul rdo 'jog tu phyin pa dang —/ rgyal bo padma'i snying bos kyang springs yig bklags te rgyun shes kyi bu la gtad nas/ rgyal bo'i bu 'di glo kyi drung du ched du 'ongs kyis 'di la sman dpyad slobs shig ces bsgos pas/ rgyun shes kyi bus 'tsho byed la sman dpyad ston par byed pa na/ slob dpon des nyung zad cig bstan kyang 'tsho byed kyis khyad par dang bcas pa lobs so/ /rgyun shes kyi bu'i kun tu spyod pa ni gang gi tshe nad pa bltar 'gro ba'i tshe bram ze'i khye'u zhig khrid de 'gro ba yin pas dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed khrid de song nas nad pa la bltas te des sman 'di dang 'di dag byin cig ces smras nas sgor byung ngo / /'tsho byed kyis 4

snyesnyesnyesnyedze—snerdzu'iXsdusdu1dzotram̐22spyond+rand+raskyasdurwa/snye————blothobasams pa/ 'di ni mkhan pos nyes te/ gal te 'dis sman 'di zos na deng nyid du 'chi bar 'gyur te/ mkhan pos bstan pa ni legs pa ma yin phyis thabs shig bya'o snyam nas/ de rgyun shes kyi bu dang lhan cig tu sgor byung yang slar nang du zhugs te/ mkhan pos 'di skad ces gsung ngo / /kho bos sman bstan pa gang yin pa de ma sbyin par 'di dang 'di dag byin cig ces zer ro/ /nad pa des de bzhin du byas pas sos par gyur to/ /ji tsam nyi ma gzhan zhig na rgyun shes kyi bu nad pa de'i khyim du song nas/ na ba ji ltar sos par gyur pa dris nas/ sang yang sman de nyid byin cig zer/ khyim mi de dag gis ci snga ma lags sam/ 'on te slad kyis bstan pa lags zhes zhus/ sman pas ci bdag gis snga phyi gnyis bstan tam zer/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di dag ni khyod kyis mngon sum du bstan to/ /'di ni 'tsho byed la phrin spring ba red zer/ des bsams pa/ bdag gis nyes kyis 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin no snyam nas smras pa/'tsho byed kyis bstan pa gang yin pa de byin cig zer/ de nas rgyun shes kyi bu 'tsho byed la dga' ba skyes pas de gang du 'gro ba der 'tsho byed khrid do/ /bram ze'i khye'u gzhan rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po khyod rgyal bo'i bu'o snyam nas 'di la ni spro bas ston par mdzad kyi/5

——snye—ge—snyeskyatu1sngasdund+rarjotshopasdind+ratshirwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/ —————bdag cag la ni mi mdzad do zer/ mkhan pos smras pa/ 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin pas ngas bstan pa gang yin pa de rang gis rnam par 'byed nus kyi khyed cag gis ni de lta ma yin no zer/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan pos ji ltar mkhyen/ mkhan pos gal te de lta na ngas khyed cag gis mngon sum du rig par bya'o/ /zhes smras nas dus gzhan zhig na/ mkhan pos bram ze'i khye'u rnams la mi re re la/khyod kyis rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin dris shig khyod kyis ni rdzas gzhan zhig che ge mo'i rin dris shig ces de rnams tshong 'dus su btang —/ 'tsho byed la'ang khyod kyis kyang rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin dris shig ces bsgos/ de thams cad tshong 'dus su phyin nas/ bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis mkhan pos ji skad bstan pa kho na'i rin dris kyi gzhan ma dris so/ /'tsho byed kyis kyang ji skad bstan pa bzhin byas nas bsam par gal te mkhan pos rdzas gzhan gyi rin 'dri bar byas na bdag gis ji skad brjod par bya/ thams cad du rdzas thams cad kyi rin dri'o snyam nas dris so/ /de dag thams cad mkhan po'i drung du song nas/ mkhan pos sngar ji skad bstan pa'i rdzas de dag gi rin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bas ma bstan pa'i rdzas kyi rin dri bar ༄brtsams te/ bram ze'i khye'u zhig la rdzas che ge mo zhig gi rin ji tsam/6

——————snye—spraziXsdurjigudzosdund+ra2spyond+raguljosdurwa/snyesnyesnyesnye—snye—des smras pa ma 'tshal lo/ /gzhan dag la dris pa/ smras pa ma 'tshal lags so/ /'tsho byed la dris pa dang des rdzas thams cad kyi rin smras so/ /rgyun shes kyi bas smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis thos ༄sam / de dag gis thos lags so zer/ ngas 'tsho byed ni shes rab can yin te cung zad bstan na yang de la rang gis rnam par 'byed nus so zhes smras pa ni don de yin no/ /gzhan mkhan pos yang mngon sum du bya'o zhes de rnams la smras pa/ thang shing can gyi rir dong la sman ma yin pa de dag khyer te shog cig /de dag thang shing can gyi ri la dong nas/ gzhan rnams kyis sman ma yin snyam pa gang dang gang btus so/ /'tsho byed kyis bsam par sman ma yin pa cung zad kyang med do snyam nas/ des 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang /rdo'i dum bu zhig blangs so/ /ji tsam na de dag lam gyi phyed na slebs tshe—/ phyugs rdzi mo zhig gi mig na nas zho'i bum pa dang phrum tshud ('o ma dang dar ba bskol ba'i snyiṭa ma/)khyer te rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'gro ba dang 'phrad—/ 'tsho byed kyis gang du 'gro/ don ci la 'gro/ zhes dris pas/des zhib par smras/ 'tsho byed kyis gnas de nyid na yod pa'i sman zhig blangs nas dpyad byas pas/ de mod la sos par gyur to/ /de dga' ba skyes nas smras pa/ zho'i bum pa dang phrum tshud 'di khyod 7

—snye————snyedzoshaṃpasngarwand+razosdu2sdind+ra1༷sbyosprisdutram̐spri—/ge—snye——snoms shig 'tsho byed kyis phrum tshud blangs te/ zho'i bum pa de nyid la phar byin/ phrum tshud de khyer te song ba las ji tsam na bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis lam gyi dbus na glang bo che'i rjes zhig mthong nas/de rnams kyis de la brtag par brtsams pa dang / 'tsho byed kyang 'ongs nas smras pa/ 'di ci yin/ glang bo che'i rjes so/ /'tsho byed kyis 'di glang bo che'i rjes ma yin gyi/ 'di ni bal glang mo'i rjes yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba de ring kho nar glang bo che'i phru gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon pa ni bud med yin la/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum ma de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'gyur ba zhig yin no/ /zhes smras/ ci tsam na de dag rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du 'ongs nas gang gis gang khyer te 'ongs pa'i rdzas dag bstan to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag 'di thams cad ni sman yin te/ che ge mo 'di ni nad che ge mo la phan pa'i sman yin la de bzhin du gzhan dag kyang 'di dang 'di'i sman yin no zhes smras nas/ 'tsho byed la dris pa khyod kyis ci khyer te 'ongs/ 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ mkhan po thams cad sman lags te/ sman ma lags pa ni ci yang ma mchis so/ /'on kyang bdag gis 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang / rdo'i dum bu dang phrum 8

————snye———spraziXsdurjispyaspyosduduspruspyond+rand+raljosdurwa/——snye————tshud cig 'tshal te mchis so/ /'di dag ci la dgos na/ sdig pas (sdig pa ra tsa/)zin pa la 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba'i dud pas bdug go/phrum tshud kyis ni glan par bgyi'o/ /rdo'i dum bu ni ston kha'i dus na zho'i bum pa 'chag par 'gyur ro zer/ (zho legs par 'chag byed kyi rdzas shig yin nam/) rgyun shes kyi bu 'dzum pa dang / bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis bsam pa/ /mkhan po ni 'di la khros so snyam nas de rnams kyis smras pa/ mkhan po 'di gcig bus 'di ltar snyam mam/ bdag cag mchi ba na lam gyi dbus su glang bo che'i rjes shig mthong ba na 'dis mchid nas 'di bal glang mo'i rjes yin te/ de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum ma de ring kho nar glang bo che'i phru gu 'byung bar 'gyur ba zhig yin la/ de la zhon pa ni bud med yin la de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba sbrum ma de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar 'gyur ro zhes mchi'o//rgyun shes kyi bus dris pa 'tsho byed bden nam/ mkhan po mad do/ de bal glang mo'i rjes yin pa ji ltar shes/ des smras pa/ mkhan po bdag ni rgyal bo'i rigs las chen por gyur pa lags na ci ste ma 'tshal—/ glang bo che'i rjes ni skum mo/ /bal glang mo'i rjes ni chur ring ngo / /mig g.yas pa zhar ba ni ji ltar shes/ g.yon phyogs su ran 'tshal zhing mchis pa lags so/ /(g.yon phyogs kyi rtswa legs pa dag zos 9

—snye—snye———༷rwasprusngasdund+razospru2sdirwadzirwatram̐dzisdutram̐rjo—/ ——snye—stonas g.yon phyogs su song ba'i don/) sbrum ma ji ltar shes/ rkang ba gnyis gnon cing mchi ba las so/ /deng kho nar 'brang bar 'gyur ba (btsa' ba)ji ltar shes/ gcin be snabs dang bcas pa 'byung bas so/ /glang bo che'i phru gu pho yin pa ji ltar shes/ rkang ba g.yas pa lhag par gnon cing mchi bas so/ /de la bud med zhon pa ji ltar shes/babs nas rkang ba'i bar du gcis pa las so/ /de yang mig g.yas pa zhar ba ji ltar shes/ g.yon phyogs su me tog 'thu zhing mchis pas so/ /de yang sbrum ma ji ltar shes/ de'i rkang ba'i rting ba phal cher gnon cing mchis pas so/ /deng kho nar btsa' bar 'gyur ba ji ltar shes/ gcin ljan rdzin dang bcas te 'byung ba las so/ de ltar lags/ gal te mkhan po thugs mi ches na 'gron po de gnas pa'i phyoṭa der bram ze'i khye'u 'ga' zhig blta ru mngag tu gsol/mkhan pos bram ze'i khye'u zhig btang nas ltar bcug pas/ 'tsho byed ji skad smras pa bzhin du gyur to/ /rgyun shes kyi bus bram ze'i khye'u rnams la smras pa/ bram ze'i khye'u dag khyed cag gis thos sam/'cho byed ni de 'dra shes rab can no/ /'tsho byed kyis klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad ma gtogs pa thams cad bslabs so/ /ji tsam na mi zhig klad nad kyis thebs 10

dzo——snye———snyedzra1༷tshorjiguspyosdund+rapakyind+rand+rasbyirwarwa/———gege——nas rgyun shes kyi bu'i drung du song ste smras pa/ rgyun shes kyi bu/bdag la dpyad mdzod cig des smras pa/ kye nang rje de ring dong rkos la lci ba dag sta gon gyis shig dang sang bdag gis khyod la dpyad bya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis de thos nas nad pa de'i phyi bzhin song ste—/ kye nang rje bdag gis cung zad bslabs pa gang yin pa de thams cad ni sems can la phan pa'i phyir yin na/ bdag gis klad pa'i thod pa dbye ba ma bslabs kyis/ sang khyod la dpyad byed pa'i skabs ji ltar byed blta dgos pas/ khyed kyis bdag dben pa zhig tu zhog /des smras pa/ de bzhin du bgyi'o/ /des lkog tu 'tsho byed khrid de khyim gyi phyogs dben pa zhig tu bzhag de nas rgyun shes kyi bu 'ongs nas mi de dong du bcug ste thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad kyis thod pa phye nas skam pas srin bu de len par brtsams pa na 'tsho byed kyis—/ mkhan po gzu lums su ma len rigs kyi bu 'di deng nyid du 'gum par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pas/ mkhan pos 'tsho byed 'ongs sam—/ mkhan po bdag mchis so/ /mkhan pos srog chags 'di ji ltar blangs par bya zer/ 'tsho byed kyis mkhan po skam pa tsha bar mdzad de rgyab tu reg nas rkang lag 'khum par gyur pa dang de nas bor cig ces smras pa ltar byas pas nad pa de sos par gyur to/ /11

——ge—snye—dzoshaṃ1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdirwatshirwasduskyasdutram̐sdu—/—————rgyun shes kyi bus smras pa/ 'tsho byed kho bo shin tu mgu bar gyur gyis khyed kyis khrus byos la shog cig dang klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad sbyin no/ /'tsho byed kyis khrus byas nas/ 'ongs pa dang des de la klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad byin nas smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag cag ni 'dis 'tsho ba yin gyis/ yul 'dir khyed kyis ma bya zhig /'tsho byed kyis rgyun shes kyi bu la mkhan po de ltar bgyi'o zer nas rgyun shes kyi bu la phyag byas nas rgyal bo padma'i snying bo'i drung du song ste phyag byas nas/ bdag gis sman dpyad bslabs lags kyis mchi'o—/ /zhes smras/ de'i tshe rgyal bo padma'i snying bo dang mi mthan pa stomatha' 'khob pa skya bseng zhes bya ba dag cig yod/ rgyal bos smras pa—/ 'tsho byed bdag dang mi mthun pa mtha' 'khob pa skya bseng zhes bya ba zhig yod/ khyod ni shes rab can dang nus pa can yin pas re zhig de phobs la phyis song zhig zer ba 'tsho byed kyis kyang khas blangs pa dang / rgyal bo des dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi bo bsdus te btang ba las des mtha' 'khob pa skya bseng de rnams phab nas gte'u bzung dpya blangs te slar bde bar 'ongs nas khyer te 'ongs pa de bzhin du rgyal bo la phul ba dang / de shin tu dga' nas rjes su yi rangs te bya dga' gnang ba dag 'tsho byed kyis rgyun shes 12

dzosnye—ge—snye——rdzurngiXtram̐rjiguspyosdund+rapaspyond+rand+raljosdurwa/snye——————kyi bu la phul to/ /de nas 'tsho byed 'gro bar brtsams te rim gyis grong khyer bzang byed du phyin nas de nyid du dbyar gnas te/ 'byung bo thams cad kyi skad ces bya ba'i bstan bcos bslabs/ grong khyer bzang byed nas chas te 'gro ba'i tshe lam du mi zhig gis shing khur gcig 'khur nas grong khyer du 'jug pa de'i rus pa dang pags pa khrag dang rtsa dang bcas pa mthong ba/ 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas/ de la smras pa/ kye nang rje ci zhig gis gnas skabs 'di lta bur gyur/des smras pa/ bdag gis kyang mi shes shing khur 'di khyer nas bdag gnas skabs 'di 'drar gyur to/ /'tsho byed ni shing brtag pa la mkhas pa yin pas/ kye nang rje shing khur 'di 'tshong ngam/ des 'tshong ngo / /rin ji tsam/ kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya'o/ /'tsho byed kyis de nyos nas bltas pa na/ shing de'i nang du 'byung bo thams cad dang bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i nor bu yod pa mthong / de'i mthu ni 'di 'dra ste/ gang gi tshe nad pa'i mdun du bzhag pa de'i tshe mar me khyim na yod pa'i rdzas bzhin du nad ji lta ba bzhin du snang ngo / /de rim gyis u dum wa rar phyin pa dang / de na mi bres 'bru 'jal ba zhig yod pa des bres gzhal nas bre mgo la bsnun pa 'tsho byed kyis mthong nas smras pa/ kye nang rje ci'i phyir de ltar byed/ des bdag gi 13

dzo——snye———dzosprapasngasdund+rarjosdund+rasdind+rakaurwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/——snyege—klad pa lhag par g.ya' 'o zer/ tshur shog blta'o zhes des de bsnyal nas klad pa la bltas/ de nas 'tsho byed kyis 'byung bo thams cad dang bar byed pa'i nor bu de'i klad pa'i steng du bzhag pa dang ji tsam na srin gyi med cig snang ngo / /kye nang rje khyed kyi klad pa na srin gyi med yod do/ /des 'tsho byed kyi rkang ba gnyis la gtugs te smras pa—/ bdag la dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis khas blangs te bsams pa/ mkhan pos ji skad bstan pa de bzhin du 'di'i dpyad bya'o snyam nas de la smras pa/ kye nang rje re zhig de ring dong rkos la lci ba dag sta gon byos shig dang sang dpyad bya'o/ /des de bzhin sta gon byas/ 'tsho byed kyis de'i phyi nyin 'ongs nas de dong du bcug ste klad pa'i thod pa 'byed pa'i dpyad kyis klad pa'i thod pa phye nas skam pa tsha bas srin gyi med kyi rgyab la reg pa byas te des rkang lag 'khum pa dang skam pas blangs te bor bas sos par gyur to/ /des 'tsho byed la yon kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang des kyang rang gi slob dpon rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed yul ro hi ta ka zhes bya bar phyin pa dang / yul de na skyed mos tshal yid du 'ong ba zhig yod pa der song nas bsdad/ der mi dmu chu'i nad kyis thebs pa sman pa thams cad kyis thabs ma rnyed par spangs pa 14

dzo—snye—gesnyegedzerdzusngasdusdurjiguspyosdund+ra2spyond+raphroṃsbyisdurwa/——dze—bhesnye—zhig yod/ 'tsho byed kyis de la dris pa/ nang rje khyod ci'i phyir 'di lta bu'i gnas skabs su gyur/ des 'tsho byed la ji ltar gyur pa dag smras pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis de la/ la phug gi sa bon mar phyung ba'i dar bar btags pa 'thung du bcug ste dpyad byas pas sos par gyur te/ mi des kyang 'tsho byed la kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang /de yang rang gi slob dpon rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis bcom brlag tu phyin nas bcom brlag gi phyi rol na shing zhig gi drung du ngal gso zhing 'dug go /ji tsam na gyad kyis gyad gcig brdabs nas de'i nang khrol rnams 'khrugs nas de shi'o zhes phyi rol du sgra byung ngo / /de nas 'tsho byed langs te ro'i drung du song nas/ de gar gnas pa'i mi dag la dris pa/ shes ldan dag 'di ci zhig de rnams kyis smras pa/ gyad kyis gyad brdabs pas shi ba red—/ 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ zhog cig dang blta'o/ /de rnams kyis bzhag pa dang / de nas 'tsho byed kyis 'byung bo thams cad dang bar byed pa'i nor bu klad par bzhag nas brtags pa na/ ji tsam na nang khrol rnams 'khrugs par byas pa mthong nas smyug ma'i sbubs su sman gyi phye ma blugs te bus pa dang phye mas nang khrol la reg nas sos par gyur to/ /gyad des kyang 'tsho byed la kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya 15

ge—————dzorwa2sngasdund+rarjospra3sdind+rarwarwaṇasdusdutram̐sprisnye/snye————byin pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis yang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /bcom brlag na khyim bdag cig gi chung ma gzugs dang lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod pa de'i mo mtshan du srin 'bu gdug pa can zhig grub nas/ de dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod pa thams cad shi bas—/ de nas de dang 'ga' yang lhan cig dga' mgur spyod par mi byed do/ /bud med des sman pa 'tsho byed der 'ongs so zhes thos nas de de'i drung du song ste smras pa/ 'tsho byed bdag la bro nad mchis kyis dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis de mthong zhing smra ba'i tshig thos nas thabs dran te smras pa/ khyod kyis dam zhig bca' bar bya dgos te/ bdag dang lhan cig dga' mgur spyad na dpyad bya'o//des smras pa/ g.yar tsha (ngo tsha/)lags so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/khyed kyi nad la phan pa'i dpyad gzhan ni med do/ /bdag las phangs pa gzhan med pas des khas blangs so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis mo sgren mor phyung ste bzo bcos byas nas mo mtshan gyi sgor sha'i dum bu zhig bzhag pa las/ de nas srin bu de de la chags pa dang des de blangs nas bor te sos par gyur to/ /de 'dod pa'i 'dod chags la lhag par zhen pas 'tsho byed la brda zhig smras pa dang 'tsho byed kyis rna ba gnyis bkag ste smras pa/ khyod kho bo'i sring mo dang 16

dzosnyesnyesnye—blosnye—rdzusbyind+rasdusdu1dzosdund+ra2spyond+rasprasbyisdurwa/snye——————'dra ste khyod kyi dpyad de yin pas kho bos de ltar byas par zad do/ /bud med des kyang 'tsho byed la kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang /de yang rgyun shes kyi bu la bskur ro/ /de nas 'tsho byed rim gyis chu bo ya mu na'i 'gram du phyin pa dang —/ des de na mi ro zhig yod pa de'i rting ba'i phyogs na rgyus pa'i breng yod pa nya rnams kyis drangs pa las de'i mig 'byed pa dang 'dzum pa mthong nas/ 'tsho byed kyis de thams cad brtags te/ ji ltar rgyus pa dang long mo la sogs pa'i tshigs kyi 'brel thabs ni de kho na ltar 'dug go snyam nas/ de rim gyis yangs pa can du phyin pa dang —/ ji tsam na gyad gyis gyad gcig la thal mos bsnun pas/ mig gi 'bras bu 'phags pa dang / 'tsho byed de'i drung du song nas/ de'i rting ba'i rgyus pa'i breng nas drangs pa dang slar tshud par gyur to/ /des kyang 'tsho byed la kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis rang gi phu bo gzhon nu 'jigs med kyi ma ar ma skyong ma la byin no—/ /yangs pa can na mi zhig gi rna bar srin gyi med zhugs te/ der de las phru gu lnga brgya byung bas de rna ba'i nad kyis nyen par gyur nas 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ste smras pa/ dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis bsams pa/ sngar ni bdag gis mkhan pos bstan pa'i las 17

dzo——gebhe—sdusdurwa1sngarwand+rarjosdu2nd+rasngasdurwasdurjosdusbyosdublo/ —————byas kyi/ da ni rang gi blos las bya'o snyam nas/ des mi de la bsgo ba/kye nang rje song la lo ma'i spyil bo byos te ras sngon pos g.yog la de'i 'og tu rnga zhig zhog ste sa yang dron por gyis shig mi des ji skad bstan pa bzhin thams cad byas so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis mi de sa la bsnyal nas sa der chus chag chag btab nas/ de nas rnga brdung ba dang srin 'bu gyi med kyis dbyar gyi dus la bab po snyam nas phyir byung ngo / /'tsho byed kyis de'i rna ba'i drung du sha dum bu zhig bzhag pa dang / de slar yang nang du zhugs te phru gu rnams khrid de byung nas phru gu rnams dang lhan cig sha'i dum bu la chags pa dang / de nas 'tsho byed kyis de'i mod la sha'i dum bu bor ba dang mi de sos par gyur to/ /mi des kar ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byin pa dang / de yang 'jigs med kyi ma la byin no/ /'tsho byed rim gyis rgyal bo'i khab tu phyin pa dang / rgyal bo gzugs can snying bos 'tsho byed ji ltar 'ongs pa thos nas/ des gzhon nu ma skyes dgra la bsgo ba/ bu khyod kyi phu bo 'ongs kyis bsur song zhig de bsur 'ongs pa dang 'tsho byed kyis ma skyes dgra bsur 'ongs pa thos nas des bsam pa/ gal te bdag gis des bsur 'ongs pa rang gir byas na/ de nam rgyal bor gyur pa de'i tshe bdag 18

dzo——bhe———bhespraXtram̐nd+rasdugudzond+rand+ratsho.ond+rakyiskyarwa3——snye————la gnod pa byed par 'gyur ro snyam nas/ de slar log ste sgo gzhan zhig nas zhugs so/ /dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed skye bo'i tshogs chen pos yongs su bskor te g.yeng zhing song ba dang / ji tsam na bram ze zhig mig nad kyis thebs nas 'tsho byed kyi drung du song ste bdag la sman ston ciga'atsho byed tshig pa za ba'i rnam pas thal ba thob cig smras/ de drang bo zhig yin pas mig la thal ba btab pa dang sos par gyur to/ /mig nad kyis thebs pa gzhan zhig 'tsho byed kyi drung du 'gro ba de sngar gyi bram ze des mthong nas dris pa/ kye nang rje gang du 'gro/ des ji ltar gyur pa smras pa dang bram ze des smras pa/ khyod la 'tsho byed ci dgos—/ 'tsho byed kyis kho bo la gang bstan pa de byos shig de yid ches par gyur nas des mig la thal ba btab pa dang long bar gyur to—/ /dus gzhan zhig na rgyal bo gathugs can snying bo'i spyi bor phol mig byung ste/ des blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ shes ldan dag sman pa rnams khug cig blon po rnams kyis sman pa rnams bkug pa dang /rgyal bos smras pa/ shes ldan dag nga'i spyi bor phol mig byung ba la dpyad byos shig de rnams kyis smras pa/ lha sman pa chen po 'tsho byed mchis na bdag cag gis bgyi ba ci 'tshal/ rgyal bos smras pa shes 19

————bhesnyedzorwa1dzisdund+razotsho2sdiglutshirwasduskyasdutram̐dzisnye/ ——snye——ldan dag 'tsho byed khug cig de rnams kyis bkug pa dang / rgyal bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' ste/ gal te lha la bdag nyid kyis khrus bgyid du gnanganabagyi'o rgyalabosadebazhinagyisashigagasangasapas de / ༄ / nas 'tsho byed kyis skyu ru ra'i khu ba bskus shing smin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab nas smin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs nas smin pa de tshe na ma tshor bar spu gris reg par byas pa dang rdol te/ 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blugs pa dang / rma de sos shing pags pa sor chud skra yang mnyam par gyur to/ /nyin gcig rgyal bos khrus byas ma thag smras pa/'tsho byed dpyad byos shig des smras pa/ lha re zhig bshos gsol cig rgyal bos bshos gsol nas 'tsho byed dpyad byos shig 'tsho byed kyis lha bgyis lags so/ /de yid ma ches nas lag pas byugs na phyogs gang na rma yod pa ma shes/ me long blangs te bltas na yang ma mthong / btsun mo la dris na des kyang phyogs gang na rma yod pa ma shes so/ /rgyal bo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas blon po rnams la smras pa—/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig mi 20

dzo—snyebhe—snyesnegesdu1༷sdusduguspyotram̐nd+rapaspyond+rand+raljosdurwa/—snye—snye——byulong ba des rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha ci sras la byams pas sam 'on te sman la mkhas pas dbang bskur bar mdzad/ rgyal bos smras pa/sman la mkhas so/ /gal te de ltar lags na 'dis bdag ni sos par ma bgyis so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje bdag gis khyod mthong yang ma mthong na sos par lta ga la byas/ des smras pa/de ni mad la 'on kyang khyod kyis gang la bstan pa des bdag la bstan to/ /ci zhig bstan/ che ge mo zhig gi mig la thal ba btab pas sos pa des bdag la bstan pa ltar byas nas long bar gyur to//'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ de'i khams kyang gzhan la khyod kyi khams kyang gzhan yin gyis/ da ni 'di dang 'di dag byos shig dang sos par 'gyur ro/ /des de ltar byas nas sos par gyur pa dang / rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha 'di sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur bar mdzad du gsol—/ de nas 'tsho byed glang bo che la bskyon nas dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur to/ /yang rgyal bo'i khab na khyim bdag cig yod pa skran nad kyis thebs nas/ sman pa thams cad kyis dpyad byas kyang ma sos pas sman pa thams cad kyis spangs pa dang / de'i bsam pa la/ 'tsho byed kyi drung du 'gro/ dpyad cig byas na legs/ gal te ma byas na bdag 21

ge——ge——skyarwapasngasdund+razotsho2sdind+radzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐skya—/——snyesnye—nyid 'chi'o snyam nas/ de 'tsho byed kyi drung du song nas/ 'tsho byed bdag la dpyad mdzod cig 'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje khyod kyi sman 'di ni rnyed par dka' 'o/ /des bsams pa/ 'tsho byed kyis kyang spangs na 'di la ci byar yod/ dus la bab kyis bdag ni 'chi'o snyam nas/ de dur khrod du song / de na ro sreg pa'i me 'bar bar de'u le gdug pa zhig dang srog chags go rnya tsan dan zhes bya ba 'thab te mer lhung ba dang de bkros pas nyen pas de gnyis zos te/dur khrod du char bab pa'i chu 'khyil ba 'thungs nas dur khrod dang ha cang mi ring ba zhig na gnag lhas yod pa der song ste/ ko dra'i chan dang mar phyung ba'i zho 'thungs pas skran rdol te yar rlon mar 'khrus nas (skyugs bshal/)sngon ji lta ba bzhin du gyur to/ /dus gzhan zhig na btsun mo lus 'phags mo'i 'doms kyi phyogs su phol mig byung ngo / /des rgyal bo la smras pa dang rgyal bos 'tsho byed la bsgo ba/ma yar mo la dpyad byos shig des khas blangs nas/ zan byas te ma ma la byin nas khyod 'di'i steng du sdod cig des de ltar bsdad pas zan gyi thog tu phol mig gi rjes yod pas 'tsho byed kyis phol mig yod pa'i phyogs de shes nas phol mig smin par 'gyur ba'i rdzas dag btab ste/ smin par shes pa'i skabs su zan gyi nang du gtsag bu 22

dzosnye—————snyerdzusngatram̐3rjirdzudzosdund+rapaspyond+rand+rasbyisdurwa/—snyesnye————sbas te ma ma la bsgo ba/ khyod 'di'i steng du 'di ltar sdod cigabatsun mos de bzhin byas pas gtsag bus phol mig la reg ma thag rdol bar gyur to/ /de nas 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas dang bsres pa bska ba'i chus bkrus te 'tsho bar 'gyur ba'i rdzas rnams btab pas sos par gyur/ de nas 'tsho byed rgyal bo'i drung du song ba dang rgyal bos smras pa/ 'tsho byed khyod kyis ma yar mo la dpyad byas sam/ lha bgyis so/ /khyod kyis sgron mor phud de ma bltas grang / lha ma bltas so—/ /ji ltar byas/ des ji ltar gyur pa rnams smras pa dang rgyal bo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ blon po rnams la smras pa/ 'tsho byed lan gnyis par sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig mi skran can la 'tsho byed kyis khyod kyi sman rnyed par dka' 'o zhes smras pa gang yin pa des rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha ci sras la sdug pas sam/ 'on te sman la mkhas pas dbang bskur bar mdzad/ rgyal bos smras pa/ sman la mkhas pas so/ /des gal te de ltar lags na 'dis bdag ni sos par ma bgyis so/ /'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ kye nang rje ngas khyod la dpyad ni ma byas kyi/ 'on kyang ngas khyod kyi sman ni rnyed par dka' 'o zhes smras so/ /des smas pa/ bdag gi sman ji lta bu dag yin/'tsho byed kyis smras pa/ gal te zla ba mar gyi ngo tshes bcu bzhi la mi 23

snyege—snye—snyedzond+ra1sngasdund+rarjotsho2sdirngadzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/——snye—skeser skya zhig shi nas de dur khrod du sreg pa na ne'u le gdug pa dang srog chags go dha tsan dan 'thabs nas mer lhung ba dang de gnyis khyod kyis zos la dur khrod du char bab te 'khyil ba'i chu de 'thungs la—/ ko dra'i zas zos shing mar phyung ba'i zho 'thung na de lta na khyod sos par 'gyur te/ bdag gis de la bsams nas sman rnyed dka' 'o zhes smras pa yin no/ /des smras pa/ shin tu legs par shes te/de bzhin du bdag gis zos so/ /de nas mi de dga' bar gyur nas rgyal bo la smras pa/ lha 'dis sman pa'i rgyal bo'i rngo thogs kyi dbang bskur du gsol/ lan gnyis su sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur to//gang gi tshe mi dge ba'i grogs po lhas byin gyis ma skyes dgra bslus nas pha rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo srog dang bral bar byas pa de'i tshe ma skyes dgra skran gyi nad kyis thebs par gyur/ des sman pa rnams la smras pa/ nga la dpyad gyis shig sman pa rnams kyis smras pa—/ lha lha'i gcen sman pa'i rgyal bo bla na med pa 'tsho byed 'di na mchis bzhin du bdag cag gis dpyad bgyid pa rngo ga la thogs/rgyal bos blon po rnams la smras pa/ shes ldan dag 'tsho byed khug shog de rnams kyis bkug pa dang / 'tsho byed nga la skran nad byung gis dpyad byos shig lha bgyi'o/ /'tsho byed kyis bsams pa rgyu 24

snye——ge———sdusngand+rasdusdurdzudzosdu2spruspyond+rand+rasbyisdurwa/———snye———gnyis kyis skran rdol bar 'gyur te/ lhag par dga' ba'am/ lhag par khros pas yin na sems can gdug pa can 'di lhag par dga' bar ga la 'gyur gyi/ rnam pa thams cad du khros par bya'o bsams nas smras pa/ lha dam zhig bca' dgos te/ gal te gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo'i sha gsol ba lta na dpyad bgyi'o/ /('char byed bzang bo ni rgyal bo ma skyes dgra kho rang gi bu'o/ /)rgyal bos thos nas khros te smras pa/legs so ngas ni pha srog dang bral/ khyod kyis kyang 'char byed bzang bo srog dang phrol/ nga yang nad kyis shi nas khyod ni rgyal bor 'gyur mod—/ des smras pa/ lha dpyad ni 'di lags te/ gzhan gyis sos par rngo mi thogs lags so/ /bdag dang 'dra ba'i phangs pa med pas rgyal bos khas blangs so/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas rgyal bo la phul te—/ lha gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo la legs par gzigs pa de ltar mdzad du gsol/ phyis gziṭa par mi 'gyur ro/ /de nas de ltar bstan nas khyim du khrid nas bzhag go /de nas 'tsho byed sha'i don du bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod du song ba las bsil ba'i tshal gyi dur khrod ni ros stong ba ma yin pas de nas ro'i sha blangs te yo byad kyi khyad par dag dang g.yos byas nas/ rgyal bo'i dro la bab pa'i 25

———snye—snye—skyand+ra1sprusdund+rarjosdu2sdind+raXrwasdusprisdutram̐skya—/—snye———dus su bstabs so/ /de nas ma skyes dgras sha khu'i phor ba blangs nas za bar gzas pa dang 'tsho byed kyis phrogs nas klad du bsdun te sdig can khyod kyis pha chos dang ldan pa chos kyi rgyal bo srog dang bral la bu'i sha yang za bar byed dam/ des rngam nas smras pa/ gal te de lta na ci'i phyir bsad ces mi bzod pa drag po skyes pas de'i skran rdol nas yar rlon mar 'khrus te/ kha nas khrag dang bcas par byung ba de kho rang gis mthong nas brgyal te sa la 'gyel to/ /de nas chu gtor nas dbugs slar byung ba dang khrus byas te 'phrod pa'i zas byin pas sngon ji lta ba bzhin gyur to/ /de nas 'tsho byed kyis gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan nas khrid de rgyal bo'i drung du song nas rkang ba gnyis la gtugs te smras pa/ lha gzhon nu 'char byed bzang bo 'di lags te/ bdag srog chags grog spur yang srog dang bral bar bgyid mi phod na gzhon nu lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ 'on kyang thabs 'dis lha 'tsho bar 'gyur bas bdag gis thabs bshams par bgyis pas so/ /rgyal bo mchog tu ngo mtshar skyes nas/ blon po rnams la bsgo ba/ 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal bor dbang skur cig blon po rnams kyis 'tsho byed glang bo che la bskyon nas dpal gyi 'byor ba chen pos lan gsum par yang sman 26

dzo——snye—dzodzebhegerdzu1༷tram̐sdurdzudzo3nd+rapaspyond+rand+rasbyisdurwa/————snye——pa'i rgyal bor dbang bskur to/ /de nas 'tsho byed dregs pa skyes nas bdag dang mnyam pa'i sman pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ bdag ni lus kyi dpyad byed pa rnams kyi mchog yin la/ bcom ldan 'das ni sems kyi dpyad mdzad pa rnams kyi mchog yin no snyam mo/ /dus gzhan zhig na 'tsho byed bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar song ba las de dregs pa'i snyems pas bden pa ma mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis dgongs pa/sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed na ci'i phyir bden pa ma mthong bar gyur snyam na/ dregs pa'i snyems pa las gyur par gzigs nas/ de'i dregs pa spang bar bya'o snyam nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed la bka' stsal ba/'tsho byed khyod kyis ri'i rgyal bo gangs can mthong ngam/ btsun pa mthong lags so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed khrid nas/ ri'i rgyal bo gangs can gang na ba der gshegs pa dang / de na sman rnam pa sna tshogs sgron me bzhin du 'od 'bar ba yod—/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sman pa'i rgyal bo 'tsho byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal te/ 'tsho byed sman ci tsam 'dod pa longs shig de song nas sman rnam pa sna tshogs dag blangs nas bcom ldan 'das kyi 27

snyesnye———snyeskyardzurngisngasdund+rarjosdu3nd+rand+radzirwasdusprisdusbyospri—/snyebhebhe——spyan sngar 'ongs so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed sman 'di'i ming ci yin/ des gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das che ge mo lags te/ cho ga 'dis nad che ge mo zhig zhi bar 'gyur/ 'di ni che ge mo zhig lags te nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur la/gzhan rnams kyi ming yang mi shes so/ /ma shes pa gang yin pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed 'di ni che ge mo ste cho ga che ge mos nad che ge mo zhig rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'di yang che ge mo zhig ces bya'o/ /de ltar re re bzhin gsungs pas 'tsho byed kyis gsol ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis sman dpyad kyang mkhyen lags sam/ zhes zhus pas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'tsho byed la bka' stsal ba/ 'tsho byed sman zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa dgos te/ bzhi gang zhe na/ nad la mkhas pa/ nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa/ nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa/spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa'o/ /dang bo nad la mkhas pa ni—/ nad 'di ni 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu yin no zhes shes pa'o/ /gnyis pa nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di ni rlung gis kun nas bslang ba'am/ mkhris pas kun nas bslang ba'am/bad kan gyis kun nas bslang ba'am/ bdag las gyur pa'am/28

dzo——————snyespra1༷sdurjigudzosdund+rapaspyond+rand+rasbyirwarwa/snye——————gzhan las gyur pa'am/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'o zhes shes pa'o/ /gsum pa nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di ni mig sman nam— sku mnye'am/ skyug sman nam/ bkru sman nam/ snar blugs pa'am—/ du bas bdug pa'am/ nan rtsi'i las kyis spang bar 'gyur ba la sogs pa shes pa'o/ /bzhi ba nad spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa ni/ nad 'di la ni 'phrod pa'i cho ga 'di dang 'di lta bu byas te spangs na phyis mi 'byung ngo zhes shes pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa yang sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya'o—/ /'tsho byed bzhi gang zhe na/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i bden pa'o zhes yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rab tu mkhyen to/ /'tsho byed de bzhin gshegs pas ni skye ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ba'i sman mkhyen to/ /rga ba dang / na ba dang /'chi ba dang / mya ngan dang / smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'khrug pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spang ba'i sman mkhyen to/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / 'tsho byed 29

snye—snyesnyesnye—dzirwasprusngasdund+rarjosdu2sdind+rarjorwasduskyasdutram̐sprisnye/ —————py-izhon/ nu'i rgyud la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba skyes smras pa/ phra rags rims nad 'joms pa'i sman mchog gis/ /skye 'gro'i zug rngu mtha' dag rab bcom nas/ /gtan bde'i bdud rtsi sman mchog la rol ba'i/ /skal ba mchog la spyod pa e ma rmad/ /ces pa 'di ni 'tsho byed gzhon nu'i gdung 'tshob dam pa sman pa bstan khos bskul ngor tha snyad pa bsam gtan rgya mtshos 'dul ba lung las btus pa yin la/ gsar bu rnams rtsom lugs sna tshogs la rgyus mnga' ched/ tshig sbyor 'dul lung bzhin byas so/ /30
༄7/ /g.yu thog gsar rnying thibazhugs so/ /rje bsam gtan rgya mtshos brtsa

dzo—ge———dzeskyashaṃ1sngarwand+rarjosdu3sdirngadzirwaṇaspritshotram̐sprisnye/————rdzi༄7/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rims dbyings su dag pa'i chos sku kun gsal mdzes ma'i ngos/ /ye shes rang bzhin gzugs sku mtshan mo'i mgon po rgyu skar phreng ba'i tshogs kyis mdzes/ /gzhan yang phrin las nyi ma 'bar bas skye rgya'i dge legs myu gu rgyas mdzad pa/ /bai ḍūr ya yi 'od dang dbyer med gu ru'i zhabs rdul rtag tu spyi bor 'dzin/ /gso rig gtsug lag phreng bas skye rgya'i gdungs pa sel mdzad pa'i—/ /sman gyi dpal mo drang srong mkhas pa brgyud par bcas pa yi /bka' drin nor bu'i phung bo sa chen 'di la rab spungs pa/ /'gro ba'i bsod nams nor 'dzin bu mo 'di yi khur du lci/ /khyad par g.yu thog pa zhes grags pa'i lha rje chen po nyid/ /thugs rgyud lung rtogs yon tan nor bu'i tshogs kyis yongs gtams shing / /phrin las 'od stong 'bar bas 'gro ba'i gdungs pa sel mdzad pa/ /32

dzoge———————skepaphroṃsdi1sturwartoXsprarwatram̐rngi/——snye—snye——snye—brgyud par bcas la snying nas mi gus dpyod ldan su zhig mchis/ /de yi rnam thar rgya mtsho las/ /thun mong mdzad pa nor gyi dpya/ /rang blo byis pas thegs tsam zhig /skal mnyam 'ga' la gzigs mor 'grems/ /de la 'dir g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes grags pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gnas la sku drin lhag par che ba'i mkhas pa chen po snga phyi gnyis kyi rnam par thar ba rang blos dpag tshod tsam zhig bri bar bya ste—/ de yang g.yu thog gi gdung 'di la g.yu thog rnying ma dang g.yu thog gsar ma gnyis yod la/ de gnyis kyi gdung rgyud rim par 'chad pa la 'di ltar/ sngon bod kyi rgyal bo lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus su/ rgya gar gyi rgyal bo rnga chen po zhes bya ba la bu bi byi dga' byed ces pa yod/ bram ze dril bzo ma zhes pa la bu mo bi lha dga' mdzes zhes bya ba yod/ de gnyis kas pha ma la gnang ba zhus te/bram ze rgyun shes kyi bu zhes bya ba'i sman pa mkhas pa ches snyan grags che ba zhig yod pa'i drung du sman gyi rig pa slob tu byon te/ gso dpyad kyi gzhung lugs mang bo la sbyangs pas mkhas pa chen por gyur/de gnyis grogs por gyur te rgya gar shar nub dang / rgya nag li yul/33

——snye——snye—dzond+ra2sngasdund+rarjosdurwasdirwatshirwatram̐sprisdu’spri—/—snye———bal yul rnams su byon nas 'gro ba mang bo la sman dpyad kyis phan btags shing / gzhan mang bo la gso ba rig pa bslabs/ skabs shig tu khong gnyis bod du byon/ sde khrod cig tu slebs pas/ bu mo zhig gis bud med dar ma zhig khur nas sgo phyir bskyal song / sman pa gnyis kyis 'di sgor bskyal nas ci byed ces dris/ bu mo na re/'di nga'i ma yin mod nad pa red zer/ sman pas/ spyir ma yin zhing dgos su nad pa yin pas sgor ma 'don nang du zhog gsungs pas/bu mo na re ma yin kyang nged rnams la nad dri phog cing khyim lha mi mnyes—/ nged bod rang gi a lugs(goms lugs/)yin zer ro/ /de nas sman pas khyed bod la nad gso ba bo'i sman pa yod dam/ zhes dris pas/ bu mos/ nad byung na zas kyi tshod 'dzin/ rma gsar ba la mar bzhus nas btang bas rtsa kha bsdams shes tsam yod/ nad gso ba bo'i sman pa pha ma yod zer/ yang sman pas dris pa/ khyed bod kyi lugs la nad pa yin tshad sgor 'don nam gsungs pas/ bu mo na re—/ bu tsha na na pha mas sgor mi 'don/ pha ma na na bu tshas phyir 'don zhus pas/ sman pa'i thugs la bod mtha' khob red/ lugs ngan pa 'di 'dra 'dug snyam du snying rje tshad med pa skyes nas/ bu mo la/bod yul 'di mun pa'i gling du 'dug mi rnams phyugs las blun/34

dzo—snyesnye—snye———gerwasdusdi1skyarwartoXrwarwarwarngi/——snye——ske—ge—pha ma nad pa sgo phyir 'bud pa ga la rung / pha ma ni bsnyen bkur dang mchod pa'i gnas yin/ ma nang du khyer/ nged gnyis kyis sman dpyad byed/ nged gnyis kyis bod 'dir gso dpyad kyi rig pa spel rgyu yin/ khyod kyis gzhan la dril bsgrags gyis/ gsungs pas/ bu mos ma dang / sman pa gnyis nang du gdan drangs/ ma la nad g.yog sman pa gnyis kyi ngag ltar byas/ sman pa gnyis kyis ma la sman dpyad byas nas drag de nas bu mo des/ bod na nad gso ba'i sman pa gnyis rgya gar nas phebs 'dug ces dril chen po bsgrags so/ /de nas sman pa de gnyis kyis sman dpyad kyis phan thog pa dang gso rig spel bas snyan grags rgyas stabs/ bod rgyal lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis gsan nas sman pa gnyis pho brang yum bu bla sgang du spyan drangs/ bsnyen bkur bla na med pa byas/ bod du yun ring bzhugs dgos pa'i zhu ba phul ba sman pa gnyis kyis zhal gyis bzhes/rgyal bo'i sras mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha sman pa bi byi dga' byed la phul nas sman pa'i yum du bzhes/ lha lcam yid kyi rol cha la sras dung gi thor cog can 'khrungs so/ /sman pa gnyis kyis reg pa rtsa'i mdo/ 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ spyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar sreg dpyad kyi mdo/ rma chas bzo'i mdo 35

dzo——snye———spyond+ra1dzirwand+rarjotsho2sdigludzirwaṇasprisdutram̐skya—/—————rnams dang / rtsa 'grel 'grel bshad khog dbug sa dpyad lag len dang bcas pa gnang ste bod yul du gso rig gi bstan pa spel/ lo shas la bzhugs nas slar rgya gar du phebs so/ /phyis su bi byi dga' byed kyi sras dung gi thor cog can yang sman pa mkhas par gyur te lha tho tho ri dang / de'i sras khri gnyan bzung btsan gnyis ka'i bla sman mdzad/ khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi sku tshe'i smad du dung gi thor cog gi sras blo gros chen pos bla sman mdzad/ blo gros chen po'i sras blo gros mtshungs med kyis/ khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi sras 'brong gnyan lde'u'i bla sman mdzad/ blo gros mtshungs med kyi sras blo gros rab gsal gyis 'brong gnyan lde'u'i sras stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi bla sman mdzad/ blo gros rab gsal gyi sras blo gros rgyal mdzod kyis/ stag ri gnyan gzigs kyi sras gnam ri srong btsan gyi bla sman mdzad/ blo gros rgyal mdzod kyi sras blo gros bshes gnyen gyis chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i bla sman mdzad/ blo gros bshes gnyen gyi sras 'dre rje rgya gar badzra yin la/ 'dis rgyal bo gung ru gung btsan dang / mang srong mang btsan gyi bla sman mdzad do/ /rgya gar badzra gyi sras khyung bo rdo rjes 'dus srong mang bo rje'i bla sman mdzad—/ khyung bo rdo rje'i sras g.yu thog yon tan mgon po yin la/36

dzo———ge———snye—nd+rasdusdi1sturwatrisasprarwatram̐rji/snye—snye——————'di bas rgyal bo mes ag tshom dang de'i sras khri srong lde btsan gnyis ka'i bla sman mdzad/ yon tan mgon po la sras 'bum seng /dpal 'bum/ dga' dga' gsum yod pas/ mu tig btsan po/ mu ne btsan po/ mu khri btsan po rnams kyi bla sman mdzad/ sras gsum pa la sras sra lu zhes sam g.yu thog 'gro mgon du grags pa 'khrungs/des mnga' bdag khri ral dang glang dar gyi bla sman mdzad/ 'gro mgon gyi sras g.yu thog jo sras kyis mnga' bdag 'od srung gi bla sman mdzad/ jo sras kyi sras g.yu thog byams pa thugs rjes mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan gyi bla sman mdzad/ g.yu thog byams pa thugs rje dpal gyi sras byams pa dkon mchog legs/ de'i sras byams pa bde legs yin la/ 'di yan gyi gdung rgyud dag la g.yu thog rnying ma ba zer la/ g.yu thog rnying ma ba de dag gi nang nas blo gros bshes gnyen yan gyi lo rgyus zhib par mi snang / de'i rgyu mtshan yang de dag gi skabs su bod rang gi yi ge'i thog nas yi ge 'bri ba'i srol ma dar ba'i stabs kyis/ mkhas pa 'di rnams kyis gzhung lugs la sbyang tshul dang mdzad pa ji ltar gnang ba sogs kyi gsal cha med/ 'di dag ma zad/ gnam ri srong btsan yan gyi rgyal bo dag gi lo rgyus kyang rgyas gsal med do/ /chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i 37

dzo——snye———skyarwasprusngarwand+rarjorjond+rasdind+radzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ —————dus su blon po thon mi sam bho ṭas bod kyi yig gzugs gsar skrun gnang ste brda sprod pa'i gzhung brtsams/ de nas sam bho ṭa dang khong gi mchan bu rnams kyis leṭa sbyar gyi skad las chos dang rig pa'i gnas bod yig tu bsgyur mgo brtsams so/ /de phyin chad bod rang gi yi ge 'bri ba'i srol dar bas/ g.yu thog gdung rgyud 'dre rje rgya gar badzra tshun chod nas lo rgyus cung zad gsal bo yod/ bod rgyal gdung rabs la'ang srong btsan sgam po tshun nas lo rgyus cung zad gsal bo yod par ma zad/ de tshun chad kyi rdo ring gi yi ge dang / gtsug lag khang gi yi ge sogs mthong rgyu yod pa las/ de'i sngon gyi bsgyur yig dang / rdo ring gi yi ge dang /mchod rten dang sku 'dra sogs kyi gzungs gzhug gi yi ge lta bu'ang mthong rgyu med do/ /'o na de'i sngon gyi sman pa dag gis/ sman ji ltar sbyangs ba red zer na legs sbyar gyi yi ge sogs mi rigs gzhan gyi yi ge'i steng nas bslabs par mngon te/ sman pa bi byi dga' byed dang khri lha dga' mdzes ma gnyis kyis reg pa rtsa'i mdo sogs bod kyi slob ma la gnang ba ste bslabs pa las bsgyur ba'i gtam med pas shes so/ /'dre rje rgya gar badzra de nyid kyis gso ba rig pa sogs chos dang 38

———snye—————pasdusdi1sturwaspraX༄rwarwarngi/—————————rig gnas mang bo la sbyangs nas mkhas pa chen por gyur te stod lung skyid sna zhes pa'i sa char bzhugs nas/ 'gro ba nad pa'i don mdzad—/ nad pa gang yod kyi sar phebs nas gso dpyad mdzad/phan pa rgya chen po byung bas snyan grags kyis bod yul khyab/ phyogs kun nas bsnyen bkur dang 'bul ba rgya chen byung / g.yu mang bo 'bul ba byung ba khang thog tu bkram yod pa lug rdzi zhig gis mthong nas / mkhas pa mthong ba don ldan la g.yu'i thog 'dug go zhes bsgrags pas/ de nas bzung mkhas pa g.yu thog pa zhes grags so/ /de nas mkhas pa chen po de/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub dang mgo thig rin chen gnad 'grel sogs sman dpyad kyi gdams pa 'tshol phyir rgya gar la byon/ khong dang bor lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bor byon nas klu sgrub dang mjal gser sung stong phul nas mgo thig rin chen gnad 'grel zhus pas rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa gnang ngo —/ /de nas rgya gar gyi yul pad mo'i gling zhes bya bar phebs nas sman pa mkhas pa su yod btsal bas/ tshong 'dus shig tu bram ze zil dang gzi brjid che ba zhig dang 'phrad/ des khyod gang nas 'ong / don dag gang la 'ong zhes dris pa la lo rgyus rgyas par zhus/khong sman pa bi byi zhes pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig yin 'dug pas/39

——————dzond+rapadzisdund+razosdurwasdi2dzirwasdusprisdutram̐kau—/—————de la bdud rtsi sman sgrub sogs zhus nas gnang / de la sogs pa'i mkhas pa mang bo'i mdun nas sman rig sogs gzhung lugs mang bo sbyangs nas mthar rang yul du phebs te btsad po'i sras mo dga' skyong ma zhes bya ba khab tu bzhes pa la sras g.yu thog khyung bo rdo rje 'khrungs so/ /khyung bo rdo rje de yang dad brtson shes rab dang ldan zhing / yab kyi drung nas rig pa'i gnas spyi dang khyad par sman rig la sbyangs pas na phra mo nas kyang mkhas pa chen por gyur nas/ nad pa yod tshad kyi sar song nas sman dang dpyad byas/ de'i dus sman khang med gshis—/ sman pa rnams nad pa gar yod kyi sar 'gro dgos pas/de'i ming la nad pa bskor zer/ khong gis ngal dub khyad du bsad nas nad pa bskor stabs/ nyams myong phun sum tshogs pa thob ste/khong gis yab la zhus pa'i gsung mgur du/sman pa'i rgyal bo skyes mchog sprul ba'i sku/ /khyed kyi thags rjes gso rig spyi khog phabs/ /ri ri ni ri bdag blos sbyangs pas man ngag 'dod rgu 'grub/ /sgrub thabs zab mos nad rnams dngos su mthong / /nad pa bskor bas myong ba lag len rtogs/ /40

dzo————snyesnye—snyegend+rasdutram̐1sturwaspyoXgirwarwarwarngi/—————————zhes dang /dregs med byams pa'i sems kyis nad pa bskor/ /ngal dub khyad du bsad nas nad pa bskor/ /phyogs cha nye ring med pas nad pa bskor/ /mi ngo nor ngo ma bltas nad pa bskor/ /ser sna 'du 'dzi med pas sman sbyin btang / /zhes dang /myong med kha ta byed na sman pa 'khrul/ /tsha grang sdebs la mi mkhas sman pa 'khrul/ /bsil drod phyogs log byed na sman pa 'khrul/ /zas dang spyod lam mi mthun sman pa 'khrul/ /kha dmar gtar sreg mi shes sman pa 'khrul/ /tshig dang nyams len 'dzol na sman pa 'khrul/ /dug chu chang la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /g.yo sgyu sdig la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /mtho 'dzug ngan la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /bud med g.yem la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /don med bskur la dga' na sman pa smyo/ /41

dzo—————bhedzohūṃ1sngasdund+rarjosdu2nd+rarwaskyarwasdusprisdutram̐skya—/———snye—sman sbyor sdebs la mi brten sman pa smyo/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /pa/ yab kyang thugs dgyes nas/ bu khyung bo rdo rje la mgur gsungs bu blo stobs che zhing shes rab ldan/ /lang tsho gzhon yang blo gros ldan/ /gso dpyad bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ /bsil drod tsha grang sdebs la mkhas/ /gtar sreg rma chas bzo la mkhas/ /tsha grang nad kyi skad ster zhing / /mkhas shing mkhas par gyur pa'i bu/ /da dung gso dpyad bstan pa spel/ /bu khyod skyes pa pha yi dpal/ /zhes sogs gsungs/de nas g.yu thog khyung bo rdo rjes rgya bza' chos kyi sgrol ma khab tu bzhes pa la sras g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes bya ba'i mkhas chen snyan grags can de 'khrungs so/ /de yang g.yu thog rnying ma yon tan mgon po 'di nyid/ bod 42

————snyesnyesnye—snyesnyend+rasdutram̐1sturwatri3rwarwarwarngi/———snye—ske———rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang dgung mnyam yin pa dang dgung snying sa pho sprel yin/ zhes rnam thar rin po che'i gter mdzod las gsungs mod / khri srong 'khrungs lo la'ang deb ther rnams su mi mthun pa yod la/ deb ther mkhas pa'i dga' ston las/ yig tshang shas che bar lcags pho rta la 'khrungs pa 'thad pa'i phyogs byed pa mang gsungs pas—/ de ltar na spyi lo 790yin no/ /des na lcags rta lo'i sprel zla'i tshes bco lnga la sku bltams par gsungs/ de nas dgung lo gsum lon pa'i tshe/ yab kyis klog yig bslabs/ tshegs med par mkhyen—/ yab kyi mdun nas gso dpyad kyi gzhung lag len dang bcas pa la sbyangs pas mkhas par gyur/ de nas yab kyi thugs dgongs la/ nga'i bu 'di na tshod 'di 'dra chung yang / yi ge dang sman sogs la 'di 'dra mkhas 'dug na tshod gzhon stabs zhabs 'bring zhig bzhag nas nad pa bskor du gtong dgos dgongs nas/bu la/ da 'gro ba nad pa'i don du sman rkyal thogs la 'gro don mdzod gsungs nas/ slob ma dge ba rdo rje bya ba zhabs 'bring bar bskos te nad pa bskor zhing 'gro ba nad pa'i don byed du bcug go/ /de nas sras g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos nad pa grangs las 'das pa nad las thar bar byas pas/ sman bla gnyis pa g.yu thog yon 43

—snye—————dzorwa1dzisdund+rarjosgrurwasdirdzudzirwasdusprisdutram̐rjo—/————thotan mgon po zhes snyan grags rgyas so/ /dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rgyal bo mes ag tshom gyis g.yu thog yon tan mgon po'i snyan grags gsan nas/ chos blon ta rag kha zhes pa gdan 'dren la btang / g.yu thog pa chen po yang rgyal bo'i bka' bzhin byon/ rgyal bo yab sras kyis brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar bu la sogs pa bod kyi sman pa rnams dang rtsod du bcug /de'i skabs su/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos/bdag dang gzhan gnyis rtsod pa byed pa la/ /dpang bo thub pa'i sman pa bod na med/ /bdag ni gso dpyad rgya mtsho'i pha rol son/ /dris pa'i lan la brduṭa med lan yang 'debs/ /gso dpyad lag len nam mkha'i thog dang 'dra/ /gang la brgyab kyang thogs brdugs yod ma yin/ /de yi rtsod lan 'debs mkhan su yis byed/ /ces gsungs nas rtsod pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgyal te/ rgyal bo yab sras khong la yid ches nas/ khri srong lde btsan gyi bla sman du dbang bskur/ bod kyi sman pa mi dgu la sogs pa'i mkhas pa rnams kyis bkur ste zhus shing slob dpon du gyur nas gdams ngag zhus 44

—————snye——snyesdusdusdirwakurwaspyoX༄rwarwarngi/snye—snye——————so—/ /de nas nyin gcig bsam yas su mi zhig na nas yod pa'i tshe/brang ti rgyal gnyen mkhar phu la soṭa pa'i sman pa rnams kyis bcos gang byas kyang ma phan pa zhig yod/ de'i tshe rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa chibs chags la byon pa'i zla la g.yu thog pa chen po la sogs pa'i sman pa rnams yod pa'i tshe/ nad pa de mi zhig gis khur nas—/ nad pas rgyal bo lags bdag ni 'di lta bur gyur/ sman pa sus bcos kyang phan pa'i skabs ma rnyed/ rgyal bo chen pos bskyab tu gsol zer bas/ rgyal bo na re/ g.yu thog pa g.yu thog pa gsungs pas—/ mkhas pa g.yu thog pas rtsa zhig gzigs te/ rgyal bo chen po mi 'di'i nad gso bar 'dod na/ rgyal bo'i chibs pa de bdag la g.yar bo zhu/ gsungs pas/ rgyal bos kyang chibs bshol nas chibs pa g.yar ba la/ g.yu thog pa chen pos chibs pa chibs nas/ nad pa'i lag pa la thag pa btags te phyag gis bzung nas chibs rgyug byas so/ /de nas nad pa sos pas rgyal bo ya mtshan par gyur nas/nad kyis gdungs pa la rta rgyug pas gang la phan gsungs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos gsungs pa/ mi 'di'i rtsib ma dang glo ba 'byar bar rta brgyugs pas rtsib ma dang glo ba phral nas nad las thar ki 5

snye——————skyarwa1sngarwand+rarjospra2sdind+radzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐ku—/ ————tholags so gsungs pas/ rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pa ya mtshan par gyur nas/ rgyal bos g.yu thog pa chen po la chibs pa sga dang bcas pa gnang ngo / /de nas sman pa g.yu mgon khong rang yul du phebs nas chibs pa sga dang bcas pa yab yum gnyis la phul to/ /yul de na sman pa kun rgyug zer ba zhig yod la/ sman pa des g.yu thog pa yab sras la chags sdang gi rnam pa zhig byed kyin yod pa de'i rkyen byas—/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i thugs la/ ngas nad pa'i don byed pa la sman pa blun po 'dis sdig tshab chen po bsags pa snying re rje dgongs nas bzhugs yod pa'i tshe sman pa de'i bu mo btsun ma zhig yod pa la mtshan srin langs nas chags pas myos te la phug cig mtshan mar brdzangs pas rtsa ba chad de mtshan mar lus pas mo'i mtshan ma'i srin bu khros nas 'chi la thug cing / pha sman pas la phug thon pa'i thabs gang byas kyang ma thon/ bu mo ma dang bcas pas phas phan pa'i skabs ma mchis/ g.yu thog pa yab sras gdan 'dren zer bas/ pha na re/ bu mo shi na'ang zog rgan pha bu mi 'bod zer ro//de nas ma bu gnyis kyis pha la dbang med par g.yu thog pa yab sras gdan drangs pas/ yab kyis sngar gyi gtam rnams thos pas ma gshegs shing / sras la yang bshol btab/ sras g.yu mgon gyis 46

dzoblo——snye—snye—snyesnyend+raphroṃrde1sngarwatri3sprarwarwarngi/—————snyesnye—byuyab la zhus pa/ nad pa dang sman pa nad g.yog sogs 'khor gyi log sgrub mi bzod na sman pas snying rje bsgoms nas nad pa'i don byed pa dang rgyab 'gal min pa mi yong / gnod lan du phan 'dogs dgos par 'dug snyam nas/ yab la ma nyan par byon pas/bu mo de'i pha na re/ bdag gi bu mo 'di bu las lhag pas/ 'di khyod kyis 'chos shig bu mo la gang ri ba'i bya dga' khyed rang la 'bul zer—/ g.yu thog pa chen pos khyed rang gis bcos ma byas pa yin nam gsungs pas/ bdag gis bcos gang shes byas kyang ma phan zer—/ de nas g.yu mgon gyis du tshwa sbyar nas sna la btab pas sbrid pa byung bas la phug thon to/ /de nas mngal gyi srin bu 'khrugs pa la sman dpyad gnang nas bu mo nad las grol to/ /de nas kun rgyug pa yid ches nas phyag 'tshal zhabs spyi bor blangs 'bul ba mang bo phul to—/ /de nas kun rgyug pa na re/ bdag la man ngag zhu zer bas man ngag nyams yig gnang ngo / /g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo bco lnga tsam bzhes pa'i skabs shig la rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis spyan bskung ba la g.yu thog pa spyan drangs pas/ g.yu mgon gyis/ rgyal bo'i spyan bskung ba las tshab che ba zhig yong ba 'dug ste 'phongs la rwa skye bar gda' zhus pas/ rgyal bos/ g.yu thog pas thabs mdzod 47

dzosnye————snyedzond+ra2sngasdund+rarjotshosdusdind+rarngiXtram̐1༷༄1sdu/—snye———gsungs/ g.yu thog pas/ rgyal bo'i phyag gis zhabs 'phongs kyi rus pa 'phur na phan gsungs/ rgyal bos g.yu mgon gyi gsangs ltar ༄mdzad pas/ mig nad drag de'i rgyu mtshan rgyal bos lag pas rgyun du spyan 'phur ba'i goms gshis chags pas/ rim gyis mig la gnod nas mig nad byung / lag pas 'phongs phur bas/ lag pa mi gtsang snyam nas/ mig la ma reg pas mig nad rim gyis drag pa'o/ /yang skabs shig rgyal bo'i tshems bskung bas mkhas pa g.yu mgon gyis gsungs pa/ rgyal bo'i ya rkan gyi dkyil du 'dzer ba skyes nas gtam gsung mi thub pa yong byas pas/ rgyal bos gsungs pa/'dzer ba mi skye ba'i thabs kyis gsungs pas/ 'o na rgyal bo rang gi ljags kyi rtse mos ya rkan phur cig zhus pas/ rgyal bos de ltar mdzad pas/ tshems na ba dwangs so/ /de'i rgyu mtshan yang / tshems cung zad mi bde ba la ljags kyis rgyun du reg thug byas pas nad je thur song / lces rkan la phur dgos byung nas so la reg gtug ma byas pas rim dwangs byung /g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe/ rgyal bo khri srong lde btsan gyis/ phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgu spyan drangs nas/mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa dang rtsod pa mdzad pas/ rgya nag gi 48

—skesnye——snyesnyesnye—sdusdund+rakrusdurwand+ranghrukausdurwasdu/ge——snye——snyesnye—sman pa stong gsum na re/ bod na sman pa yod dam zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ rgyal bo lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan ring gi sman pa dung gi thor cog can nas bzung khri srong lde btsan ring gi g.yu thog yon tan mgon po kho rang yan gyi lo rgyus brjod pas/ rgya gar gyi sman pa na re/ rgya gar/ rgya nag /bal yul/ li yul sogs la gso ba rig pa'i bka' bab tshul gang yin gsungs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos 'di skad gsungs so/ /rgya gar gyi lugs la rig pa ye shes kyi rgyud—/ rgya nag gi lugs la 'khor 'das rtsis kyi rgyud/ bal bo'i lugs la 'khor 'das bzo'i rgyud/ kha che'i lugs la rdzas sbyor rin po che'i rgyud/ sog po'i lugs la nad phyir 'dren pa gtar kha'i rgyud/gar log gi lugs la nad bsreg pa me'i rgyud/ ta zig gi lugs la nad gsod pa dugs bcos kyi rgyud/ khrom gyi lugs la chu dpyad zla bsil gyi rgyud/ za hor gyi lugs la nad sdud pa rngab ru'i rgyud/ ge sar gyi lugs la nad 'ded pa sngags kyi rgyud/ zhang zhung gi lugs la nad thur du 'ded pa bshal gyi rgyud/ o rgyan gyi lugs la nad gyen du 'dren pa skyugs kyi rgyud/ bod kyi lugs la nad gso bar byed pa gnyen po bzhi ldan gyi rgyud/ g.yung drung bon gyi lugs la nad zhi bar byed pa dugs lums byugs gsum gyi rgyud/ thags 49

dzo——————skyarwapadzirjond+rarjorjo3nd+rand+radzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐sngasnye/gegebheblo—bzang lha ma yin gyi lugs la nad bcing ba de ba chings kyi rgyud/tshangs pa lha'i lugs la gso dpyad 'bum gyi rgyud/ 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa'i lugs la thugs rje rang grol gyi rgyud/ drang srong gi lugs la tsa ra ka sde brgyad kyi rgyud/ phyi ba'i lugs la dbang phyug chen po'i rgyud/ nang ba'i lugs la rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyud do//gsungs pas/ yang bal bo'i sman pa na re/ mkhas pa so so'i lugs la du yod zer bas/ yang g.yu thog pa chen pos 'di skad gsungs so—/ /phyogs rigs kyi sman pa mi dgu'i lugs ni 'di lta ste/ dang bo ni rgya gar shan ting gar bha'i lugs la lus spyi gso ba'i yan lag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ rgya nag gi sman pa stong gsum gang ba'i lugs la byis pa gso ba'i yan lag chung dpyad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ ma hā de ba'i lugs la mo nad gso ba'i yan lag zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ rnyarma bud dha'i lugs la gdon nad gso ba'i yan lag rdo rje pha lam/bal bo'i sman pa da na shī la'i lugs la rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag gnad kyi mdzub tshugs/ kha che'i sman pa khu na badzra'i lugs la dug nad gso ba'i yan lag rus sbal gyi 'gyur 'gros/ sog po'i sman pa na la shan dir ba'i lugs la rgas pa gso ba'i yan lag bcud kyi rgya mtsho—/ dol bo'i sman pa khyom ru rtse'i lugs la ro tsa gso ba'i yan 50

—snye—ske—snye———sdusduspra1sturwartoXnd+rarwarwarji/—————snye———lag dga' bde 'phel byed/ gru gu'i sman pa seng ge 'phel byed kyi lugs la btsal ba thig gi yan lag ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long / khrom rgyal mu rje the khrom gyi sras btsan pa shi la na'i lugs la khrom gyi dbye ba drug la sogs pa dbye ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs so/ /bod kyi sman pa mi dgu'i lugs ni 'di ltar/ 1 bi byi'i lugs la—/ bi byi'i bo ta kha ser/ 2 'ug pa'i lugs la/ lag len gsal sgron—/ 3 cher rje'i lugs la/ cher rje'i zin thig 4brang ti'i lugs la/ gdams ngag gser bre dang dngul bre/ 5 mi nyag gi lugs la/ rdo sbyor chen mo/ 6 g.yu thog pa'i lugs la g.yu thog bu don nyams yig khrid yig rgyud kyi cha lag bco brgyad/ 7 gnya' ba'i lugs la/ 'grel ba dri med 'od zer 'phros pa dbang gi rgyal bo—/ 8 stod sman gyi lugs la/ stod 'grel gzi 'od 'bar ba/ 9 mtha' bzhi'i lugs la bstan bcos lam gyi sgron me rnams so/ /zhes gsungs so//gzhan yang / kha che'i sman pa dang / sog po'i sman pa/ gru gu'i sman pa rnams spyi//sa dri ba byas pa la lan thogs pa med par btab pas—/ phyogs 5gas kyi sman pa dgu na re/ bod na 'di lta bu'i skyes mchog dam pa nganugs pa ya mtshan gsungs nas/ g.yu thog pa chen 51

dzo——————dzorwa2sngarwand+rarjosdu2sdind+ratshirwatram̐rjosdutram̐spri—/——snye——po la bstod pa 'di phul to/ /sngon bsags sbyangs pa'i yon tan rab rgyas shing / /'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi mgon gcig bu/ /bod yul mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma mchog /g.yu thog chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te bla mar bsten to/ /de nas rgyal bo 'khor dang bcas pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgyal te/phyogs rigs kyi sman pa rnams kyis phyag byas pa mthong nas ngo mtshar zhing dad par gyur to/ /de nas phyogs rigs kyi sman pa rnams kyi nang nas rgya nag gi sman pa na re/ gza' khyi bya gsum gyi bcos thabs khyed kyis bdag la gnang du gsol/ gsungs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ bya khyi gza' gsum gdug pa che bas/ de drag bcos byed mi nyan/ 'jam bcos byed dgos mod/ de'i sgrub thabs nged kyis mi shes khyed kyis gdams pa stsol gsungs pas/ rgya nag stong gsum gang bas gza' bcos srog gi 'khor lo/ bya bcos mtshan gyi 'khor lo/ khyi bcos spu gri'i 'khor lo ste/ 'khor lo gsum gyi gdams pa g.yu thog pa chen po la phul to/ /52

dzosnyegesnyeske—————nd+rasdusdirwadzosdurtoXsprarwarwarngi/snyesnye———————de nas g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo nyi shu rtsa lnga bzhes pa'i tshe rgya gar la 'gro rgyu thag bcad nas gser mang bo btsal te bsgrubs/rgyal bo la sogs pas bshol btab kyang ma thebs par gser srang brgya 'bul bar khyer nas rgya gar la byon/ bal bor sleb nas bal bo'i sman pa dha na shī la ha dang mjal/ khong gis sne len dang bya dga' chen po mdzad/ bal bo rnams la 'di bod kyi sman pa g.yu thog pa chen po red gsungs pas/ bal bo'i nad pa mang bo'i don du bal yul du cung zad bzhugs dgos byung / bal bo'i sman pas tshad pa sgos bcos dang rngam ru ste ba'i man ngag rnams skyes su phul/de nas rgya gar du byon pas/ bal bo dang rgya gar gyi mtshams ri kun tu rgyu bar lo tsā ba bee ro tsa na rgya gar nas tshur phebs pa dang mjal/lo tsā ba na re/ g.yu thog pa gang la 'byon zer/ bdag rgya gar la gso rig gdams ngag len du 'gro byas pas/ lo tsā ba na re/ khyed rgya gar la 'byon na/ paṇa chen tsan dra de ba la sman rig gi gdams ngag khyad par can yod pas de longs zer/ de nas g.yu thog pa rgya gar la byon te/ lo tsā ba'i gsung ltar paṇa chen tsan dra de ba'i drung du byon te gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul nas gdams ngag zhus so/ /de nas paṇa chen tsan dra de bas g.yu thog pa la gso ba rig pa'i 53

nga—snyesnye——snyedzordzupadzisdund+razotshopasdirwaskyarwatram̐sprirwatram̐spri—/ —snye———rgyud la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang bo gnang / slar yang gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul nas rgyud kyi kha skong zhus pas/ rgyud kyi kha skong mu tig phreng ba/ rgyud kyi dkar chag gsal ba'i sgron me gnang / de nas rdo rje gdan du phebs/ phyi skor la phyin/ de na mdze mo rkang lag zha ba/mig 'gribs shing ra ling skyes pa/ sha sprin sha 'dzer gyis gang ba/mgo bo srin nad kyis btab pa stod 'khrugs pa dang / bar bad kan / smad grang bas khyer ba/ tshigs rnams chu ser gyis khengs shing /lus spyi dmu chus bzung ba/ kha skugs nas smra mi shes pa zhig gzigs pas/ bcos ma ma yin pa'i snying rje lhang nge ba zhig skyes nas—/ bla ma dang lha la gsol 'debs dang bcas mdze mo la sman dpyad byas pas yun mi ring bar mo nad las thar/ mdze mo lus sems kyi sdug bsngal las grol/de nas khong rgyal bo'i khab tu phebs/ mkhas pa chen po me dbang zhes bya ba'i drung du/ a tsa ra'i sde skor phyi nang gsang gsum/rgyud 'grel stong dang rtsa gcig dmar 'ded brgya dang bco brgyad/ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long / byang khog gsang dbye mdzub btsugs/thur dpyad gnad kyi lde mig mngon shes gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor/gsang thig rin chen sgron ma/ man ngag phan byed gnod byed bsam 54

dzo—snyesnye—snyebhe—snye—pasdusdi1stu2rtoXgi༄rwarwarngi/—ge—snyebhe———byulas 'das pa/ phran tshegs kyi man ngag rtsis las 'das pa rnams zhus shing sbyangs/ yon du gser srang nyi shu rtsa lnga phul/ de sogs bla ma du ma bsten nas rgya gar du lo gsum la bzhugs/ phyir bod yul du phebs/ lam bar du phar byon tshur byon bsdom pas lo gcig 'gor song gsungs/ de nas gdams ngag gi skor mdzod mang bo zhus nas bod du phebs pas/ rgyal bo shin tu mnyes nas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgya gar la byon pa'i lo rgyus dang phyir 'khor ba'i lo rgyus dril chen bsgrags so/ /yang g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo so lnga bzhes pa'i tshe/ gser mang bo bsnams nas rgya gar du thengs gnyis pa byon/ sngar gyi slob dpon paṇa chen tsan dra de ba'i drung nas gdams pa mang bo thob/gzhan yang slob dpon mi rmi tsan dra de ba dang / sngar gyi slob dpon mkhas pa me dbang gi mdun nas khrid yig brgya rtsa la sogs pa thob nas sbyangs/ rgya gar du lo gcig bzhugs lam bar la zla ba brgyad 'gor—/ phyir bod du phebs nas sngar bzhin nad pa shin tu mang bo nad las grol bar byas par ma zad/ bu slob dam tshig can dang dad brtson shes rab dang ldan pa rnams la sman dpyad kyi man ngag rnams ma sbas par bstan cing / rgyud kyi sde skor phyi nang gsang 55

dzobhegesnyesnye——skyardzupasngarwand+rarjospra2sdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/snye—snye—byugasum—/ slob dpon gyi gsung ltar kha bskangs nas/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya'i don du yi ger bkod/ bod gangs can du gso dpyad dar zhing rgyas par gnang zhing / phrin las ha cang rgyas bzhin pa'i tshe / spyir nag phyogs phrag dog cing / khyad par blon po glang sna can bya bas bod kyi mkhas pa rnams la skyon phabs/ g.yu thog pa chen po btson du bcug de rjes blon po glang sna tshe las 'das pa la/ mi rnams kyis g.yu thog pas mthu byas zer nas g.yu thog pa chen po klo kha khra'i yul du sgyugs so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen po klo kha khra la rgyal bo me rtsa yo khur zer ba cig 'dug pa'i gam du slebs klo kha khra la mi sha za ba'i srol yod pasaske/ rgyal bo me rtsa'i sems la/ mi 'khyam 'di'i gzugs phang rgyas sto'adug pas bsad nas sha za dgos bsams te/ g.yu thog pa la/khyod sa phyogs gang nas yin/ don gang la yong / las su gang shes/ming la gang zer/ nged kyi sa 'di shin tu rtsub pas do nub yod pa sang nub med zer bas/ g.yu thog pas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhib par bshad/ khyad par du khong gis nga mi srog gso ba bo yin/ srog ster gyi bdud rtsi nga la yod byas pas/ kho na re/ khyod de ltar yin na nga la na tsha yod pas rtsa la ltos zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos da lta rtsa 56

dzo——————snyesnyesnyesduphroṃsdirngisngarwartoXdzisprarwarwarngi/——snye—snye————la lta ba'i dus min/ sang nyin ri mtho la nyi ma shar ba dang blta'o gsungs—/ kho na re/ rung zer nas phyi nyin 'gram pa g.yas su rams bcug g.yon du btsag bcug rtsa gnad skud pas bsdams nas da rtsa la ltos zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos kho'i bya ba dang bsam pa tshang ma shes nas/ rgyal bo da lta bsnyung mi mnga' yang khyed mi sha za 'dod pa red gsungs/ yang g.yu thog pas gsungs pa/klo yi rgyal bo me rtsa khyod/ /mi yi sha khrag za 'dod phyir/ /rdzun dang g.yo yi na rdzun byed/ /khyed kyi lud pa sngo ljang de/ /rams dang btsag gi rgyu las byung / /rtsa rnams tsha zhing mi bde ba/ /rtsa gnad bsdams pas 'khrugs pa yin/ /nga ngo khyed kyis ma shes na/ /g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zer/ /mkhas pa kun gyi gtug sa yin/ /tshe srog ster ba'i tshe lha yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyed kyi sha kham re dang khrag 57

dzo——gege—gedzorwapadzirwand+rarjotsho3sdind+radzirwasdusprisdu’spri—/———snye—thig re gtong zer nas/ 'khor rnams bskul te gsod grab byas skabs—/ la las gsod mi rung zer/ la las gsod dgos zer ba sogs nang mi 'cham pa byung nas/ kho tsho'i nang khul du gsod rmas chen po byung / khong gi sems la nga la mi srog 'tsho ba dang gnod lan du phan 'dogs pa'i dam bca' yod pas/ da zug rngu can 'di rnams la phan 'dogs dgos dgongs nas/ rmas ma rnams kyi rtsar song nas so sor sman byug pa sogs sman dpyad byas pas/ tshang ma nad las grol to/ /yang rgyal bo ngan pa des/ g.yu thog pa 'di nges par gsod dgos snyam nas 'dzin mi pho nya mngags/ g.yu thog pa chen po byol bas—/ pho nya rnams kyis ma rnyed par phyir log de nas g.yu thog pa chen po'i bugs dgongs la/ yul 'di ni 'di 'dra ba'i mtha' 'khob cig tu 'dug da mtha' 'khob chos la 'jug phyir na nus 'chi nus zhen med chaṭa bral zhig bya dgos dgongs nas/ klo'i rgyal bo la btsun mo kha khra mdzes ldan zer ba'i shes rgyud 'jam zhing rang bzhin bzang ba zhig yod pa'i rtsar song nas/ chos kyi gtam byas pas—/ btsun mo 'khor dang bcas pa dad par gyur nas/ khong pho brang du gdan drangs nas chos zhus/ gser srang lnga brgya phul/ bya ba 58

—————snye—snye——tshoshaṃsdi1sngarwartoXsprarwarwarji/snye—snyeblo—blo———de blon po kha khra nag po bya bas tshor nas/ rgyal bo la btsun mo kha khra mjos ldan ma dang g.yu thog pa gnyis lus 'brel byas 'dug ces zhus nas/ g.yu thog pa dang btsun mo gnyis lhan cig tu ras kyis bcings te/ mtsho nag rba rlabs can zhes pa'i nang du bskyur to/ /g.yu thog pa dang btsun mo gnyis mtsho'i rba rlabs kyis pha rol du 'phangs nas ma shi bar re zhig 'gro don byas te/ skabs shig nas g.yu thog pa chen pos btsun mo pho brang du bskyal/ rgyal bos g.yu thog pa mtshos ma gnod par tshor nas/ blon po zhig khrid de g.yu thog pa 'tshol du song / g.yu thog pa dang 'phrad de 'thab pas/ g.yu thog pa ma thub par/ g.yu thog pas rgyal blon gnyis kyi rkang ba nas bzung ste sa la drud cing sa la brdab ste/ mtsho nag rba rlabs can gyi nang du bskyur ro/ /zhes bsdigs mo mdzad pas/ kho gnyis skrag ste/g.yu thog pa lha'i sprul bar 'dug sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba mthol zhing bshags/ da khyed kyis gang gsungs bgyid pas bdag rgyal blon gnyis srog gi 'jigs pa las skyobs zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ 'o na dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro'am gsungs pas/ rgyal blon gnyis na re/ bdag cag 'khor bcas chos sgor 'jug ci gsungs dang du len pa'i bro(mna')phul to/ /de nas 59

—————geskyand+ra1dzisdund+rarjosdu2sdirwadzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ ——bhe——g.yu thog pa chen po pho brang du spyan drangs/ rgyal blon 'khor bcas kyis bkur sti gya nom pa'i zhabs tog byas nas chos zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ dal 'byor rnyed dka'/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs rnams gsungs nas/ dam pa'i chos dar zhing rgyas par byas pa'i snyan pa bod du thos so/ /de'i tshe bod kyi rgyal blon rnams kyis bka' bgros nas g.yu thog pa chen po gdan 'dren pa'i mi gnyis klo yul du brdzangs/ de gnyis kyis g.yu thog pa chen po gdan drangs te/ g.yu thog pa chen po rang yul du phebs so/ /de nas rgyal bu sad na legs kyis g.yu thog pa chen po pho brang du gdan drangs/ za 'og khri dgu brtsegs kyi steng du bzhugs su gsol—/ nor ba rin po che'i 'bal ba mdzad nas bstod pa phal riring riring niris to—/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo so brgyad bzhes pa'i tshe yang rgya gar la song nas sngar ma gsan pa'i gdams ngag len dgongs nas gser srang stong bsnams te rgya gar du thengs gsum pa byonaske/ bal bor zla ba drug bzhugs pas bal bo'i ye rang grong na bram ze gnyis rgya gar la gdams pa 'tshol ba la 'gro zer ba gnyis 60

————————dzedzesdusdusprakyisturwartoXrwarwarwarngi/————————zidang mjal te khong gnyis dang bsdebs nas byon/ rgya gar nub na mkhas btsun bzang gsum dang ldan pa su bya ba yod gsungs pas/bram ze na re/ paṇḍi ta dpal ldan chos skyong bya ba na len dra na bzhugs zer bas/ g.yu thog pa na len dra ru byon/ paṇḍi ta dpal ldan chos skyong la gser srang lnga bcu phul nas/ kyi rdo rje gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang ma hā ma ya sogs chos dang gdams pa mang bo zhus—/ de nas pad ma spungs pa'i skyed tshal du phebs te/ slob dpon pra wa has ti la gser srang lnga bcu phul nas dam chos rdzogs pa chen po la sogs pa gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor rnams zhus/ mkha' 'gro ma seng gdong can la mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi chos skor rnams zhus/yon du gser srang brgya phul/ paṇḍi ta rig pa'i khu byug la gser srang bcu phul nas rig pa'i gnas bco brgyad/ rig pa'i gnas lnga la sogs pa'i rig gnas phyi nang mtha' dag zhus/ bram ze sa ra ha la gser srang brgya phul nas phyag rgya chen po brda'i skor/ dbu zhabs zung 'jug rdzogs phyag zung 'jug rig pa'i ral skor lnga rnams zhus—/ drang srong chen po gzhung skyes la gser srang brgya phul nas skar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs/ nag rtsis 'khor 'das gtan 'beebs la sogs pa rtsis kyi rnam grangs brgya rtsa gcig khyad par 'bras rtsis 61

——snyesnye——snyeskyarwapasngarwand+rarjosdund+rasdi2tshirwasdusprisdutram̐sprisnye/snye————shing rta'i srol 'byed zhus/ mkhas pa me dbang la gser srang brgya phul nas/ gso dpyad 'bum pa/ rgyud shel gyi me long / bstan bcos so ma rā dza cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa rnams zhus/ paṇa chen tsan dra de ba la gsor srang brgya phul nas drang srong snyan brgyud dang bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa rnams zhus/ gzhan yang skyes bu tshad ldan la gser gyi 'bul bas mnyes par mdzad nas/ phan byed gnod byed 'dres pa'i gdams pa gnad ldan shin tu mang bo zhus so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen po mu stegs kyi sde chen po zhig tu byon/de na mu stegs kyi paṇḍi ta smra ba zla med bya ba zhig yod pa de na re/nged gnyis rtsod pa byed/ khyod rgyal na nga khyod kyi rjes su 'jug nga rgyal na khyod nga'i rjes su zhugs shig zer bas/ rung gsungs nas/khong gnyis kyis rtsod pa byas pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po rgyal nas rgyal rnga lan bdun brdungs pas/ bod rgyal rnga bdun par grags/de nas smra ba zla med g.yu thog pa chen po'i slob mar gyur te/phyag phyir khrid nas rdo rje gdan du byon pas mkhas pa me dbang dang mjal nas sngar gyi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas/ mkhas pa me dbang mnyes nas/ smra ba zla med nga la phul cig gsungs/ g.yu thog pa 62
