—ske——snye———snyepasdusdisdukurwartoXnd+rasdurwarngi/—snye———snye———chen pos kyang phul nas nang ba'i bstan pa la zhugs pas/ paṇḍi ta smra ba zla med zer ba'i mkhas pa rtsod bral zhig byung bar grags so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen po bod la chas byon pas lam bar zhig tu pha dam pa dang mjal/ g.yu thog pa chen pos dam chos sdug bsngal zhi byed/ dkar nag khra gsum gyi mkhyud spyad/ rten 'brel brgyad cu rnams zhus nas bod du bar chad med par phebs so rgya gar du phebs thengs gsum pa 'di'i skabs rgya gar du lo bzhir bzhugs gsungs so/ /de nas mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa rgya gar nas phyir 'khor ba'i dga' ston du yon bdag bu slob shin tu mang bo 'dus nas tshogs 'khor bshams/ gtang rag phul ba'i tshogs gral du khong gis rgya gar du byon tshul dang gzhan la med pa'i gdams pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa lon tshul rnams gsungs pas bu slob dang yon bdag tshang ma dad cing ngo mtshar bar gyur/ bod kyi rgyal bo yang shin tu dgyes nas dwags kong khyung gsum g.yu thog la phul to/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos/ mkhas pa mi dgu la sogs pa'i bu slob rnams la rig pa'i gnas lnga nyin bshad mdzad/ snying bo don gyi man ngag rnams mtshan la 'chad nyan mdzad/ slob ma byang chub rdo 63

—————snye—༷nd+ra1dzisdund+rarjosdund+rasdirwaspyaXtram̐sprisdutram̐sdu—/ —————rje—/ slob ma 'jam dpal seng ge/ sman pa dkon mchog ming can rnams kyis zhus ngor sman a ru ra byung tshul ro nus sogs rgyas par gsungs so/ /de nas dpon slob thams cad kyi thags bzhed la dngul chu'i cusgrub pa zhig bya'o snyam nas/ dpal ldan 'bum seng dang / dbus pa phyug gtsang bde la sogs pa'i slob ma kha yar kong po'i dngul chu chung rgod ma len du btang bas/ kong po'i stang bo che'i dngul chu khal lnga bcu nga lnga lon pa la/ rdzas 'dul sngags 'dul btso bkru sogs mdzad nas/ dpon slob lnga brgya tsam bal yul du 'gro don la byon—/ der rgya gar gyi paṇḍi ta nyi ma rab gsal dang mjal nas yi ge dang rtsa'i dkyil 'khor brgal brtag mdzad pas/ g.yu thog pa rgyal stabs kha che'i yul du snyan grags kyis khyab/ de nas kha che'i rgyal bo 'dzum ha ri 'bam nad kyis thebs pa la dngul chu'i sbyor sde dang rtsa lto sgrigs pa'i gdams ngag mdzad pas/ rgyal bo bskun las grol nas mu tig khal nyi shu rtsa lngas mgo byas pa'i rin po che du ma phul/rgyal bos zhus ngor dngul chu'i las sbyor rgyas par gsungs so/ /de nas dpon slob rnams phyir lha sar phebs/ jo bo rin po che la mu tig gi rgyan bkod pa'i 'phan rgyu ta hun las grub pa nyi shu rtsa lnga la 64

——————sne———sdusdusdi1sturwartoXsarwarwarngi/—snyege————snyesnemu tig khal bcu bkod nas phul/ 'phags pa rang byon la mu tig khal lnga bkod pa'i 'phan phul/ ma cig dpal lha la mu tig khal gcig bkod pa'i 'phan phul/ lha sa na yod pa'i mi lnga stong tsam la chang tshugs zla ba gcig btang ngo / /de nas yer bar phebs nas o rgyan phug tu zhag 'gar bzhugs nas 'gro don byas/ de skabs bal bo'i rgyal bo ha dha ru/ grang ba thur babs kyis zin nas/ gdan 'dren la byung bas/ dpon slob rnams bal bor phebs/ bal bo'i sman pa shī ri sing ha dang mjal/rgyal bo'i rtsa la sman pa gnyis char gyis gzigs pas g.yu thog pas gsungs pa/ rgyal bo'i nad 'di khyed bal bos tshad par 'dzin/nged bod kyis grang bar 'dzin te/ 'di la sngar lan tsha ma btang bas thur du 'khrus pa yin/ da lan tsha che chung ran pa bsten gsungs pas/ bal bo'i sman pa na re/ lan tsha ni nad kun la mi 'jug ste/ dug bzhi dang bral ba'i spyod lam dgos/ dug bzhi ni lan tsha rus pa'i dug chang sha yi dug nyi ma pags pa'i dug bud med lus zungs kyi dug ste dug bzhi spangs nus na bde stobs 'phel nad pa myur du 'tsho zer zhing / sgrub byed sngon gyi lo rgyus dang bcas pa gsungs te/ dug bzhi spangs dgos pa'i sgrub byed mang bo bkod/65

dzo——————dzond+rarjisngasdund+radrispru3sdigluskyarwatram̐sprirjotram̐skya——————g.yu thog pa chen pos de'i lan du 'di ltar gsungs te/ skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi dngos bstan de 'dra yin kyang / de la dgos pa dgongs gzhi khyir btang dmigs bsal dang bcas pa yod pas/ nga'i gdams pa lag len 'di yin te nyon cigand gzhi gang dang gang la yang / /dug bzhi spangs par gsungs pa de/ /spyir btang bshad pa'i dbang du byas/ /dmigs bsal lag len 'di lta ste/ /khrag mkhris rgyu byas tsha ba rkyang ba la/ /ro ni tsha smyur lan tsha mngar ba spangs/ /kha ba bska ba dus kun bsten par gsungs/ /snyi snum ro dang tsha ba bsten drags na/ /tshad pa'i gzhi 'dzin khrag mkhris glo nad skyed/ /bad rlung rgyu byas grang ba rkyang ba la/ /ro ni tsha skyur lan tsha mngar ba bsten/ /kha dang bska ba dus kun spang bar gsungs/ /yang tsub grang dang bsil rtul bsten drags na/ /66pho ba'i me 'chi span dang dmu chu skye/ /

———————————tram̐tram̐1dzirwartoXnd+rarwarwarji/—————————nad rigs spyi la lan tsha bsten tshul ni/ /grang nad rkyang bar lan tsha cha gsum bro/ /tsha grang 'dres na lan tsha rta la bsten/ /nad med pa la sum gnyis bro ba tsam/ /de las thal na tsha ba rkun por skye/ /lan tsha med na grang ba rkun bur skye/ /zhes sdo tram̐ ra/ lan tsha'i bsten tshul shes par bya/ /lan tsha rus pa'i dug tu gsungs lags kyang / /lan tshas rus chag spyor dang chu ser skem/ /zhes sogs dug bzhi'i spyir btang dmiṭa bsal gyi gdams pa lo rgyus dang bcas gsungs pas/ sman pa shī ri sing ha dad par gyur nas— mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog pa la phyag byas/ sngar 'gran sems 'chang zhing chags sdang gi sgo nas rtsod pa byas pa la/ 'gyod bshags byas shing gdams ngag mang bo zhus pa dang / g.yu thog pa chen ngo mes ngo dang bcas pa rgya gar la phebs tshul sogs kyi lo rgyus kyang (glus so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos nyin mtshan dbyer med du 'gro6 ṭwāṃ

dzo——————dzotram̐1dzirwand+rarjotsho3sdigludzirwasduspritshotram̐sprisnye/—————nad pa'i don byas/ skabs shig g.yu thog pa dpon slob rnams kong po sman lung dgon par phebs nas re zhig bzhugs/ der 'gro ba mang bo nad kyi 'jigs pa las skyob par mdzade/ kong po don yod rdo rje zhes bya ba la bu mo mkhas pa zhig yod pa'i drung nas/ khyi dug gi bcos thabs bye ma reg gcod du grags pa gsan to/ /de rjes g.yu thog yon tan mgon po slob ma nyis brgya dang bcas pa mnga' ris su phebs nas/ 'gro ba mang bo la sman sogs rten 'brel du ma'i sgo nas 'gro don bsam las 'das pa mdzad/de'i tshe mnga' ris kyi sman pa mtha chen rgyal bo bya ba phrag dog skyes te/stokho'i slob ma zhig rtsod pa byed du btang byung ba des g.yu thog pa chen po la/ khyed g.yu thog pa chen po mkhas pa yin zer bas/ ngas dri ba 'di rnams la lan thob cig zer nas 'di skad brjod/ro nus zhu rjes kun ldan pa'i/ /sman mchog de 'dra bod na med/ /sa steng dug rigs bsam mi khyab/ /sa steng sman du gyur pa ci/ /rgyug rtsa khog stong nang na mar/ /khrag ngan rlung gis rtsa spug bdas/ /68

———————snye—nd+raphroṃsdi1sturwatri3nd+rarwarwarji/————snyebhe———dbugs dang bsdebs nas 'phar ba la//rtsa la brtag pa ci yi phyir/ /nad de gnyen pos 'joms pa la/ /nad la phan zhes tha snyad 'khrul/ /de 'dra'i 'gal ba ltag sprod la/ /g.yu thog pa yis lan thob cig /ces zer byung ba'i/ lan du g.yu thog pa chen pos 'di skad gsungs so—/ /ro nus zhu rjes kun ldan pa'i/ /sman mchog bod na med ce na/ /a ru ra yang med par 'gyur/ /sa steng sman min gang yang med/ /nad gzhi rang rang gnyen po'i sman/ /lus dang grib ma'i tshul bzhin gnas/ /sa steng dug sman stobs che yang / /'khol ba shes na sman gyi mchog /rgyug rtsa khong stong yangs pa'i nang / /don snod bcu gnyis rtsa rnams mtsho'i/ /69

dzo———snye——skyarwa1dzisdund+rarjosdu2sdirwatshirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ —————rba rlabs 'phreng ba ji bzhin du/ /ma 'dres so sor rgyu ba yod/ /ngo bo rlung khrag byed las yin/ /tha snyad rtsa la brtag ces bya/ /rtsa la brtag kyang rlung la brtag /rlung khrag rtsa gsum zung 'jug yin/ /nad de gnyen pos 'joms pa la/ /nad la phan zhes tha snyad de/ /nad la mi phan nad la gnod/ /nad kyis btab pa de la phan/ /brda sbyor mkhan po'i rtog spyod yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ kho dad par gyur te/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i slob mar gyur te/ sems can la phan thog pa'i mkhas pa chen por gyur to/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen po sa skyar phebs te/ 'jam dbyangs phug pa zhes bya ba na sman pa yon tan dpal bzang zhes bya ba yod pa de'i mdun du phebs nas/ sbyor ba'i phreng ba la sogs pa'i man ngag brgya rtsa gcig zhus so/ /de nas tshur phebs pa'i lam bar du sman pa 70

dzo—snyesnye—snyesnye—snye—sdusdusdikyisturwaspyoX༄rwarwarngi/—————————dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dang mjal bas khos chibs pa sga 'khor tshang ma zhig dang gser srang bzhi phul te gdams pa zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos bdud rtsi bum pa rtsa ba'i rgyud gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rgyas par gnang / de nas dpon slob rnams kong por byon/kong po'i sman pa khams gsum zil gnon gyis chibs pa sga 'khor tshang ma gcig dar yug bcu/ gos yug lnga/ ja sig bcu/ gser srang bco brgyad rnams phul nas skyabs 'jug zhus/ de nas dpon slob rnams rgya nag tu ri bo rtse lnga bskor du phebs/ lam du gangs char sogs kyis dka' tshegs chen po byung / ri bo rtse lngar sman pa drang srong arya zhes bya ba las sbyor ba'i phreng ba dang / byang khog don 'grel la sogs pa'i gdams ngag khyad par can mang bo gsan te/phyir bod du phebs/ yang g.yu thog pa dpon slob bya yul du phebs/bya yul gyi mjal mi dman btsun bya ba'i bud med sman pa la sogs pa'i slob ma rnams la sman dpyad la sogs pa'i gdams pa rgya cher bstsal—/ de nas dpon slob rnams dwags por byon/ sman pa lhun grub rdo rje rtsod pas pham par byas te rjes su bzung / de la sogs kā'i slob ma rnams la sman la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang bo gnang —/ / 71

————snye——spyorwapasbyirwand+rarjotshopasdigludzirwasdusprirwatram̐sprisnye/ snye—snye—thogayu thog pa chen po dgung lo zhe lnga bzhes skabs rgyud bzhi gter nas spyan drangs/ rgyud kyi cha lag la sogs pa'i gso dpyad kyi dpe rgyud kyi cha lag bco brgyad la sogs pa'i gzhung mang bo brtsams/de nas dgung lo nga lnga bzhes pa'i dus/ slob ma bde ba dpal phyag phyir khrid nas kong por byon/ der slob ma sum brgya tsam 'du ba byung —/ de rnams la rgyud bzhi cha lag kha skong dang bcas pa gnang bas—/ sman pa 'bum rams pa bya ba lnga bcu tsam/ sman pa rab 'byams pa bya ba lnga bcu tsam byung / sman pa dka' bcu ba bya ba brgya tsam byung nas dgung lo drug cu re lnga'i bar kong por bzhugs so/ /sman pa 'bum rams pa bya ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang / phyogs rigs kyi sman pa dgus bsgyur ba'i gso dpyad kyi dpe rnams dang / bod kyi mkhas pa mi dgus mdzad pa'i dpe rnams dang / 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i bstan bcos so ma rā dza dang / o rgyan rin po ches mdzad pa'i bdud rtsi'i bum pa/ slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa/ drang srong dpal ldan 'phreng bas mdzad pa'i drang srong snyan brgyud/ kha che'i paṇḍita zla dgas mdzad pa'i tshig don zla zer sogs kyi rtsa 'grel kha skong cha lag rnams blo la 72

——snye——snye——snyepaphroṃsdi1sngarwartoXgisprarwatram̐rji/———blosnyesnye———thon cing / de dag gi don lag len du sgril shes pa la bya'o/ /sman pa rab 'byams pa'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang / bod kyi mi dgus mdzad pa'i gdams pa dang —/ bstan bcos so ma rā dza dang / bdud rtsi bum pa rtsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa'o/ /sman pa dka' bcu ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel cha lag kha skong mdo byang dang bcas pa'o/ /sman pa bsdus ra ba'i gzhung tshad ni/ rtsa bshad phyi gsum rtsa 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa la bya'o/ /rgyud bzhi cha lag re tsam thon pa rnams kyis/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i grwa ba rnams kyi thug pa skol ba dang —/ bang chen pa dgos par gda'/de nas g.yu thog pa chen po dpon slob dar rtse mdor byon te/rgya bod kyi 'gro ba mang bo'i srog bskyabs/ de nas dpon slob stong tsam gyis kong po'i sman lung bya bar sman gyi dgon pa blta na sdug bya ba btab ste/ sman pa'i rigs su gyur pa'i bya bral ba thams cad la bshad nyan gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa byung ngo / /gnas der sman bla mched brgyad/ drang srong rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pa dang /dar byed kun tu grags pa'i sman pa rnams rdo la rang byon du yod 73

dzobam̐ge—snyegesnyedzordzukyidzisduhūṃskyaspra2sdind+raXrwasdudzirdzutram̐dzisnye/snye————pa'i rten 'brel gyis gnas der 'brel ba zhugs pa tsam gyis sman bsod rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs so/ /g.yu thog pa chen pos yum rdo rje mtsho mo khab tu bzhes pa la sras 'bum seng / dpal 'bum/ dga' dga' gsum 'khrungs/ sras gsum yang rim gyis mkhas par gyur/ skabs shig nas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ gtsang 'di sa ngan pas chas mi 'byor rang yul du 'gro dgos gsungs nas bslab bya 'di ltar gnang / khyed rnams rang 'dod khog 'gras ser sna ngan g.yo bor la/ byang chub kyi sems kyi gzhi bzung / 'gro ba nad pa'i bya ba don du gnyer/ mtho 'grogs dang khe tshong mi byed par ngag glod mtha' nas skyongs/ mi ngo zas ngo la mi blta bar nad la phan pa'i sman dpyad mdzod/ phyogs cha nye ring spongs la kun la khyab pa'i sman pa mdzod/ bdag bzung gi gnas mi brten par rgyal khams phyogs med 'grim la nad pa phyogs med la ltos/ che btsan gyi bla sman ma byed par sprang bo brtse bas skyongs—/ nag chang phyogs su ma 'dod par dkar gsum lto la brten/rta drel bzhon pa spongs la nad pa'i bran du rgyugs/ mi shes shes par ma rloms rgas kyang slob gnyer mdzod/ mi srog tshad len ma byed mi shes pa ngos longs/ sgo gsum chos la 'bungs la phyi ma'i lam sna 74

———snesnye—snyesnye—rwatram̐rdzu1sngarwartoXrwarwatram̐rji/—snye————snye——zungs/ gsungs nas slob ma brgya tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams rang rang gi gnas su slog rang gi sras gsum la gso dpyad kyi bka' gtad de/ tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang nas/ phyi ma'i don chen sgrub pa la nyin mtshan g.yel med du bzhugs so/ /de nas skabs shig g.yu thog pa chen pos/ slob ma rnams la gangs te se bskor du 'gro gsungs pas/ slob ma rnams kyis bshol btab kyang ma thebs par gangs te ser gnas bskor la phebs/bod kyi gangs te se ri bo bzhi mtsho dang bcas pa bskor nas la stod brgyud de bal bor phebs/ 'phags pa shing kun bskor te la stod bal bo la sogs pa'i yul mang bor phebs nas/ 'gro ba mang bo'i srog bskyabs/ de nas 'on ljang rdo'i lha khang du phebs der rgyal bo'i bla sman 'dzin pa bzhi yod pas/ de rnams kyis/ rtsa'i rgyal blon sras dang bcas pa ngos 'dzin lugs shig zhu zer nas ja sig gcig yon du phul ba la/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ rtsa'i rgyal bo sde lnga/ rtsa'i blon po sde drug rtsa'i btsun mo sde dgu/ rtsa'i sras sde bcu/ rtsa'i las byed sde bcu/ rtsa'i khol mo sde gcig rtsa'i dmag mi grangs las 'das pa/dwangs ma dang rlung thig le rgyu ba'i rtsa'i gtso mo gsum/ rtsa'i 'khor lo bzhi/ rtsa'i pho brang lnga rnams yod do gsungs nas rtsa'i stong thun 75

———ge——bhedzond+rapasngarwand+rarjotshond+rahūṃrwadzirwaṇasngarwatram̐spri—/—————rgyas par gsungs so/ /der mi mgo bo tshal bar chag pa zhig ston 'ongs pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ 'di lta bu'i nad pa la gso dpyad byas kyang phugs phan thogs pa dka' gsungs kyang / nad pa na re bdag mi 'gyod pa la gang la gang dgos mkhyen mkhyen zer/khong gis sman pa gzhan dang sprad kyis gsungs pas/ sman pa gzhan gyi don med/ khyed rang gi lag tu 'chi zer/ de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos dras drub sogs gang la gang 'tshams kyi bcos mdzad/khyad par seng phug dod pa/ klad med 'don pa/ rus mthong dbye ba/klad pa bsdoms pa/ lha ba 'gugs pa/ gro kha'i 'jibs chang / krung gi them bu la sogs te rus chag rdza stugs kyi gdams pa mdzad nas/klad rus rtsa la sogs pa skyon thams cad sangs nas nad pa 'khar ba la chag tsam yod dus/ nad pa'i spyod pa log pas/ gza' nad phog nas bal 'dab ltar lob pa dang / rengs pa dang / kha sna mig gsum yo zhing / kha chu mi thab pa/ gtam ldib pa/ lus zo mi thab pa risi dmi byung ste/ g.yu thog pa chen po spyan drangs pas/ 'di mgo skyon min gza' phog pa red gsungs kyang / tshang mas mgo skyon du thag bcad/kho tshe 'phos so/ /yang g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa mgo nad yod pa zhig sman pa gang gis bcos kyang ma phan pa zhig la bcos mdzad 76

blo—ske—————snyend+rasdurdzukyikurwartoX༄rwarwarngi/—————ge———pas—/ mgo nad las grol te skor ba byed pa'i tshe/ zas log byung nas pho ba na ba'i tshe/ mkhris phyugs btang bas zas dang nad gson por thon nas yod pa'i tshe/ yang chu bsris pas chu gsang bsros pas nad las grol kyang zungs kyis ma thub par nad pa tshe'i dus byas pa las/yul de'i mi zhig gis nad pa skyel mi dgos na g.yu thog pa gdan drangs zer ba sogs/ g.yu thog pa chen po la bskur ba 'debs pa/khong gis thos nas gsungs pa/ chu chun grangs mang na rdza'i bu chu chun gyi lag tu chag nad pa kun sos na gdan thog tu pur mi chags—/ rta zhon grangs mang na rtas brdabs pa yang yod/ rta la chag pa yang yod gsungs/ kho de nub mo 'bu logs langs nas 'chi grabs yod pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po gdan 'dren du yong na'ang /bu slob rnams kyis nged dpon slob rnams byon na/ nad pa'i skyel ma byed zer/ kho shi na'ang shi zer nas g.yu thog pa chen po la ma zhus/kho'i chung ma g.yu thog pa chen po'i mdun du song nas/ bzod pa bzhes la nad pa srog las bskyabs tu gsol zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa'i bu slob rnams kyis zhus pa/ khong la bskur ba btab pas 'byon mi 'tshal zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen po'i zhal nas/ spyir sman pas khro 'dzin byas na dam tshig dang 'gal/ sgos nad pa'i sems bsad 77

thosnye—————dzotram̐1dzirwand+rarjotshond+rand+rardzudzirjosdusprirwatram̐rjobhe/snye——snye—na mi bzang gsung nas byon te nad g.yog la sems gso mdzad/nad de la phan pa'i sman gla rtsi bdun pa dang / chig thub khaṇḍa gnyis ltag sprod gnang / de'i steng du bshal sman bsnan nas sbyangs/ sman nas sun gyis drangs/ long rtsa phab/ nad pa drod la sgor nas pho ba khu tshur gyis phur/ de ltar byas pas glang thabs kyi rigs tsha grang med par tshang ma bsal te/ nad pa de nad las grol/ de nas nad de las thar ba'i gtang rag tu/ mkhas pa chen po la chibs pa sga srab kyis brgyan pa zhig dang nas khal brgya rnams phul nas 'khor dang bcas pa la bshags pa phul to/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa zhig la rtsa gzigs pas/nad pa khyod kyis sngar sman pa su bsten/ sman gang zos/ nad 'di gang du ngos bzung gsungs pas/ nad pa na re/ bdag gi nad 'di ma zhu ba yin zer/ lo gcig zla ba lnga tsam song / sman pa 'phrad tshad kyi lag nas sman zos/ lhag par bdag gi nad 'di la rgyus yod pa'i sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel bya ba zhig yul 'di na yod zer ro//de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos sman pa de bos nas/ nad pa 'di'i nad gang red ces dris pas/ kho na re/ dang bo ma zhu ba'i rgyu byas da lta skran dmu chur song ba 'dra zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos de ma 78

———bhe——snyegesnyesnyend+rasdusdi1dzorwatrisprasprarwarwarji/snyesnye———————red—/ nad 'di tshad pa 'dres pa red/ da lta tshad gzhug ma chod pa red—/ zas dang spyod lam log pas/ da tsha chur 'gro gsungs/ kho na re—/ de la bcos thabs gang byed zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos/ tsha chur grang chur bsgyur grang chu gtan la 'bebs gsungs pas/ khos tsha chu gso mi thub/ grang chu gsor rung zer bas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos rgyud kyi dngos bstan de 'dra yin kyang chu'i 'phrul 'khor byas na gso thub par 'gyur gsungs nas/ chu'i man ngag bdun ldan/ go rim nges pa'i dpyad la sogs pa mdzad pas nad las grol bas/sngar gyi sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel gyis khyod nad las grol ba nga'i sman gyi drin yin pas nga la gtang rag dgos zer bas/ nad pa na re—/ nga nad las grol ba g.yu thog pa chen po'i drin yin/ khyod la gtang rag mi yong byas pas/ kho khros te/ las mkha' 'gros byas pa dngos grub 'bal mo la mi yong / nad ngas bcos pas drin gzo g.yu thog pa la byed pa mi rigs zer/ g.yu thog pa chen pos nad pa la—/ spyir lha rje 'di med thabs med pa'i mi yin pas/ khyed kyi nad nged kyis gsos pa yin yang / gtang rag khong la phul cig gsungs pas—/ nad pas kyang bka' dang du blangs te/ sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel la gtang rag sogs bya dga' chen pos mnyes par byas so/ /79

dzo—————5sprasprarngisprurwand+rarjosdupasditshisdurwatram̐skyasdutram̐dzi—/———dzemide nas g.yu thog pa chen pos sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel la 'di skad gsungs/sman pa 'tsho byed bsam 'grub 'phel/ /'dod chags dang rang 'dod ma che bar/ /khrel dang ngo tsha'i gdan la bzhugs/ /zhe sdang dang phrag dog ma che bar /dad pa dang mos pa'i g.yang gos gyon/ /gti mug dang le lo ma byed par/ /brtson 'grus dang bag yod kyi ska rags chings/ /nga rgyal dang ser sna ma che bar/ /byams pa dang snying rje'i rgyan cha thogs/ /g.yo sgyu dang gzhogs slong ma byed par/ /nges 'byung dang shes rab rta la zhon/ /ngan g.yo dang bag med ma byed par/ /dran 'dzin dang skyo shas ci rigs mdzod/ /gtang rag dang bya dga' ma sems par/ /phan sems dang gzhan sems bya ra thongs/ /mi srog la tshod len mi byed par/ /80

——snerdzi—ge—ske——nd+raphroṃsdi1kaurwartoXrjorwarwarngi/———snye—ske——ziman ngag la slob pa gdeng ldan gyis/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas/ sman pa bsam 'grub 'phel dad pa skyes te phyag phul zhabs spyi bor blangs so/ /g.yu thog pa chen po dgung lo brgya dang nyi shu bzhes pa'i tshe bu dang slob ma rnams kyis/ gdams ngag gnad dang ldan pa zhig bdag cag rnams la gnang du gsol zhus pas/ g.yu thog pa chen pos gsung ba/ nga'i bsam pa la nga rang la gang yod kyi gdams ngag khungs lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ khyed rang rnams la byin tshar ba'i lugs yin/ nga mi rgan dal du chug gsungs pas/ sras g.yu thog 'bum seng gis 'di skad zhus so/ /bdag cag rnams la sngar yang gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod kha phyes nas thang mar brdal kyang da dung yid ma tshim/ da dgung lo yang brgya dang nyi shu bzhes 'dugarig 'dzin drang srong dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi tshogs dpon du nam ci 'byon mi shes/ da gdams ngag gi lhag ma bdag bu slob rnams la gnang 'tshal zhes zhus so/ /de nas g.yu thog pa chen pos rgya gar nag bal bo la sogs pa'i mkhas pa thams cad kyi man ngag gi snying bo bsdus pa/ g.yu thog nyams yig mthong ba don ldan ma/ bu slob rnams la gnang / de nas dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga'i bar du 81

—bhe——blo—snyeskyardzupasngarwand+raskyatsho2sdirngatshirwasduskyasdutram̐spri—/ ———snye—bu slob rnams la gdams ngag gi dkor mdzod gang la gang dgos gnang zhing / dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga'i thog sprel zla'i tshes bco lnga'i nyi ma shar ba dang dus mtshungs su sku gshegs so/ /g.yu thog pa chen po'i gsung rtsom gyi skor ni/ rig gnas phyi nang zhes pa'i gzhung la le'u so gsum/ de'u skor phyi nang gsang gsum la le'u nga lnga/ rig pa'i gnas mchog bco brgyad 'grel ba kha skong dang bcas pa/ rgyud 'grel stong rtsa gcig la le'u stong dang sum brgya—/ man ngag phan byed dang gnod byed kyi gzhung phran shin tu mang ngo —/ /dmar 'ded kyi man ngag la le'u brgya dang dgu bcu/ ro bkra 'phrul gyi me long la le'u nyer lnga/ byang khog gsang dbye la le'u brgyad—/ thur dpyad gnad kyi lde mig la le'u so lnga/ mngon shes gnad kyi 'phrul 'khor la le'u bco lnga/ gsang thig rin chen sgron me la le'u bco brgyad/ nag rtsis 'khor 'das gtan 'bebs la le'u brgya nyi shu/ 'bras rtsis la le'u nyer lnga/ dkar rtsis ri bo rdul 'bebs la le'u drug cu/ rgyud bzhi'i them yig gab pa gsal byed/tho byang / rgyud kyi kha skong / dkar chag cha lag me btsa' mdo chod nag po/ gtar kha lag len 'phyugs med/ gyen 'dren lcags kyus nya 'dzin/ thur 'bebs ri bo rbab sgril/ nyams yig mthong ba don 82

—ge——snyesnyesnye——sdusdusdi1sturwartoX༄rwarwarngi/—gesnye—dze—blo——ldan—/ khrid yig brgya dang nyer gcig nad pa la gces pa srog 'tsho dpal skyed kyi gdams pa/ sman pa la gces pa bskrad pa lnga ldan gyi gdams pa/ gzhan yang phran tshegs man ngag gi gzhung phran mang bo yod pa la sogs pa'i gzhung shin tu mang bo mdzad gsungs so// //༈ gnyis pa g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i rnam par thar ba cung zad brjod pa la/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ byams pa bde legs yan gyi g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud la/ g.yu thog rnying ma zhes grags—/ de nas g.yu thog nyi ma 'od zer/ pad ma rdo rje/ gu ru rdo rje/byang chub rdo rje/ gangs can mkhas pa dang lnga bo 'di gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi chos la mkhas shing nyams su len mkhan yin la/ lhag par gangs can mkhas pa zhes bya ba 'di gsang sngags gsar rnying dang gso dpyad spyi la shin tu mkhas par grags kyang / 'di lnga'i ring la bdud rtsi sman sgrub dang sman phreng sogs nub cing / g.yu thog gsar ma'i mgor byung ba'i rus rgyud tsam las gsar ma dri ma med pa ma yin gsungs/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang 'di ltar yin snyam ste/bstan pa snga dar dang snga dar gyi mjug tu byung ba'i g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud rnams la g.yu thog rnying ma dang / phyi dar gyi skabs su byung ba'i g.yu thog gi gdung rgyud rnams la g.yu thog gsar ma zer 83

dzo———snye—snyedzorwa2dzisdund+rarjotsho3sdiglurwarwasdusprirjo’spri—/—blo———la—/ glang dar mas chos dang rig gnas kun bsdubs te/ chos byas mi chog pa'i bka' bsgrags pa'i rjes nas/ chos dang rig gnas gang la'ang slob gnyer byed pa'i srol re zhig nub/ de'i stabs kyis gso ba rig pa'i bstan pa'ang shin tu nyams dmas par gyur/ des na nyi ma 'od zer sogs lnga bo 'di snga dar dang phyi dar gyi mtshams sam phyi dar gyi mgo tsam la byung stabs/ gso ba rig pa'i khrid rgyun dang lag len gyi rgyun phal cher chad kyang dar spel gtong ma thub pa'i stabs kyis/ g.yu thog gsar ma'i mgor byung yang rus rgyud 'dzin pa tsam las gsar ma dri ma med pa min zhes sngon gyi lo rgyus las bshad do/ /des na g.yu thog gsar ma ni/ sngar gyi g.yu thog rnying ma'i mkhas chen lnga'i mtshan slar gsar ma'i skabs kyi mkhas chen lnga la rim bzhin gsol ba/ gsar ma 'dre rje badzra/ gsar ma khyung bo rdo rje/gsar ma yon tan mgon po/ gsar ma 'bum seng / gsar ma sra lu rdo rje grags te lnga la zer la/ de lnga'i nang nas kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ni gsar ma yon tan mgon po yin no/ /g.yu thog rnying ma 'dre rjes badzra gyi skabs su khyim gzhis stod lung skyi sna zhes pa'i sa char yod la/ gsar ma 'dre rje badzra gyi skabs 84

dzo—————snye———nd+rasdurde1skyarwartoXgi༄rwarwarwa/snye—snye——snye———su khyim gzhis nyang stod sgo bzhi re thang zhes par yod/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis 'di ba'i mtshan la nyang stod sgo bzhi re thang ba yang zer ro—/ /gsar ma 'dre rje badzra 'di ni/ gangs can mkhas pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs te/ gzhon nu nyid nas yi ge dang rig pa'i gnas la sbyangs—/ blo rig gsal zhing skyes bu dam pa'i ngang tshul dang ldan pas/rten 'brel gyi dgos khyad la dmigs nas/ rnying ma 'dre rje badzra gyi mtshan 'di ba la gsol te/ gsar ma 'dre rje badzra du grags/ khong nar son nas sman dpyad kyi brgyud pa chad pa dag slar gso bar dgongs nas rgya gar du byon nas/ sman phreng dang bdud rtsi sman sgrub sogs gsan/ gzhan yang mkhas pa du ma'i mdun nas gso dpyad sogs gsan pa mtha' dag rang gi sras gsar ma khyung bo rdo rje la gnang —/ gsar ma khyung bo rdo rje ni rig gnas bcu la mkhas shing /khyad par du gso ba rig pa nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad pa'i mkhas grub chen po yin zhes snyan grags rgyas shing / phrin las kyang shin tu che/ de'i sras la gsar ma yon tan mgon po 'khrungs pa yin te/ khyung bo'i jo mo pad ma 'od ldan zhes bya ba shes rgyud dul zhing byams snying rje can zhig yod pa la/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes 85ji

———snyesnye—snyeskyatupasngarwand+rarjotsho2sdind+raskyarwatram̐rjotshotram̐spri—/———snye—brgyad la 'khrungs/ byis pa'i dus yab khyung bo sogs kyi mdun nas yi ge sogs la sbyangs/ dgung lo brgyad nas bzung rig pa'i gnas kun dang khyad par du gso ba rig pa'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa la sbyangs shing / phul du phyin par mkhyen pas gzhon nu nyid nas kyang snyan grags dang phrin las rgyas pa yin te/ rje rang nyid kyi gsung las/kho bo g.yu thog mgon po yis/ /lo brgyad lon nas sman dpyad sbyangs/ /zhes gsungs pa dang /gangs can khrod kyi g.yu thog mgon/ /'jam dpal dpa' bos rjes bzung bas/ /nang dang gtan tshigs sgra rig dang / /bzo dang gso ba rig pa yi/ /tshig don kun la mkhas par gyur/ /ces gsungs so/ /rje 'di dgung lo bcu bzhes pa'i skabs shig tu/ dge bshes rog ston zhes pa dbus phyogs su grwa skor la 'byon mkhan zhig lam 'bamagyisabasnyanganasagasaramagayuthogapachenapo'ibar du zhabs 86

dzosnyege———————pasdusprakyitrind+ratri3sprarwarwarngi/snye—snyesnye—————drung du ston par byon pa la g.yu thog pa chen pos gzigs nas sman byas pas khong skun las grol te/ dga' bzhin du dbus la byon/ lo gnyis tsam gyi rjes su yang dge bshes rog ston la chu nad shin tu thu ba zhig byung bas/ sman pa kha shas la gtugs na'ang drag skyed ci yang ma byung ba la dbus pa dar grags kyi snyan pa thos te/ de'i drung du phyin nas 'phrod bsten bgyis pas nad las grol/ de nas khong la g.yu drug dmar nam mkha' gsal bya ba nas khal stong ri ba zhig yod pa de/ dbus pa dar grags la phul/ gso dpyad kyi slob dpon zhus nas rgyud bzhi zhus pas/ dbus pa dar grags kyis rog ston la rgyud bzhi man ngag gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa gnang zhing / gzhan yang sman dpyad kyi man ngag mang bo gnang zhing / de nas dge bshes rog (dkon mchog skyabs/)ston log byon pas yar lam g.yu thog pa chen pos snga sor rkang 'bam bcos pa'i drin dran pa dang / rgyud 'di g.yu thog pa la phul na phan pa rgya che bar dgongs nas/ sgo bzhi re thang du byon te g.yu thog par rgyud 'di gzhung 'grel man ngag dang bcas pa phul/ de nas rgyud 'di yan lag brgyad pa soṭa gso dpyad spyi dang cung zad mi mthun pa'i thad rnams la/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po dang rog ston gnyis kyis rtsod pa mdzad pas rog ston 87

dzosnyesnye—snyesnyesnyeskyand+rasprudzisdund+rarjotsho2sdind+radzisdusdusprisdutram̐spri—/ snyesnyesnyesnye—rgyal bas g.yu thog pas rgyud 'di khungs btsun par gzigs te thugs shin tu mnyes nas/ rog ston la rta sga srab dang bcas pa zhig dang yum rgyas pa 'bum gyi gtso byas pa'i 'bul ba gya nom pa phul/— re zhig chig rgyud kyi bka' rgya grol ba ma mdzad par rje ltad rang gis zab bzhes su mdzad/ 'di'i sngon du g.yu thog gdung rgyud gsar ma la rgyud bzhi'i man ngag gzhung 'grel dang bcas pa rgyun chad 'dug go /de nas dgung lo bco brgyad du phebs pa'i tshe rgya gar la phebs nas/ thog mar ku da'i yul du gtso mo dpal ldan phreng ba zhes bya ba las lcang lo nag po'i rgyud gsan/ yul 'khor mo 'jig tu phebs nas/ yan lag brgyad pa/ so ma rā dza/ phan pa'i mdo—/ rin chen spungs pa/ ku mud/ reg pa rtsa mdo/ srog skyob ṭī ka rnams gsan/ sing ga la'i gling du phyin nas/ zla zer dkar nag bdud rtsi bum pa che 'bring chung gsum rnams gsan/ rgyal bo'i khab tu dpa' bo'i bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa/ 'khrungs dpe che chung —/ rdo sbyor gab pa rnams gsan/ gser gling du byon nas drang srong phyogs kyi go cha zhes bya ba las sman gyi rgyud/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rgyud—/ sha khrag 'tsho ba snying rje med pa'i rgyud/ srog chags sgrol ba'i rgyud—/ sgrol ma 'byung rgyud/ gser sogs rin po che'i bzo rgyud/ gro 88

dzo——snye———snye——sprasdutram̐1dzorwaspyoXnd+rarwatram̐rji/—snyesnye——————ga'i 'dab ma'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal yab yum gyi rgyud/ bse sgrom gyi rgyud—/ dpa' bo 'ching 'grol gyi rgyud/ ro bkra'i le'u/ ro bkra sil bu—/ 'byung ba so so'i rgyud/ rtsa mdo chen mo/ snying bo bstan pa'i rgyud/lus kyi rnam bzhag bdud rtsi them yig reg pa rtsa dpyad/ rgya yi smra chung —/ gu ṇa sha bkra'i rgyud bam po sum brgya ba/ ka la'i tshal zhes pa'i tshal du lha mo bdud rtsi ma zhes pa dang mjal nas/ zhus lan skor gsum dang / rma rtsi 'chi med bcad 'byor rnams gsan/ slar yang bee dha'i yul du lha mo bdud rtsi'i mdun nas gso dpyad kyi gzhung sgrol ma skor gsum sogs gsan te/ dgung lo nyer gcig thog bod du phyir phebs nas/ shangs dpal snyel zhes pa'i sa char bzhugs nas/ bu slob du ma bsdus te 'gro ba'i don mdzad do/ /dgung lo sum cu so bzhir slebs pa'i tshe yang rgya gar la phebs nas drang srong tsa ra ka sogs paṇḍi ta du ma'i mdun nas gdams pa mang bo thob/ sngar gyi slob dpon mo/ gtso mo dpal ldan phreng ba'i mdun nas/ yan lag brgyad pa bsil zer gyi gnad dang / rgyud rigs drug cu rtsa lnga sogs gsan nas/ slar yang bod du phebs te/lus can du ma na ba dang 'chi ba'i sdug bsngal las thar bar byas pa dang —/ slob ma skyong ba sogs kyis 'gro don bar ma chad par gnang 89

———————dzorwakyisngasdund+rarjosdu2sdirwaskyarwasdusprisdusbyosprisnye/——ge—stebs—/ rtsod bral gyi mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog yon tan mgon po zhes mtshan snyan gyi gdugs dkar bos gangs can gyi ljongs yongs su mdzes par byas so/ /gzhan yang gsar ma g.yu thog pa chen po rgya gar du phebs te mu stegs kyi ston pa lnga brgya rtsod pas pham par byas pa dang / yang rgya gar lho phyogs dpal gyi rir phebs pa dang / skabs shig o rgyan gyi yul du phebs pa dang / yang rgya gar du phebs te/ rgyal bo chen po zhig gi mchod gnas mdzad pa dang rdo rje gdan du paṇḍi ta mang bo'i tshogs dpon mdzad pa sogs snga phyir rgya gar du lan drug byon pa yin te/ rje rang gi gsung las/rgya gar 'phags yul lan drug bskor/ /ma hā rā dza'i mchod gnas byas/ /mu stegs ston pa dregs pa can/ /dpon slob lnga brgya rig pas bcom/ /rgyal ba'i bstan la bya ba byas/ /rdo rje gdan du slebs pa'i tshe/ /paṇa chen mang bo'i tshogs dpon byas/ /mkhas pa 'tshogs pa'i gtsug rgyan yin/ /90

dzo—snyesnye——————pasdurdzurngidzorwartoXrwarwarwarngi/—snye—snyesnye——snye—rang 'dod mi shes drang gtam lags/ /zhes gsungs so/ /de nas gsar ma g.yu thog pa chen po dpon slob rnams kyis 'gro don rgya chen po gnang zhing bzhugs/ skabs shig dpon slob brgya lhag tsam gtsang gi tshong 'dus mgur mor btsad po jo dar yab sras rnams kyis spyan drangs/ dus der sman dang / sgra'i bshad pa mdzad—/ dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab la ṭī ka brtsams pa dang / rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga'i khrid bskyangs pa'i chos gzhis zla ba lnga la btegade rnams legs par tshar nas dga' ston gyi nyin btsad pos tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams shing / rje btsun g.yu thog pa chen po'i drung du gser bre chen gcig dngul bre gnyis/ chibs pa ngang ba khyung gshog gi mgo byas pa'i chibs pa lnga/ chibs rol drug ja sig dgu/ tshos ltang / mdzo g.yag 'bri/ gos yug dar yug man tri yug ka dan gyi gtsos pa'i 'jam phrug bub longs re re bzhin dgu tshan re phul/ za 'og yug gnyis/ gser 'bum tshar gcigagayu dmar nyi ma khrom gshog sras mo lha mdzes ma'i mgul du btags nas phul/ bu slob khyi la'ang gtang rag bsnyen bkur so sor gral 'byed—/ spyi 'bul phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas gtang rag gi 91

——————skyand+rapasngasdund+razotsho2sdiglutshirwasdusprisdutram̐skya—/ ———ge—dga' ston bla na med pa mdzad do/ /de nas gsar ma yon tan mgon po dpon slob sum brgya lhag tsam zhig skyid grong du rgyal bo lha btsun gyis spyan drangs shing zla ba bzhi'i mchod gzhis bteg pas/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub sogs mdzad cing —/ der 'bul ba ches shin tu mang bo byung yang / phyogs de'i dge 'dun thams cad spyan drangs nas so sor gang dang gang la 'dris pa'i thugs dam mdzad par gsol zhing / zhag mang bo'i bar du bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas mchod/ sprang bo dang nad kyis mnar ba'i nyam thag pa rnams la'ang zang zing gi dngos po gang la gang 'dod dang / khyad par sman gyi sbyin pa rlabs po che'i sgo nas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad/ jo bo rang byon wa ti bzang bo'i drung du'ang blor mi shong ba lta bu'i mchod pa phul nas thugs smon mdzad do/ /de lta bu'i mkhas pa chen po g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon pos snga phyir ljags rtsom mdzad pa ni/ brgyad pa che chung gi snying bo bsdus pa dang / dpa' bo'i snying bo bsdus pa'i mdo gnas kyi 'grel ba mthong ba'i me long / rtsa dpyad rig pa rang gsal sde tshan lnga ba/lag len pod chung / man ngag shog dril skor gsum/ rgyud chung ba/92

———snyesnye—————nd+ratram̐sdikrurjorwagluXsprarwarwarji/——————snye——nyams yig bu don ma rnams mdzad/ khyad par dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid gso dpyad kun gyi yang rtser gzigs nas gangs can gyi ljongs su lus can kun gyi spyi nor du spel/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab nas gser mchan/ zong mchan gnyis btab/ rgyud kyi gzhung 'grel man ngag kha skong dang bcas pa'i go chod du cha lag bco brgyad legs par bsgrigs nas skal ldan gyi thugs sras dam pa sum ston ye shes gzungs la gdams so/ /gzhan yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa gsal byed mdo sngags kyi gsung rab du ma'i dgongs 'grel rtsom par mdzad do/ /rje 'di la bu slob grangs las 'das pa byung ba'i gtso bo ni/yul ru mtshams sum pa'i bur skyes pa ye shes gzungs zhes pa rje nyid kyi zhabs rdul lo bcu gnyis kyi bar du bsten te lus longs spyod kyi sgo nas mnyes par byas shing ci gsung bka' bzhin du dus skad cig tsam yang g.yel ba med par sgrub pa zhig yod pa de dang /ljang sman leb se/ 'bal sman nyi ma/ ston pa a tshes/ sha ram nyi ma dpal/ g.yu thog bsod nams seng ge dge bshes rog shāng sogs mkhas pa ming dang don mthun pa sum brgyar nye ba byung — —/ / 93

——————dzorwa1dzisdund+rarjosdu2sdigluXrwatram̐skyasdutram̐spri—/—snye—snye—de nas mkhas grub chen po de nyid kyis dgung lo bdun cu don drug bzhes pa'i tshe bu slob rnams la bslab bya dang zhal gdams du ma gnang nas sku tshe'i 'phen pa btang ngo / /g.yu thog gsar ma'i lo tshigs sogs dar mo sman rams pas mdzad pa'i rnam thar du mi gsal zhing / sde srid kyis bee sngon du/rnying ma nas mi rabs bcu gsum snga phyi ha lam 'brom sogs dang dus mtshungs gsungs shing / mar mi dang dwags po lha rje'i rjes su byung ba 'dra ste/ khong gi gsung gleng skabs de dag gi sgros byung 'dug des na rab byung gnyis pa'i stod tsam zhig e yin snyam mo//smras pa/rmad byung brgyud pa gangs kyi ri bo las 'ongs pa'i/ /gso rig bdud rtsi gang gā'i rgyun bzang 'bab pa yis/ /skye 'gro'i phyi nang gdung ba'i duḥkha kun bsal te/ /drang srong chen po'i gdan la yongs su 'khod gyur cig /gna' bo'i shes rab ral gri yis/ /kun rmongs dgra bo bsad pa'i khrag /dmar ba byu ru'i mdangs ldan 'dis/ /94deng dus 'dir yang dge legs sbyin/ /

——snyesnyesnyesnye—snyesnyesnyepasdusdi1kaurwartong sprarwarwarngi/——snye——————mgo skyes dung ltar dkar ba dang / /chabs cig dkar ba'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /don ldan smra ba'i rol rtsed la/ /dga' ba'i ljags dmar glog zhags 'phen/ /glog zhags 'od kyis snang ba yis/ /stug po'i smag chen yongs bsal te/ /dge legs lam chen legs mthong nas/ /bde chen grong la sleb gyur cig /ces g.yu thog gsar rnying gi rnam thar 'di ni/ bsam gtan rgya mtsho mi 'jigs dbyangs can dga' ba'i blo gros su 'bod pas/gzhan dag gis bskul ma nan che ba'i ngo ma bzlog par/ g.yu thog yon tan mgon po rnying ma'i rnam thar gzi brjid rin po che'i gter mdzod ces bya ba dang / g.yu thog gsar ma yon tan mgon po'i rnam thar dar mo sman rams pas mdzad pa las thun mong gi mdzad pa tsam btus te bsgrigs pa yin la/ rab rgyal lcags sprel lo'i(spyi lo1980)dbyu gu zla ba'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang bor dbu btsugs / smin drug zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang bo dang bo'i nyin mjug rdzogs par bris pa'o// //95
༄7/ /rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo byang bdag rnam rgyal grags bzang gi rnam par thar ba rab bsngags snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /rje kun dga' grol mchog gis brtsams/

—ske—— ———skya4ri 1sngasdund+ra rjotshond+rasdind+raskyarwasdusprisdutram̐ku—/—snye———༄7/ /na maḥshrī kā la tsakrā ya/ /dus gsum shes bya'i gnas tshul kun/ /dus gcig nyid du gzigs gyur kyang / /dus dang dus min rtog mi mnga'/ /dus kyi 'khor los dge legs 465/ /char sprin stug po 'khrigs pa'i khro gnyer gdong / /glog phreng gser 'od 'khyug pa'i 'brug sgra can/ /zla nyi snang ba'i rig byed zhal ldan pa/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug sdom par mgos phyag 'tshal/ /sna tshogs dbang bo'i gzhu ltar snang ba'i sku/ /sngo ljang 'khri shing yid 'phrog gzhon nu ma/ /kun khyab bdag po'i bde chen lhan skyes yum/ /bcom ldan 'das ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud//gdengs can gtsug gi nor bu'i khrir 'khod pa'i/ /zhabs sen chu ris 'bar ba'i 'khyog 'gros can/ /'dab bzang dbang bo'i gzugs 'dzin lha yi lha/ /bde gshegs mkha' lding dbang bor bdag skyabs mchi/ /ye shes me dpung chen po'i rta gdong dbus/ /98

——snye—————sdurjirjo2nd+razidzisduparjorwarjikyisngarwarwa/—snye—————sra brtan rdo rje'i khor yug pha mtha' yas/ /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' bo mchog /srung ma'i dbang bo drug cus 'gro 'di srungs/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i grags pa'i gzi ldan pa/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi gser gyi gnya' shing can/ /kun la snyoms pa'i rgyal rnga mthon po dag /mnga' 'bangs gling bzhi'i tshal 'dir sgrog pa bzhin/ /sngon dus grags pa gsal ldan nyi ma'i 'od/ /de sras lag na rdo rje zla ba bzang / /'jam dbyangs rigs kyi thig le padma dkar/ /chos rgyal rigs ldan ma lus rgyal gyur cig /spyam mkhyen stobs bcu'i rgyal bo stags pa dpal/ /mkhas btsun bzang bo'i nyi 'od cher 'phro zhing / /sprul ba'i sku mchog ngo mtshar mdzad pa brgyas/ /sa 'di chos bzhin skyong mdzad mgon der 'dud/ /spyam mang mkhyen pa'i rta bdun gom stabs ni/ /99

dzo—snyesnyesnyesnye—dzorwapasngarjond+rarjotshond+rasdind+radzirwasduspritsholjuspri—/—snye———rgyal rigs sā la'i ngogs 'dir 'ongs pa bzhin/ /grags pa'i 'od ris dge tshogs padmo'i gnyen/ /bzang bo'i ring lugs skyong ba'i nyi 'od shar/ /rnam dkar rgyal sras gzhon nu'i grags pa'i sdi/ /dri bzhon bzang bos gos pa tsasdu pa'i ༈la/ /phul byung tha gru yangs pa'i nyi 'od dag /dag pa'i snang bas yongs su bzung ba bzhin/ /bzhin bzang skye bo'i mig gi bdud rtsi'i dpal/ /0 dpal ldan sa yi dbang phyug mthong na dga'/ /dga' ba rgya chen thos pa'i sgron me deng / /deng 'dir bstan pa'i dmigs bur snang ba nyid/ /nyid kyi yon tan dpag yas lta/ /100

dzo——snye——snyesketram̐rjirjorwand+razidzisduparjorwarjigluljosdurwa/———————lta las nyung ngur brjod na yang / /yang yang bsngags 'os skye dgu'i gaghrin/ /gnyen mchog ma 'dris mdza' bshes lags/ /de slad rab gus dang ba'i yid/ /cha shas yar ngo'i zla tshes ltar/ /nyin re bzhin yang 'phel ba na/ /dge mtshan kunda'i tshal rab rgyas/ /snyan tshig 'od dkar snang ba yis/ /ring du sbyangs pa'i mkhas pa'i ngag /sdeb legs sbrang rtsi'i bcud mchog dag /blo gsal rkang drug yid bde'i rgyu/ /sngon rabs gtam gyi me tog ni/ /rna ba'i tshal du 'ongs pa gang / /tshig gi phreng ba la brgyus nas/ /skal bzang thod dang cod pan bzhin/ /yid gzhungs thos pa'i lam zhugs nas/ /rab bsgrims yang yang bsam pa'i phul/ /101

————bhe—skyaspra1sngarwand+rarjosdu2sdirwadzirwaṇaskyasdutram̐skyasnye/ ——gesnyezig na'i yul der sgom pa gang / /'di na yi ge'i snang bar 'god/ /mkhas pa'i rang bzhin grub pa'i rje/ /bzang bo'i mdzad pa bye ba brgya/ /dang ba'i rgyal mtshan rtser bkod tshe/ /byin rlabs 'dod dgu'i char chen 'bab/ /nyin mtshan snang ba dbyer med pa'i/ /spro dga'i yid drangs skad cig tsam/ /g.yeng ba med par rab bde'i tshul/ /bdud rtsi'i zas can lus sems nyid/ /bka' drin gzhan du 'gog min zhes/ /mi yi dbang bo'i lung bzhin yang / /chos kyi rgyal bo chen po de'i/ /ngo mtshar rtogs brjod phreng ba spel/ /de 'ang gang 'dir smra bar bya ba'i gzhi ni/ 'di ltar rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo rnam rgyal grags pa bzang bo'i zhal snga nas kyi sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i gnas las rjes su brjod pa'i ngo mtshar tshig gi phreng ba/ thos pa dang mthong ba'i legs byas 102

dzo———gebhe——sdurjirjorwahūṃrdzudzisdu1rjorwarjigasngasdurwa/—snyesnye————tsam gyis kyang / gang gi ye shes gzigs pa'i rgyun ma lus pa yid la 'jug pa'i legs lam 'di nyid spel ba la klan ka'i gnas med do/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ gang yang chos kyi rgyal bo rigs thams cad kyi 'khor los sgyur ba srid zhi'i dpal mgon dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi'i nying khus rang gzhan phan bder 'god pa/ dus de tsam gyi mkhas pa'i yang mkhas pa mtha' yas pa'i thod dang cod pan gyis zhabs la mngon par btud pa/ kun mkhyen pa'i smra ba'i dbang bo/snyigs ma'i dus kyi thams cad gzigs pa/ 'gran pa'i zla mtha' dag dang bral ba'i skyes bu khyu mchog rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog la gzigs pa ma log pa'i mthu grub pa/ nam du'ang chos smra ba'i ring lugs la gcig tu dgongs pa'i thugs can/ 'chad pa dang rtsod pa dang rtsom pa ste/ mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam gsum la skad cig kyang mi g.yel bar spyod pa/ dris shing brtags pa'i mtha'i lkog na mo'i gnas la yang mngon sum du lung ston pa'i brtul phod mnga' ba/bka'i zer phra mo'i gnas tsam gyis kyang / gzhung lugs rab 'byams la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob par khas 'che ba dag kyang lan brgyar skyengs pa ster bar mdzad pa/ mkhas rlom du mas sbyar ba'i legs par bshad pa'i khur chen por spyod pa'i glegs bam 103

——snye————dzosprarjidzisdund+radzitram̐nd+rasdigludzirwatram̐skyasdutram̐dzi—/snye————mthon po ba dag la'ang / 'gal 'brel gyis dpyad pas gnas ma yin pa'i khung bur ngang gis 'jug cing / khengs pa'i ri bo lan brgyar snyil ba/ sgrub pa dang sun 'byin gyi de nyid thugs su chud pas rton pa bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas sadul bya'i yid rtog ge'i rnyog mas dkrug par mi mdzad pa'i rigs pa'i dbang phyug dam pa/ rig gnas phra mo'i sgo bye ba khrag khrig la yang 'jam pa'i dpal gyi go 'phang brnyes nas/ gnas gang la'ang gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i gsung gi mdzod lhug par stsol ba/ ha cang spros pa'i ngal ba kho nas/dal 'byor ming stong gi lhag mar 'jog pa'i bstan 'dzin spyi lugs las khyad par du yang / nang gi de nyid la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas/zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la ji bzhin du rtogs pa'i gdeng thob pas—/ thogs med 'bar ba'i gnam lcags kyis kyang brdzi bar mi nus pa'i grub pa'i dbang bo/ rim pa gnyis kyi nges gsang la mnyam par sbyor ba'i rten 'brel las/ bdud dang log 'dren 'bum sde'i mthu 'phrog cing / bka'i bran du 'khol nus pa/ lugs gnyis kyi 'phrin las gang la'ang sngon dang phyi mthas rjes su dpog pa dang dpag par mi nus pas/ dpal sa'i dbang phyug phyogs thams cad las spyam par rgyal ba'i/ gags phywa'i rgyal rnga mthon po lan brgyar 10

dzo—gege——sne—tram̐sdurjo2nd+rasprazisduparjorwasdugusdusprand+ra/bhe——————brdung ba'i skal bzang gi 'dren pa chen po/ rigs ldan padma dkar bo 'di nyid kyi rnam par thar ba'i dbyings chen por 'jug pa'i sgo yang 'di snyed du sems la shar te/ bsdus pa'i don dang rgyas par phye ba'i rab dbye gnyis las/gang rigs dang 'azel ba khungs kyi lo rgyus/dang bo ni gang rigs dang 'brel ba khungs kyi lo rgyus las/sngon byung ba 'dzam gling dge ba'i grong las kyang / ma hā tsi na zhes yongs su grags pa'i grong chen po/ ma lus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i legs byas thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i zhing / rnam thos kyi bu'i bang mdzod gsar ba'i dga' bas nye bar gang ba'i khyim bzang bo bye ba du mas phyogs kyi 'khor sa khebs par byas pa'i dbus na/ bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dpal las grub pa'i rgya nag stong 'khun gyi pho brang chen rgyal mtshan gyi tog lta bur mngon par mtho ba'i bsti gnas der/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang / lha dang / klu dang —/ gnod sbyin dang / grub pa'i rig 'dzin du ma/ 'gro 'di'i bde skyid kyi mngon mtho spel ba'i slad ma nyid du bsam bzhin yang 105

dzo———snyege—dzotu1sngasdund+rarjosdu3nd+rand+radzirwatram̐sprirwatram̐sprisnye/ —————skye ba mngon par byang chub pa'i tshul ston pa zhig las skabs der yang —/ dpag tu ma mchis pa'i bgrang bas mi spobs pa'i sngon gyi yang sngon/ snga ma'i yang snga mar rgya che ba'i bsags pa khyad par can gyi dbang las/ glo bar 'phral gyi rgyal bo nyad du mnga' dbang gi ༄ ༄'khor los sgyur ba/ mi nyag se'u rgyal bo'i gdung rabs drug gi mthar son pa'i bdun tshigs su gyur pa'i/ mi nyag rgyal rgod nyid kyi dbon / rigs kyi cho 'brang mtshungs par spyod pa'i dpal mngon du gsal zhing / mtho ris kyi yon tan du ma'i rgyan khyad par can gyis ngang gis dul ba/ shin tu gshin zhing brtul phod pa'i dpa' bo dag dang lhan cig gis byed pa'i mdzangs pa'i rang bzhin/ mthong thos kyi phyogs kyi mgron po mtha' dag gi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes/bsod nams chen po'i dbyings las/ gnam sa'i bdag por dbang bskur ba'i sa chen skyong ba'i mthu ldan dag phyogs 'di'i bstan pa dang sems can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen du/yang dag pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i bden pa'i phul dang /bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha dag gis mgron du bos pa'i tshul gyis nye bar byon pa na/ zhes sngon gyi gnas de dag la ring mo zhig tu yid bde ba'i phreng ba bar ma chad par sems pa'i bsam pa nyid las/106

——bhesnye—skesnyesdu2rjo2nd+rasdusdusdu1rjorwarngekyisngarwarwa/——blo—geske—de'ang brjod pa'i tshig tu bsgrags na/ rna ba'i dbang bor thos pa dang —/ mig gis yongs su brtags pa'i dbang las/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus dang / da lta'i yang blo gros kyi skal ba mthon po ba dag gis/ ga na'i gnas der/ yid spro bas drangs pa'i dbang las/ rje gong ma'i rnam thar la yid ches thob pa'i rab gus dad pa'i shugs brtan po/rang gi snying gi thig ler spyod pa 'di lta bu'i legs lam gyi bgo skal rnyed par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam dang bo'i tshes kyi zla ba'am—/ btso ma'i gser bzang bo'i rang bzhin ltar skyes pa'i mthu las—/ 'di ltar du brjod pa ni/ /mkhyen dang brtse ba'i rang bzhin las/ /las 'bras ston pa'i me long ltar/ /legs nyes 'byed pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /mi yi dbang bos srid 'di srungs/ /'di na rnam dpyod gsal ldan bdag /ye shes snang ba'i gzugs brnyan ni/ /dbyangs can ngag gi rgyud mang las/ /sngon med legs bshad 'di ltar sgrog /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po gang / /107

dzosnyesnyesnye——snyedzordzupasngasdund+radritshorwasdipaskyarwasdusprisdu’sprisnye/ ———snye—du ma'i sems can don du yang / /bskul ba med par sprul ba'i sku/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i zlos gar rtsen/ /nid 'ong lha yi gzhal med khang / /gid 'phrog dga' mas gang ba'i khyim/ /did la bde ba'i dpal ster ba/ /nid kyis yongs su bris pa bzhin/ /gnod sbyin nor gnas khang ba'i dpal/ /yongs su blangs pas ma tshim par/ /sa chen 'di yi mkho dgu yang / /bka' yis phyogs der drangs pa snyam/ /rgyal rigs sā la'i sngon shing spyang / /gang gis nyin rer spel ba na/ /spya chung gzhon nu stong phrag rdi/ /108

dzo—snyesnyesnye——snyetram̐rjizind+rand+razidzisdu1skyarwarjikyisngarwarwa/—snye—————lnga rtsen grong gi 'dod ldan bzhin/ /mda' lnga ba yi dpal 'byor dang / /mgrin sngon gyi ni 'dod pa'i ro/ /pad dkar mig gi gya gyus kyang / /rgyal bo de yi dper mi bsgrun/ /mes pos sprul pa'i yid rlom la/ /khengs pa zlog byed 'phrul gyi sgo/ /mnga' thang chos bzhin skyong mkhas pa'i/ /yid kyi 'dod 'jo 'di ltar spel/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thod bzhin/ /rjes su bkur mdzad dam pa'i chos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong smra ba'i dpal/ /mkhas pa du ma ring nas bkug /thub pa'i bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dus mthar sa skya'i mtshan 'chang ba'i/ /kun dga'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin mdzad pa/ /bka' yi pho nyas yongs su bzung / /dkon nor dpag yas stsol ba'i zol/ /109

——dze———snyedzordzupasngasdund+rarjosdu2nd+raglutshisdutram̐sprisdutram̐skyasnye/—dzesnyesnye—rab lci'i bka' yig gis drangs nas/ /gtsug rgyan nor bu'i 'od kyis kyang / /zhabs sen mchod pa'i dge mtshan bskyed/ /chos rje'i nyin byed nub ri'i spor/ /yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i khur 'degs pa'i/ /ngal gso mdzad nas sku yi dbon/ /'phags pa'i zla ba phyogs der bzhag /mkhyen rab 'od dkar 'dzum pa'i mdangs/ /mkhas mang kunda bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /srid zhi'i mun pa drungs 'byin pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin rgyu skar bdag por gyur/ /blo chen 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid/ /gong ma'i cod pan rtser 'khod nas/ /bod yul yangs pa'i rgyal khams la/bka' yi rnga chen rab tu bskul/ /chol kha gsum las legs brtsams nas/ /gnam sa'i srid la dbang bsgyur zhes/ /chos kyi rgyal bo'i lung gis ni/ /110

———————dzesdurjirjohūṃnd+razidzisdu1rjorwasdu'isdusdurwa/—snye—snye—snye—gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon du bsngags/ /e ma 'jam mgon chos kyi rje/ /'gro ba'i mgon po gang gi srol/ /mig sman tsam la brten pa yi/ /khyod bstan ming gi lhag mar lus/ /phyo chung rang rdos gzhal ba'i tshig /cwag can zas ltar dug mda'i mtshon/ /yin lugs nin bzhin 'dor mkhas pa'i/ /khengs can khedas pas bstan rtsa bkums/ /gang gi 'phrin las dag pa'i zhing / /rgya nag yul gyi tha gru yang / /khyod bstan las bzlog 'ga' yis (karma ba'i)ni/ /mig 'phrul zol gyis bdag gir byas/ /sa skya'i rje btsun mchog rnams kyis/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong ba'i rje/ /byang phyogs rigs ldan brgyud par bcas/ /111

—bheblosko—gesnyedzorwa1sngasdund+razotsho3sdind+ratshirwasbyosprisdutram̐spri—/ —snye—snye—thugs rje'i dpal las 'ongs sam snyam/ /de ltar rim gyis bsnyad pa'i ngag /don ldan cho rigs btsan po dag /ra sa rgod po lung zhes pa'i/ /gnas las slar yang phyogs 'dir phebs/ /skabs der stag sde seng lung du/ /mi dbang tha bo lha yi rje/ /cuche btsan legs pa'i dper bzhag des/ /khungs ldan dga' ma zung dang rol/ /rab bde'i cha shas bgo skal dag /yang yang yid la brnags pa bzhin/ /'jam mnyen lag gi 'khyud mos ni/ /'bral mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur bstan/ /dkar gsal thig phran mu tig rgyun/ /nyi gzhen lang tsho'i sgeg mo yi/ /rin chen padma rā ga'i snod/ /bcud kyi rgyal bo nor bus gtams/ /dpa' mdzangs 'phrul gyi ya lad can/ /112

dzo————snye——tram̐rjirjo3nd+rarjisbyisdu1rjorwarnge'isngasdurwa/———snye———zhu zhang spun dgu 'phel ba na/ /seng ge'i gling nas nye lung du/ /so sor sa yi dpal la spyod/ /kun las gnam sa'i ngo mthong ba/ /dang bor gyur pa'i mthu bo che/ /mi mchog seng ge dar gyi sras/ /skye dgu kun dga'i grags pa thob/ /de yi gdung gi cha shas kyis/ /yongs su brgyan pa'i lha de'i sras/ /yon chen badzra (rdo rje dpal/)shrī bas/ /'khon ston grags pa'i (rgyal mtshan/)zhabs pad bsten/ /sa steng 'di na mtshungs med cing / /skya rengs bu ltar grags pa'i tog /srid rtse'i bar du nyer song ba'i/ /bstan pa'i sbyin gnas mchog tu khums/ /badzra (rdo rje dpal/)shrī'i sras dkon mchog gi /snyan grags spel la rjes chags pa/ /de yis bskyed pa'i sku mched gsum/ /113

snye——snye——dzoshaṃ1sngasdund+rarjotsho2sdirngazirjosdusprisdu’spri—/ —snye———mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid lags/ /dpal ldan 'bum sde'i shes bya'i gnas/ /skyong mdzad sangs rgyas skyabs kyi gtso/ /dpal mgon mchog tu bsten pa yis/ /mi yi dbang bo de dag gis/ /'jigs med sa skya'i paṇa chen gang / /dpal ldan mkhas pa'i khyu mchog che/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i/ /zhabs la mngon par mchod ces thos/ /dpal ldan 'bum sde'i bdag po des/ /rang yul yul gru'i gnas 'dir ni/ /legs byon sras kyi thu bo drug /(sras drug ni yon chen grags pa dpal/ sri gnon dpal/ dgi ba dpal rgyal mtshan dpal/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ grags pa dar rnams la/ yon sri'i sras dpal ldan mgon po/ de'i sras khri dpon dpal she la sogs te mang du 'phel/ thog ma'i grags pa dpal dang dge ba dpa la la sras brgyud mi mnga'/ rgyal mtshan dpal rab tu byung ba yin zhes thos/)spel nas srid 'di'i mgon du mdzad/ /dus der nor 'dzin thig le na/ /'gran pa'i dpe zla kun bral ba/ /114

———snyesnye——sdurjirjond+rand+razidzisdu1rjorwarjikyisngasdurwa/dzesnyesnye——snyestechos kyi rgyal bo 'phags pa de'i/ /bka' yi phrin las dpag med bsgrubs/ /kun la dga' ba'i rgyal mtshan des/ /legs bskrun lha yi lcam gcig gang / /(ma cig shar la thug ma/ mtshan dngos kun dga' nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan 'di/ bdag nyid chen po bzang bo dpal bas khab tu bzhes/)'khon rigs zla ba dang 'grogs pas/ /rgyal ba'i myu gu mched gnyis 'khrungs/ /(ti shrī kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang / ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo)gcung nyid lha sras gzhon nu'i skabs/ /dus kyi lang tshor spyod pa na/ /(ma cig bsod nams dpal la)ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ /gu shrī nam (dbon kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang lcam mo 'od zer ldan gyi sras/)mkha' rgyal mtshan gang / /chang gu'i yab gyur nyid kyi mtshan/ /kun spangs chos grags ('di nyid kyi yum lcam mo byang chub ldan/) dpal bzang bo/ /bzang ldan chos sde'i dge mtshan spel/ /drug mthar 'khrungs pa'i (dbon chen yon btsun chen po/ mtshan1 sduṭwāṃs

———————skyaXsprusprusdund+rarjosdu2sdirdzuspyaXsduskyasdutram̐skya—/————skegrags pa dar/) mi yi dbang / /sa chen skyong ba'i dpal ldan de/ /rje btsun rnyarma rakhri ta'i/ /spyan gyis 'tsho ba'i bu bzhin gyur/ /se chen rgyal bo'i bka' yi lung / /dgos dgur spyod pa'i mnga' dbang dang / /rin chen tham kar bcas pa yi/ /si tu'i las ka legs par blangs/ /dbus gtsang gnyis kyi 'jar go phye/ /rang srid thus kon 'dzin pa yi/ /'ja' sa'i snang ba legs bzhes nas/ /gdan sa'i bya dka'i khur chen bteg /slar yang gong gi bka' btags dag /ti shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis/ /brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis drangs te/ /bod yul bde skyid dpal la sbyar/ /dus der 'dzin ma'i ljongs (ngam rings/)'dir ni/rgyal ba'i bka' stsal ji snyed pa/ /116

bhesnye—snye———snyetram̐rjirjo3nd+rarjidzirwa1skyarwarjikyisprarwand+ra/——————byurin chen khu bas rjes spel zhing / /'dus (yol ja du)pa'i dge tshogs rgya cher btsugs/ /shākya'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i phul/ /seng ge'i khri la bste mdzad pa/ /stag sde la rgyab sku 'khrungs pa'i/ /dge ba'i bshes de mkhan por bskos/ /ngo mtshar tshes kyi zla ba che/ /dge mtshan yar ngor spyod pa'i dpal/ /rim gyis gnyer 'dzin spel legs pas/ /chos grwa 'di nyid dge bar mdzad/ /snga nas (sangs rgyas dpal/)ti shrī'i lcam gcig (bkra shis ldan/)nyid/ /dga' mgu'i rten du mdzad gyur kyang / /'dod ma'i 'bras 'byin (pu spro/)nus med nas/ /(mkhan po shāspya seng ge'i gdan sar/ /ngam char du 'khrungs pa'i zhang yon tan rgyal mtshan/ de'i rjes su/ dger bu rgyal sar 'khrungs pa/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa chen po/de rjes bcung gi spyir 'khrungs pa'i 'dul 'dzin brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan te/ 'di yan dpe'u dkar bo bla brang dang / de'i nub kyi tshoms la 'du khang mdzad skad do/ /)zur du rigs sras nye bar spel/ /lha sras rdo rje mgon po zhes/ /117

dzo—snye—blosnye—dzospra1sngarwand+rarjotsho3sdipamatharwaṇasprisdutram̐spri—/ ——snye——snyan pa'i dri bzhon mthar son pas/ /shin tu phra ba'i lang tsho'i skabs/ /lung dang lag rtags nye bar thob /yab (dpon chen yon btsun ra po/) rje zhing gzhan bskyod nas kyang //lugs gnyis skyong la brtul phod pas/ /sngar bzhin dbus gtsang dbang bsgyur zhing / /sde (dge 'dun sgang ba/ ches lung ba/ tshogs chen pa/ bye jing pa/)bzhi'i tshogs btus sri zhur mdzad/ /cho rigs rab gtsang 'khon gyi yum/ /ma cig dpal ldan bzang mo nyid/ /khab tu bzhes pas rim bzhin du/ /lcam sring drug gi 'phel ba rnyed/ /drug mthar byon pa'i mi yi rje/ /mkhyen yangs nam mkha'i mthar son zhing / /dpa' brtan 'gran pa'i dpe bral de/ /pa sangs rgyu skar dbus gnas bzhin/ /gzhon nu'i skabs su gong gi lung / /118

dzosnye————snye—tram̐rjirjo2nd+razidzisdu1dzirwarjikyiljorwarwa/———gebhegebyustag mgo nor bu gsum par bcas /gu'i gung gi ni mtshan gsol zhing / /gser dam shel gyi tho shu stsal/ /bcu phrag gsum gyi dgung lon tshe/ /thung ling shi gya'o lung las ka /ta dben gu shrir mnga' gsol te/ /dwangs gsal shel gyi tham ka gnang / /sa 'dir sngar byon chos grwa'i nags/ /bshad pa'i pad tshal rab rgyas te/ /smra ba'i rkang drug du ma yis/ /chos kyi nga ro sgrog par mdzad/ /de tshe de la bste stang du/ /rin chen phur ma'i me tog yon/ /dad pa'i snyim pas legs stob pa'i/ /dge ba'i bka' srol btsugs zhes grags/ /dus der blo gsal 'dus pa'i mgon/ /mnga' ris yul grur sku bltams pa'i/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal dus zhabs pa/ /119

dzo——————skyarwapasngarwand+rarjotsho2sdi2tshirwaṇaskyasdutram̐spri—/ ————thobla yi mchod gnas nyid du bkur/ /rgyal ba'i gtsug lag kun ra'i khyams/ /dge 'dun so so'i spyil bu sogs/ /'phags pa'i zhing dang dgra bcom gyi/ /nyer spyad dka' ba med par bsgrubs/ /'du ba'i sgor gyur rnyed pa'i srol/ /dge ba'i zhing sa'i lo tog gang / /srid mthar 'byung ba'i legs tshogs kyi/ /phan bde'i dpal yang rgya cher bskrun/ /de tshe khams yul 'khrungs pa yi/ /mkhas grub bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas/ /gdan sa cung zhig mdzad cing slar/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal nyid kyis bskyangs/ /de mthar bka' yi cod pan gang / /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la gtad pas/ /chos grwa'i gzhi 'dir legs sbyangs des/ /mkhas pa'i ring lugs rgya cher spel/ /'di nyid sa skyong gdung 'dzin pa'i/ /120

dzo——dze——snyebhesdurjizi3nd+razidzisduparjotram̐sdukyiljosdurwa/—snye—snye———chen po'i dpal dang rab ldan zhing / /bstan srung nag po chen po nyid/ /zhal gzigs bran du 'khol zhes gleng / /ta dben thabs mkhas 'phrul gyi sgo/ /theg chen yum gyur shes rab dang / /mnyam sbyor sras mchog lcam sring dag /legs 'khrungs 'khon rigs dpon du gyur/ /slad nas 'od zer seng ge ba'i/ /sras mo ma cig dpal ('bum la sras lcam ming sring drug)bltams shing //gcen nyid rin chen rgyal mtshan dang / /de gcung nam mkha' rin chen no/ /gcen la gzhon nu'i skabs nyid dus/ /dbus gtsang 'jar gor lung gis bskos/ /si tu'i dam kha legs nos shing / /phyi nas chang gu'i las ka yang / /dka' ba med par ngang gis byung / /spyan ras gzigs sprul zhes grags shing / /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mngon gyur pas/ /121

dzo——————dzosprapadzirwand+rarjosdurwasdigludzirwasdusprirwatram̐spri—/ —————rdo la zhabs rjes rab bzhag la/ /sku gdung ring bsrel blo 'das sprul/ /de lta'i gu'i gung che de yis/ /thog mar bzhes pa'i ma cig la/ /gu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang 'khrungs/ /'di nyid dad brtson snying rjer ldan/ /rgya hor rgyal bo'i rim bzhin lung / /si tu chang gu'i las ka dang / /rin chen dngul gyi dam kha bcas/ /legs thob srid 'di'i bde skyid bzung / /slad nas gu'i gung chen po'i khab/ /sne gdong lcam gcig dbon mo la/ /zla ba rgyal mtshan legs bltams shing / /brtul zhugs mchog 'dzin mkhas par grags/ /zur du byon pa'i lcam gsum gyi/ /chung mtha' rnam par grags de ni/ /'khon ston pund+ra me ga la'i/ /yum mdzad bde legs bkra shis bskrun/ /122

——snye—snyesnye—snyesdudrirjond+rand+razisdusdu1skyarwarjikyiljorwarwa/——snye———4gcung bo 'jam dbyangs chen po gang / /sngon tshe sa skya paṇḍi ta'i/ /rim gro bar gyur bee ji yi/ /skye bar tshad ldan du mas bsgrags/ /nges pa'i shes pa'ang sku tshe 'dir/ /ji lta'i sgo nas sa skya'i srol/ /dar zhing rgyas pa'i 'bad rtsol gyis/ /nyin mtshan yongs su 'da' bar gyur/ /gdan sar mkhas mang 'dus pa'i dbus/ /chos kyi 'brug sgra legs bsgrags shing / /gser yig bka' yi bsdu ba dang / /kon ting gu shrī'i bka' rtags phebs/ /skabs der yab dang gcen gyi bka'/ /rab lci'i dbang dang rgyal sras kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pa gong ma'i ched/ /nyan thos bslab pa 'bul chog mdzad/ /de tshe sras lcam gsum bskyed pa'i/ /thog ma nam mkha' dpal bzang bo/ /123

dzo—————snyespusprapadzisdund+rarjotsho3sdigludzisdusdusprisdutram̐spri—/ —————rab tu byung zhing shes bya'i gnas/ /du ma sbyangs mthar bde bar gshegs/ /gcung bo dpal ldan bi rū ba'i/ /rnam 'phrul chos skyong mtshan ldan pa/ /sa skya'i bla chen mchog gi srol/ /yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyu mchog nyid/ /si tu'i sras mo 'bum skyong sman/ /gu'i gung btsun mor legs bsus pas/ /sras lcam drug gi dpal sbyin zhing / /longs spyod dzam la'i mdzod ltar 'phel/ /lha sras mched gnyis sprul ba'i skur/ /bsam bzhin skye bar byang chub tshul/ /ngo mtshar che ba'i mdzad pa'i 'phrul/ /brjod pa'i sgo brgya rim bzhin dbye/ /de ltar bsdus don lus rnam gzhag gang rigs dang 'brel ba khungs kyi lo rgyus rnams byed tshig yang ba'i dbang las/ nyung ngu'i tshigs bcad du bsgrigs nas/ gsal zhing dpyis phyin par bsdebs pa'i rjes thog tu slad nas don gnyis pa yan lag rgyas par phye ba'i 124

dzosnye—snye—snyesnyesnesdurjikropand+razisbyisdu1rjorwa2kyisngasdurwa/snye———snye——ngag tshig gi dbyings chen por 'jug pa'i rab tu byed pa/ ji snyed dzhai/ spobs pa khyad par can/ rjes su thob pa yang shes par bya ba nyid tshogs gnyis shar ri'i rtse mor son/ /cho rigs btsun po'i ri bong 'dzin/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyis mun pa sel/ /mtshan mo'i mgon des srid 'di srungs/ /rnam mang stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha/ /rgyal ba sras bcas gcig bsdus zhes/ /gags pa bsam yas mi yi rje/ /bsdung bo'i ring lugs skyong mkhas nyid/ /gang gi rmad byung rnam thar gyi/ /gzugs mdzes mig gi bdud rtsi ni/ /rnam dpyod me long gsal ba la /gser gyi ri mo bkra ba bzhin/ /bsngags 'os tshig gi me tog ni/ /125

dzo——snye———skyand+rarjisngarwand+raskyasprarwasdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐skya—/ ——snyesnye—snyan pa'i dri bsung 'phro ba can/ /phyogs kyi bu mo'i rna ba yi/ /rgyan du gyur pas bdag yid spro/ /rtogs brjod chu gter mtha' dag ni/ /blo gros mgrin pa'i phug yangs su/ /phyin par nus pa ga la yod/ /cha tsam gyis kyang gdung ba sel /yon tan dri bzang ma la ya'i/ /rlung gi cha shas reg pas kyang / /dad pa'i spu long cher g.yo zhing / /log rtog tsha ba rab tu sel/ /deng sang phal cher legs bshad la/ /don gnyer med cing phrag dog mes/ /yid ni bsregs pa kho na ste/ /sbrul gdug gtses pa ji ltar nyid/ /dam pa'i mdzad pa phul byung gtam/ /dbyar skyes rnga thos rma bya bzhin/ /rab tu dang ba lhur len pa'i/ /126

———snye——dzesdurjizo3/spradzisdu3rjorjorngekyikaurwarwa/————snye—4skal bzang rnams la yid gsos 'gyur/ /de slad dga' dang spro ba'i sems/ /phan bde'i lhag bsam skyed tshal las/ /snyan ngag me tog legs btus pa/ /gzur gnas yongs la mgron du sbyin/ /bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid sku bltams tshul/de yang skabs su bab pa/ da ni rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo chen po nyid kyi rnam par thar ba'i tshul las rjes su bsgrags par bya ste/de'ang sngar bshad pa ltar/ yab gu'i gung chos grags dpal bzang bo dang / yum 'bum skyong rgyal mo'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i tshul yang lcam gsum bltams pa'i rjes thog tu bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid bltams par mdzad ces thos te/ de la gang du sku'i skye ba yongs su bzung ba'i gnas ni/ dpal ngam rings kyi rgyal sde chen po/ byang phyogs shambha la'i 'dun sa nye bar 'phos pa'i bste gnas bkra shis pa'i mtshan ma du mas yongs su brgyan pa'i ljongs 'di nyid de/ de yang 'di skad du/shambha la yi pho brang mchog /127

dzo—snye—snye——dzorwa2dzisdund+razotsho2sdigludzirwasduskyasdutram̐spri—/ —————sa 'dir 'phos 'dra'i grong khyer ni/ /phun tshogs yid 'ong lta na sdug /lugs gnyis dpal 'bar yul ljongs 'dir/ /snying rje'i nor rgyas srub thag gis/ /bsod nams chu gter bsrubs pa las/ /kun gyi nyer 'tsho bdud rtsi'i gter/ /'chi med bstan pa'i dpal 'di 'khrungs/ /mdog legs mdangs bkra'i gzhon nu de/ /yid 'phrog mig gi bdud rtsi dang / /dge mtshan bye ba'i dpal 'bar ba/ /sa chen skyong ba'i nyin byed shar/ /dge la spro dang zhi dang dul/ /dad dang bzod dang dbang bo rno/ /sbyin phod la sogs theg mchog rigs/ /bltams pa'i skabs nas mngon sum gyur/ /legs tshogs slob pa'i ma ma'i ngag /shis brjod 'brug sgra zab mo ni/ /lha sras char sdod bye'u la/ /128

————snyesnye—sdurjirjopand+razidzisdu1rjorwarjikyisngarwarwa/snye—gesne—snye—rna ba'i bdud rtsir sim pa spros/ /'di ltar byis pa skyes tsam nas/ /nu zho len la brkam pa ltar/ /sngon goms nyid las legs bshad la/ /khyod thugs sred pa ngang gis 'phel/ /ngo mtshar shin tu dpag dka' ba'i/ /rin chen ljon shing 'khrungs pa'i tshe/ /shin tu gces par bsrung ba ni/ /skye bo mkhas pa'i tshul lugs yin/ /bsod nams ra ba rab yangs par/ /snying rje'i chu yis rab tu brlan/ /dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan po can/ /rgyal sras myu gu 'khrungs tsam na/ /yongs 'dzin smra ba'i nyi ma yis/ /mkhyen brtse'i 'od kyis skyong bar mdzad/ /snyan grags gsar ba'i dpag bsam shing / /srid rtse las kyang brgal bar gyur/ /mkhyen pa'i yal 'dab rgyas pa ni/ /129

////// gu 1/// //// /// dzo—snye—snesnyege1—2sngasdund+rarjosdu2—rdzuzirwa—sprisdu—skya—/ snye————srid pa gsum gyi khyon yangs 'dir/ /shong ngam mi shong bdag gi ni/ /the tshom da dung bzlog ma gyur/ /srid pa'i mtha' las brgal ba yi/ /bsam yas mkhyen brtse'i rgya khyen dag /srid pa gsum po 'dir shong ba/ /shes rig ldan pa su zhig sems/ /rab dkar grags pa'i me tog ni/ /nam mkha'i khyen kun gang ba'i rgyan/ /gdung ba yongs la grib bsil can/ /lus can re ba skong ba yi/ /'di 'dra'i dpag bsam shing chen ni/ /mthong bas yongs 'du'i a shwattha/ /skyengs nas sa las rab 'phags nas/ /lha gnas sum rtsen bsnyeg pa snyam/ /de ltar sku na phra ba'i gnas skabs nyid na/ dpag tu ma mchis pa'i sngon gyi yang sngon bgrang bar mi spobs pa'i bskal ba rab 'byams du mar bsags pa'i dbang las/ ji skad bshad pa'i theg 130

dzosnyedze————snyesdurjirjo3hūṃzidzisdu1skyarwarjiguljorwarwa/—————snye—chen rigs kyi legs lam ma lus pa mngon du gyur cing / de nyid kyang rgyas shing yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon po yang dag pas yongs su skyong bar mdzad pa yang thog ma'i lam ston kho na nyid du byung ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang bo grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i byin rlabs zil chen gyi dpal 'bar ba/ ma hā lo tsā ba byang chub rtse mo'i zhabs dang / rang rigs kyi gdung gi thig le 'dzin pa mkhas grub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan pa dang / de'i seng ge'i khri la mngon par dbang bskur bar mdzad pa'i rgyal tshab/ mkhan chen zla mgon shes rab pa'i drung sogs la/ dam pa'i chos kyi dga' ston bdud rtsi'i skyes/ dang bo'i tshes kyi zla ba lta bu'i legs byas nyin rer yang 'phel ba 'dzin pa'i sgor gyur pa ji sted pa yang /yang dang yang du nod par mdzad/ de nas dgung lo bzhi lnga bzhes dus—/ mo bon gyi ngag gi dbang las dgung rta'i zur la 'dzem pa'i stabs kyis lho'i sa 'dzin/ bskyed ma'i pho brang ga la ba der phebs nas bzhugs zhes gleng la/ bslab par bya ba'i gnas kyang klog yig sogs 'jug sgor gyur pa'i bgyi ba mtha' klas pa thams cad la slob dpon gyi go 'phang ring mo ma lon par mngon du mdzad ces grags so—/ /131

dzo——————dzotram̐rjisngarwand+raskyasdu2sdind+raXrwasduskyasdutram̐spri—/ snye——sne—ste ba skye ba du ma'i sngon/ /༷gas bsags legs spyad bye ba'i mthus/ /dus 'dir dus gsum shes bya'i gnas/ /ju lta ji snyed ngang gis gzigs/ /phyi rol drang srong g.yo sgyu mkhan/ /rdzus te skye ba'i mngon rlom can/ /de spyod las bzlog mi yi dbang / /zla bzang ji bzhin mngal las bltams/ /khyod sku yon tan gyis lci ba/ /gang gi khur du longs min mod/ /zla bcu lus la 'dzin nus pa'i/ /a ma khyod yum ngo mtshar rmad/ /sa bcu'i rgyal sras nyer bltams pa/ /chu bur mig gis ma mthong bar/ /mu cor mo bon ngag nyan te/ /sa yi dbang phyug phyogs mthar bskrad/ /132

dzo—blo—snye——snyetram̐rjizond+rand+rardzudzisdu1rjorwarjikyikaurwarwa/ske——snye———kyi hud mngon shes kyis 'phongs pa'i/ /byis pa'i blo can pha ma dag /skyed dang skyed ma'i zol gyis ni/ /yul mchog dag la bkur mi byed/ /gzi 'od lha bu'i dpal 'phrog cing / /gsung dbyangs dri za'i ngag gnon la/ /gang thugs tshangs pa'i dper min pa/ /'di 'dra srid 'dir ga la rnyed/ /padma dkar 'dzin lha sras kyis/ /cod pan mthing sngon ral ba'i nags/ /zhabs sen 'od phung gis 'gebs pa/ /'od dpag med mgon nyid las su/ /de lta na yang grub pa'i rje/ /byin rlabs zil chen rab 'bar ba'i/ /byang chub thugs can lo tsā ba/ /gus pa'i gtsug rgyan rtse mor mchod/ /gang gi rang bzhin mi dpogs pas/ /rtog dpyod blo yi yul 'das kyang / /133

//sa/15/rdo //// //// //// ——————rngisnye1sprusdund+rarjotsho2—rdzudzirwa—sprisdu—skya—/ ———snye—ma bsgribs mkhyen pa'i gzugs brnyan ni/sbas kyang sa ler snang ba nyid/ /blo gros mig ldongs gang dag gis/ /zhabs pad bsten kyang ma mthong mod/ /bdag cag dad pa'i rgya mtsho cher/ /yon tan rgyu skar bgrang yas 'char/ /thugs rje rab gsal zla ba gang / /masmo rab nyi ma 'od 'bar ba/ /khyod thugs dri med nam mkha' la/ /lhan cig gnas pa rmad du byung / /khyod kyi grags pa'i dri bzhon ni/ /khor yug ri bo'i khong du'ang rgyu/ /nam mkha'i pha rol brgal lam ci/ /yid ni khyogs la 'phyang mo nyug /mkha' la mtha' ni yod min na/ /de yi pha rol ga la 'gro/ /snyan grags mtha' yang yod min pas/ /des na de gnyis phan tshun mnyam/ /134

nga—snyesnyesnye———tram̐rjirjorwand+razidzitshoparjorwarjikyisprarwarwa/———snyesnyesnyebyugazhon nu'i sku can rgan po'i thugs/ /byis pa'i gzugs 'dzin mkhas pa'i phul/ /sems can lus can rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ma 'dres ston pa'i dper gyur lags/ /de nas slar yang / rang gi pho brang bkra shis dang bde legs kyi byin mngon par phebs pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i 'du gnas chen po'i yab dang yum gyi zhabs kyi padmo'i chu mtsho chen po der byon to/ /byang phyogs skyid pa'i ldum ra nyams dga' 'dir/ /u dum me tog mkhyen brtse'i 'dab stong 'khrungs/ /rdzun skyo phra ma'i rlung gis bskyod byas pas/ /lho phyogs nags mtha'i ngogs su re zhig byon/ /sna tshogs mdangs bkra'i me tog bye ba brgyas/ /dpe zla'i 'os min rgyal ba'i me tog de/ /mngon mtho'i legs smon tshogs gnyis lag pa'i rtses /slad ma'ang bskyed ma'i bsod nams dpal du sbyin/ /stos shig mig can rnam dpyod dkyus ring dag /mdzes sdug me tog 'di 'dra lha yul dkon/ /sangs rgyas 'jig rten byon pa'i brda sbod mkhan/ /135

dzobhe—snyesnye——skyardzu1sngarwand+rarjosdu2sdihūṃdzisdusdu1dzitram̐sprisnye/snye————mdangs hasal 'dab rdzong klu rgyal rdzongs na'ang rtsi( zlogrags chen ston pa 'byon tshe 'dus byas kyi/ /snang brnyan me tog gsar bas mgu skyed na/ /mkhyen rtogs gnyis ldan rang shar 'dus ma byas/ /chos dbyings gdod ma'i pu e ma mtshar/ /de nas dgung lo bcu tsam bzhugs skabs/ nub gcig gi mtshan lam na/ ngam rings kyi gtsang khang steng la bskor ba mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ gtsang khang gi shar skyid phug gi nub skya'i spang skya'i rtsig srubs na o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma sambha ba bzhugs pa gzigs—/ dung gcig phyag tu stsal ba'i thugs nyams dang / sku mi chung la rtsig srubs mi che ba'i snang stong zung 'jug dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed dam/ skra tsam khyen la dus gsum tshad snyed kyi tshul gyis ting nge 'dzin rtsol med du dgongs pa'i legs byas rnyed skad do/ /'jam dbyangs chen po'i drung du yang dbu ma'i lugs kyi cho ga'i sgo nas theg mchog byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa gnang la/ phyis sku nar son pa'i skabs mdo las bshad pa'i/ byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i snying bo la gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgrub pa thugs nyams su bstar bas/ 'jam dbyangs 136

dzo—snye—snye——snyesdudrizorwahūṃsduzitsho1rjorwand+raguljosprand+ra/————snye—zichen po'i rnam par bstan nas dbugs dbyung mdzad/ ces 'byung bas rgyal sras nam mkha'i snying bo'i rnam par 'phrul bar mtshan mthun pa'i dpes bstan pa'am/ sems bskyed pa'i slob dpon du gyur pa'i dbang gis yin nam snyam pa'i yid dpyod skyes so/ /'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rin chen pa'i nyer len gyis rkyen mdzad nas lho'i shel dkar nas/ chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa spyan drangs/ngam rings kyi chos grwa 'di nyid kyi rtsod pa'i khyu mchog mang bo'i dbus su seṅge'i nga ro sgrog par mdzad pa'i tshe/ thog ma'i bka' 'brel gsan zhing / gzhan yang skabs der dka' lnga ba dpal 'byor shes rab ces pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de nyid dang / de'i yang gdan sar gyur pa'i mkhan chen rin chen dpal bzang bo gnyis la'ang bka' 'brel legs par gsan la/ mkhas grub seng ge rgyal mtshan pa/ blo ldan na bzhugs dus mjal ba la phebs / bde mchog gi dbang zhig gi gsol ba btab pas bka' gnang byung / de nub mnal lam du ngam rings kyi sgo gsum gyi tshoms de na bskor ba mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ ḍā ma ru zhig sgra sgrog gin 'phur byung ba/ tshoms kyi sgo chung nyis ral ma de na phar song bas phyag gis bsnyabs pas zin nas/ thigs khang gi steng du phebs/137

————snye——skyaspra1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdind+raXrwasduskyasdutram̐sdubhe/ ———snye—bskor ba mdzad cing 'khrol ba gnang ba rmis pa rje drung gi snyan du zhus pas/ de mnal lam bzang bo yin/ dbang de yong ba byed kyang da res ni stabs ka mi 'grig par 'dug gsungs nas/ lo 'ga' 'gyangs zhes grags la slad nas lha rtser bzhugs pa'i dus shig pho brang du mkhas grub seng ge phebs/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa bzhengs nas/ spyan 'dren rkang btsugs gnang ste/ yab sras lhan du dbang gi bgyi ba mtha' dag yongs su rdzogs rma ra mdzad nas/ sngar gyi mnal lam gyi tshul phul ba ma bsnyel bar/ na ning gi drung gi mnal lam du byung ba'i ḍā ma ru de bde mchog gi ḍā ma ru yin snyam yang min par 'dug dus kyi 'khor lo'i ḍā ma ru 'dug go gsungs/ mkhas grub seṅge ba nyid kyis/ phyag ḍi rgyun bzhes de gnang ngo / /de dag la yang 'di skad ces/'gazhon nu byis pa'i tshul 'dzin nyid nas sngon/ /rgya chen bsags pa'i sgyu 'phrul zlos gar ni/ /pra phab snang ba'i gzhom med ri mo can/ /gdod ma'i snang brnyan lhun grub mchog tu gzigs/ /padma las 'khrungs padma saṃ bha rjes/ /dung dkar nā da'i rang sgra sgrogs pa'i dung / /138

—gesnye———snye—sdusdurjopand+raspyadzirwapaskyarwarjikyiljosdurwa/———————phyag gi yal gas gang gi phyag sor rtser/ /yongs su stsal tshe yongs su dgyes pa thob/ /cha med rdul phran gzhon nur stong gsum gyi/ /mdzes sdug dpa' bos 'khyud pa'i mnyam sbyor gzugs/ /ye shes spyan gyis gzigs pa'i de ma thag /srid zhi mnyam nyid phyag rgya'i bde chen rnyed/ /las dang ye shes phyag rgya'i yul min pa'i/ /phyag rgya chen mo'i bde mchog brnyes pa'i sku/ /bcu phrag dgung gi na tshod 'dzin pa'i gzugs/ /sprul ba'i bu chung rgyal ba'i myu gu lags/ /'jam dbyangs grub rigs nam mkha'i snying bo las /rin chen byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed cing / /rgyal sras bslab pa'i spang blang gser 'gyur rtsis/ /rnam mang dpe yis rjes dpag bgrang yas dgongs/ /a la ci byas dge ba'i thabs mkhas 'phrul/ /bo rnyi sa twa'i shing rta bla na med/ /ka ru ṇi ka 'gro la rab brtse'i phul/ /gang gi mkhyen pa'i yul du bdag gir mdzad/ /139

dzo—————bhespyorwa2sngarwand+rarjotsho3nd+rand+ratshirwasdusprisdutram̐rjo—/ —————klu yi me tog seng ge rol ba'i nags/ /sgrub pa'i sman ljongs rgyal bas bsngags pa'i gnas/ /mtshan ldan snying bo'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i spo/ /blo ldan ri bo'i bste gnas gang der byon/ /seng ge'i zhal can mkha' 'gro'i dbang mo che/ /chos kyi sgron mas rgyal ba gnyis pa'i mgon/ /klu sgrub snying bo'i skye bar lung bstan pa'i/ /mkhas grub mtshan mchog ldan pa'i spyan sngar son/ /'jam mnyen usprul 'dab bzang rtsibs stong gis/ /'khor lo'i ri mos spud pa'i phyag zung dag /mnyam sbyor sor mos bcings pa ral ba'i rtser/ /yongs su bkod de dam pa'i zhabs pad bsten/ /ka la ping ka'i gsung snyan du/ /dbang gi bgyi bas rjes skyong zhes/ /rje yi sgra 'dzin lam zhugs nas/ /bde gsal mi rtog khyim der song / /gnas skabs byis blo 'khrid pa'i lam/ /byams dang snying rje'i gzhung bzang gis/ /140

—————snyesnyesnyetram̐2rjo2/zidzisduparjorwarjikyiljosdurwa/snye——————rgyu yi theg pa'i sgra dbyangs dag /dka' ba med par sgrogs bgyid mod/ /mkha' 'gro gdug pa'i kha rlangs kyis/ /nye bar sbags pa'i yid bzhin nor/ /'dod dgu'i dbang gi rgyal bo de/ /ci dgar spyod la rngo mi thogs/ /dang ba'i gdengs ka'i 'phur lding can/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus gnas pa/ /sa skyong klu rgyal khyod nyid la/ /dbang gi nor bu gtsug tu sbyin/ /bka' yi 'brug sgra'i sgra dbyangs de/ /thos tshe mos pa'i gtsug phud can/ /gus pa'i spu long cher g.yos nas/ /yid bde spro dga'i mdzes gar bsgyur/ /de tshe mngon mtho'i dpal gyis bskrun pa'i dar zab 'bol gdan yangs pa'i dbus/ /gzung 'dzin snang ba'i las rlung rgyu ba byu tir zhugs pa'i rtse dga' las/ /141

———snyesnyesnyeskyarwapasngasdund+rarjotshorwasdigludzirwaṇasprisdu’sprisnye/—————thogs med nam mkha'i bya lam yangs par stong nyid sgra sgrogs ḍā ma ru/ /myur mgyogs de ni skal bzang phyag gis dngos grub rten du yongs su bzhes/ /de lta'i rang bzhin mngon sum pa'i//gnas don dam pa la bsnyad pas/ /e ma ho skal ldan khyod kyi yid/ /re ba'i cha shas gang bar bgyid/ /de mthar yun ring btang snyoms zhu ba'i dbyings/ /ye shes spyan yangs gzigs pa rgya chen dag /'gro don dus las yol bar mi spyod de/ /phyi nang rten 'byung nam langs nyi shar tshul/ /slad nas pho brang ri bo'i rtser/ /dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor sprul/ /spyan 'dren bka' yi bya ma rtas/ /lha yi khang bzang rtse nas drangs/ /chos rgyal gu'i gung chen po dang / /yab sras lhan cig smin par mdzad/ /142

dzo———snyesnye—bhetram̐rnguzind+rand+rasdusdusdu2rjosdudriglusdurwarwa/—snyesnye————de tshe sngar gyi mnal lam la /the tshom mdud bkrol rjes lung bstan/ /zhes so/ /yang smras pa/rū ba/ju /ti'i dbyings su nyi zla sdod mnan nam mkha'i rnal 'byor bi bde mchog 'khor lo brtson pas bsgrubs kyang dgyes pa rdo rje'i dngos grub brnyes/ /mnal lam sgra sgrogs ḍā ma ru yang bde mchog las gzhan dus 'khor lo/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i spyan gyis nyer 'tsho rdzun bral bden pa'i mthu dang ldan/ /phyi nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i ring lugs pa/ /pad dkar zhal lung 'byed la 'gran bral ba'i/ /rton pa bzhi ldan shing rta'i srol chen po/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pas bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ /deng sang blo chung rang blo'i rtsal/ /yig ngor 'god pa'i yi ge ba/ /pad dkar zhal lung pad dkar gyi/ /143

dzo—snye————spurdzu1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdind+radzirwasbyosprisdutram̐sprisnye/—————ring lugs dag las ring du spyod/ /padma dkar bo'i mtshan mchog don ldan pa/ /padma rgyas pas spud pa'i khrir bkod kyi/ /padma brtsegs pa'i ngogs der phyag bgyid na/ /padma'i 'dab lta'i zhabs zung spyi bor stsol/ /sangs rgyas thams cad ngo bo gcig /rnam pa tha dad gdul bya'i ngor/ /rang rang las kyi skal ldan la/ /de de dngos grub lha yin no/ /zhes bya ba yang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /de nas chos kyi rgyal bo nyid dgung lo bco brgyad tsam bzhes pa'i skabs/'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal sa skya ba 'khon ston kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i zhal snga nas/ rgya nag gi pho brang chen por ta'i ming rgyal bo'i spyan sngar phebs snyam pa dgongs tshe/ dgung lo mthon por son pa dang / yul thag ring zhing /lam bgrod dka' ba'i dbang las/ chos rgyal gu'i gung yab sras kyis nan bskyed kyis mi phebs par gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/bar chad kyi yul thams cad spangs pa'i rnal 'byor chen po'i gnas 144

rdze——————tram̐rjirjopand+raspradzirwa1rjorwarjikyisdusdurwa/snye———ge——mngon sum du mdzad pa'i ye shes gzigs pa'i dbang las/ dka' bar bya ba ci yang med par myur ba nyid du 'khor nas yong zhes lung bstan te/ lam na gnas pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i gdul bya dag la—/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya cher bskrun bzhin du 'phrin las kyi chu bo chen po'i gzhung lam la brten/ brtson pa'i gru gzings mig 'gyus kyi tshul gyis bskyod de/ ma hā tsi na'i grong khyer chen por bskyod lam bde bar phebs/ chos kyi rgyal bo ta'i ming gis kyang gtsug gi nor bur bkur/ ji ltar bzhed pa'i don mchog dman ci dang ci mchis pa dag kyang bka' stsal ji bzhin du bsgrubs te/ slar yang bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i spo nyid du seng ge rnam par rtse ba'i tshul gyis 'jigs pa med par 'khod cing theg chen chos kyi rgyal bo zhes ched du brjod pa'i mtshan dang bcas lha'i dpal gyis mngon par mi bsgrun pa lta bu'i dge mtshan gyis/ dus yun ring mor dub cing ngal ba'i yid can mtha' yas pa'i yid kyi re ba bskang zhing /slad nas dpal sa'i dbang phyug gi bste gnas nyid du yang zhabs pad bkra shis pa'i rtags kyis nye bar bcags pa'i skabs dang mthun par chos rgyal yab sras la ta'i ming rgyal bo'i lung rnams rim par stsal te/ chos rgyal chen po'i yab chos grags dpal bzang bo la 145
