dzo—snye——snyesnyedzirwa3sngasdund+rasdudzond+rand+rand+rarjiXsdusdurjo32rji/——snyesnye—chang gu'i gung gi las ka dngul gyi dam kha dang / rigs ldan chen po nyid dgung lo nyi shu ba la ta'i si tu'i las ka dngul gyi dam kha dang /chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa la ming lu'i dzño gyun dbus gtsang du shri'i zi'i dre hos kyi las ka dngul gyi dam kha dang bcas pa gnang /spyi dang khyad par gyi legs byas ma lus pa yar ngo'i dpal du rgyas shing rnam par 'phel bar gyur pa nyid do/ /sa chen 'di na mtshungs pa'i zla med skya rengs bu ltar grags pa'i rnga/ /srid rtse las brgal thos pa'i lam bcas yongs la son pa'i snyan pa'i sgra/ /chos kyi rje bo sa skya bar btags rgyal ba'i ring lugs chen po ba//rim par byon pa'i spel legs zhabs la yid rab dung ba'i spyi bos 'dud/ /'gro ba'i bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ /kun la snyoms pa'i thugs rje'i nyi ma des/ /legs bskyangs myu gu 'phel ba'i n+ya gro'i shing / /yongs su rgyas pa'i grib bsil 'di na mtshar/ /gang yang 'jig rten las snang dag /146

———————sdurjizi3/zidzisdupaskyarwa2gluljosdurwa/———————drin gzo mi len phal ba'i srol/ /'dris las rnam par sun 'byin pa/ /rtsod dus rang bzhin nye bar bstan/ /rdzun dogs phra ma'i ri mo ni/ /sna tshogs rma bya'i mgrin sngon ltar/ /khyu can khros pa'i sdang mig gis/ /rang mtshungs bzang bo'i 'dzum dkar btang / /ngag tshig g.yo can sgyu ma ru/ /phan tshun bcol ba'i mu cor gtam/ /la las la la 'byed pa'i dbyen/ /phan tshun so sor yid brtan zhugs/ /de tshe lus med mda' lnga'i mtshon/ /sdig can stobs kyis yongs bzung nas/ /go cha'i ya lad rnam mang gis/ /chos grwa'i mdzes pa nyams par gyur/ /skabs der mkhyen yangs spyan stong mnga' ba'i lha/ /chos kyi brgya byin de ni rab brtse'i dbang / /ta ming lung gi rdo rje 'dzin pa des/ /147

dzo—snye————spyond+rasprusngasdund+rarjosdund+rasdirdzuXrwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/———ge4lha min bdud sde'i g.yul las rgyal ba thob/ /rnam par rgyal ba'i chos smra'i khang bzangs dbus/ /mthu chen lag na rdo rjes nyer bsrungs pas/ /dkar phyogs lha bu'i yid tshim dus mthar yang / /nag phyogs bgyi bas pham pa med par mdzad/ /ka ye bka' drin tshong zong gis 'tsho ba'i/ /don gnyis nor bu'i gling du chas pa dag /chos kyi ded dpon che la gus pa'i blo/ /snying nas dang ba bskyed la mngon dgar byos/ /dus der dgyes pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /rgyun du rab brtse'i lhag bsam gang / /'dir ni gzugs su mngon sum zhes/ /dkon nor dpag yas lhag par stsal/ /shul ring lam gyis dub par ma dgongs pa'i/ /dam pa'i mdzad pa khrel gzhung mdzangs pa'i go /bzod pa'i rang bzhin phan bde'i 'od brgya bas/ /nyes byas mun pa'i smag rum drungs nas bsal/ /zhes so/ /gong du khab tu bzhes pa'i dbon rnam sras rgyal 148

———————tram̐rjizi2nd+rapadzirwa1rjorjorjikyisngasdund+ra/snye—blo—snye——mtshan gyi sras mo lha gcig ma de la/ bdag po nam mkha' bkra shis ༵ljing/sa pa yang / sku gzhon nu nas zhi bar gshegs shing slad mar cho rigs rab gtsang 'khon gyi gdung 'dzin ma/ /lang tsho'i gzi 'od gsal ba'i 'od dkar can/ /lha sras ri bong 'dzin pa'i dpal yon gyis/ /dge mtshan cha shas gang ba'i rjes mthar yang / /bcu drug nas brtsams cha bsags legs byas phul/ /rim gyis yongs su dman pa'i gzi med ma/ /nag phyogs mar ngor gzhol ba'i 'bab stegs su/ /stong mthar 'jug pa'i mun pas snying khong khyab/ /de tshe nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gang / /sgra gcan gdug pas yongs bsgribs shing / /lha min bu mo khros pa des/ /rnam rgyal khang bzang gyi nar spyod/ /phan bde'i 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i nyin byed dbang / /las snang sgra gcan gdong las ring song ste/ /nub phyogs khrus kyi rgya mtsho'i 'jug ngogs der/ /149

dzosnye—————dzond+rakyisngasdund+radrisdund+rasdigluskyarwaṇaskyasdutram̐skya—/—snye———chu nyi ji bzhin sgyu 'dra'i ting 'dzin brnyes/ /de ma thag tu rab brtse'i mgon/ /thams cad gzigs la phrin gsol te/ /gru 'dzin bu mo mig 'dra ba/ /gshin rje'i bu mo khros mas zos/ /chos bzang lha yi 'dun sa'i rtse/ /lha min spyi brtol can mas bzung / /lugs bzang mdzes pa'i me tog tshal/ /bsnyon dor glang bos 'dam du brdzis/ /'jig rten gnas skabs grags pa'i tshon/ /yid srubs dri mas mdangs bkra bsubs/ /zhes brjod yi ge'i 'dab gshog gang / /pho nya'i rkang mgyogs kyis bskyod de/ /yid skrag 'jigs pa'i zol gyis ni/ /myur du lag pa'i rtse nas lhung / /thams cad mkhyen des cha tsam gyis/ /ji bzhin gzigs nas rgyal sras la/ /rab brtse'i rang bzhin ga bur chus/ /150

———snye———snyesdusdurjo2nd+ragudzisdupaskyarwarjigusngarwarwa/——————zigang sku'i brtan pa rab tu phrogs/ /shog dkar rgya bcings mdud pa'i cha/ /grol bar mdzad tshe phyag sor dag /phan tshun 'thab pa'i zol gyis ni/ /re zhig dam bcings nyid du lus/ /de mthar drung gi char 'khod kyis/ /mdud pa'i bcing ba yongs bkrol te/ /spyan ras kyis 'khyud gnas don rnams/ /thugs kyi za ma tog tu chud/ /slad nas dbyangs can dga' ba'i bka'i/ /snyan tshig dri za'i rgyud mang gang / /zhu mchid pi wang la drangs nas/ /sa skyong dgyes skyed rol mo sbyin/ /de tshe'ang po nya blo ldan des/ /brtson pa'i shugs kyis rab drangs te/ /chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'dun sa der/ /mi dbang mchog la nye bar springs/skad cig de la mkhyen pa'i mkhar/ /151

——————snyedzorwa1sngarwand+radzitsho3sdirwadzirwasdutrisdutram̐skya—/ ——————bka' stsal nyin byed legs shar bas/ /skyo ba'i rab rib kun sangs nas/ /gdams pa'i snang bas khyab par gyur/ /skabs der mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid can/ /theg mchog sa skya'i bla chen dang / /byams ldan seṅge'i mtshan can gyis/ /bdud mo de la gros btab kyang / /gang yang zhi ba'i gtam bzang bo'i/utpal rna char len min zhing / /dam pa'i rang bzhin dwangs pa'i chu/ /slar yang rtsub mo'i sman du sbyar/ /zhe sdang gdug pa'i sems ldan ma/ /'dod khro'i me rtse rab 'bar te/ /mi shes gti mug phug ring na/ /dmod pa'i las dag lhur len byed/ /de nas ring bo ma lon par/ /dge ba'i mgon pos spangs ma de/ /sdig pas bskul ba'i zug rngu'i nad/ /152

snye——————blosdurjirjo3nd+razizisdu1rjorwarjikyiljorwarwa/snye————snye—dmyal ba'i bsu mas nye bar rtol/ /mthong chos las kyis 'phangs pa'i 'phrul/ /myur bar sa 'og rab phug nas/ /rang gnas gshin rje'i rgyal bo'i drung / /brtse med ma de zhags pas drangs/ /'brum nag rnag chu'i 'dag zhal gyis/ /byil bor spags pa'i rul ma'i lus/ /myags pa'i dri nga'i bsung can de/ /sgyug bro'i gnas su sa rdos bsgribs/ /de nas snying rje'i pad dkar can/ /rab brtse'i dbang las byams pa'i thugs/ /yang yang bskul ba med par yang / /shang shong dma' bar chu rgyun bzhin/ /gang sku'i 'khril shing brten pa'i mdza' mo de'i/ /yid kyi bag chags bud shing rnying ba dag /thugs rje'i ye shes me 'od kyis sbyangs nas/ /ma rig las nyon mtha' yas dag par mdzad/ /yongs 'dzin lha gnas gang gā'i rgyun/ /153

snye—————dzorwa1sngasdund+rarjotsho2nd+ragluskyarwatram̐sprisdutram̐skya—/ snyesnye———khrel gzhung ral ba'i nags su sim/ /gathungs sngags dza snu'i bu mo'i chus/ /dmyal gnas sdig pa'i dri ma bkrus/ /gang la brten dang reg mthong gi /las ngan sdig sgrib ma lus pa/ /yud tsam gyis kyang sbyong mkhas pa'i/ /byang chub sems la phyag bgyid do/ /bshes gnyen du ma bsten nas gdams pa gsan tshul/de ltar rigs ldan sprul ba'i sku nyid/ dgung lo nyer gsum gyi skabs sa sdig pa'i grogs kyi 'ching ba spangs nas/ dge ba'i bshes stokyi mgon po du ma las gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa mang bo'i mdzod lhug par bzhes pa la dang ba stobs su gyur pa/ gzhon nu nor bu bzang bo'i rjes su 'jug pa'i tshul ston par mdzad pa yang /skabs de tsam na/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi mkhan po chen po/ ma hā paṇḍi ta shā ri pu tra la/ legs par sbyar ba'i skad du/ sngon chad bod yul du 'gyur ba'i mdo sngags kyi sgo du ma dang / paṇḍi ta de nyid kyis/154

dzobhege—————tram̐rjirjo22zidzirwaparjorwarjiguljorwarwa/snyesnye—snye———grub chen bi ru pakṣa dang / sto ṣa nā tha'i dngos kyi zhal slob 'ga' las nod pa'i 'chi med 'phrul 'khor dang ga'u gdams pa'i rlung sbyor rnams kyang / chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa dang lhan cig gsan zhing / gzhan yang / bhu tra ba bla ma yon tan 'byung gnas pa pho brang nyid du spyan drangs nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa chen po'i dbang bskur ba yang bzhes/ grub chen burta shī la yang sku mched lhan du bka' dbang du ma nod/ rgyal sras chos dpal mgon po la yang /chos kyi bgro ba du ma mdzad/ khyad par chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba nyid la dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du 'dren pa'i phud du bkur nas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa mdo dang sngags kyis bsdus pa ma lus shing / lus pa med pa'i chos kyi sgo yongs la gcig la gcig tu sbyangs pa ltar kun la 'dris par mdzad de—/ dpal ngam rings kyi rgyal sa chen po nyid dang / lhun grub sdings pho brang rtse sogs su yang yang spyan drangs shing / bka' rab 'byams mtha' dag gi smin par byed pa'i dbang dang grol bar byed pa'i lam bskyed rdzogs ji snyed pa dag lan grangs du ma du mar bzlas shing nan tan du byang chub par mdzad nas/ rje btsun nyid kyis bzhed pa'i dgongs don rnams kyang phyogs gcig tu 'khod pa'i bka'i 155

byang bdag rnam smol grags bzang gi rnam thar/ne—dzesnye———dzorwa1sngarwand+rarjosdund+rasdigluzirwasdusngasdu’dzi————— bsdu ba chen po'i gsol ba 'debs pa bo yang nan bskyed du mdzad de/ de nyid 'dus pa'i chos kyi glegs bam yi ge'i phyi mo'i grangs su bzhugs pa'i/ rtsom pa'i phreng ba kun zhu ba bo dang / nyan zhing klog pa—/ 'bri zhing kun chub pa bo'i gtso bo khyu mchog tu gyur cing rigs ldan chen po 'di nyid ma mjal ba'i skyes chen gong ma dag las/kun mkhyen dol bu ba chen po dang / dngos su mjal ba'i yongs su 'dzin pa'i 'dren pa rnams las/ rje btsun chos kyi spyan ldan dpal ldan 'jigs med grags pa 'di nyid/ zugs mos kyi yul du 'dzin skad/ slad ma'ang rje btsun gyis mdzad byang yod phyin brtag dpyad kyi gnas mi mdzad par bkur ste'i yul du mchod cing 'dud par mdzad sku gsung thugs ro gcig pa'i dbyings dang ye shes gnyis thed kyi ngo bo gcig tu 'dres pa'i dbang las phyis 'od gsal gyi rang babs su byon nas/ rje btsun nyid kyi snang ba'i rang gzugs su gyur pa'i/ 'jam dbyangs sgyu 'phrul dra ba rigs gsum kyi dkyil 'khor dbang gi bgyi ba rab tu rdzogs pas thugs kyi re ba yongs su gang bar byin gyis brlabs la rje btsun dang 'brel ba'i mchog dman yongs la bdag gir gnang / rje'i dbon sku dngos kyi gdan sa ba chos rje bshes gnyen pa yang drug cu ba'i sku rim sogs bsgrub 156

———————tram̐rjizi3rnga1sbyitshospritshorwarjikyispra—rwa/———————pa'i mgon du yang spyan 'dren par mdzad cing phyis bka' 'brel tsam yang gsan rna/ /pho brang du chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa dang /rje rong ston nyid kyang / rtsod pa'i 'brel gtam rgya cher mdzad ces gtam du gleng la/ dus de tsam na mus chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ba yang bzhugs pas/ rong chen gyis bka' chos gsan par thegs zhes grags so/ /skabs der pho brang du/ mdo sde dang 'dul ba lung la gzigs rtog stsal bas/ bcom ldan 'das la zugs dang ba'i dad pa stobs su gyur pa'i legs byas khyad par can ngang gis 'phel zhing / mnal lam du yang / ne'u sing me tog 'bab chus brgyan pa'i sa phyogs gtsang zhing dag pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang bo bzhugs pa dang mjal/ dam pa'i chos kyi bdud byu legs par bzhes pa'i tshig 'bru/ mnal sad tshe/ zugs kyis ma zin 'dug gsungs la/ yang byang chub kyi shing me tog dang lo 'bras rab tu rgyas pa rkang dmar ba zhig nam mkha' la 'gro ba'i mtshan ltas dge ba/ gsang ba gyi rgyud las/ zi lam sangs rgyas mthong na ni/ /yon tan rgya mtsho mngon sum bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / rjes su mthun pa'i ltas bzang 'bad med du brnyes par mdzad la/ gzhan mnal lam du rgyal bo gzugs can snying bo dang mjal ba bka sdus

dzosnye—snyesnyesnye—dzohūṃ1sngasdund+rarjosdu2tram̐gludzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐sprisnye/———snye—rgyal ba khyu mchog gi bur bshad pas/ rnam thos sras kyi ngo bor dgongs shing gtor ma'i mchod 'phrin lung bstan ltar mdzad pas/dngos grub kyi pha phabs dpal mkha'i mdzod yongs su rgyas shing gang bar gyur ces kyang gsungs la/ mthu stobs kyi bdag po/ chos rje brtson 'grus pa la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang / srung ma'i dbang bo drug cu'i zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang yang yang gsan zhing snga sor lha rtser gdan chags pa'i skabs zhig gi mnal lam du/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gi drung na/ rje brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan pa bzhugs nas/bka' las 'dir 'khod lha tshogs thams cad kyang / rdo rje dang gri gug dang ral gri dang rin po che dang padma dang 'khor lo rnams su 'dus zhes lung bstan la/ phyis rgyud 'grel la mkhyen pa mthar son tshe—/ de kho na bzhin du nges shes rnyed/ ces gsung las byung ngo / /gzhan yang chos rje jo bzang chen po rgyal ba dpal la yang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i bka' lung man ngag rgya cher nos nas/ dbang brgyud kyi gtso bor mdzad/ rgyun bzhes kyi cho ga'i ngag 'don thams cad la/ jo bzang chen po sogs rdo rje rnal 'byor dngos su ston mdzad pa'i/ rigs ldan brgyud pa zhes pa kho na 'byung bas khong du 158

dzo—snye———ge—sdusdurjo2nd+rarngidzisdu1skyarwand+ragusbyisdurwa/———snyesnyege—chud par nus la/ 'dren mchog shes rab bzang bo la yang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi bdud rtsi bzhes/ slad ma rje de nyid kyi khrid ma rdzogs pa dag la'ang rigs ldan mchog gis 'doms par mdzad ces gleng / de nas chos kyi rgyal bo dgung lo so gcig gi steng du phebs pa'i skabs/ dpal sa skyar theg chen chos kyi rje dag pa'i zhing la phebs/ ngo mtshar ba'i mtshan ma dpag med bstan zhing /gsol 'debs kyi khur len yang dag pa'i bgyi ba thams cad pang bzhes su mdzad la/ skabs de tsam du/ seng ge rtse'i si tu bsod nams dpal gyi dbon mo bdag mo nam mkha' dpal 'bum ma khab tu bzhes pa la/ sras mo rdo rje tshe ring 'khrungs pa/ rin spungs drung nor bu bzang bo'i btsun mor gnang zhing / lha cig ma 'di nyid/ sku skye ba snga ma'i las dkar bzang bo'i rgyun sad pa'i/ mthong thos dran reg gi 'brel tshad don ldan/ rigs ldan sprul ba'i sku nyid la/bsnyen bkur dgongs len gyi bgyi ba che rags mtha' dag ya rabs kyi ring lugs las skad cig kyang ma g.yos pa'i thugs kyi snang ba 'dren mkhas pa'i dbang las/ lhag par brtse ba'i sgo nas skal ba ldan pa'i gzigs pas rjes su skyong ba'i skabs nyid nas/ mtho ris kyi them skas mthon po'i lam la rim gyis 'ardzags nas/ rigs 159

———snye——spyond+rapasngarwand+rarjotsho2sdind+rarjorwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ske———sgobazang ma de ni thar ba'i grong khyer chen por bzhud ces grags so/ /de dag la 'di skad ces/thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs 'jigs med grags/ /rgyal ba las gzhan gang du'ang mi spyod par/yid ches snying la brnags pa'i skal bzang gis/ /rgya chen chos kyi bdud rtsi rgya cher bzhes/ /ming tsam brjod la ngal ba'i khur bskyed pa'i/ /de nyid 'dus pa'i chos kyi chu klung gis/ /khyod blo'i ma dros mtsho chen yongs gang bas/ /mkhas grub klu dbang gnyis par mod la gyur/ /rab 'byams mdo dang rnam mang rgyud sde'i gzhung / /rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ldan shing rta'i srol/ /gangs can ljongs su grags pa'i mdo rgyud rnams/ /kun gyi zhal lung nges gnas ma lus mkhyen/ /shākya'i rgyal dang rdo rje 'chang dbang las/ /mdo sngags 'byed la ston pa ma mchis grang / /de dag ji bzhin dgongs pa 'di yin zhes/ /rnam nges lung dang rigs par bzlas te stsal/ / 160

———————snyetram̐rjirjorwand+rardzudzisdu1skyasdurjikyisngasdurwa/———snye—ge—blo chung ma mthong ma thos rang blo'i khyon/ /dper 'dzin du mas rtsod dang 'khon 'dzin mod/ /rab sbyangs blo gros gsal ldan bye ba brgyas/ /gus pa'i thal sbyor ngo mtshar bsngags par mthong /de ltar thams cad mkhyen de'i rjes slob pa/ /thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan yangs mi yi rje/ /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'byed pa la/ /thams cad dgongs pa'i mi 'jigs spobs pa thob/ /rang gi yongs su 'dzin pa'i zhal bum las/ /dngos su legs nod dag dang rjes mthun par/ /dri med bka' yi glegs bam mang bo dag /gzigs pa'i dbang las rgyal la dad pa 'khrungs/ /mnal tshe 'od gsal dang du rgyal ba'i bka'/ /rjes su 'dzin par mdzad cing byang chub shing / /'gro la rjes chags rkang 'thung rab dmar de/ /srid rtse'i bar du yongs su bgrod pa bzhin/ /gang yang dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo'i bshad sgrub rin chen dam pa'i gling / /161

dzoske—snyesnye——skyarwasprusngarjond+radzisdu2sdiglurngiXsdu1dzitram̐sprisnye/—————yid bzhin nor bu rton pa bzhi ldan ji bzhin legs pa'i ded dpon 3/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i ring lugs phul byung don gnyer mkhas pa'i tshong ba rnams/ /mi shes gyi na'i dbul ba sel mdzad padma dkar bo dngos byon lags—/ /zhes bya ba ni ched du brjod pa'i skabs so/ /rten dang gsung rab bzhengs tshul/de nas rigs ldan chen po nyid/ dgung lo bzhi bcur phebs pa'i steng du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dngul gyi blos slongs rang bzhed ltar thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor dag kyang rgya cher rol ba'i mdo'i bcom ldan 'das yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang / rjes su mthun par sngon chad gzhan dag gi yid yul tsam du'ang mi gnas pa'i bkod pa khyad par can dang 'brel bar yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad tshang bar bsgrubs shing / rgyu'i rin po che'i dngul mtha' dag kyang / rtsol ba med par/ gter chen po'i bum pa las yongs 'don par mdzad nas/ gser dang nor bu'i rnam grangs 162

dzo—snyebhesnyesnye—snye3rjizo2nd+razidzisduparjorwa2guskyarwarwa/—snyesnye—snye——mtha' dag dang / btsun mo rin chen dam pa de'i rgyan du bzhes pa'i g.yu dang mu nyag gi phreng ba'i tshogaspo ma lus pa yang gzhal med khang de'i rgyan tshoms dang / do shal du phul/ skal bzang dam tshig can ma'i sku gdung rnams kyang chos kyi rgyal bo nyid kyi phyag tsha gnang nas dkyil 'khor gyi gar bu'i dbus su bzhugs su gsol zhes gtam du thos la/ skabs de dag tu ngam rings kyi chos grwa nyid kyi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs pa/ chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang /mkhan chen yon tan blo gros (tshogs pa dge 'dun sgang / phyis mkhan po dpal yon pa dang / mkhan chen rab 'byor seng ge la bka' 'azel tsam gsan/) pa la yang bka'i 'brel ba tsam re gsan zhes kyang grags so/ /ston pa'i spyan sngar rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /yongs su zhu ba'i mdun na 'don/ /lag na rdo rje zla ba bzang / /de yi rjes su rab tu zhugs/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo che'i/ /pho brang rin chen snang brnyan las/ /rab tu sprul pa'i mig 'phrul gyis/ /mthong ba'i dpal 'dzin ya mtshan rmad/ /163

——————dzond+ra1sngarwand+radrisprapanigludzirwasdusprirwatram̐spri——————chos rgyal rigs ldan 'dus pa'i mtshan/ /'dzin mkhas 'jam dbyangs grags pa ltar/ /sprul ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po der/ /dbang gi bya ba bgrang yas bsgrun/ /de sras padma dkar bo de/ /khyed nyid sngon bzhin rgyas 'grel gyis/ /mi shes yul las rab 'das pa'i/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug dgongs pa bstan/ /de ltar rigs gsum mgon gyi lha'i/ /rjes sprul chos rgyal rigs ldan dang / /rnam dbyer ma mchis mi dbang mchog /sa skyong de la snying nas dad/ /ye ma mkhyen yangs 'jam pa'i dpal/ /rab tu snying brtse spyan ras gzigs/ /mthu stobs mnga' dbang gsang ba'i bdag /gang gi rang bzhin nyid las ci/ /zla bzang chos bstan dkyil 'khor bsgrubs/ /'jam dpal grags pas smra ngan bcom/ /16

———————tram̐rjiziparnga1dzotshosngatsho—rji1༷—nd+ra/———————padma dkar bos rgyas 'grel spel/ /de dag kun kyang phyogs re nyid/ /'dir ni sprul ba'i pho brang rin chen las/ /legs bsgrubs phyir rgol 'bum sde'i dpa' bkong zhing / /rab rgyas rgyud 'grel mtha' dag rjes dgongs nas/ /mdzad pa'i pa mthar gyur pa su yis dpogs/ /ka ye rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drung du sor bcu bkod de'ang ( ba ba nga bo/) gzhan min la/ /nyi ma'i shing rta'i bsnyems pa phyogs mthar rigs gcig bsgyur mkhas ('jam dpal grags pa) de 'ang su/ /phye gapy-i sa/nga/ bdag gis ni rab tu sgo bldams rgyas 'grel lde mig gis padma dkar bo'i rigs gsum gcig bsdus rnam rgyal grags pa bzang bo nyid/ /sprul ba sprul ba'i mdzad pa khor mo ru/ /srid 'dir srid mtha'i bar du rjes bstan nas/ /165

dzoge——snyesnye—dzorwa1sprusdund+rarjosdu2sdigludzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐dzi—/ ————4gang yang gang dag chos kyis phongs rnams la/ /bsam yas bsdum pa'i re ba rdzogs par mdzad/ /dbyāng bcu'i sar bzhugs rgyal sras kyis/ /dbang bsgyur mdzad pa'i legs lam la/ /daXng med mos gus mig chu ni/ /dbang bo'i mchog nas char ltar 'bab/ /lus skyes du ku la yi bla gos can/ /sems ni rab tu bsdams pa'i bag yod dang / /rab dul byin brlabs zer gyis yid bde'i ngang / /drang srong mchog gi snang bas 'di na khyab/ /da ni skabs 'dir sngar gyi bsdus pa'i don gyi kha skong gi tshigs su bcad pa 'ga' zhig spel te/sngar brjod rigs (ta'i si tu rnam rgyal grags bzang /) ldan chen po dang —/ /yab (gu gung chos grags dpal bzang dang 'bum skyong rgyal mo/) yum gcig 166

dzo——snyegebhebhe—sduzirjorwand+rardzusdund+rasprirjotram̐sdukyitrisprand+ra/——snye————gis legs bskrun pa/ /dkon mchog legs pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal/ /bzang bo dre hos grags 'di ni/ /nges par sa la rab bzhugs shing / /sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / /nyams len sbas pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang /bla mar mi phyed dad pa'i thugs/ /mos gus mchog gi rnam rol can/ /gcen gyi sras mchog gzhon nu gang / /nam mkha'i bkra shis 'ja' snang de'ang / /nyid kyis yongs su bskyangs mdzad nas/ /rang sras las kyang gces par bzung / /skabs der 'ja' tshon 'od bltams pa/ /mkha' dbyings sim tshe dge ba'i tshogs/ /gzhal dkas yul de'i khrel bskyangs shing / /yun ring skyo ba'i ngang tshul bstan/ /de tshe rigs ldan chen po bas/ /mya ngan bsal ba'i gdams pa'i phrin/ /167

—snyesnye——ge—༷nd+rakyisngasdund+rarjosdu2nd+rand+radzirwaṇadrisdutram̐skyasnye—bhe———legs bshad mdor rgyas yang yang du/ /bsnyad las dgongs pa'i yid gso brten/ /ma pham sku yi snang brnyan gzugs/ /gser ri ltar 'tsher lhun po'i spo/ /'dus pa'i dge 'dun tshogs bcas pa/ /lhag bsam mchog gis rim bzhin spel/ /zhes so/ /da ni dkyus ma nyid la 'jug ste gong du brjod pa ltar/pho brang bkra shis rtse rgyal gyi rtse mor/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gzhal med khang lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i legs tshogs bar chad med par bsgrubs pa'i rjes thog nyid du sems dpa' chen po bul rong ba rgyal sras gzhon nu rgyal mchog mtshan gzhan dkon mchog 'bangs su 'bod pa de'i rab brtse'i bkas yongs su bskul te/ sa phyogs 'dir rgyal tshab ma pham pa'i sku rin chen ri bo'i spo chen po dang lhan cig tu dga' ldan 'phos 'dra'i gzhal med khang dang bcas pa'i gzhi 'dings par mdzad/ mnga' zhabs kyi bu gsum kun kyang bsdus nas/ byams phrug gi sde chen po btsugs te/ dus lan gcig nyid la skal ba ldan pa/ khyim pa'i rtags dor te rgyal bas bsngags pa'i ngur smrig gi gos thob pa bdun brgya tsam yongs su tshang 168

dzosnyesnye——snye—bhetram̐rjirjorwand+raziXsdu1༷rwarngekyisngasdurwa/—snye—snyebhesnye—bar bskrun nas/ ston pa'i 'phrin las rmad du byung ba'i dge mtshan 'bad med lhun grub tu grub par mdzad do/ /de dag la yang 'di skad ces brjod de/sa chen 'di na rang rang zhen pa'i blos/ /sgro btags brjod pa'i smra ba mang na yang / /skyon med sangs rgyas bstan pa'i padma'i tshal/ /skyong mkhan mi dbang nyin byed 'di las su/ /gang yang las dang skal ba mchog rnams dgra bcom 'phags pa'i sar bkod cing / /dman 'gro yongs ni dal ba don yod dge ba'i las la rab bskul te/ /nyin mtshan dbyer med dkar phyogs la spyod de yi mdzad pa phul byung dag /chos kyi rgyal bo bsngags 'os gang de'i bgyi ba nyid du lha yis bsgrags—/ /'di ltar sngon bsags smon lam mthus/ /'bad pa med par dge ba'i 'phrul/ /dkar phyogs rgyas pa'i yar ngo'i dpal/ /169

dzo—snyebhebhe—snyedzond+rapasprurwand+razosdu2sdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐spribhe/ —snye——4nya gang zla ba 'di na shar/ /'dod ldan rab bdes bskyed pa'i bu/ /mdzangs mas bsags pa'i bang mdzod dang / /rab sbyangs shes bya'i gnas kun gyis/ /gcig tu bstan la phud dud gyur/ /gang gang bu ni chos kyi gos/ /rnam gsum 'dzin pa'i lhab lhub dang / /bya rog mig 'dra'i snod mchog kyang / /lag thogs bskyed ma'i mdun sar song / /dgra bcom gsar ba mthong na dga'/ /'phags pa'i yul nas 'dir lhags sam/ /'on te zhing 'dir sprul ba lags/ /myur du nang byon bsnyen bkur bzhes/ /zhes brjod dga' bas rtab rtab pos/ /rang gi stod g.yogs gdan bting nas/ /bzhugs par bskul tshe rang bu des/ /'dzum dkar g.yo zhing 'di skad smras/ /bdag cag sprul dang 'phags yul nas/ /170

dzosnyesnye—ge———sdurjizirwand+razidzisdu1skyarwarji1sngasdurwa/bhe——4——— 'ongs pa ma lags khyed kyi bu/ /pha ma'i gos la gdan bgyi ba'i/ /bag med bsnyon dor ga la bgyi/ /zhes brjod rang gi phrag gzar ba'i/ /gding ba gru bzhi'i steng du 'khod/ /de nas pha ma blo can dag /rab brtse'i dbang las mig chu zags/ /kye ma kha rtsang byis pa'i gzugs/ /deng 'dir 'phags pa'i sku ru bltams/ /bdag cag 'khor ba'i pha mtha' ru//sgrol ba'i mnyan pa nyid gyur to/ /lhag par drin ldan ma yi yid/ /rab tu g.yos nas gtsang ma'i zas/ /sdig pa'i dri mas ma sbags pa'i/ /spyad 'os bza' ba de la sbyin/ /de tshe'ang de yi tshogs spel phyir/ /zhen pa med par longs spyad mthar/ /mkhan slob ngag las thob pa'i phrin/ /171

dzosnyesnyesnye—snyesnyedzoshaṃ1dzisdund+rarjotshohūṃsdispradzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐dzibhe/ ——snye——sbyin pa'i tshigs su bcad par bsgrags/ /de thos khyim gyis bcings pa'i yid/ /ser sna'i mdud pa yongs grol nas/ /dkon nor rin chen dpag yas pa/ /bu yis mkhan (gzhon nu rgyal mchog la/) la nye bar bstabs/ /des kyang bdag gir ma bzung ste/ /bsod nams ri bo'i dpal 'dzin pa'i/ /dad pa'i tshong zong spungs pa'i drung / /byams sku'i gter du yang yang sbas/ /de nas bskyed bu dgra bcom des/ /drin can dag las rjes chags pas/ /'dzad med bang ba nam mkha'i mdzod/ /mi zad gter de pha mar sbyar/ /rna pāl mkhas pa yid skyong ba/ /slob mar bcas pa'i lag pa ni/ /bi shwa'i 'phrul la co 'dri zhing / /rang dbang gyur pa'i dge mtshan rnyed/ /zangs ma'i ri bo gser chu yis/ /172

——snyesnyebhe—snye—tram̐rjizi2nd+ragusdutsho1rjosduḍidzosdidzosngasdurwa/——snyesnye4dzege—yongs su bsgyur pa'i mtshan dpe'i spor/ /rin chen bye ba'i rgyan spud pas/ /lhun po'i dpal yang phrogs pa snyam/ /de tshe gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lha'i/ /snying la gzer bu rab zhugs nas/ /yid srubs bdud sde'i dmag dpung gang / /khros pa'i bzhin bsdus mchi ma 'dzag /mda' lnga'i mtshon gyis snying phug pa/ /rgyal phran 'dus pa'i 'khor tshogs dag /phan tshun che la yid 'gran pas/ /rtsod pa'i g.yul shom rim gyis 'gyed/ /sa bdag dbyen gyis 'byed min yang / /rang rang las ngan 'khrul ba'i ngor/ /'di 'di gang gang mnga' yin zhes/ /khron pa'i rus sbal ri mo bzhin/ /las nyon dman pa'i zo chun des/ /'dren byed rkang la rab 'khor nas/ /bdud kyi pho nya'i gtso bo dag /173

dzo——————dzond+ra1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdirngaXrwasduskyasdutram̐sdu—/ —snyesnye——drug cu'i srung ma'i zhal du bstabs/ /spyan ras gzigs dang byams mgon gyi/ /rjes sprul mched gnyis gdan 'dzom tshe/ /mkha' dbyings kun khyab lha rdzas kyi/ /me tog phreng bas ljongs 'di gang / /de ltar bar chad kyi g.yul las yongs su rgyal ba dang rgyal ba ma pham pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i byin 'bebs kyi rab gnas lhan cig tu 'dzom ste/ mkhan chen a nanta ma (mdo smad kyi 'ga' rong du 'khrungs/) ti bzang bos gtsang khang du nang gi rnal 'byor zab mo la brten nas gsang sngags lugs su/ bdud 'dul ba'i bgegs gzhom dang 'brel ba'i me tog 'bul ba mdzad cing / sems dpa' gzhon nu rgyal mchog gis tshogs pa spyi dang phyogs mthun du/ dga' ldan nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa'i dad mos rtse gcig tu dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i rten 'brel gyi dbang gis mdo lugs dang 'brel ba'i me tog 'thor ba gnang / de'i tshe mnga' ris kyi yul phyogs mtha' dag tu gtam du grags pa yang / kasmi ra kha che'i yul na dngul gyi rgyu las bsgrubs pa'i byams chen khru brgyad cu ba zhig bzhugs pa/ yul de'i rgyal bo phyi rol ba'i grub pa'i mtha' la zhen 174

——snyebhesnye——bhesduziXnd+rand+rasdudzisdu1rjosdurjigīsnga— tharwa/—snye—snyesnyesnye—pa dang / sdig pa'i slob dpon gyis bsgyur pa'i dbang las rgyu'i rin po che la brnab sems kyis rin po che'i ri bo lta bu'i sku gzugs de sdig pa'i las byed dag gis bshig par chas pa na gsung byon te da ste zhag bdun du gtsug lag khang 'di'i sgo sdoms la zhog cig nga nyid mtsho chung gcig gi 'gram na dge slong zhig gis 'bod kyin snang bas der 'gro'o zhes thos pas/ sdig lta can rnams kyis de bzhin du bsgrubs nas zhag brgyad pa'i nyin bltas pas dngul gyi sku de yang so sor phye ma dgos par zhig nas 'dug ces nges gnas su grags shing sku'i cha shas 'dre ba yin zer snod lung ma/ ma shes rab tu grags pa de la/ shes ldan rnams spyi bor len pa dang / byams pa'i sku bzhengs pa'i rgyur 'gro ba yang yod la/ dus de dang / rje sems dpa' chen pos phyogs 'dir byams chen rab gnas mdzad pa gnyis legs par 'grig pa yin no/ /de skabs nyid du rgya gar shar phyogs dam par rgyal bo'i rigs su sku 'khrungs pa'i paṇḍi ta chen po/ nags kyi rin chen yang phebs ārya mi tri'i pho brang dang sku la ched du brjod pa'i snyan ngag spel zhing paṇa chen nyid kyis grub chen sha wa ri la dngos su gsan pa'i bde mchog bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang gi bya ba yang gsan/ de nub rigs ldan chen po nyid la yid 175

———snyesnyesnyeskyarwa1sngasdund+rarjo—༷2sdigluXrdarwatram̐sprisdutram̐sdu—/—snyesnye——bzhin nor bu dbang gi rgyal bo yi dam gyi zhal mdog can phyag tu son pa'i dge ltas kyang byung la/ paṇa chen nyid kyis rgya gar du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel rgyal bo tha dad pa bcu gsum gyi lag na yod pa kun bsdus nas gsol ba btab pas de thams cad gcig tu gyur te/ der gnas don drang bor gsungs na kun kyang yid mi ches pa la gzhan thabs ma rnyed de/ thugs chad de ba'i ngang nas sangs rgyas kyi yon tan la rab tu dad pa'i sgo nas gsol 'debs drag tu mdzad par mnal ltas dge ba dang bcas sngar las gcig 'phel bas thugs mgu ba rnyed nas ring bsrel rnams rgyal bo so so la gnang / gcig bu de paṇa chen nyid kyi sku dang ma bral bar yod pas de byams pa'i rten bzhugs su phul na dgongs kyang thugs kyis ma thongs pa la mnal ltas su nges par stsol dgos pa'i mtshan ma brtan po shar nas slar la stod sman khab nas gnang ste/ dung g.yas 'khyil nang du bcug nas byams pa'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu na bzhugs so/ /dus der chos (ngam rings/)sde chen po'i gdan sar bzhugs pa mkhan chen (sa skyar 'khrungs pa/)seng ge dpal bas rang gi bdog pa'i dngos po thams cad byams pa'i sku'i rgyur dmigs pa'i spong dag bzlas pa lan gsum du mdzad cing ci nas kyang khur bzhes 176

——snyesnye————sdurjizi2hūṃgudzisdu1༷rwarjikyisngasdurwa/—snye—————che ba gnang zhes grags la/ de'i gdan sar phebs pa'i mkhan chen don bzang rgyal mtshan pa la chos kyi rgyal bos bka' chos kyi 'brel ba tsam gsan la/ slar yang rgyal sras gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa dang /chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa'i drung gis bzang ldan na bzhugs pa'i (rje btsun byams pa'i/)gser sku de nyid kyang bzhengs/ (de'i gdan sar mkhas grub seng ge'i dbon po mkhan chen blo bzang ba/)(mnga' ris stod du 'khrungs/ 'di la chos kyi rgyal bos bka' 'brel zhus/ 'khrungs yul 'brog bud pa/ snga sor zhal slob yin la phyis bka' 'brel yod tsam gsan/) de rjes mkhan chen kun dga' ba/ de nas mkhan chen sangs rgyas seṅge bas mdzad/) bka' 'gyur byang brtsegs ma yang legs par grub rjes/ byams chen bzhengs nas lo bdun lon pa byi ba'i lo la bab pa na/chos rnams kun gyi snying bo ni/ /'jig rten las snang las bzlog nas/ /srid pa'i gnas la skyo bskyed de/ /'khor ba'i bde la yid rab 'byung / /gang yang chos kyi rgyal bo de/ /gang du srid 'di rab bskyangs nas/ /gang dag bya ba'i 'phro can yang / /gang gis bzhag nas bde bar gshegs/ /

dzo—snyebhege—snyetsond+rapasprusduhūṃrjosdund+rahūṃrdzutshisdutram̐dzisdutram̐tri—/—bhesnyesnye—ltas bzang ngo mtshar bye ba brgya/ /bltas pas ma tshim nam mkha'i 'ja'/ /bltas tsam nyid nas 'jig chos can/ /ltas nges mi rtag rab tu bskul/ /mig chus bsgribs pa'i rab rib mig /mthong mdzes chos rgyal de ma mthong / /yid 'byung skyo shas dub pa'i yid/ /de tshe der 'dus kun kyang de/ /zhes so/ /der dgongs dbyings yongs su skong ba'i dge tshogs rlabs po che bsgrub par mdzad skabs/ lho phyogs su dus lhag par gzings pa'i dbang las rigs ldan chen po ba nyid mi phebs ka med shar nas glo bur pho brang nas dpal ldan sdings kyi na khar en tsam gdan phab/ chos rgyal nam mkha' rdo rje sku na phra mo rang du bzhugs pa na/ thugs sna khrid pa'i bka'i bslab cha nan chags su stsal rjes de nub rang shel dkar phyogs su chibs kha bskyod de/ de'i nang sel gyi 'khon dbyung dang legs spel nyes bsubs gnang bas/dus skabs rnal du 'khod pa'i phan bde bsgrubs nas/ slar yang phyogs 'dir phebs zhes gtam du thos so/ /178

———snye————tram̐sduzipahūṃrjisbyisdu1rjorwasdukyisngasdurwa/—dzege——geblo—kye ma las nyon bsags pa'i sa bon dag /kun gzhi'i zhing la mi mngon gab pa'i tshul/ /rgyu rkyen chu lud nam zla'i dus kyi dbang / /dkar nag myu gu'i 'phel ba rim gyis thob/ /sna tshogs bya ba 'dus pa'i tshang tshing nags/ /srid pa'i bde sdug me tog so sor 'khrungs/ /rang rang myong nges mngar kha snga ma'i las /'bras bu'i 'phel ba du ma'i lo tog smin/ /sgyu lus phung bo'i dbyar khyim 'byung bzhi'i mkhar/ /col chung rig pa'i gnas bdag tshugs med ma/ /'phral 'grogs snang ba khrid pa'i zol sbyor gyis/ /dal 'byor nor bu'i tshong nyes de 'u byung / /yun ring mi gnas 'dus byas dngos po'i gshis/ /rtag 'dzin 'khor ba'i khong skran las ngan can/ /nges 'byung chos bzhin spyod pa'i sman mchog gis/ /sdug bsngal rtsad nas 'byin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes bya ba yang / chos la bskul ba'i bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o/ /slar yang rnam par thar ba'i byings nyid la 'jug par 179

dzo—bhe——snyesnyeskyashaṃ1dzirjond+rarjotsho2hūṃrngaskyarwatram̐sprisdutram̐sdu—/snyesnye—snye—bya ste/ de ltar chos rgyal dkon mchog legs pa yang zhi bar gshegs/bdag chen nam mkha' rdo rje ba'i drung yang sku na lhag par phra ba'i dbang las/ sde srid chen po'i bya ba la gang gi sgo nas kyang mdzad dka'i skabs nyid du thug kyang 'jig rten las snang sgyu ma'i zol tsam du gzigs pa'i dbang nyid las ci dga'i klong du dgongs te/ rang nyid kyi bgyi ba ni/ shambha la'i chos rgyal rigs ldan dag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i seṅge'i khri la g.yo ba med par/ dam pa'i chos kyi bya ba nyid rnyed pa'i mchog gya nom par thugs su chud nas nam du'ang chos smra ba'i ring lugs las skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par mdzad pa'i dbang las/ dus de tsam na mkhas pa'i mkhas par bgrangs su gtoṭa pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba kun kyang —/ chos la rjes su brten pa'i mos dge blun po'i dad ngor ma yin pas rgyud brlan te/ gang gi yid ches kyi snyim par/ bka'i bdud rtsi nos nas/ thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsos su longs spyod par mdzad do/ /180

dzo———ske—snye—sdurngirjorwand+razidzisdu1rjorwarji1sngarwarwa/——bhesnyesnyebhe—gsung gi bdud rtsis yongs su smin pa'i slob brgyud spel tshul/deltaragasangagibadudartsisayongasasasminapa'izhalaslobargyud ri sgo ri sgo 'grel la gsan pa mthar phyin pa yang ji snyed snang yang rags pa tsam gyi mtshan smos na/ rtse thang ba sangs rgyas lhun grub pas rigs ldan nyid las rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa'i 'grel ba gzhung phran mtha' dag gi bka' lung gi gsan pa mthar phyin nas/ dbus phyogs su phebs nas/ gra byams pa gling du/ rje yar dbon par grags pa/ paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgyal ba'i drung du/ rig gnas kyi bslab sbyang 'ga' la thugs kyi 'jug pa spyod par mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'phral gyi zhal 'phros la/ dpal ldan rgyud dang 'grel ba'i chos skad du ma rim gyis rim gyis glengs pas/ rje byams pa gling ba chen po'i zhal snga nas thugs lhag par dang ba stobs su gyur ba'i bka' stsal lhug par 'byon pa yang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'di nyid rgyud sde ma lus pa'i bla na bzhugs shing / rdo rje'i tshig mdud du bsdams pa'i rgyud ma lus pa'i gnad don 'grol zhing / phyi nang gis bsdus pa'i grub pa'i mtha' ci dang ci mchis pa'i nges gnas 'dir 181

dzo———snyesnye—skyaspra1sngasdund+rarjosdund+rasdind+raskyarwasdusprisdutram̐sprisnye/snyebhe———ma tshang ba med pas gcig shes kun grol nyid yin kyang phyogs re'i mig can mtha' dag gi ji ltar yang gting dpogs par mi spyod pas mkhas rlom dag kyang mgo 'thoms nas chos ma yin par 'dzin pa'i log shes rgya 'byams kyis/ skal ba dman pa'i khung bur ngang gis 'jug la/ lo tsā ba chos kyi mig can dag kyang don spyi tsam las/gnad don la 'bru 'jem par nges pa'i spobs pa ma rnyed pas/ gyi jo'i 'gyur mang nas shong 'gyur bar la yang rnam gzhag tha dad pa'i dbang ldan kho nar yod la/ shong la 'gro mgon 'phags pas kyang legs so stsal/ sngon chad ma rtogs log rtog the tshom gyi mun pas bsgribs pa kun sel ba'i dbugs dbyung gnang ba'i snyan pas sa steng ba kun gyis yid ches su 'dzin par gyur cing / thams cad mkhyen pa ba ston pas kyang shong 'gyur nyid 'chad dpe'i mthil du ༄mdzad nas/ 'dir mi bcos su mi rung ba sum cu so grangs tsam yod ces bka' stsal ba ltar/ kun mkhyen chen po dol bu sangs rgyas kyi lo tsā ba rnam gnyis la bka' bsgos nas 'gyur sar mdzad skabs sngar gyi bu ston gyis mchan bur btab pa'i 'gyur bcos kun thad sor bzhag de las don la rton pa'i dbang gis nges pa'i mthar thug rnams rang skad zur phyin par mdzad de/ dol mchan nyid kyi 182

—snyesnye———snye—sdusduzo2nd+raṭīsdusdu1skyarwasdukyisbyisdurwa/————snyesnye—gzer bur bsdams nas/ gnas don rgyas 'grel nges don rgya mtsho bstan pa spyi 'grel bka' bsdu bzhi ba sogs kyis gsal zhing gsal ba'i shing rta'i srol phye ba 'di las gud pa'i byang shambha la na yang dpal ldan rgyud la 'grel mdzad med nges snyam pa'i yid ches yod cing —/ bstan pa spyi'i sgo mtha' dag la 'chad rtsom gyi khur ba ston che ba tsam 'dug kyang / dus 'khor nyag gcig gi nges gsang 'doms pa'i skabs dol bu ba'i char mi bsgrun nges na'ang / kun mkhyen chen po nyid kyi mkhyen rab zab cing gting dpag dka' ba'i cha rnams slob ma'i gtso bor grags pa kun gyis kyang / ji bzhin du ma rtogs pa 'dra/ chos rje phyogs pas rnam gnyis 'gyur la dol mchan la skyogs pa'i mchan bu mdzad pa la/ sa bzang ma tis gzhung mchan nang 'gal ba'i skyon bzung rjes slar shong 'gyur la mchan mdzad/'di shar ba ye shes rgyal mtshan pa sogs kyis thugs mos kyi bsngags pa rgya cher gnang ba'i skyo mas yar ba mtha' dag yid bder 'dzin mod kyang 'di la yang ma ti'i gsung ltar gzhung mchan mi 'grig pa'i skyon gnas te/ de min na/ shong 'gyur las slad ma 'gyur gsar phye ba la dgongs pa ci yang med pas so/ /des na da lta'i chos rgyal rigs ldan gong gi gsung 'di kun ni/ padma dkar bo dngos kyi 183

——snye—ge—snyeXnd+rarjidzirjond+raXrdatshond+rasdind+radzirwatram̐skyarwatram̐kau—/snyesnyeske——bka' stsal nyid de/ nged rang gis sngar dpal ldan rgyud dang 'brel ba'i rtsom cung zad byas yod pa kun la nges par bcos dgos pa yang mang bar 'dug gsungs/ yig cha 'ga' re la gsar bcos kyang gnang / yang skabs shig shambha la'i tshad kyi 'bel gtam skabs/'di la shong 'gyur dpang bor mdzad pa/ chos rje phyogs pa'i gsung sgros yin na'ang / dus kyi 'khor lo'i skabs 'dir tshad ma'i skyes bu ni shes rab rgyal mtshan rang lags kyang gsungs shing / phyis lo chen bsod nams rgya mtshos dus kyi 'khor lo'i blos slangs dang / gser sku chen mo sogs kyi snyan pa bsgrags dus bre mo'i tshul du lo chen pas mi dus 'khor du song ba la thugs gzhig ma chug pa'i bzo'i dus 'khor la thugs ha las pa/ nged rang dbus pa gser dngul la mig chungs pa'i stabs kas yin gsungs/ yang chos rje rtogs ldan pas 'khrul sel ba dang rtsod pa la byon dus/ rje byams gling ba chen po'i gsung nas/ 'di dag la kho bos smra ba cig gleng na 'khrul sel ba'i rnam gzhag ma lus pa la bsdu tshoms ci yang mi yong nges kyang / chos rje yid bzang rtse ba'i drung gis dge bshes nang gi chags sdang du dgongs yong yang gsung zer zhing / mdor na rtse thang ba sangs rgyas lhun grub pas/ rigs ldan chen po'i bzhed pa lha'i rnga sgras mkhas pa 184

——————snyesnyetram̐rjirjo2nd+rasprasbyisdu1dzisdusdukyisbyisdurwa/————snye—mimang bo'i snyan du dgyes pa'i rol mo rgya cher bsgrags so/ /de dag la yang 'di skad ces/gang gsung dbyar skyes rnga yi sgra dbyangs dag /thos pas rab dga' rig gnas gtsug phud can/ /dad pa'i spu long bye ba rab g.yos nas/ /ngo mtshar bsngags pa'i 'jo sgeg rol gar sgyur/ /rab zab rgyal ba'i zhal chems gab pa'i bka'/ /sa bcu'i rgyal ba'i sras po'i snyan bzhugs gang / /skal ldan yid la re ba'i nges gnas su/ /sprul ba'i drang srong tshogs la rjes su gdams/ /de nas gangs ris bskor ba'i yul ljongs 'dir/ /grub pa'i skyes bu brgyud mas legs drangs te/ /lo paṇa gyis gzigs mkhas la grags pa'i chos/ /rtsod pa kun bral shing rta'i srol chen yin/ /gting mtha' mi dpogs rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho'i byings/ /blo chung khu ta'i stobs kyis ma brgal nas/ /rang snang grub mtha'i skad ngan sgrog pa yi/ /kha gdangs rgyal la co 'dri smra ba bzhin/ /185

——snye——snyesnyeskyand+rapasngarwand+radzisdu3sdigluXrwatram̐skyarwatram̐kausnye/snye————sgyur byed rim pas ma rtogs sbas pa'i cha/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i spyan yangs shong ston dang / /rton pa bzhi ldan tshul gyi gsar 'gyur du/ /bsgyur mkhas lo chen nyi zla zung gnyis lags/ /gzhung gzhan shes ngor 'dren pa'i kyog bshad kyis/ /rgyud 'grel dri mar byed pa'i mdzes chos mkhan/ /drang nges so sor 'byed pa'i mthu med pa/ /de dag rgya mtsho'i 'gram gnas yi dwags nyid/ /sngar sbyangs grub mtha'i bag chags 'thas pa'i blos/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i thugs mtsho las/ /legs byung yid bzhin nor bu rin chen dang / /'od ldan mching bu mnyam 'dzin byis pa'i tshul/ /bshes gnyen ngan pa'i gdon gyis btab pa 'ga'/ /phyi rol bstan chos tsam du 'dzin byed mod/ /lha mi'i ston pa'ang mu stegs dman pa yis/ /g.yo can drang srong go 'u ta mar sgrog /thos tshod bon gyer phal ba'i srol dor te/ /dpyad pa gsum gyi lung rigs la brten nas/ /186

————snye——ge—tram̐rjirjorwand+raspyasbyisdusprurjorwasdu1sngasdurwa/bhesnyebhe—dze—snye—chos dang chos min 'byed la mthu thob pa/ /shes rab sgron mes bdag rgyud gang gyur cig /rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pas kyang rigs ldan chen po nyid las—/ rgyud 'grel gyi gsan pa mthar phyin par gnang zhing mus srad kyi spe'ur/ dpal ldan rgyud las bshad pa ltar chu'i 'phrul 'khor gyis gyen du chu 'dren pa'i sgyu ma'i rol rtsed kyang ston par mdzad la/paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan pa'i gsung las kyang chos rje rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i masmo yangs 'dis rigs ldan padma dkar bo'i bshad srol nyid la phu dud du bskyangs pa yin na spyi sgos kun gyi bstan pa nyi ma shar ba 'dra ba zhig yong nges pa la/ sa skya ba gsar rnying gi dbye 'byed ban bun 'dis thugs brel ba rang zhig byung 'dug kyang gsangasazhesagatamaduthosal rjedeganyisaka'ithagasasrasaminyagari zhu ba ring chos grags dpal bzang bas kyang / rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal po'i zhabs pad la btud de/ rgyud 'grel la gsan pa rgya cher gnang zhing slad nas rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa'i drung la yang / rtsis sogs lhag mar gyur pa'i bslab sbyang thams cad rdzogs par mdzad/ paṇa chen pa la yang dri mal gyi sgo nas nan tan du thugs la rjen par gyur skabs—/ gting skyes sogs su gdul byar gyur pa'i shes ldan mang bo 187

sgrosnyesnye———bhedzorwa1dzisdund+rarjoku2sdind+ramathaXrdzurjosdusbyoskyasnye/snye——snye4la rgyud 'grel gyi 'gro don 'phel rgyas mdzad la/ phyis paṇa chen pa dang mjal nas chos gtam gyi dgyes pa lhur gnang ba'i tshe gsung las / nged rang gi mi nyag pa'i dpal ldan rgyud las thog mar 'jig rten khams le la go ba mthar phyin skyes/ /dbang le sgrub le'i shar chog pher tsam byung 'dug kyang / nang le la yid gnyis phyang mor spyod pa dang ye shes le'u'i gnas don gyi dri mi bro ba gda' zhes bre mo'i tshul gyis bzhad cha gnang zhes kyang grags la/ de mthun chos rje mi nyag pas dbus phyogs su/ sgra'i gsan sbyong ched lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i drung du phebs/ zhabs tog kyang bsam las 'das pa gnang / khyed lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ bstan pa la gces pa yin zhes bsngags pa rgya cher stsal/ de mtshams sgra rig sogs kyi thugs bzhed yod tshul snyan du zhus pas/ chos rje rab 'byams pa/da lta'i tshe thung 'di la tha snyad sad sud la nan sbyor gyis dal 'byor ming stong gnang bas gang la yong / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rab 'byams kyi nges gnas ma lus pa gcig tu bsdus pa'i glegs bam gcig bu/sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi zhal chab kyis yongs su bzung ba 'di dag la dang ba'i dad pas mgo btud de nyal na'ang theg pa gzhan du ring mor sbyangs pa las byang chub la nye ba kho na yin gsungs shing /188

——blo————snyesdurjizirwand+raspyadzisdurjirjorwarji'isngarwarwa/———————paṇa chen nags rin las brgyud pa'i rnal 'byor yan lag drug gi myong khrid yang spus bsgyur du stsal zhes grags la/ de skabs su dpon slob phan tshun rigs ldan mchog gi dgongs pa dang / chos rje yid bzang rtse ba'i bzhed pa 'khrul sel lugs las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam khor mor mdzad skabs/ rje mi nyag pas res 'ga' rigs pa'i nga ro mthon po'i gad brgyangs ches cher sgrog par yang mdzad la/lo chen pas logs su bka' lung 'byon pa la/ byang gi chos rgyal de rigs ldan padma dkar bo slar byon kho nar 'dug dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i phyi nang gzhan gsum la ji bzhin gzigs pa'i nges gsang phun sum tshogs pas thugs rgyud yongs su gang ba rang kho na'i dbang las grub pa'i mtha'i skyong tshul yang ji tsam pa'i mkhas par ming bzhag pa dag gis kyang phyogs tsam yang bsgrun par mi dpogs pa nyid du gnas zhes rgya cher bsngags pa'i ched du brjod par mdzad ces thos la/ slad nas chos rje mi nyag pas paṇa chen rin po che'i drung du phebs skabs kyang chos kyi 'beel gtam gnang dus/ da dung yang gnyug ma'i don la thugs kha ma phyogs pa 'dra gsung ba'i zhal kyal gsungs pas/ mi nyag pa'i gsung las gang byas kyang chos dbyings bden grub la nges pa 'drongs pa rang zhig mi yong bar 189

———snye—snye—skyarwa1sngarwand+razosdu2sdirwatshisdusduskyasdutram̐sdu—/ —sne—snye—'dug lags zhus pas/ ya ya 'o na rang zab lam gyi thugs myong yod yod gnang ba 'di yang ci 'dra lags sam gsungs pa la/ de rtags kyi 'char sgo khyad par can la nges shes yang dag rang 'drongs pa'i dbang gis yin zhu ba la/ paṇa chen pa phyag se gol thog gnang nas—/ de ka chos nyid ma 'khrul ba'i tshad ma ye shes snang ba'i rang gzugs rjen pa lags mod kyang gsungs zhes zhib par thos pa ltar bris pa'o/ /paṇa chen pa nyid kyis kyang glo bor bzhugs dus nas zhu yig gis 'brel ba'i sne sbyor yang yang mdzad rjes/ phyi lam byang gi phyogs la gnang nas thog mar/ ngam rings kyi chos grwa chen po 'di nyid du/ dbyar chos stengs su phebs mkhan chen spo ra ba (bar phug tu 'khrungs/)'jigs med grags pa bzhugs pa la/ bstan pa'i bgyi ba la dgongs nas bslab phyag sogs kyis sri zhu che bar gnang rjes sngar mnga' ris nas phul ba'i sdom gsum gyi dri mal las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam kho nas dus 'da' ba gnang zhing / byis pa'i slob gnyer ba sum brgya tsam gyis grwa skor grub rjes/ chos rgyal sprul ba'i sku mjal ba la lhun grub sdings su phebs/ mjal tsam nas mkhas pa mkhas pa'i nang na mdzes pa'i tshul du phan tshun thugs ye shes kyi 'jug pa ro gcig pa nyid du gyur cing / der chos kyi rgyal 190

——snye—snye——snyetram̐rngurjo3nd+raspradzirwakrurjorwarngeglusngasprarwa/———————bos sa sde la mu mthud pa'i dris mal rim can du gnang ba rnams paṇa chen pas dpyis phyin pa'i zab bshad phul bas dgyes pa rab kyi mthar son zhing / paṇa chen pa nyid kyis kyang dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag che rags ma lus pa la sngar nas thugs the tshom mchis pa re re nas dris mal zhus pas ci la'ang chags thogs ma mchis pa'i bka' stsal rjes su bzung bas rgyud 'grel dbu zhabs la thugs bskyed mu 'brel ba'i dgongs dbyings kyi re ba yid bzhin du 'byor bar gyur te/ paṇa chen pa'i gsung las/ nged rang byis pa'i dus/rje don yod dpal ba'i phyag phyi byas/ mkhan chen padma bzang bo ba mjal ba la phyin pa'i gral la/ mkhan chen pa'i gsung nas/ slob dpon pa/ byams chos bar ba gsum gyi dgongs pa gang du gnas gsung gin yod gsungs pa la/ rje don yod dpal bas nged sems tsam du gnas zhu yin yod lags gsungs pa la/ de'i rgyu mtshan gang yin gsungs pa la/ sems las gzhan med par ni blos rig nas/zhes lung 'dren mdzad kyin 'dug pa la/ 'o na de'i mjug rang na/blo dang ldan pa gnyis ka med rig nas/ sogs shar te gsungs nas 'di rnams ci lags/ nged cag ni dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/byams chos kyi dgongs don dbu ma chen po'i shing rta rma med pa nyid 191

dzo———snye—rdzidzospra1sngasdund+rarjotsho2sdirdzutshisdusdusprisdutram̐kau—/———snye—du 'grel ba yin gsungs shing / de nga la gzigs nas/ dbon chung shes rab 'dug pa 'di 'dra'i skor la gzhig pa chug cig ces ja'i gsol ras kyang gnang ba de dus man nas nges don la gzhig 'brel chug pa yin kyang grub mtha'i gzhung shin tu bsgril ba'i bstan bcos su zhib rgyas rang 'khod pa med/ than thun ngag nas smras pa tsam yin / slar nas rigs ldan chen po ba'i bka'i bsgo ba thob phyir rtsal 'don du bskyangs pa yin no/ /zhes yang yang 'dus pa'i dbus su bka' stsol bar grags shing / paṇa chen rin po che nyid kyis mnga' ris su ma phebs gong gi thugs rtsom dang / de'i man ngag gi thugs rtsom rnams shes rab kyi mig gis bltas na so sor nges pa 'drongs pa yod la/ de dus/ dus bzhi cig car ba dang rim gyis pa'i skabs/chos kyi rgyal bo nyid kyis na bza' ber gyi phu dung brjes te/ thal 'gyur 'phen len yang mdzad la/ paṇa chen pa'i gsung gis kyang gzigs pa dri med kyi chos spyan dag pas rigs pa'i tsher ma tsam la'ang rtog ge la yun ring sbyangs pas rngo mi thogs pa'i/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pa yang mkhyen pa'i yul du sa ler 'dug gsungs skad cing / slad nas dad pa gsum gong nas gong du 'phar ba'i shugs kyis/ sdom pa che chung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i 192

————dze—————tram̐rjirjo3nd+raguXsdu1rjosdusdukyisdusdurwa/4bhege——4dze————bka' drin yang nod nas mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen po'i yul du bkur bar mdzad de/ ched du brjod pa'i bstod pa yang phul/ zhu mchid kun la'ang/ gcom bskyungs pa'i zhe sa bla na ma mchis pas yongs su bsngags par gnang ngo / /de dag la yang 'di ltar/bka' stsal bdud rtsi'i zil mngar ro brgya bas/ /blo gros dbang bo rgyas pa'i rkang drug pa/ /legs bshad glu dbyangs sgrog pa'i dar dir ngag /'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i ljongs su khyab par rgyu/ /rdo rje theg pa'i zab don 'byed pa la/ /rab sbyangs blo ldan rgyal srid skyong ba bzhin/ /nyin mtshan g.yel ba med par brtson pa'i mthus/ /zhib mor dpyod pa'i mnga' dbang mchog tu gyur/ /rgyud rgyal las bshad ngo mtshar rig pa'i sgo/ /chu rgyun gyen du 'dren pa'i mig 'phrul gyis/ /shes ldan yid ches dga' bskyed mdzad pa'i 'phrul/ /ya mtshan sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin rjes su bstan/ /chos smra'i khyu mchog nyid du rab grags gang / /dpal mgon mi dbang che la yongs btud de/ /193

——ge——snyesnyeskyatram̐kyisprusdund+rarjorjo2sdind+raXrwardzusprisdutram̐kausnye/———snye—bka' drin bzang bos 'tsho ba'i legs bshad kyis/ /gzur gnas mkhas pa'i snying la mgron du sbyin/ /rig gnas gdong lnga'i nga ro'i gad rgyangs can/ /mkhyen yangs ral ba'i khur chen g.yur za ba/ /bstan 'dzin ri dwags skyong ba'i rgyal bo de'ang / /khyod zhabs 'degs pa'i ngal ba lhur len to/ /mkhas pa mkhas pas legs bkur ba/ /blun pos blun ngor gcam bu'i zol/ /phyogs lhags phyogs bcu'i bsngags pa'i yul/ /rang yul rang gi dpon tsam 'dzin/ /'dab rgyas ze 'brur son pa'i bcud/ /ring 'ongs rkang drug ldan pas myangs/ /nya sbal padmo'i drung gnas pas/ /yun du 'khod kyang ga la myong / /gang gi yon tan ma la'i dris/ /phyogs mtha'i khyon yangs ma lus khyab/ /zhabs rten dri bzang gis sbags pa/ /sa 'dir bsnam bya'i dper 'dzin 'ga'/ /194

dzo———————sdurngizi2nd+rarngisdusdu1skyasdurngekyisngarwarwa/—bhe——snye——zhes so/ /rang srid kyi khyon 'dir zhal slob kyi gtso bor gyur pa/bdag nyid chen po slob dpon dpal ldan chos skyong mi 'phrogs pa'i mkhyen rab can/ rang rigs kyi thig le 'chang ba nyid kyis dbu mdzad pa'i mkhan slob che rags/ bla ma so so ba dag dang / dpal jo mo nang gi gdan sa 'dzin pa/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' chos skyong zhes mtshan du grags pa chos kyi rgyal bo nyid la mi phyed dad pa'i thugs can des mtshon pa'i phyogs kyi bla ma che dgu so so dang /byams pa gser mchog 'od dpal la sogs pa/ rigs ldan chos kyi rje bo nyid la sangs rgyas dngos su mthong ba'i mos ldan ri khrod pa bgrang ba las 'das pa dag dang tsha sna ba bsam gtan rgya mtsho sogs nyams rtogs mthar phyin pa'i rnal 'byor ba dpag med bskrun cing / dbang brgyud kyi srol 'dzin ni smon lam dag pa'i legs byas kyi dbang las/ shangs ston kun dga' dpal ldan las paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mnos te/ de nyid kyis rjes su bzung ba'i lo paṇa mched gnyis las 'phel rgyas su gyur pa 'di nyid yin zhing / de las gzhan mo rtsis dang sman dpyad dag gi srol skyong ba'i zhal slob yang slob nying slob yongs sa rgyas pas sa steng stokhyab par gyur to/ /195

——snye————dzospra1dzisdund+ra rjosdu2sdigludzisduṇaskyasdutram̐sprisnye/ ————4rang rigs thig phreng dkar bo'i 'od 'dzin gang / /mkhyen yangs phul byung grub chen bi rī ba/ /gang gi zhal slob nyid kyang de de la/ /blo gros mkha' 'dra'i bsngags pa rgya cher gnang / /thub bstan shar ri'i rtser 'khod bstan 'dzin gyi/ /mkhyen brtse'i nyi zla du ma'i cod pan rtser/ /khyed zhabs bkra shis rtags kyis rol mdzad cing / /rang rang rigs kyi dbang bo mchog tu bkur/ /gzhan yang grub pa'i rjes zhugs rnal 'byor dbang / /nyams myong rtogs pa'i gar bsgyur mtha' yas dang / /mos dge'i bsod nams dpal 'dzin bka' 'bangs ni/ /skal ldan bye ba'i rgyu skar bgrang yas bskrun/ /theg pa'i mthar thug dus kyi 'khor lo nas/ /sman dpyad mo rtsis bar gyi rig gnas la/ /gdul bya rang rang bsam pa bzhin drangs te/ /kun kyang mkhas dang grub pa'i sa la bzhag /mtha' yas shes bya'i yul la rjes dpogs pa'i/ /thams cad gzigs khyed tshad ma'i skyes bu ste/ /196

dzo———————sdurjikrond+rand+raspyadzisdu1rjorwazekyisprarwarwa/snye——————snyigs dus mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dpal/ /bskal bzang 'dren par bsam bzhin byon pa nyid/ /gang gang yongs la sbyangs pa'i tshul bstan nas/ /1 1ra blo bzang rjes su rab drangs te/ /yang yang 'chad mkhas gsung gi phan bde yis/ /sdogs phyogs 'dus pa'i dga' ston rgya cher spel/ /ces—/ de ltar 'chad pa'i tshul las ched du brjod mthar slad nas kyang rtsod pa'i khyu mchog gi mdzad pa yang / dngos su mjal ba'i skyes bu kun la dus khor mor bstan pa'i gzhung lam las 'ongs pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'bel gtam gyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba gnang zhing —/ de nyid kyi tshul gyis/ gang bla mar gyur pa zhu bar 'os pa dang /phyogs kyi bstan 'dzin mkhyen gsol thob pa dang / blo gsal yid gzhungs springs par 'os pa dag la dus rgyun mi 'chad du bka' dang bstan bcos rab 'byams mdo dang sngags kyis bsdus pa ma lus shing lus pa ma mchis pa dag dang / de las gzhan rgyal ba'i bka'i grangs su gtogs pa dang / bstan bcos kyi char gtogs pa phra mo 197

dzosnye——snye—skeXnd+ra1sngasdund+radrisdu2nd+rand+radzisdutram̐skyasdutram̐skya—/ ———snye—tsam la'ang khungs dang 'brel ma 'brel bka' 'gyur bstan 'gyur sgrig po tshad ldan dag gis spyan ras gzigs ma gzigs/ phyi mo'i stabs kyis dbus gtsang phan tshun du 'phel che chung re re nas/ gang la'ang dka' tshegs la mi bstos par dag nges ma tshang ba kha skong ba/ma dag pa rnams kyang ngos 'dzin phur tshugs rgyu mtshan dang bcas pas gnang zhing / gsang sngags nang gi 'phrul 'khor zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las so so ba la yang / gsang sngags snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur phan tshun nang sel tha dad gnas pa dag kyang / re re nas de dang de'i gnas la byang chub dag la dri mal nan tan mdzad nas nges gsal ma 'dres par phye/ de las gzhan phyi rol ba'i dbyangs 'char sogs kyi 'khor lo rnams kyang / phyi nang ma 'dres pa'i ngos 'dzin 'them pa gnang zhing gsung rab las brtsams pa'i che rags kyi dgag sgrub yi ger bkod pa gnang ba'i gzhung lugs che ba dang dris lan phra mo so so'i mtshan ni rtsom pa'i skabs su 'byung la mdor na rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud nas brtsams te sman dpyad la/ sman gyi dri ro nus pa skye yul gyi dbang las bzang ngan ming 'dogs so so skad tha dad pas bsgyur pa'i gnas phra mo tshun gyi bar dang / rig gnas gzhan la'ang de bzhin du zhib cha gnang nas/ dag ma dag so sor 198

dzo———————sdurjizirwahūṃspyaXsdu1༷rwadrikyisngasdund+ra/———————'byed pa'i 'phrul bskyed par mdzad do/ /gang dag 'di na rang chags grub mtha'i blos/ /gzhan dag la smod gshung ba lhur len pa/ /chos spong rtsod par rlom pa'i sdig lta yis/ /phan bde dge ba'i rtsa ba drungs nas phyung / /'phags yul nas drangs gangs can ljongs byon pa'i/ /rgyal ba'i bka' dang de yi dgongs 'grel gzhung / /ji snyed ji bzhin spyan gyis nyer dgongs nas/ /chos dang chos min 'byed la bsnyengs bral gyur/ /tshad ldan shing rta che chung mtha' dag gis/ /rang rang dgos pa de de bzhin bskyangs nas/ /drang nges ma phyed gzu lum smra ba'i ngag /ldib po gang dag chos las bcos par bstan/ /kye ma yid ngo'i legs legs nyi tshe la/ /zom por spyod pa'i khungs med grub mtha'i tshig /lu ba bsdoms pa'i snying bo ltar dgongs nas/ /gzugs brnyan tsam gyi bstan par rjes su bsgrags/ /don la rton pa'i nges gsang rigs pa'i mda'/ /199

dzosnyesnyesnye———spyond+rarjisngasdund+rarjosdu2sdigludzind+rardzusprisdutram̐tri—/ —————mkhas rlom dregs pa'i snying la rab bsnun tshe/ /drang don yid kyi brtan pa kun nyams nas/ /mi smra'i ngang du brgyal te gum pa lags/ /bka' yig 'brug sgra'i pho nya'i rnga sgra yis/ /gzur gnas char sdod bye 'u rab tshim ste/ /bsngags 'os skyes bu bstod pa'i snyan pa'i sgra/ /ca co'i rang sgra myur du sgrog par mdzad/ /dru ta (pho nya/)blo gsal rtsod pa'i khyu mchog des/ /'khrul sel 'khrul ba'i lam du rjes bstan nas/ /pad dkar zhal lung ming can ming tsam gyi/ /brjod ngor shes ldan (rtogs ldan pas) yongs la gsal bar byas/ /zhes rtsod pa'i tshul las ched du brjod pa'i rab tu bsngags pa'i tshigs su bcad pa spel ba'i skabs so/ /bstod pa sogs gsung rtsom spel tshul/da ni rnam thar gyi gtso bo lta bur gyur pa de ltar 'chad pa dang rtsod pa'i go rim nyid kyis yang yang byi dor mdzad pa'i thugs mtshor snang brnyan yi ger 'phos pa'i rtsom pa nor bu'i phreng ba spel ba'i 200

dzo——snye———snyesdurngiX2nd+ragusdusdu1༷sdu2kyisngasdurwa/—snyesnyesnye—snye—tshul yang / spyi dang khyad par zhar byung du mdzad pa las/ thog mar bstan pa spyi'i gnas las bsgrags par mdzad pa yang / 1 de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rabs/ bde bar gshegs pa'i bla na med pa'i ye shes la mnyam rjes gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa nges don gsal ba/ 2 cho 'phrul chen po las brtsams te de bzhin gshegs pa la bstod pa'i rab byed/ 3 gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgo nas bstod pa/ 4de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan re re yang pha rol tu phyin pa drug sbyar ba/ 5 thub pa'i skyes rabs bstod pa/ 6sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i bstod pa utpa la'i phreng ba/ 7 sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga'i sku mdog dang / phyag mtshan gyi brjed byang / 8 byang chub lhung bshags 'don pa'i tshul/ 9 de nyid 'don pa'i man ngag thar lam gsal byed/ 10 'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug gi bstod pa/ 11 'phags pa zhal bcu gcig pa'i bstod pa padma dkar bo'i phreng ba/ 12 'jam dbyangs dkar bo'i sgrub thabs—/ 13 dze tā ri'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi bsgrub dkyil/14mdo sde lta ba'i man ngag 15 mdo sde'i brjed byang la nye bar mkho ba'i lung btus lung gi snye ma/ 16 yang mdo sde'i brjed byang la nye bar mkho ba'i lung gi phreng ba/ 17 'phags pa bden pa chen 201

——ge—snye——dzorwa2dzisdund+rarjosdu2sdind+radzirwatram̐kausdutram̐skyasnye/ ———snye—po'i le'u'i don gtso che che rnams btus pa/ 18 sangs rgyas sa bcu ba zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo'i snying bo btus pa/ 19 gzungs bsdus kyi brjed byang / 20 'dul ba lung gi brjed byang /21 rgyal bo nor bzang gi rtogs brjod/ 22 rtogs brjod bcu ba/23 chos kyi rnam grangs ngan song sgo 'gegs/ 24gsung rab zab brgya'i snying bo bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ 25 dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab kyi ṭīkka mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan/ 26 chos dbyings bstod pa'i 'grel ba dri med snang ba/ 27 rnam bshad rigs pa'i snying bo bsdus pa bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ 28 sdom gsum gsal ba'i me long /29 gnas gsum sogs kyi bshad pa/ 30 mtshan nyid rigs kyi bstan bcos/ 31 sngags kyi rigs kyi bstan bcos/ 32 gsang snying rgyud rnam dag tu bsgrub pa/ 33 nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig bsdus pa/ 34dgyes pa rdo rje'i rdzogs rim lam dus/ 35 sa skya 'khon gyi gdung rabs rnams so/ /rtsis kyi balhan bcos sogs matred tshul/gnyis pa khyad par du/ sngon chad mkhas pa'i mkhas par grags pa dag gis kyang ji bzhin dpag par ma nus pa'i/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la/ nan tan gyis thugs rtsom rgya cher gnang ba yang /202

———snye——bhesdurnguzirwand+razispul sduspruXrwasdukyisngasdurwa/bhebhesnyebhe——rdzidapal ldan rgyud 'grel gyi thog ma'i le'u gnyis kyi don 'grel gyi dbang du mdzad nas/1 rtsis kyi bstan bcos byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa/ 2 grub pa'i mtha'i rtsis lugs chen mo shin tu gsal bar byed pa yid bzhin nor bu'i phreng ba/ 3 gza' 'dzin brtag pa'i dka' ba'i gnas shin tu rgyas par bshad pa/ 4yul drug dus sbyor so so'i rgyu mtshan/5 rtsis kyi bstan bcos dri ma med pa'i nor bu/ 6 rtsis gzhi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 7 byed rtsis 'ga' zhig 8 bskal ba'i sgra gcan re'u mig 9 rgyud kyi dgongs pa gsal bar byed pa'i 'bras rtsis sna tshogs kyi bshad pa/ 10 rtsis kyi nges ster rin chen phreng ba/ 11 gza' lnga myur ster sgrub thabs/ 12 drag gza' gsum gyi myur ster re'u mig 13 lnga bsdus dag pa gcig thog re'u mig 14gza' stong 'jug brtsi tshul legs bshad dri med/ 15 rnam par dag pa'i lnga bsdus/ 16 stong 'jug 'khor lo'i lo grangs bsgrub tshul re'u mig dang bcas pa/ 17 bskal chen gyi tshad kyi deb rtsis/ 18 bod kyi dus sbyor rnam dag 19 bod kyi dus sbyor rnam dag gi rgyu mtshanaske/ 20 nyi zla gza' 'dzin brtag pa'i thabs/ 21 nyi ma gza' 'dzin brtag pa'i thabs/ 22 rtsis gzhi rin po che'i gter 203

dzosnyege————dzospra1sprusdund+radrisdurwasdind+radzirwasdusprisdusbyoskya—/ ——snyesnye—mdzod—/ 23 'khrul med sme ba'i ngos 'dzin/ 24grangs kyi gnas gzhan dang bskal ba'i lo grangs kyi rtsis/ 25 bskal ba'i li tho than stomong ma yin pa bskal ba'i cha shas re'u mig dang bcas pa/ 26 gza' 'dzin brtag dka' ba'i gnas shin tu rgyas bshad dang bcas pa/ 27 nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi yig chung nyi skar 'char tshul gyi dus mtshams ngos 'dzin/ 28 dag pa gcig thog gi re'u mig bsgrub tshul dang nyin rtsis bya tshul/ 29 rtsis gzhi rin po che'i phreng ba—/ 30 rtsis kyi bstan bcos yang dag mkhas pa dga' byed/ 31 go la'i skabs kyi rgya cher 'grel ba/ 32 dus sbyor gyi 'bras rtsis 'ga' zhig 33 dus rnams gsal bar byed pa'i rtsis kyi bgyi ba dus gsal/ 34bskal ba'i dhra ba chen po sogs kyi re'u mig 35 go la zung bdun sogs kyi shog khra/ 36 las chen bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo/ 37 las tshogs sna tshogs kyi khyad par rnam 'byed/ 38 dbyangs dang gsal byed dgra grogs brtsi ba/ 39 las sna tshogs kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par rnam 'byed/ 40 byis pa gso thabs/41 shambha la'i tshad/ 42 mkhas grub chos rje'i 'jig rten khams le dang ske/ nang le'i ṭīkhri'i rtsod lan rnams so//gnyis pa dbang le dang bsgrub le'i don 'grel gyi dbang du 204

——————tro sdunghruXrwahūṃṭīdzisdu1rjorwarjisdidzoXsdurwa/bhesnyeskebhe———mdzad nas/ 1 dbang chog bde ba chen po'i chu rgyun/ 2 bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ 3 yang bdag 'jug gcig 4sngags kyi bslab bya nor bu'i phreng ba/ 5 rtsa ltung bcu bzhi'i bshad pa/ 6 rgyud 'grel las gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbye ba/ 7 sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgrub thabs shin tu rgyas pa dngos grub bsam 'phel/ 8 de nyid kyi dka' 'grel lung rigs rgya mtsho/ 9 sgrub thabs dngos grub gter mdzod/10 de'i don 'grel bdud rtsi'i thigs pa/ 11 sgrub thabs yid bzhin nor bu/ 12 yongs rdzogs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs de kho na nyid kyi snying bo/ 13 thugs dkyil sgrub thabs/ 14lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs/ 15 lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ 16 lha dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ 17 lhan skyes sgrub thabs/ 18 yang shin tu bsdus pa rang cig 19 dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can gyi sgrub thabs/20 dus 'khor rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu/ 21 sgrub thabs de nyid kyi dka' ba'i gnas 'grel byed—/ 22 bsrung 'khor sbas don gsal ba/ 23 'khor lo sdom chen gyi lha tshogs bstod bskul/ 24drag po'i 'phrin las mdor bsdus—/ 25 bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gsal 'debs/ 26 bsrung 205

—dze——bhegeskyarwa1dzirwand+radzisdupasdind+radzirwand+raskyasdutram̐skyage/—ge———'khor gyi lha gsal 'debs rgyas pa/ 27 28 'khor lo gsum gyi sdom pa'i sgrub thabs cha gnyis/ 29 gsang ba 'dus pa lha dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ 30 'dus pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ 31 'dus pa lha bcu dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ 32 'dus pa lha nyi shu rtsa lnga ma'i sgrub thabs/ 33 'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/34'dus pa lha sum cu rtsa bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs/ 35 sgyu dra lha bzhi bcu rtsa gsum ma'i sgrub thabs/ 36 sgyu dra lha bzhi bcu rtsa lnga ma'i sgrub thabs/ 37 sgyu dra lha bzhi bcu rtsa dgu ma'i sgrub thabs/ 38mkha' lding gi rgyal bo'i sgrub thabs/ 39 klu'i rgyal bo'i sgrub thabs skye dgu'i lo tog rnam par 'phel ba/ 40 char 'bebs las tshogs dri med/ 41 rnal 'byor ma so drug gi mchod chog 42 rab gnas bkra shis dpal 'bar 43 gshin chog ngan song rgyun gcod/ 44las bcu'i sbyin sreg gi thig rtsa/ 45 zhi ba las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 46 rgyas pa las thams cad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 47 zhi rgyas las so so'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 48 dbang du byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 49 dgug par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga50 gsod par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 51 bskrad pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 52 rmongs par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 53 206

————ske———tram̐rjizi2nd+razidzisdu1rjorwasduzisbyisdurwa/———snyesnyesnye—rengs par byed pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga ste/ (phyi ma 'di rnams la mtshan byang rdo rje 'bar ba'i me 'od kho nar yod/) 54yongs rdzogs kyi sngags phreng rnams so/ /gsum pa ye shes le'u'i yang don 'grel du/ 55lus dkyil sgom tshul/56 rdzogs rim lam dus/ 57 zab lam sngon 'gro'i khrid rim—/ 58 thog mar dge ba/59 bar du dge ba 60 tha mar dge ba rnams kyi khrid yig 61 sbyor drug sras don mar grags pa/ 62 'od gsal gsang don rab gsal/ 63 bsgom chos nges don snying bo—/ 64bla ma brtson rgyal ba'i bstod pa/ 65 gsol 'debs lam rim—/ 66 rang sems yongs su 'dul ba'i chos 67lam rim nges don gsal bar byed pa 'od zer brgya ba rnams so/ /de ltar le'u so so'i gnad don dka' ba'i cha shas zhib rgyas su dkrol nas spyir bsdoms la/ rgyud la 'jug pa'i brda chad kyi tshoms shes bya gsal ba/ rgyud 'grel rags pa'i brjed byang / mdor bsdus dang bo'i rnam bshad/ nges don bdud rtsi'i nying khu/ dka' 'grel rdo rje'i tshig gi mdud 'grol/ rgyud 'grel gyi brjed byang zhib mo ste/nang don rig gnas thun mong ma yin pa'i tshogs gsungs nas/gsum pa thun mong ba'i zhar byung du spel legs kyi bka' stsal 207

snye—ske—snyesnyedzorwasdudzisdund+radrirjorwasdind+raspyaXtram̐sprisdutram̐skyasnye/ snye——snye—yang / sgra rig la ka lā ba'i mdo rgyan/ bzo rig pa'i gnas la de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi phyag tshad/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad snyan ngag gtam brgyud du gleng ba gaṅga'i chu rgyun/ dkon mchog legs pa mya ngan bsal ba'i rab byed rtsa 'grel/ phrin du mngags pa'i snyan tshig gi 'phreng mdzes/ rje btsun thams cad mkhyen pa phyogs las rnam rgyal la yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba sogs rnam grangs bdun tsam dang / dbus gong ma chen po/ spyan snga rin po che/ mkhan chen bsod nams bzang bo/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa/ slob dpon dge sdings pa chen po/ grub chen kun blo/ (zhu yig tu 'a.a pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bka' 'grel yang gsan/) lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho la snyan ngag tu gnang ba'i bka' shog dag dang / mkhas grub chos rje la rtsod lan snga phyir springs pa gsum/ chos rje gzhon dpal la dri ba gnang ba dang / dri ba zhus pa'i skor rnam grangs drug tsam/ gzhan paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan pa/ rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan pa/ bka' bcu shes rab dpal/ shangs pa ngag dbang grags pa sogs kyis dri ba phul ba'i lan dang / chos rje dge 'dun grub la dri ba 'ga' zhig gnang ba/ nor bu gling gi lha chen dkar chag rnams la snyan ngag gi tshom bus spras pa rnams/ sdebs legs kyi tshig gi sbyor bas bcings 208

—blo—————ge—tram̐rjirjo2rnga1dzisdu1rjorwarjikyizisdurwa/bheskesnyege———par mdzad nas/ tshig rgyan dang ming gi mngon brjod ston pa'i mtshon dper gnang ba dag dang /gso ba rig pa'i gsung rtsom mdzad tshul/gso ba rig pa la/ yan lag brgyad pa thams cad kyi snying bo bsdus pa yid bzhin nor bu rin po che zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos le'u brgya nyi shu tham pa yod pa zhig dang / rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi bshad pa rgyud don gsal byed sgron me/ bshad rgyud kyi ṭīka chung dang / yang bshad rgyud kyi rgya cher 'grel ba bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun/ phyi ma rgyud kyi dka' 'grel dgos 'dod 'byung ba/ yongs gtad kyi 'grel ba tshig don rnam par gsal ba/ sman gzhung rin chen sgrom bu/ rtsom pa chung ba rgyud bzhi'i dka' 'phreng mun sel/ 'tsho byed rnams la snying brtse ba'i 'phrul gyi yig chung / seng ge rtse'i 'tsho byed kyis dri ba zhus pa'i lan du gsungs pa rnams yin la/ de bzhin legs nyes kyi brda gsal bar ston pa 'i mo rtsis skor la 'khrul med sme ba'i ngos 'dzin/gab rtse la ma bltas par sa ris la brten nas nag rtsis gtan la 'bebs tshul/ mdud rdzong chen mo gzhis phywa gsal ba'i me long /dgra phywa'i man ngag gces bsdus rnams mdzad do/ /209

dzo——————dzotu1sngasdund+rarjotshond+raspraglutshind+ratram̐skyasdutram̐kau—/———snye—smra mkhas 'jam dbyangs gsung gi sgra dbyangs ni/ /don gnyer dri za'i bu mo'i rgyud mang las/ /nyer drangs blo ldan rna ba'i lam zhugs pas/ /dad gus yid kyi 'dab stong rnam par g.yos/ /sgra tshad rig gnas kun mkhyen grub dbang bo//ji bzhin gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan yangs pas/ /spyi dang khyad par zhar byung tshul gsum gyis/ /sa 'dir bka' yi chos char 'bebs par mdzad/ /dam chos rdzogs ldan chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ /zab rgyas 'brug sgra'i legs bshad sgrog pa'i rnga/ /thar 'dod zhing ba'i snying la 'bab pa'i sman/ /gsung rab spos chu'i chab kyis bsil ba thob/ /mi shes mya ngam thang la yun ring du/ /thos sogs bsgrub phyir 'khyams pa'i 'gron po dag /yid ches brnags pa'i khyod gsung skom pa'i gnyen/ /bdud rtsi'i btung bas lus ngag tshim pa rnyed/ /thos pa'i mig can dregs pa'i nyams can gyis/ /mthong tshe rab skrag sa mthar yid dpyod dang / /2/0

dzo—snyesnye—snye——tram̐rjirjo3nd+raspradzirwasprisdurwa2kyisdusdurwa/———ske———yang yang bltas pas snying nas mgu ba'i sems/ /sngon med spobs pa'i dge mtshan mthong ba lags/ /gsung rab yongs la mi 'jigs spobs pa'i tshogs/ /gang gis brnyes nas rab brtse'i bdag nyid las/ /yi ge'i gzugs kyis phan bde'i lam ston pa/ /mkhas pa'i ded dpon che la phyag bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du mkhas pa'i bya ba rnam pa gsum gyis/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yongs su skyong bar mdzad cing / de dag gi byin gyis brlabs dang / rigs ldan chen po nyid kyi thugs rje'i mthus/gdung brgyud kyi 'phel ba yang rim gyis rnyed/ mnga' thang gi dpal yang byams pa'i stobs kyis bskyangs pa'i khyon ltar gyur/ chos rgyal mes dbon kun kyang bkra shis pa'i dpal gyis rab tu brjid pa'i dge mtshan bzang bo'i nyi 'od rgyas par gyur to/ /'dir yang sngar gyi bsdus don gyi snga 'grel du 'brel rgyu'i tshigs sa bcad de smras pa ༄ni—/ /rigs ldan rigs kyi thu bo ba/ /nam mkha'i nor bu )ma mkha'i rje/ /211

————snyesnye—dzospra1dzirwand+rarjospra3sdigludzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ —snyesnye——rdo rdo ltar brtan rdo rje'i drung / /dpal rdo mdzes ldan bzang rdo byon/ /nyi gzhon 'char ka'i 'od ris kyis/ /mnga' 'bangs gling bzhi'i mun bsal zhing / /mdzangs grung pad tshal rab phye bas/ /rnam gsum rigs kyi lha sras 'khrungs/ /zhes so/ /skabs der dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gser sku chen mo'i rten bzhengs kyang mthar phyin te/ chos rgyal nam mkha' legs pa dgung lo bcu/ sku gzhon pa gnyis brgyad drug gi dgung grangs su phebs tshe mus gling kha nas/ (nam mkha' legs pa/ bsod nams bzang bo/kun dga' legs pa'o/) rje sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan spyan drangs nas/ dpal kyi rdo rje la brten pa'i rab tu gnas pa'i mnga' gsol phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing / sku mched bar bas bstan pa'i sgor 'jug pa mdzad nas mtshan yang bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhes gsol zhing / rje sems dpa' chen pos chos sde chen por yang —/ blo sbyong dang gsung ngag gis gtsos pa'i chos 'khor rgya chen po bskor/ de dus rigs ldan chen pos bka' chos kyi 'brel ba 212

dzosnye—snye—snye—snyesdusdurjo2nd+rardzudzisdu1kurwazikyisngasdurwa/—snye—gesnye4dzo—legs par gsan cing / kye rdo rje'i dbang bskur ras bris la brten pa gcig gsan skabs/ rje mus chen gyi kyi rdor brtsegs gdan gyi dkyil 'khor mdun bskyed bsgrub pa mdzad tshar rjes/ chos rgyal chen pos bka' lung phebs nas nged la chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang theg chen pa'i bzhed pa ltar kyai rdor bkram gdan dgos gsungs nas/ slar yang dkyil thang brjes nas mdun bskyed bskyar bsgrub mdzad pa la dbang bskur bzhes zhes kyang grags la/ chos rje a nanta pa la yang mnal ltas sogs rtsub 'greskabs chos skyong gi rjes gnang gsan par grags shing / gzhan bka' 'brel yod tsam snang ba chos rje bsam pa/ chos rje mchog bzang ba/ bla ma dpal ldan pa—/ chos rje nam mkha' ba/ chos rje grags pa ba/ bla ma zang phug pa/lho ba jo bo ba/ bla ma 'od 'phro ba/ bla ma dpal tshul pa/ chos rje nyi ma ba/ grub chen thang stong rgyal bo rnams so/ /slad nas kyang rgya gar nas lhags pa'i paṇḍi ta lo kotta ra dang / mnga' ris nas mar lam sngar brjod pa ltar paṇa chen pa sde snod 'dzin pa'i zhabs 'bring gi tshogs dang bcas pa dbus nas khrus khang lo tsā ba sogs lo paṇa mkhas pa ji snyed kyi spyan sngar bsdar te/ chos kyi dga' ston rgya cher spel nas yid mgu ba'i gnas kyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa sha stag tu 213

sgro—snyegesnyesnye—spyond+ra1sngasdund+razosdurwasdigluXsdutram̐skyasdutram̐skya—/snye——snye—gyur to/ /de tsam nas brtsams te rigs ldan sa chen skyong ba'i dpal dam pa nyid kyang / rang srid phan bde'i gzi 'od rgyas pa'i dbus su ci bde'i sku nyams brtas pa'i 'tsho skyong dang / bsgrub mchod gtor zlog sogs kyi cho ga'i rgyab rten du bzhugs pa tsam gnang zhing / mos ldan gser mchog 'od dpal bas/ rin po che gser gyi maṇḍal mngon par bkod nas zhus pa'i tshe lam thams cad skad cig tsam gyis rdzogs par byed pa rdzogs rim gyi lam dus gnang zhing / gzhan yang skal bzang dam tshig can 'ga' la yang dag pa'i dam pa'i bdud rtsi zab dgus bskyangs/ mnal lam sogs kyi mtshan mas bskul nas zhal ngo rnam pa la yang sdom pa chen po'i dbang yang stsal/ drung jo skyabs pa'i gzhi 'dzin la/ gdon drag pos longs spyod pa'i yul du bzung ba la phur btab kyis bgegs 'dul gnang bas/ yul de'i dpral bar rgyun gyi phyag phur dngos shin tu btabs pa'i rnam cha'i zug rngur spyod pa dang lhan cig smreng bzhin du phyis mi yong du khas blangs nas bskrad pa'i gnas su mdzad pa la sogs te byin brlabs kyi mtshan ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /me yos la mnal lam mi bsrun pa'i thugs kyi 'jug pa shar ba la/sku rim thugs dam gyi ting 'dzin kha bsgyur gnang yang / je tsub tu 214

—bhe—snyebhesnye—bhesdunghrukrorwand+rarjipasduparjorwarji'isngarwand+ra/—snye——snyesnye—gyur tshe dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gser sku phyag tu phebs pas kyang rten 'brel gyi sgo 'grig cing / de nyid kyi sgrub thabs thugs rtsom gnang bas bar gcod kyi g.yul las yongs su rgyal ba'i dngos grub brnyes so/ /mdor na rigs ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po 'di nyid la/ mnal lam 'od gsal gyi ngang du ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan rtsol med du 'char zhing / de nyid kyi phyi nang rten 'brel ma lus pa yongs su 'grig pa nyid du snang ste/mnal lam du rje btsun mi la ras chen gyis mgur sngon chad ma gsan pa'i tshig 'bru dang dbyangs snyan par bsgrags pa na/ sngon med kyi legs par bshad pa'i spobs pa khongs rdol ba'i legs bshad 'phel ces gsungs shing / yang rje sa skya ba chen pos mdzad pa'i gsang sngags kyi gzhung sngon gzigs yul du ma phebs pa'i tshig don bzang bo dang ldan pa zhig gzigs pas/ dang ba'i dad pa lhag par g.yos mthar dbu gtsug tu/ rje sa chen bsgoms nas gdung shugs kyis gsol ba btab gnang bas/ dbu gtsug nas sku la thim pa'i snang ba byung bas/ sa skya ba'i dgongs pa'i gnad zab mo sems la shar gsungs la/ yang mnal lam du ri bo shin tu mtho ba'i rtse na thogs med sku mched bzhugs shing / ri de'i g.yas phyogs kyi sgang 215

dzo————snyebhespyond+ra1sngasdund+rarjotshorwasdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐skya—/ ——snegemizhig na dar dkar gyi yol skor shin tu srab pa'i nang na sa skya ba'i rje btsun gong ma rnams bzhugs pa'i gzigs snang yang byung zhes thos la—/ de las gzhan mnal lam du mkhas pa dag dang / bde gshegs snying bo'i gnad la 'bel gtam gnang bas rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i mtshan ma brnyes shing mdo sngags kyi rigs kyi bstan bcos gnyis su grub pa'i mtha'i gnad don gting tshugs su 'god par mdzad la mnyam rjes dbyer med du dgongs pas/ snga sor pho brang du gnam lcags 'bar ba'i mtshon gyis kyang cung zad brdzi bar ma nus shing /bris thang gi sbyin bdag gi tshul du bris pa'i sku gzugs la yang gnod 'tshe gtan nas med pa/ deng sang yang mthong ba'i yul du yod la/ srung ma'i dbang bo drug cu dang khyad par rdo rje gtum mo drug po las chen gyi lha mo des/ bka'i bran nyid du zhal gyis 'ches nas—/ dus dang gnas skabs kun tu phrin las drag po'i las mtha' yas pa'i mnga' dbang gis cho 'phrul grangs las 'das pa bsgrubs pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu ma lus pa rnams dang gsang ba'i rgyas btab pa'i rnam thar ches gsang ba dag sgrog pa dang —/ yi ger spel zhing 'bri bar ma nus so/ /tshig 'bru tsam la 'chel ba'i gtan tshigs kyis/ /216

dzo—snye—————sdusduX2nd+rasprasdusdu1skyarwa2kyisngasdurwa/———————smra brjod tshig gi ro myangs byis nyams la/ /ngo sor spyod pa'i mkhas tshugs 'khrul ngo yis/ /khengs pas 'khor bar nan gyis nye bar drangs/ /sdukhas mkhas tshig la gtsor 'dzin tha snyad mkhan/ /bsdon btsun mig sngar mdzes bsgyur tshul 'chos mkhan/ /bzang bzang zhig por 'chos pa'i bsnyon dor mkhan/ /mkhas btsun bzang bor btags pas ci la phan/ /mi shes rdzu ba'i gab tshig phal ba'i gtam/ /khrel shor ngo tsha spangs pa'i rgyang glu la/ /grub thob gsung du zhen pa'i mun bsgom gyis/ /gsung rab zab mo'i tshig sbyor bzhad char 'dzin/ /kye ma deng dus snyigs ma lnga ldan 'dir/ /skyob pa khyod ni gang gis (kyang)ma gos par/ /mkhas dang grub pa mtshungs par spyod bzhin du/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i mgon du byon pa snyam/ /chos spyan dag pas nyes tshogs las rgyal zhing / /bzlas brjod nus pas bdud sde'i dpung 'joms la/ /217

dzo—snyebhegesnye—dzospra1dzisdund+rarjotshorwasdirwadzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ ———gemiting 'dzin stobs kyis gnam lcags thog rdugs pa/ /grub brnyes grub mchog khyod la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes so/ /mthar gzugs sku'i bkod pa bsdus tshul/de ltar dgung lo brgyad cu gya gcig gi bar du bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya cher bshad pa ltar mdzad nas/ slar yang sa la spyod pa'i 'og min gyi bste gnas lhun grub sdings su zla ba gcig tsam en zhig sku'i 'du ba ma snyoms pa lta bu'i tshul bstan rjes/tshes kyi dpal dang mtshungs par nyin re bzhin/ je che je che'i lha rdzas me tog dkar bo'i char mngon par sprul te/ gzims khang gi thog gis kyang mi sgrib par gang gi sku'i lhun po chen po nyid la 'bab pa'i ngang nas/ snon gyi zla ba'i gral tshes drug gi nyin/ a wa dhu ti byang chub kyi ljon shing gi nang du bde bar gshegs la/ de'i tshe snang ba'i yul du ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu ma mchis pa/ sngon chad mthong thos kyi yul du ma gyur pa'i snang ba dag rjes su bstan to/ /kye hud lus can bdag cag 'du ba'i gcong / /sum brgya drug cu yis mnar skad cig la/ /218

—snye—snyesnye—snye—sdunghruzi2nd+rapadzirwa1rjorwasdukyisbyisdurwa/—snye————dzo—nad sel sman pa'i rgyal bo khyed gshegs na/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman mchog ming du zad/ /rkyang dang ldan pa'i 'du bas dub pa dag /gang la gang gi gnyen pos legs bskyangs te/ /nad med rab bde'i gnas la yongs bzhag nas/ /'chi med dbang bo lnga ba'i gnas su bzhud/rdo rje'i bzlas pas las rlung 'chi bdag dpung / /gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i gshin rje rab bcom khyod/ /rtswa mchog shing drung thub dbang gzims pa ltar/ /kye ma zhi ba'i dbyings su nye bar sim /rig gnas yongs dang mdo rgyud mtha' dag la/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur chen gyis dub nas/ /zag med dbyings su mgon khyod ngal gso bsten/ /e ma sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i chos bstan to/ /de nas brtsams te/ dgung zhag gi mthar thug gi bar thams cad du nyin rer yang / lta bas mi ngoms pa'i 'ja' 'od me tog gi char gyis mos gus can mtha' yas pa'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa yang 'di ltar/219

snye——snye—snyedzond+ra1sngarwand+rarjosdusdusdirdzudzirwasdudzisdutram̐spri—/ —snye—— dbang sngon yongs su bzhus 'dra bee ḍūr mdog /gzung 'dzin rnyog ma'i smin tshogs rab dwangs te/ /'od gsal 'ja' ris bde stong 'dus ma byas/ /pra phab snang ba'i cho 'phrul yongs la bstan/ /lha rdzas me tog rnam bkra'i mdangs ldan pa/ /yid shes snang bar mi dpogs dri bsung can/ /rnam kun stong ba'i 'dab brgya'i ge sar gyis/ /yongs su spud pa'i char gyis 'dzin ma khyab/ /gzugs med gzugs bzang kun gsal mdzes ma'i gdong / /sna tshogs 'ja' 'od me tog gsar pa'i rgyan/ /gzugs brnyan ma lus bkod pa'i mdzes sdug gis/ /sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i mig gi rol rtsed bsgyur/ /'ja' 'od brkyang ba'i 'phyang mo la/ /rnam lnga'i bla re bres pa bzhin/ /gzhan du za 'og gsar ba'i gos/ /nam mkha'i dbyings su bkrams pa 'dra/ /'dzin mkhan med pa'i bar snang la/ /lha rdzas gos kyi 'phur lding can/ /220

—snye—snyesnye—bhesdurjizi2nd+raspyasbyisdu1rjorwadrikyisngarwarwa/—bheske————mkhar nyal lag pas bzung ba'i 'phrul/ /dman pa'i mig la gab pa bzhin/ /'od zer 'phro ba'i me tog khyon/ /'ja' zlum 'khrigs pa'i gur khang ltar/ /mthon po'i dbyings nas rab 'bab pa/ /btud tshe sgyu ma bshig pa snyam/ /mkha' nang mthing mdog mar gad mdangs/ /yongs su bsgyur ba'i gsal ba'i tshon/ /mthong bas bde gsal mi rtog nyams/ /sgra med skad kyis chos ston bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po de'i dgongs pa'i dbyings zab mo yongs su bkang ba'i rnam grangs du ma'i dge tshogs rlabs po che dpe bral yang dag par bsgrub par mdzad cing / sku gdung rin po che bsam 'phel nor bu rin chen ni/ rin po che'i mchod sdong dang bcas—/ bkur ste'i sgo mtha' yas pas sri zhu'i yul du mdzad nas/byin brlabs chen po'i bde drod rang 'bar gyi dge mtshan rang babs su bzhugs pa 'di nyid do/ /221

dzo——————dzond+ra1sngarwand+rarjosdu2sdiglutshisdutram̐sprisdutram̐skya—/ ———snye—mjug bsdus pa'i don gyi tshig gi zeng ba spel ba/slarayang bsdusapa'idon gyizhabasasabartenapa'itshigagiphreng sto ba spel ba yang / /nam yang mkha' mnyam sems can la/ /phan bde legs pas skyong mdzad des/ /cho rigs btsun po'i khab bzhes tshe/ /lcam gnyis tsam zhig bltams zhes grags/ /de mthar dkon mchog rjes gnang ba'i/ /lung bstan ji bzhin srid 'di'i rje/ /rab gtsang gser mchog ma ma las /mnga' 'bangs mgon skyabs 'khrungs (nam mkha' tshe dbang rdo rje grags pa dpal bzang bo/ bdag mo bzang mo rgyal mtshan la/ gcen thugs rje ('di klo bor phebs phun tshogs rgyal mo lcam sring bltams/)sri gnon rgyal mo/ gcung lha chos gnang ba'imatshan dpal mo yon tan ces gsol/) ma thag /bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma shar/ /'di nyid theg chen rigs sad cing / /mkhyen yangs chos kyi spyan ldan pas/ /222
