dzo——snye——bhe—tram̐rjirjo2nd+ra1sdurwa1༷rwa2kyisngasdurwa/—snye— —bhe—dzozilugs gnyis spel la 'gran bral gyur/ /de sras nam mkha' rin chen gang / /snying stobs gtong phod che ldan zhing / /bla ma la gus srid 'di yi/ /phun tshogs spel ba'i byed por gyur/ /mi dbang (bdag chen nam mkha' rdo rje ba'i )sras mchog bar ma ni/ /gzhon nu rab byung thos bsam ldan/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan mtshan 'chang zhing / /gnam lcags thog rdugs chen po 'o/ /gcung gyur kun dga' ('di'i khab tu klo bo nas bdag mo nyi zla dpal sgron bsus/) legs pa zhes/ /dpa' gtum phas rgol rab bcom nas/ /bka' 'bangs nam mkha'i mthas khyab ste/ /lho byang yongs la mnga' dbang mdzad/ /slad nas rgyal bu byang chub sems/ /nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan mched (kun dga' rin chen grags pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / nam mkha' dpal bzang ngo /) la sogs/ /phyis byon sa skyong mtha' (cho rigs btsun pa'i hor mo la/ 'dzam gling bu 223

—snyesnye————dzond+rasprusngasdund+rarjosdurwasdigludzirwasduskyasdutram̐rjosnye/ ————midaga' 'khrungs/) yas pas/ /srid 'di dge zhing skyong gyur cig /de ltar na mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis thams cad bstan zin to—/ /shā ya sestu/phan bde'i nyi ma bslab gsum 'od 'phreng can/ /thos bsam shar ri'i mkha' la rtag zhugs nas/ /bstan pa'i pad tshal rab rgyas chos smra yi/ /rkang drug 'bum sdes dga' ba'i glu len shog /sa skyong bla yi mchod yul dam pa'i zhing / /'phags mchog dgra bcom 'dus pa'i dge 'dun gyis/ /smon lam rgya chen phul byung 'dun pa'i mthus/ /srid 'di dge zhing shis pa'i mgon du byon/ /mkhas mang dbus su seng ge'i khrir bzhugs nas/ /(sngar gyi rjes su mkhan chen byams pa (tag khyur 'khrungs/)rin chen rdo rje/ mkhan chen dpal (chos lung rab khar 'khrungs/)ldan blo gros/ mkhan chen byang chub (rong sman lung du 'khrungs/)sems dpa'/ mkhan chen sher (zur tshor 'khrungs/)dpal/ mkhan chen bde legs ('brog bud par 'khrungs/) bkra shis/ mkhan chen bsod nams (khang gsar du 'khrungs/)bzang bo/ mkhan chen (brag lung du 'khrungs/)sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen(lcags thang du 'khrungs/)byams pa bsod nams dpal ldan no/ /224

dzo—snye—4 —sko4 sduX2nd+raXdzedzisdusprurjorwarjiXdzozi—༷sdu—tre 4dzesnyesnye———blo gsal bye ba'i re skong chos kyi rnga/ /rgyun mi 'chad par sgrog pa'i sgra chen gyis/ /chos min g.yul las rgyal ba'i dge legs 465/ /bkra shis skyid pa'i nyi ma phan bde'i dpal/ /mnga' thang dgung la reg pa'i dpal yon can/ /sa chen skyong ba'i dpal ldan mi yi rje/ /chos rgyal yab sras sku tshe brtan gyur cig /mi mthun g.yul las rgyal ba'i snyan pa'i sgra/ /khor yug ri bo'i khongs su khyab pa dang / /dpal gyi sde yang dbyar mtsho rab rgyas ltar/ /gang zhig mngon par mtho ba nyid gyur cig /ces rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo rnam rgyal grags pa bzang bo'i rnam par thar ba rab bsngags snyan pa'i 'brug sgra zhes bya ba 'di yang —/ sa skyong mkhyen yangs mi'i dbang bo'i bkas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ chos kyi rje bo de nyid la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i skal ba bzang bo can/ btsun pa grol mchog gis/ byang phyogs chos kyi rgyal bo'i pho brang / dpal ngam rings kyi rgyal sa chen por bkod pa'i yi ge ba ni sgyug thogs rgyal bo blo bde bzang bos bgyis te mthar phyin 225

—snye——snye——skyardzu1dzisdund+rarjosdu2sdind+radzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐rjo——dzesnye——rdzipar grub pa'o/ /'dis kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo chen po kun dga' rin chen grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo'i drung gis spar du bzhengs pa'i dus kyi yi ge ba ni shrī badzra yis bris pa'o/ /maṅga stu'i // //༄gi /na mo mañdzu rghaṣā ya/'char ka'i 'od ris thun mtshams gzhon nu'i mdangs/ /gcig tu bsdus pa'i dpal kun zil gnon cing / /lha brgya'i gtsug gis gang gi zhabs bsten pa'i/ /'jam mgon bla ma gus pa'i gtsug gis mchod/ /chags bral mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis mjos pas 'dod lha'i na chung nye bar gzir/ /khyod thugs zhi ba'i ngang tshul nyid kyis me tog mda' can bsnyems pa 'phrog /byams pa'i go dang snying rje'i mtshon chas bdud sde'i dpung tshogs kun tu bcom/ /srid gsum bla ma rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i tog der mgos phyag 'tshal/ /226

dzo——ge————sdunghruzihūṃhūṃspyaXrwa1༷tram̐dri1sbyisdurwa/—snye—dze—ge——snang byed 'char ka'i dmar ba la 'gran li khri'i mdangs kyi mdzes pa 'phrog /glog phreng 'gyu ba'i rol rtsed dang 'grogs dmar ser 'od kyi khor yug can/ /thun mtshams sprin dkar gsar ba'i rtse nas nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor shar bas kyang / /dpe zlar 'os min gsung gi dbang phyug bdag blo'i pad mtshor gsal gyur cig /mig sman mdog 'dra'i gtsug rgyan las son atpal gzhon nu'i ༄zur phud g.yo/ /snyan tshig gsar ba'i sgra dbyangs dang ldan sngon med legs bshad rol rtsed mkhan/ /bdag blo'i ku mud gsar du bzhad mdzad dri za'i dga' ma yid 'phrog ma/ /dbyangs can gdong gi sbyan zur rol bas tshe rabs kun tu skyong gyur cig /mdzes sdug ral ba'i khur chen spangs shing thub pas bsngags pa'i ngur smrig 'chang / /227

dzo———snye—gespurwa2dzisdund+rarjotshorwand+raspraXrwatram̐rjosdutram̐skya—/ —————srid pa'i bde la bdag gir mi 'dzin nags 'dabs drang srong rjes su slob/ /bag yod gtsang ma'i khrims kyis 'tsho ba'i go 'u ta ma'i rjes 'jug ces/ /rdzun bral ngag ni gnyis skyes tshig bzhin tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nyid du'ang 'jug /nyam chung blo gros gsar bas bskrun pa'i grog mkhar dang ni sbrang rtsi ltar/ /phan tshun ma 'dres gnas lugs gsal ba'i yid 'ong tshig gi zlos gar ni/ /snang stong zhen bral chu snod nang na dpag tshad lnga bcu'i zla ba bzhin—/ /sgro skur spangs pa'i gnas lugs cha tsam rang nyams dag dang sbyar nas gleng / /'di ltar/ dpal ngam rings kyi gnas grong khyer chen po lta na sdug gi snang cha me long la 'phos pa lta bu'i bste gnas yid 'ong nyams dga' ba der/ 'khos med kyi btsun pa bdag gis zhag 'ga' zung blo phebs pa'i nyams bde yid spro'i dpal la skal ba 228

——snyebhe——snye—tram̐rngiXrwand+rarjidzisdukrurjotram̐rji'isngasdusdu/snye——bhe——dze4bzang bor bgyis pa'i skabs zhig na/ chos kyi rgyal bo yab sras kyis dges pa'i bka' drin gyi legs tshogs rnam grangs gzhal du ma mchis pas yid skyo ba drungs phyung ste/ re zhig sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gzhon nu dga' ba'i tshal la sred pa lta bu'i ngal gso'i gnas thob pa'i tshe/ nyin zhig skya rengs kyi bu snying rje chen pos 'dzam gling du rtol ba tsam gyi dus kyi cha la/ rang rig las son pa'i dri za'i na chung mdzes ma glog phreng 'gyu ba lta bu'i mig yangs ma lnga yid kyi mkhar sgor 'ongs nas snying gtam gyi gsang gros 'di ltar du bsgyur ro/ /kye ma skyo med yid bde'i rnal 'byor ba/ /sos dal skyid par nyal ba'i snying sran can/ /nges 'byung grogs kyis khrel ba'i snyom las mkhan/ /bag med gyi nar spyod pa 'di ko ci/ /khyod blor yang yang nyul ba'i bya ma rta/ /yid 'byung grogs mo chags bral 'dzum dkar can/ /srid bde'i gnas las ring son dga' ma de'i/ /cung zhig ngal ba'i shugs nar dal gyis 'byin/ /kho mo'i snying grogs blo gsal ri khrod pa/ /nges med lam du zhugs pa'i bsod snyoms mkhan/ /229

dzo————snye—snyeXtu1sngarwand+rarjorjo2sdind+raXnd+ratram̐trisdutram̐trisnye/ske——snye—ri dwags rmas ma lta bu'i gzhon nu de/ /srid pa'i bde la 'dun pa'i yid shes g.yo/ /bdag dang rang nas 'grogs pa'i grogs po 'di/ /nam yang srid pa'i grong du yid ma bltas/ /da lta chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'dun sa na/ /nges 'byung grogs kyis dben pa'i skyid nyal byed/ /snang shas chos brgyad gsar ba'i lang tsho la /mthun 'jug zur mig 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal can/ /sna tshogs 'dus pa g.yeng ba'i 'phrul 'khor des/ /chags bral sems kyi shing rta drangs par dogs/ /dben gnas nags 'dabs brten pa'i drang srong zhig /dung so'i 'dzum gyis bsu ba'i yid 'phrog mas/ /'khor ba'i gnas su drangs pa'i sngon gyi gtam/ /de nyid 'dir yang 'jug snyam som nyi g.yo/ /'khos med gcig por nags tshal rgyu ba la/ /yid 'phrog 'dzum zhal rgyas pa'i lang tsho mas/ /ri dwags mig gis zur mda' 'phangs pa na/ /snying gi 'ben la 'phog na ji ltar bgyi/ /230

——bhe—————2rjiXrwand+rarngidzisdu1skyarwazezisbyirwand+ra/——snye——snye—phan tshun yid shes dag pa'i dar dkar la/ /brtse sems snying nas 'khyud pa'i sen mdud rgya/ /gang gis 'byed par dka' ba'i snang cha zhig /rtsol med lhun gyis grub pa'i dge mtshan mthong / /zhes brjod pa'i mod la/ kho bo yang yid shes cung zad tsam skyo ba'i ser bas kun nas g.yo ba'i ngang nas/ mdzes ma de dag gi ngo ༄mtshar lus kyi dpal la ma chags par nges 'byung grogs mo'i phrin lan rnams rim gyis bsnyad pa ni/skya rengs 'char ka'i snang bas ma sad cing / /skyu ru'i tshal ltar lus sems rgyas pa can/ /stong nyid nam mkha'i don la mngon phyogs bdag /sad pa med par gnyid kyi bde la spyod/ /rang sems gzhon nu yid skyo'i ngang tshul 'di/ /gang du'ang chags shing zhen pa'i gnas ma rnyed/ /deng sang smon lam dag pas bskrun pa'i mthus/ /yid bde'i ngal gso bsten la mtshang ci yod/ /nges 'byung grogs mo skyid la phrag dog ma/ /yud tsam srid pa'i gnas na bde ba la/ /231

dzo————rdzisnyeskyand+ra1sngarwand+rarjosdund+rand+ragludzisdusduskyasdutram̐spri—/ snyesnye—— grogs po bde tshe grogs mo sems skyo ba/ /'di ni shin tu'ang mi rigs chen po yin/ /chos brgyad srid pa'i khyim du nyal ba dang / /snang shas che 'dod mdzes ma'i sems 'khrid dang / /'dod yon sred pa'i nyo tshong la sogs pa'i/ /ngan pa'i gnas rnams cung zad bsten pa med/ /yab rje chos rgyal lha sras zhabs pad drung / /yid kyi bung ba chos sgra'i sgra dbyangs sgrog /gtad med snang ba rang gzhan bde ba'i nyams/ /bdag gi yid la zim char bzhin du bab/ /utpal mig gi sgo nas rjes zhugs pa'i/ /mtshan dpe'i gzi 'od rgyas pa'i gzugs brnyan zhig /drangs pa med par bdag gi snying dbus kyi/ /lhag bsam sems kyi gzhal med khang du zhugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dad pa'i spu long las/ /nye bar 'thon pa'i shes ldan lus phra ma/ /bag yod 'dzum bag g.yo ba'i rang rig gis/ /mig sgyur mkhan de de drung nyid du nyul/ /232

dzo——snye—4———tram̐1༷rwand+raspyadzisdu gasdusdurwarji1sngasdurwa/snyesnye— —————ci nas rab dges bskyed pa'i sri zhu'i gnas/ /ngo mtshar bye ba phrag brgya bskrun la mkhas/ /gang thugs bde ba'i dpal la dbang bsgyur pa'i/ /phul byung rten cing 'brel 'byung legs par 'grig /pha ltar brtse zhing ma ltar byams pa'i gnyen/ /ma 'dris mdza' bo bdag gi dpal du byung / /de yi yid dbang bde ba'i bsti gnas la/ /cung zhig ngal gso'i bka' drin stsal la ci/ /zhes smras pas/dri za'i bu mo rnams kyi nang nas/ spyi brtol che ba'i 'dzum kha ma zhig gis slar yang bdag la 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /snga nas 'grogs pa'i yid 'byung grogs mo la/ /yid dbang g.yo ba'i gzhon nu 'dod sred can/ /skyid snang bde la zhen pa'i zol gyi phrin/ /ji ltar smras pa mi 'gyur tshig tu springs/ /rang tshig dam bcar shar ba'i pho nya bas/ /nges 'byung grogs de khyod kyi khyim du bos/ /zhen med snying la goms pa'i so tshis kyis/ /233

dzo——snye———skyatusprusprusdund+razotshopasdind+ratshisdusdukausdutram̐rjo—/ ge————bya btang mdun ma'i gnas lugs rtse la song /rang rigs khye 'u ri khrod 'dzin pa'i sras/ /gtan grogs 'di la sngar yang du ma skyes/ /da dung 'byung rung 'brel can 'di bor nas/ /'phral snang skyid grogs 'tshol la yid rab skyo/ /sdig med lung stong mi khyis dben pa'i gnas/ /sdig med zwa phrug rkang dkar skyes pa'i tshal /bag phebs ri dwags rgyu ba'i pha yul na/ /snga 'grogs nyid dang lhan cig 'dug na bzang / /zhes pa'i tshig gis bdag la bskul ba'i lan du slar yang brjod pa ni/ /kho bo cho rigs btsun pa pha yi bu/ /rab mdzangs ma yis bskyangs pa'i gces 'dzin can/ /na mnyam spun gyi dbus na lham me ba/ /snang bde'i grogs su bzang mo du ma mchis /mig yangs bu mo gzugs mdzes bzhad pa'i dpal/ /rna snyan bu mo sgra yi ca co ma/ /dri 'dzin bu mo ha ri ljon pa'i sman/ /234

dzo—snye—snye—snye—sdurjizirwand+razisbyisdusdurjorwarjikyisprarwaḍi —bhesnye——lke—ro ldan bu mo skyur ba'i rnam 'gyur mkhan/ /reg ldan bu mo bde ba'i 'dod 'jo ma/ /yid sred bu mo kun khyab rdo rje'i dbyings/ /tshogs drug skyed tshal snang bde'i do ra na/ /'dod yon mdzes pa'i dpal la dga' mgur rol/ /yid kyi skyes bu 'dod pa'i smig rgyu la/ /nye bar snyog pa'i dus btab rings pa'i tshul/ /phyin pa rjes med nam mkha'i bya lam ltar/ /rmad byung sgyu ma'i mkhan pos ci yang sprul/ /blo gsal rig gnas du ma'i rgyan phreng can/ /rnam dpyod lang tsho gsar ba'i uṣpel mig /sdeb legs snyan ngag tshig gi yid 'phrog glu/ /thos tshe skyo ba mi sel srid na ci/ /bzang mo lnga la bdag gir spyod pa yi/ /sems kyi dpa' bo kun bzang kha lo ba/ /bde chen ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ /khyab gdal yangs pa'i thig ler ro gcig nyid/ /gnas 'dir skyo dang sun pa ga la skye/ /235

——————snyeskyahūṃ1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdirtoXhūṃṇaskyasdutram̐sdu—/ —————de phyir gnyug ma'i rang gdangs ma nyams par/ /rang grol lhod de shig ge 'bol le ba/ /yengs med lhug pa'i ngang la lhod de zhog /ces smras pas/ dri za'i bu mo mig yangs ma rnams kyi gtso mor 'os shing de nyid kyi snang cha 'dzin pa cig na re/snang byed 'od kyis dkris pa'i gzha' ris can/ /phun tshogs shar ri'i rtse nas 'char du nye/ /dus bab tho rengs cha la lon bsgyur rnams/ /gab sbas med par brda sbyor dgongs na go/ /nges 'byung yid skyo'i gzhi 'dzin yangs pa na/ /bden 'dzin phung krol g.yo ba'i phra ma mkhan/ /rang khyim dam chos bang mdzod nor bu'i cha/ /'du 'dzi'i rkun mos 'joms la bag yod bsten/ /ces pa'i tshig bsnyad nas sngar 'ongs pa'i yid shes kyi lam mtha' mi mngon pa der yud tsam zhig gis mi snang bar song / der nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i dpal gyi snang ba dang lhan cig chos kyi rgyal bo'i 'dun sa thams cad ni phyogs dang ris ma nges pa sna tshogs nas lhags pa'i mi'i tshogs rnam pa dang cha lugs ma nges pa 236

dzo——snye————sdurjirjopand+raX dzirwakyiskyarwadrikyisngasdurwa——— —snye—du mas yongs su gang / lam srang thams cad kyang lhun gyis grub pa'i bsod nams dang 'byor ba'i dpal chen pos yongs su gang /gnyug mar gnas pa'i zhabs 'bring ba dag ni phan tshun nas 'gran pa'i tshul gyis rang rang gis bgyi bar 'os pa'i bya ba dag la yid gzhungs pa'i brtson pa lhur byed/ dpal chen pos mngon par mtho zhing mthong ba tsam gyis yid bde ba'i gnas la 'god par mdzad pa'i rigs ldan chos kyi rgyal bo chen po yab sras kyi zhabs drung du nyin rangs por dam pa'i chos kyi sgo rnam grangs du ma'i 'phros las brtsams pa'i gsung gi bka' stsal rjes su gnang ba'i bde ba de nyid kyis nyin yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /de nas rang gis kha ton la sogs pa'i bya ba rnams ni grub/ bde ba'i mal du yid bde ba'i blos sems phab skyid par nyal nas dar tsam zhig song ba na/ sngon chad snang ba'i khung bur lhung ba nyid du ma gyur pa'i/ 'gyur khugs kyi sgra snyan stong phrag gi snang cha dang ldan pa'i sgra bung ba'i glu dbyangs las kyang ches phra ba/ gzhom med kyi nā da'i rang sgrar grags pa'i dbyangs las 'di skad thos so/ /ka ye gson dang chags med spong ba pa/ /rang grol nges 'byung ma yi phrin 'di dgongs/ /237

——snye—snye—snyedzond+ra1sngasdund+rarjosdu3sdind+ratshirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spribhe/—snye———tshig 'bru thugs kyi dkyil du mi sims na'ang / /don nyid phyag bzhes btab na mi legs sam/ /dka' thub kyis mdzes sku yi ljon shing la/ /yid shes g.yo ba'i skyo ldan mdzes ma ngas /nye bar 'khyud tshe sku nyams bde ba'i gshis/ /de 'dra 'khor ba'i gnas na su la mchis/ /gang la'ang ma chags dga' ba'i spu long ni/ /ci la'ang ma reg 'dzin bral sing nge ba /kun nas g.yo tshe rang rig dran pa'i dbyings/ /gsal stong bde ba'i ngang du lan brgyar thims/ /'jig rten snang bas ma reg zhen med kyi/ /dga' ma snying sdug nga ni khyod kyi grogs/ /yun ring 'bral med 'grogs pa'i brtse shugs 'di/ /khrus chab stong gis bkrus kyang 'dag pa min/ /rab gtsang rtswa yi gdan la khyod bzhugs nas/ /yid dbang gzhon nus bdag la rol ba'i tshe/ /ser bus bskyod pa'i nags 'dab g.yo ba ltar/ /dam pa chos kyi phyogs su nye bar bskyod/ /238

— —ge—snye——sduguX2nd+ra1sdusdu1rjorwasdusdi sngasdurwa/—snye——snye———de nas 'khor ba'i rang bzhin tsher nags bzhin/ /gang la reg kyang zug rngu 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /zhi ba'i gnas su spong ba lhur len pa'i/ /nyams myong yid bzhin nor bu skyong yang 'tshal/ /zhes so/ /de'i skabs shig na mi dbang 'khor los sgyur rgyal yab sras rje btsun thugs rje'i bdag mo dang bcas pa/ zhabs 'bring ba'i tshogs kyis bskor te kun chab tshan gyi gnas su phebs pa'i phyag phyi dang / 'khos med rang yul du chas pa'i lam gyi sna sel dang lhan du lhags pa'i tshe/ 'phral snang gang gi zhabs kyi padma'i drung du yid bde zhing 'khod pa la ni sems kyi gnas ci nas kyang lhag par sred/ lam gyis dub pa dang de las kyang / rang yul dug lnga'i tsher nags kyi snang cha dran pas ni gang gi sgo nas kyang yid lhag par 'tsher bar gyur pa'i dus/ rang la rang gi gnas lugs ji ltar shar ba ngag tu gleng ba'i gros 'debs 'di ltar bgyis pa ni/bzung bas mi zin gyu gyu rgyug rgyug pa/ /gtang tshe mi 'gro lam lam 'khor 'khor ba/ /bzhag na mi sdod spun spun long long can/ /brtags na mi rnyed srib srib yal ma yul/ /239

dzoske——snye—snyedzond+ra2sbyisdund+rarjosdu2nd+rarwadzirwatram̐rjosdutram̐sduge—————bde skyid phun tshogs rgyas pa'i mnga' thang can/ /mi dbang gong ma'i 'dun sa 'di dor nas/ /col chung rang rig 'khor ba'i nyon mongs 'dam/ /pha yul snyeg pa'i bsam sbyor 'di ko ci/skyid 'dod can gyi chos pa bzang brdzus pa/ /mtha' dag 'khor ba'i zhags pas 'ching pa'i gnas/ /rang sdug rang gis nyo ba'i 'phrul 'khor 'di/ /las kyi rlung shugs drag pos bskyod min nam/ /khyod la yul na brtse ba'i ma med cing / /skyong byed dpon dang 'degs byed grogs med par/ /gcig bur rang nyid yid skyo'i 'khar ba la/ /nye bar 'chel la phan bde cang mchis sam/ /gzhan la phan na mnar med me nang du'ang / /ngang pas pad mtsho mthong ltar bsnyeg rigs kyang / /phan sems log par mthong ba'i bag med dbus/ /spyi brtol med par 'jug 'di blun po'i gshis/ /rang gi snying dbus thig le lo tsā ba /rje btsun snying rje'i bdag nyid can de dang / /240

———snyeske——tram̐rjizirwarwarjidzisduparjorwarji1spyam rwaneesnye——bhesnye——yun ring 'grogs pa'i skal med skyo ldan ma/ /shugs ring gdung ba'i bstod tshig dbyangs su 'bul/ /bde ba'i phyogs su sprin dkar lding ba'i tshul/ /chu bur mig gis mthong tshe mchi ma lhags/ /lus kyis ma skyod 'dzin med dran pa'i rta/ /bla ma khong gi phyogs su lan brgyar rgyug /khyad par 'bral mi phod pa'i mi dbang rje/ /rigs ldan yab sras drung nas 'gro ba 'di/ /rab chags thugs rje'i lcags kyus kho bo'i snying / /nye bar btab nas g.yo 'gul bral ba bzhin/ /lha yul lha yi dpal 'byor rab btang nas/ /gnas gzhan dbang med rgyu ba'i yid dbang ltar/ /skyo ba gzung du med pa'i 'khyog po'i yid/ /'di na bdag gi skal bar nye bar rgyu/ /bsdad na ma bde blos byas 'dun ma'i gshis/ /phyin tshe rab skyo rje la 'phreng ba'i tshul/ /ci bya gtol med da lta'i las snang 'di/ /rang bzhin med kyang rtag brtan g.yung drung 'dra /241

——casnye—snye—snyedzohūṃpadzisdund+rarjotshopand+raspradzind+ratram̐rwaXtram̐rjo snyebheske——yid 'ong khyim gyi gnas der snying sdug gi /0yid 'phrog bzhag nas de la 'phreng bzhin du/ /yid dbang g.yo zhing bshul ring lam brten pa/ /yid kyi gnas tshul dngos gnas de nyid rang / /nam zhig rang yul khyim der lhan cig tu/ /dga' mgur spyod pa'i dus btab sems bzhin du/ /re ba can gyi phyi mig rjes lta zhing / /gom re ngal re'i rnam pas lam du 'jug /mthong ba med kyang mig shes 'ongs pa'i phyogs/ /yang yang sems pas yid rab blong blong bo/ /dran pas bkug pa'i lhag bsam dag pa'i mig /mu tig zegs 'dra'i chu zil lhag par g.yo/ /de tshe 'di la skyo med su yis ster/ /lag gi padmos mig dbang legs phyis nas/ /snying chen brang 'og tshud pa'i zol gyis ni/ /ma mchu'i pad ngos so yi ze'u 'brus rtsen/ /242

dzo——snyesnyesnyesnyesnyetram̐sdukro2rwa1dzisduparjorwarji1sbyisdurwa/—snyesnye—4—snye—sngon las dbang gis bskyod pa'i ma lī ka /dri zhim phreng mdzes phyags dar khrod du khyer/ /rang bzhin nyams pa med kyang gyi na'i ljongs/ /me tog mdzes byed rgyan gyis bgyi ba dor/ /brtse ldan mkhyen pa rab yangs sprin gyi rnga/ /snyan par bsgrags pas rma bya gzhon nu'i yid/ /dga' ba'i mdangs gsal rgyas pa ngom byed cing / /legs bshad gar gyis zlos gar ci yang bsgyur/ /yab sras dges pa gsar du 'khrungs snyam nas/ /le lo'i g.yeng ba mtha' dag rgyang bsrings te/ /ngag dbang snyems pa'i ro 'dzin glog 'gyur bas/ /phul byung snyan tshig sdebs legs 'di sbyar ro/ /'dir 'bad pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rgyun/ /dung dang ku mud kha ba'i 'od chags des/ /mchod 'os dges pa'i zla ba yar ngo'i dpal/ /slar yang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang gyur cig /bkra shis dge legs bsam pa 'grub/ /ces bya ba 'di ni bsod nams kyi mdun sa chen po ngam rings 243

su / rigs ldan mi'i dbang bo sras dang blon por bcas pa la/legs par bshad pa'i skyes su gnang ba'o/ /'di lta bus kyang 'phral yun dge zhing shis par spyod cig/ maṅga lo/ /agyi ra ba shrī badzra gyi he//
༄sha /drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po bzhugs so/ /don grub rnam rgyal gyis brtsams/

snyesnyesnye—snye—skyahūṃrjisngarjond+rarjosdu2sdind+razirjotram̐sprisdutram̐sprisnye/——bhesnye—༄ / /su sti dza yantu/ gang gi rang bzhin thams cad dkar ba'i lus ni zla tshes bzhin du phra/ /mkhyen brtse'i nu 'bur zung ni mkhregs shing bcud kyis rab tu gang bas lci/ /thugs rje'i phyag ring shel gyi gdu bus ris med 'gro la dam du 'khyud/ /dge legs nyams myong ster ba'i 'khril bag 'dzum ldan ma des bdag la rol/ /sna tshogs tshon ris 'dzin pa 'gro blo'i shel gyi snod yangs por/ /rab dkar dam pa'i mdzad pa rmad byung 'chi med sman gyi rgyun/ /'tsham par lhung ba'i bde chen ro yis myos pa nyid 'dzin pa'i/ /lus can rnams kyang bsod nams rgyu phyir 'di na phyag byar 'os/ /shin tu gtsang ba'i rigs 'dzin cing / /gzhon nu nyid nas dam pa'i chos/ /yongs su rdzogs nas kun tu rgyu/ /drang srong 'di ni gzhar yang 'tshal/ /khyod kyi cho ga ji snyed pa/ /tshangs pa yis kyang mi nus na/ /rlan gyis btang ba'i ro 'dzin can/ /smra la sred kyang gyi nar zad/ /'on kyang rnam par thar ba'i cha/ /bgrod dka' chu gter chen po las/ /gangs can legs bris gtso bo yis/ /rang dbang bum pa gang du gyur/ /des na bdag blos nges gtsang ba'i/ /ku shas blangs pa'i thigs pa tsam/ /des kyang don yod ces thos nas/ /brtson 'grus lhod par ma gyur to/ /'ga' zhig khyad 'phags zhes 246

——rna—snyege—dzo—nend+ra2sdiXnd+rardzurwadzishaṃnd+rardzurdzuspyotram̐’rji/snyesnye ——snye— —'dod nas/ /rang mtshang phra mo'ang 'chab pa dang / /ngo mtshar rdzun zol las bsgrubs pas/ /rang nyid smig sgyu bzhin du ston/ /dbang phyug bzang bor gyur kha cig /'di ni 'khrul ba zhig go zhes/ /'dod phyir tshul min spyod pa kun/ /a la la zhes dgod pa mthong / /'di dag phal cher pha wang gzugs/ /'dab bzang las ches mtshar ro zhes— /yid la brnag pa'i bya ba de/ /rang nyid bslu ba'i sgyu thabs yin—/ /rang bzhin brjod pas yi rangs pa'i/ /cho ga mdzad po'i yongs 'dzin ni/ /deng sang rtsod pa'i dus 'di na/ /mang bor bgrang byar yod ma yin/ /de slad 'dren par rlom sems can/ /kun gyi rtogs pa brjod pa rnams/ /brgya byin gzhu dang 'gran pa bzhin/ /rang bzhin 'khyog la 'phyang mo nyug /khro bas dmad pas dpa' bo khyod—/ /cung zad lhung bar mi 'gyur zhing / /de bzhin 'bad pas gzengs bstod kyang / /mthon por bgrod pa ga la zhig /chos brgyad nyams kyis mi sgeg cing / /tshul 'chos glu ru mi len pas/ /bstod dang dmad la 'dzum zer gyis/ /rnam 'gyur ci yang g.yo ba med/ /dngos bstod bdag gis mi shes bzhin/ /cha yis dmad na sdig 'gyur phyir/ /mdzad pa'i cha shas gang thob pa/ /bsnyon med tshul bzhin 'chad par 'dod/ /'di yi rdzu 'phrul rkang ba dag /dus 247

———4 snye—dzo—skyaspra1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdirngaXrwatram̐trisdutram̐tri——————'dir phal la skog na mo/ /mthun snang rnam rig kun sad pa'i/ /mdzad spyod zlos par smras pas ci/ /'on kyang dus bzhi'i mtha' la yang / /nyams med yi ge'i rang bzhin du/ /bsgrubs na rang dang gzhan dag gi/ /dge legs dpal yon ci yang yin/ /sngon gyi rgyal bo grags pa'i gzugs/ /ngag gi rang bzhin me long thob/ /de dag nye bar mi gnas kyang / /rang nyid nyams pa med la ltos/ /de slad mes po'i rtogs brjod dbyangs can gzugs/ /dad pa'i pir gyis 'du byed gsal byas pa/ /ma dris na 'ang dam pa'i tshul smra 'di/ /rang gi mche ba las ni de ring sprul/ /zhes bya ste/ de yang bdag cag gi 'dren pa dam pa theg pa thams cad kyi ston pa gcig bu dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso bo/ rigs kyi bdag po he ru ka chen po 'di la mtha' gcig tu nges pa'i mtshan gyi sgrib pa dang bral yang chos thams cad kyi de kho na nyid mngon du mdzad pa las don dang mthun pa'i mtshan dkon mchog rin chen/ mnyam nyid rdo rje/ g.yu thog 'bangs/ 'tsho byed grub pa/ dpa' bos bskyangs/ kun la byams pa'i blo gros/ lhun grub rgyal mtshan la sogs te rnam grangs gsal bar sus kyang brjod par mi nus mod/ 'dir gangs can pa phal cher la thun mong du grags pa'i mtshan zur mkhar a bo chos rje'am 248

snye—————snyesnyend+ra2spraXnd+rardzurwadzi3nd+rartordzusdind+rarwarwarwa/—dzemidze——snye——dharma swā mi zhes pa de dag gi rnam par thar ba mtha' dag ni nam mkha'i tshad dang dbyer ma mchis pas gzhal bar nus pa su zhig de bas na gangs ri'i khrod 'dir lhag ma tsam zhig gsal ba'i nang nas kyang rang gi blos ji ltar dpogs nus pa tsam zhig brjod par 'dod de / de la bdag nyid chen po 'di ni sngon bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sngon rol nas bsod nams bye ba'i dngos po ji snyed pa 'du bgyis shing / rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi lam rim pas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sar phyin te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gnas ngan len gyi bag chags shin tu phra ba dag bcom nas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa la rang dbang du gyur kyang / 'dor len dang bral ba'i skye bo sgrib pa'i phung bo la mngon gyur du longs spyod pa'i 'gro ba tha mal ba rnams la lhag par phan gdags par dgongs nas yang nas yang du skye ba sprul ba'i sku sna tshogs par 'khrungs nas gang la gang 'dul gyi gnyen po mngon sum du ston pa zhig las/ thub pa'i bstan pa rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus 'dir chos thams cad kyi dgongs nga phyin ci ma log pa nyams su len pa bo ches dka' zhing / gal te len par 'dod pa rnams kyang dus min par 'chi bas thar ba dang thams 249

dzo——snye———skyahūṃpadzirwand+radzispra2sdind+radzirwatram̐sprirjotram̐sdu—/ —gegesnyemicad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gzigs shing / khyad par du chos dang nor dang mchog thun mong gi bde ba rnams tshe ring ba las sgrub dgos shing —/ tshe ring ba de'ang gso ba rig pa nyid la rag las pa de'i phyir che'i rig byed kho na chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba'am snying bo la yang dag par mkhyen te/ de dag gi sgo nas lus can ma lus pa 'dren par bzhed nas 'dir sku 'khrungs pa ni/ gzhan gyi drin la cung zad tsam yang ma ltos par zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi phung bo mtha' dag la mkhyen pa'i spyan dkyus ring du btsa' bas/ rnam pa kun dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i don dam pa chos kyi sku la rang byan tshud pas 'gro ba rnams kyi bag chags kyi rgyun ji srid pa de srid du mi bzod pa'i brtse ba chen pos skyobs par mdzad pa'i phrin las zad mi shes pa—/ thog ma med pa nas sems can thams cad la pha mar 'du shes pas nye ba dang ring bar 'dzin pa'i chags sdang ro gcig tu mnyam pa—/ nyon mongs pa'i mal sar dug lngas bskyed pa'i nad rlung mkhris bad kan ldan 'dus kyi zug rngu drag pos thar ba'i srog dbugs chad pa la shin tu nye ba'i dbugs thung ngu ngar ngar bor byed cing / mi dge bcu'i mchil snabs dang kha rlangs kyis gzhan gyi yid sun 'byin pa dang / chos brgyad kyi mdza' bshes kyis mtha' bskor te smre 250

——ske—snye—snye—nd+ra2sdiXnd+ratram̐rdzudzi3nd+rardzukau༄rwarwarngu/snye———4———sngags dang cho nge drag po sgrog bzhin du 'jigs su rung ba'i gshin rje'i sen ris kyis lus thams cad khyab pas nyam nga ba'i 'jig rten pha rol tu 'gro ba la shin tu nye ba'i 'gro ba nad pa rnams la snying rje'i gzhan dbang 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa/ de'ang so so'i bsam nga dang dbang bo dang bag la nyal ba'i 'phel zad 'khrugs nga 'i mtshan nyid mngon sum du mkhyen cing gzigs te gang la gang 'tsham pa'i sman rkyang ba dang sbyar ba las byung ba'i ro nus zhu rjes mthun mthun du sdebs pa'i bdud rtsi phangs med du sbyin pa la ris su ma chad pa gang byin pa'i sman de nyid yongs su smin nas mthu stobs yon tan so so'i bya ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshe/ nyon mongs pa 'phel ba'i cha de rnams zad pa dang / dge ba'i lus zungs zad pa rnams 'phel ba dang / dge sdig gi 'khrugs pa ma 'dres par phye nas dug gsum 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i zug ngu nye bar zhi ba'i thabs la mkhas pa/gal te log pa'i rkyen sna tshogs pas glo bur du mnar ba ste/ khong khros skrangs pa dang / tshig rtsub kyis 'drul ba dang / gnod sems kyis sbyo ba dang / phrag dog gis rengs pa sogs la sbyong ba dang dpyad kyi sgo nas meg cheg por byed pa la legs par goms pa mthar phyin pa zhig ste/ mdor na/ sman pa che mchog gtso bo ste/ /251

bhe—snyesnyesnyeblodzospra1sngasdund+radzisdu2sdigludzisdusdurjosdutram̐kau—/ snye—snye——zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med/ /sman rnams ma lus ljon pa'i shing / /nad do cog gi dgra che ba/ /zhes bya ba'i don gyis yang dag par brgyan pa'i skyes bu chen po snyan grags kyi atpal la yongs su dar ༄ba'i chun pos phyogs thams cad kyi rna ba'i mdzes pa kun nas brjid chags par byed pa bo 'di ni gang gis kyang dpes mtshon du med pa zhig go/ /'o na de dag gi rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang ni ci lta bu zhig go snyam na/ de la'ang 'di skad thos te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas lung bstan pa'i gdong dmar can bod kyi yul 'dir chos kyi rgyal bo lha las babs pa'i gdung 'dzin pa mang bo zhig byung ba'i nang nas/ dpal ldan lha rje dkar bo dam pa'i chos la dbang 'byor ba'i rigs dang rus dang cho 'brang rnams kyis yang dag par 'byor ba rgya ma rin chen sgang ba zhes grags pa de las bar skabs shig tu de'i sras dam pa lha dang mi'i chos lugs ma lus pa byang zhing chub pa zhig gis shar phyogs dwags po las smad kyi cha ri bo sharnyi'i 'dabs/ chu bo gser ldan gyi 'gram/ rgya hor gyi lung bzang bo lan mang du thon pa'i yul dbrong ka zhes pa'i sar phyag phebs pa las rim pas sde chen por gyur pa la bang rim pa zhes nor 252

dzo——snye——snye—nd+rarwasdiXnd+rardzurwadzisdund+rartosbyi༄rwarwarngu/—dze— dzo——4——'dzin skyong ba gcig bu bar gyur/ chos dang mthun pa'i khrims lugs bzang bos skye bo thams cad dge ba bcu'i las la bkol bas rdzogs ldan gnyis pa ltar spyod pa la ci yang ngal ba med pa zhis las/dus ring zhig na sku mched so sor mdzad pa'i 'bring bo'i rgyud la dpon chen bsod nams rin chen zhes mtshan gzhan dpon khams par grags pa zhig byung ba des la war lung gsum ga mnga' dbang du mdzad/ lugs gnyis kar gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog khyad par du 'di khams su byon te/ zang zing gi nor mang bos bang mdzod yongs su bkang / tha na rgyan 'brum gyi sa bon bsnams te rang gi gzhis g.yu zhol spang gsum gyi ldum rar btab pas 'dod pa 'jo ba'i 'bras bu dus su smin/ de las rim gyis 'phel te dwags kong phal cher la khyab pa da lta mngon gsum pa 'di tsam gyis kyang drin du che ba yin la/ yang yul dbus kyi jo bo shākya mu ner mjal du byon/ de'i dngos grub tu chos kyi rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po'i mgul g.yu bar ma rgyal mo 'od 'bar zhes bya ba yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che rin thang med pa de nyid dka' tshegs ci yang med par lon/ zhar la dge slong tshal ba'i drung du theg pa che chung gi chos mang du gsan/ bye brag tu gso ba rig pa'i gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs par 253

dzo——— —snyesnyesnyedzoshaṃ1sdu ༷nd+rarjotshohūṃsdirngadzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐spri—/ ———snye—nos—/ slar rang gi khab tu srid skyong zhing gdul bar 'os pa'i skye bo rnams la'ang chos kyi sbyin pas mgu bar mdzad pa ste/ 'di ni rgyal dbang karma ba rang byung rdo rje dang dus mtshungs pa las gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang gsan no/ /de la sras gsum byung ba las che ba'i mtshan dge slong dpon grags pa zhes pa ste/'dis rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag gi rnam par 'phrul ba dpal mkha' spyod dbang bo'i zhabs la gtugs/ dam pa'i chos kho na nyid nyams su bstar/ des kyang sku skye ba phyi mar bla mar 'gyur bar dgongs nas thugs la btags/ de dang mthun par rje chos dpal ye shes 'khrungs ma thag tu sku'i skye bar ngos bzung / chos phyogs nas gsan sbyong gi slob dpon gyi sku tshe bar chad sel thabs kyi srung 'khor tshe sgrub/ 'jig rten phyogs nas phyi nang bar gsum gyi 'tsho tshis legs spel nyes srung kong long ral gsum gyi zhwa dmar nag gnyis ka'i gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs zhig gsos/ 'khrug pa bzlum pa sogs zhal ta ji lta ba bzhin du sgrub pa sku tshab tu 'os pa'i bya ba gzhan yang rmad du byung bar mdzad pa yin te/ de ltar yang rje mkha' spyod dbang bo'i rnam thar spyan snga rin po che nas mdzad par/dge slong dpon grags pa 'di ni lugs gnyis kar zhabs tog phul 254

dzo———snye————st+ri2sdiXrwatram̐rwadzisdund+rardzurdzudzitram̐rwarngi/snyesnye—skesnye——du phyin par snang ngo zhes bkod pas kyang shes so/ /sku 'bring ba rgyal sras tshangs pa zhes pa ste/ des dbus gtsang du gsan sbyong thos bsam gyi mtha' gcod du byon/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal ba dang zhang dbon mnyam du chos kyi rje rong ston chen po'i zhabs la gtugs—/ rig pa'i gnas du ma la mkhyen pa rgyas/ so sor thar ba'i khrims dang 'gal ba'i ltung ba ni 'ga' tsam yang mi mnga'/ gal te byung srid kyang de ma thag tu mi 'chab par phyir bcos kyi cho gas ltung ba zhag tu mi 'jog bla mar 'os pa'i bya ba thams cad ngang gis sgrub pa zhig las/ rang nyid kyis gdul bar bya ba'i skye bo mdo khams su yod par dgongs nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin du na lend+ra'i gtsug lag khang gi mchod rdzas sgrub pa la bsnyad de dpon slob shin tu mang ba dang bcas te byon/ li chu mkhar yan gyi lha mi'i sde mtha' dag gis bsnyen cing bkur/ dad cing gus pa chen pos btud/zang zing gi dngos po ma tshang ba med pas phu dud byas/ de 'dra ba'i mod la mdzo g.yag rta drel brgya phrag gsum khal dang bcas pa bla ma'i drung du 'bul bar brdzangs/ phal che ba 'dam bu'i tshal du thon pas da lta'ang gzim khang 'og rnams su rgya hor gyi mchod rdzas mang rab 'byung ba ni de 'dra ba yin zhes dpal ldan bla ma phyogs las 255

————snye—dzond+ra1dzisdund+rarwadi2zind+rarjorwatram̐skyasdutram̐trisnye/ —dze———rnam rgyal ba'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung dri ma med pa las so/ /sku gzhon pa bla ma rig 'dzin phun tshogs pa ste/ 'di yang thog ma nas rdzogs chen pa'i bla ma ka phu ba yon tan phun tshogs la rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor ma lus par gsan/ chos de dag gi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log pa nyams su len pa la spobs pa rnyed/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i mnyam par bzhag pa las dus skad cig kyang mi g.yel/rnam par g.yeng ba 'du 'dzi las rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i dben pa la gcig tu gzhol yang / thu bo gnyis ka rab tu byung ba dge slong gi rten can yin pas srid mi 'dzin pa'i thabs dang rang dbang ma rnyed/de'i tshe slar yang kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal ba'i lcam mo zhig khab tu bzhes/ 'khor ba'i chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i sgo nas srid bskyangs/ de la sras a bo chos rje/ dwags po paṇa chen/ dpon rje btsun te gsum byung ba las/ sku bgres pa ni rnam par thar ba 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo yin pa'i phyir 'og nas rgyas par 'chad la/sku 'bring ba dwags po paṇa chen mtshan dngos don grub rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bo de nyid sku na gzhon nu nas rab tu byung ste/ dbus gtsang gi mtshams 'bras yul skyed mos tshal du sde snod mtha' dag gi tshig don la rang byan tshud par mdzad/ thun mong gi rig gnas 256

————ge—snyend+rarwardzuXnd+ratram̐rwadzisdu2rtosbyirwarwarwarngu/————snye——rnams kyang rtsol med du mkhyen cing slar dpyis phyin par mdzad pas 'ga' zhig tshar gcod pa dang / 'ga' zhig rjes su 'dzin pa dang /rang nyid kun shes pa'i bya ba mtha' dag thugs su chud pas paṇḍi ta chen por gyur/ de'i mthus phyi rol gyi chos thams cad kyi sgro 'dogs rtsa lag dang bcas pa yongs su chod nas shes bya nang gi de bzhin nyid mngon du gyur pas grub pa'i ring lugs pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu gcig bu bar gyur/ sdom pa gsum las gyur pa'i ltung ba ni bag tsam yang mi mnga' bas bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba med pa ste/ de ltar mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi snyan grags kyi dril chen pos nor 'dzin yug gcig tu khyab/ mnga' ris grangs med pa la dbang 'byor ba sa skyong don yod rdo rjes bsnyen cing gus pas btud/ ji ltar bzhed pa'i chos kyi bka' drin du stsal/ nyi ma gtsang phyogs kyi rgyal khams thams cad dge legs kyi mtshan mas shis par mdzad/ de'i mod la lha rigs dri ma med pa las 'khrungs pa'i rgyal bu grags pa mtha' yas pas spyan drangs/ gus pas bsnyen cing bkur ba'i bste stang gis nye bar mchod de g.ya' bzang gi sde chen po'i mkhan por mnga' gsol/ skabs skabs su ha la sgang du byon—/ des kyang yun ring du bsnyen/ nye logs zhig tu dga' tshal 257

———snye———dzisprapridzisdund+rarjorjorwand+ragludzirwasdudzirjotram̐spri—/ snye————zhes pa'i bshad pa'i grwa chen po btsugs/ mdo sngags rab 'byams sasmraba'idageba'ibashesaganyen kyangajisnyedacigabaskrun de'itshe༄ / grub pa dang drang srong dri za'i tshogs kyis snyan grags kyi yi ge nam mkhar grags pa las bod khams skyong ba'i bdag po mi dbang rin po che pho brang chen po sne'u gdong rtser spyan drangs/ kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra'i zhabs stegs kyi ྾ ྾ ྾ gsol/ sa skyong ba chen po'i cod pan du zhabs sen gyi thig le bkod/ chos yang dag pa bsgrags pas de'i rgyud la bslab pa byin/ ྾ ྾ ྾ ba'i khrims lugs bzang bo bskyangs te chab 'bangs pa rnams rtsod dus min pa ltar spyod—/ rig pa dang grol bar smra ba'i sde chen po rtsis thang ྾ ྾ ྾ mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum lung dang kha bton sbyin pa la zla ma mchis kyang snyems pa mi mnga'/ me tog gi mtshon gyis zin pa 'ga' tsam yang ྾ ྾ ྾ 'byin pa la gtsor mi mdzad kyang zhar las byung /lung dang rig pa'i dga' ston chen po ni zad mi shes/ de'i 'khor du 'dus pa'i dge 'dun pa ྾ ྾ ྾ tsam yang 'dus pa med do zhes deng sang gi rgan rabs pa rnams kyis kyang smra la/ de bas na bstan pa rin po che'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa ྾ ྾ ྾ da lta'i bshad grwa 'di btsugs—/ nyid kyi slob ma bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi bshes gnyen 258

————sne——snyend+rand+rasbyoXnd+ratram̐rwakausdund+rardzuljo༄rwarwaX/———————'ga' zhig 'chad nyan par bskos nas rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mngon par 'du bgyis te zhing khams gzhan gyi gdul bya'i don du gshegs/sku gdung gi ring bsrel gser btso ma'i gzhal yas khang du bzhugs su gsol nas rang cag rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du da lta'ang g.ya' bzang gi gtsug lag khang du mchod pa'i sprin phungabasam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas te bzhugs pa yin no/ /de 'dra ba'i skyes bu chen po 'di la gsol ba 'debs pa'i slad du lo dus su 'ardus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mang du bzhengs te de dag gi gtso bor 'di nyid he ru ka'i rnam par spyan drangs nas mchod pa'i yo byad dpag tu med pas mchod cing mchog thun mong gi 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa zhig g.ya' bzang dang /rtsis thang gi sde chen por snang ba kun gyi mthun snang du gyur pa nyid do—/ /'di dag gi slob bu paṇa chen phyogs las rnamargyal/ g.ya' bzang gu shri/ sgrub pa mkhan po/ grub thob sangs rgyas bsam grub/dwags po gsung rab mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang bo sogs te mtha' dag ni blos ji ltar dpogs/ de'i phyir 'di tsam zhigaspros pa yin zhing —/ kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal/ bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid/zhabs drung karma phrin las pa gsum po la shar dwags po'i paṇḍita 259

dzo——snyerdzi——dzorwapasngarwand+rarjotsho3sdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/ ——snye— dang bo dang gnyis pa gsum pa zhes pa'i mtshan gdags pa gsal bor grub pa 'di lags so/ /sku gzhon pa dpon rje btsun gyis rkyen yul gyi nor 'dzin skyong ba'i sras mo zhig khab tu bzhes/ chab sgo'i skye dgu mtha' dag la bu gcig pa'i ma ltar brtse/ slong ba ba rnams kyi re ba'i ra ba phyug por 'gengs—/ gang byin pa de'i lan la re ba gtan mi mnga'/ kong lding cho brgyad brgya'i ral bar bka' lung gi nor bu ngal 'tsho/ lugs kyi bstan bcos dang bzo dang gso ba rig pa mthar phyin/ de dag gi sgo nas rang dang gzhan gyi 'dod pa yongs su rdzogs par spyod cing /rgyalasridaphanasamatshogasapa'ibadebasa'atshozhingagazhesapazhigaste sto ra /'di la sras gnyis yod pa'i che ba la nang so kun tu bzang bo zhes pa rang bzhin gyis rgyud dag pa/ zhi zhing dbang bo dul ba/ sgam zhing brling ba/ gsung 'jam por smra ba/ mi'i chos lugs legs par byang zhing dam pa'i chos la rab tu spro yang gdams ngag gi gnad 'ga' zhig tu dril nas nyams su len bzhin pas yab kyi bka' bzhin du srid skyong bar mdzad pa yin la/ sku gzhon pa de ni lugs gnyis kar spyod pa'i blo gros kyi rtsal lhag par che yang yab mes rnams kyi rjes su 'brang ba las cung zad gol nas/ rten skya bo'i 260

———snye—snye——nd+rarwardzuXnd+rarwarwadzi3nd+rardzurdzutshirwarwa1/—rīrisnyesnye——tshul gyis 'phong dang spe ga mchong dang glu gzhas/ pyu lo rgyan po sogs sgyu rtsal gyi bya ba mtha' dag la nang byan bde blag tu tshud nas longs spyod pa/ de'ang dpa' zhing mdzangs pa rā ma ṇa ltabu'i brtul zhugs bzung nas rang gi phyogs legs par skyong zhing pha rol gyi rgol ba rnams 'joms nus pa/ de'i mtshan yang nang so phag rgod khyung gi rgyal bo zhes grags shing grub pa la/ mched po de gnyis kyis khab tu bzhes pa las ni nang so rnam rgyal grags pa la sogs te rang cag mched gsum gyis rigs kyi lhag ma tsam zhig mtshon par gyas pa yin no—/ /'dir smras pa/ 'chi med bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i rigs 'dzin zhing —/ /lha rje dkar bo'i lang tsho gsar ba ni/ /bdun grwag rdzogs pa'i cho rigs lo lon zhing / /dam pa'i tshul gyis tshig dma' kun grub pa/ /stobs ldan sdig pa'i dri ma sbyong ba'i slad/ /rti las lam gsum 'ongs pa'i gang hā yin/ /'di ni mkhas las su tig char ba'i tshogs/ /lhung ba las kyang dwangs pa 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /sngon bsod nyi ma'i zer gyis smin pa las/ /mngar bor gyur ga sbrang ma'i rtsi bo che/ /ngoms par 'thung ba'i bung ba gang mchis ga/ /kun kyang 'di yis bskyed pa yin nam snyam/ /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi thena'i 261

—snye—snyesnye——skyarwa1sngasdund+rarjosdu2sdiglutshisdutram̐sprisdutram̐kau—/—————gtam chen po las rigs rus cho 'brang gi tshul rags tsam brjod pa ste sarga dang bo'o// //brtse chen snying la zhugs pa'i sprin shugs can/ /blo 'das gsum rtsen tshal du bgrod zin kyang / /srid pa'i bya skyibs 'gram du rgyu ba ni—/ /'gro ba drang srong rnams kyi dge legs rgyu/ /legs bris sa la bkram pa 'phags pa'i yul/ /ra ba yangs por rgyal rnga cher brdungs pa'i / /paṇa chen 'ga' zhig de yang khyod yin zhes/ /gar dbang sprul ba'i zhal skyin 'di ltar mthong / /de 'ang gar dbang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam par rol ba zhwa dmar cod paṇa 'dzin pa bzhi ba chos kyi grags pa ye shes dpal bzang bo'i zhal sngar/ bdag nyid chen po 'dis nged rang rnam pa gnyis sngon skye ba mang bor dpon slob kho nar 'brel ba yin nam snyam pa ci ltar lags zhes zhus pa'i lan du/rang cag smon lam gyis 'brel tshul ni re zhig rgya gar lho phyogs ko ṭi ra zhes bya ba'i gnas su bdag paṇḍi tar gyur nas ra shi pha la zhes bya ba'i gtsug lag khang du slob gnyer la nan tan byas/ bla ma mang du bsten—/ mkhas shing nus pa dang ldan pa'i tshul bstan/ ming yang mkhas grub nyi ma'i snying bo zhes bya bar grags/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rnyarmā rā ga zhes bya ba'i bu zla ba la dga' ba zhes bya ba rjes su bzung 262

ne—bhe—ge——gend+rand+rasdiXrwatram̐rwakau32rdzurdzutshirwarwarngu/snye————snye—ngo / /zhes gsungs te/ 'di ni slob dpon dpa' bo'i slob ma ste/phyi nang gi rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pas kha che'i paṇḍi ta chen po zla ba la mngon par dga' ba zhes grags pa de nyid yin par gdon mi za zhing / 'dis slob dpon dpa' bo las nod pa'i sman gyi bstan bcos yan lag brgyad pa'i snying bo bsdus pa la 'grel chen tshig don zla zer sogs bstan bcos bsam las 'das par mdzad mod—/ rgyas par de nyid kyi rnam thar du blta'o/ /yang de'i gsung las/rgya gar rdo rje gdan du sngags 'chang gzi brdzid chen po zhes bya bar sprul te badzra ma ti zhes bya ba rjes su bzung ngo / /yang bal yul shri dhwa dza zhes pa'i yul du sprul ba bstan te/ de'i dus su gzungs ldan zhes bya ba rjes su bzung ngo / /de nas bod du sprul ba'i sku bstan te/de'i dus su lha gzigs zhes bya ba rjes su bzung yang phyi ma'i dus su mi bskyod rdo rje dang blo gros rgyal bo zhes bya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di ni mtshon par byed pa'i sa bon tsam zhig yin mod/don dam par bdag nyid chen po 'di ni bya ba legs par byas shing byed pa byas pa las/ sangs rgyas thams cad chos kyi sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zab zhi spros pa dang bral zhing mtshon du mi rung ba kho nar ro gcig tu gyur pa zhig yin no/ rgyal ba gar gyi dbang bo 263

—skesnye—snye—snyedzotu1sngasdund+razosgrurwand+ragluXrwasduskyasdutram̐skya—/snye————dang tha dad pa ga la zhig sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa'ang 'di'i mdzad pa yin la 'di nyid kyang rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo/rjes su bzung bya yang sangs rgyas la 'dzin pa bo yang sangs rgyas/de'i phyir 'di dag gi spyod pa'i tshul mtha' dag ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mdzad pa dang dbyer mi phyed na ji tsam brjod kyang 'dzad du ga la rung de bas na 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo gcig tu bsdus pa yin no zhes gleng bar mdzad pa yin te/ gang dag skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi gsung ni mi bslu ba'i bdag nyid can du grub pa yin zhing / de'ang rdzun gsungs pa'i rgyu med cing / gsungs pa la legs pa'i 'bras bu mi 'byung ba las dpag nus pa'i phyir/ kun gyis yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i gnas su rung bar gor ma chag go—/ /'on kyang tshu rol mthong ba bo rnams kyi ngor ji ltar snang ba'i mdzad pa rnams gtso bor byas te bkod pa yin no/ /sgyu ma dang ni mig 'phrul gyis/ /'gro kun bslu ba'i tshul 'di rdzun/ /sgyu ma'i mkhan po gcig bu 'di'i/ /mig 'phrul bden par su zhig 'dzin/ /brtse ba'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'i sku/ /'gro blor dpyid kyi dga' ston che—/ /stsol mdzad a ru ras mtshan pa'i/ /rgyal ba dus kyi pho nya'i rtsal//go skabs med pa srid pa'i phug /gang du khyod kyi cho 'phrul che/ /264

dzo—snye—————rwarwa1༷rwardzurwakausdu2tram̐sbyirwarwarwarwa/snye——————yangs pa ltar byed 'di kho nas/ /'ga' zhig yid ni khug mar song/ /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po las 'das pa'i dus kyi mdzad pa'i cha shas chung ngu tsam brjod pa ste sarga gnyis pa'o// //gal te gdung ba 'gog par byed na lho phyogs rlung dang zla ba don med 'gyur/ /ci ste yin gyi re ba 'gengs na dpag bsam shing dang nor bu gyi nar 'gro/ /gang yang ro 'dzin stong phrag brel na sprin rnga'i sgra dang yi ges ci zhig bya/ /rnam par rol ba med tsam gyis kyang da dung 'di tshul ston mdzad pa/ /gso rig sna tshogs shing rta nub phyogs kyi/ /pha rol song ba'i thod pa'i dum bu tsam/ /lhag mar mthong la snying rjes ma bzod nas/ /bzhon pa'i kha lo drag tu bsgyur bar zad/ /lus can padma'i 'dab ma rnying ba 'di/ /skad cig tsam la 'dor bar nye ba'i tshe/ /slar yang rlings por byed pa'i a mṛ ta/ /sbyin mkhas dbyangs can thu bo rgyal gyur cig /de'ang bdag nyid chen po 'di ni ji ltar 'khrungs pa'i yul dang gdul bya dang yab yum dang rigs rus cho 'brang la sogs pa'i sgo nas legs par gzigs shing dran shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i tshul dang drang srong grub pa rig 'dzin gyi mngon par shes pas mthong ba dag lung du ston pa 265

—snye—————༷nd+ra1sngasdund+razotsho3sdipadzirwatram̐sprisdutram̐trisnye/ snyesnyesnyege—gcig tu spobs pa thob pa gsang sngags rnying ma ba grub chen 'ga' zhig gi gsung gi zol ltar 'di skad du thos te/ padma thod phreng rtsal gyi lung las/ 'di nas mi rabs drug pa na/ /o rgyan chen pos byin rlabs shing / /nges don gter chos zab mo la/ /nges shes skye ba'i ba ༄gcig ni/ /dwags kong bar du skyes nas kyang / /rgyal bo'i rigs kyis 'gro don byed/ /ces pa dang / kun skyong gling ba'i lung las/dwags kong gnyis kyi sa mtshams su/ /zab mo'i gter phran dbang byed pa'i/ /padma rig 'dzin sbas tshul gnas/ /nges pa'i don rtogs rnal 'byor ba/ /rgyal bo'i rigs su skyes nas kyang / /brtul zhugs spyod pa sna tshogs skyong / /ma bslab yon tan kun la mkhas/ /khyad par sman dpyad bstan pa 'dzin/ /zhes pa dang / ratna gling ba'i zhal lung las/ dwags kong mtshams su gter phran 'don pa 'byung / /padmas byin rlabs gcig car gang zag de/ /mthong thos dran reg don chen 'aspub par byed/ /'di yis sbyar ba'i sman thun re zos kyang —/ /nges par 'khor ba mtha' can byed par 'gyur/ /zhes pa dang —/ nyid kyi lung bstan rin chen 'od 'bar las/ dge bsnyen mchims lha gnas pa'i gangs zhol du/ /gnam sa gru gsum chu klung chen po'i 'gram/ /me pho rta'am sa mo lug lo ba/ /bee ros byin rlabs 266

—snye—bhesnyesnye—snyend+rarwasdiXnd+ratram̐rdzudzi3nd+rardzuzi༄sdurwarngu/——snye————theg chen chos bdag 'byung / /zhes dang / snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gter rdzas thams cad ni/ /ma lus sun 'byin padma'i bstan pa ni/ /nyin mor byed phyir sprul ba'i sku nyid do/ /zhes dang / rnal 'byor brtul zhugs pa chen po thang stong rgyal bos kyang / skyes bu me khams sa lug lo/ /sngon sbyangs dkar bo'i mthu ldan zhing / /theg chen chos kyi bag chags sad/ /snying rje'i dbang gis gso rig skyong / /sbas tshul rgyal rigs sprul ba'i sku/ /la war mtshams kyi yul na yod/ /'brel tshad don dang ldan pa'o/ /dam sel grib kyis phog pa'am/ /zhing gzhan mkha' 'gro ngo che na/ /lo ni nyer brgyad dus su 'da'/ /de la phyi nang rten 'brel gyis/ /sku tshe bsring ba'i thabs la 'bad/ /skal ldan slob ma ma gtogs pa/ /gdul bya mi skyong gsang tshul bya/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i bdag nyid chen po 'di bsam bzhin du skye ba sprul ba'i skur lung ston par mdzad mod/ 'di 'dra ba'i skyes bu chen po rnams la/ mchog dman gyi sgro skur gang gis kyang rtsod pa med—/ ji skad du/ du ba las ni mer shes dang / /chu skyar las ni chu dpog bzhin/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan gyis/ /rigs ni mtshan ma nyid las shes/ /zhes pa ltar rnam par thar ba dam pa rnams kyi spyod tshul ci 'dra ba dang mtshungs par mthong ba'i phyir/267

snyesnye———snyedzotu1sngarwand+rarjosdu2sdirdzuXrwasduskyasdutram̐skyasnye/———snye—grub zin sgrub pa'i rig pa 'di lta bus ci zhig bya/ 'on kyang dbang rtul dad pa kho na'i rjes su 'brang ba la sogs pa rnams dang ba 'phel ba'i dmigs rkyen du 'gyur bar dgongs nas bkod par zad do/ /bee ḍūr dkar bo'i bam pa bzang bo de/ /ji srid rkyen gyis ༄lhag mar bsgyur pa na/ /yid 'phrog dbang bo'i gzhu ris ltar bkra ba'i—/ /ngo mtshar grangs med 'char la rin thang ci/ /snying rje'i rang gzugs 'gro blo'i dga' ston la/ /ngang gis gzhol 'di gshis la gnas mod kyang / /rtog ge pa rnams lkog gyur smra ba la/ /'dris phyir 'dir yang ngo mtshar brjod par byas/ /khyod cag ri khrod gnas pa'i ma ma rnams/ /re zhig brtse gdungs ma yi zol can mal/ /nyin re gang bskyed mtshan mo lhag med du/ /zos pas da dung cung zad mi skrag gam/ /rnam mang 'gro bas gser bzhin bcos pa'i dngos/ /sreg bcad brdar tshe rdzun par gyur mthong nas/ /'khrul med sna kṣi rnar bu 'chang ba dang / /rton pa bzhi don shes pas phyogs 'di bskal—/ /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po las 'ga' zhig the tshom dang bral ba'i slad du lung tshig gsal bor bkod pa ste sarga gsum pa'on/ //268

dzo—snye—snye——snyend+rarwa1ngachend+ratram̐rwakau3nd+rardzurdzuspyorwarwadri/—gesnye—snye——rmad byung dam pa'i gzugs sku 'gro blo'i dpyid/ /sgyu 'phrul blo yi yul min ci yang ston/ /don dam chos dbyings kun snang ston pa'i gar—/ /drang srong chen po'i ring lugs yid la brnag /rang bzhin 'jigs med gdong lngas btegs pa'i khrir/ /nye bar bkod pa'i he ru ka dpal mchog /'chi med lam la goms pa ma rtsol kyang / /sa 'dzin khab tu bgrod pa'i dge legs sprin/ /bsod nams gaṅgā'i lha bas ngoms pa las/ /khyod mtshan nam mkha' rgod pa'i skad gsang zhig /gangs can khor yug brgal nas song ba'i tshe/ /byis pa phal cher spag nas 'gyel bar gyur/ /zhes brjod de/ skyes bu dam pa rnams ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i phyir/ rang cag rnams la snang ba'i mdzad spyod rags pa skye ba dang / rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba thams cad kyang snang tshul ston pa tsam du shes dgos pas—/ de ltar yang bdag nyid chen po 'di ston pa shing mo glang la 'khrungs pa'i dbang du byas na/ de nas lo drug cu skor so dgu dang lo rkyang lnga 'das pa don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo/ dpyid zla tha chung sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi phyi dro sku bltams pa yin no/ /de la yab ni gong du smos pa'i bla ma rig 'dzin phun tshogs/ yum ni kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal ba'i lcam mo ste/ 'di yang bud med kyi 269

—snye—————skyand+ra1sprurwand+radrisdurwand+rarngarwarwatram̐sdusdutram̐spri—/ ————4yon tan phal cher dang ldan zhing / dad pa dang gtong ba la dga' ba zhig go/ /sras de nyid 'khrungs 'phral nas bzung rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi sgos kyi bya ba la lhag par rings pa'i tshul gyis sku bskyed shin tu che bar gyur/ dgung lo gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ na mo ma hā gu ṇa ya zhes yang nas yang du gsungs pa la yab kyis brtags pas/ dpal mgon g.yu thog pa la gsol ba 'debs par go ste/ 'di ni sus kyang khong du chud par dka' ba zhig snang bas rang cag rnams kyi skyob pa dam par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa las rim gyis dgung lo bzhi ba'i thog tu sleb/ de'i tshe yum gnyan kha med ces pa'i nad kyis cher snyang ba la yab rin po che dang gso dpyad 'dzin par khas 'che ba mtha' dag gis sman dpyad zhi drag gi sbyor ba ji tsam byas kyang phan pa ma rnyed nas sku tshe'i 'du byed la shin tu nye ba na/ gzhon nu des yum gyi bzhin ras la yun ring du gzigs nas mthar sman 'di dang 'di rnams kyi sbyor ba byas na phan nges so zhes gsungs pas—/ yum na re/ a ye bdag 'chi bar nye ba 'dis kyang shes par gor ma chag ste/ de bas 'di ni ngo mtshar bas phan pa'ang srid pas ji ltar smra ba bzhin mdzad du gsol zhes yab la zhus/ yab kyis kyang de bzhin du mdzad pas zug rngu gzhi med du gyur pas kun ya 270

snye——snye———nd+rarwasdiXrwatram̐rdzudzisdund+rardzukausprarwarwarji/———snyebhe——mtshan zhing 'di ni dpal g.yu thog mgon po'i sku'i skye ba'am sprul ba yin par thag chod de/ chung ngu nas gzhan phan 'ba' zhig gi dngos por lhun gyis grub pas mtshan yang a bo chos rje zhes bos shig byas pas phyis kyang de bzhin du grags la/ de nas rim gyis yi ge 'bri klog sku gzugs kyi ri mo dang 'bur dod/ sman dpyad/ dus kyi 'khor lo/ rdzogs chen rnams la yab kyis brda bstan pa tsam gyis de dang de rnams rtsol med du mkhyen/ dgung lo bcu lon pa'i tshe chos dbyings rtser g.yu thog snying thig gi bla ma'i sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu zhugs—/ de'i rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor dbus su dpal g.yu thog pa de nyid 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi cha lugs ji lta ba la drang srong mang bos bskor ba zhig mngon sum du gzigs/ bstod pa'i tshogs mang du spel/ byin gyis rlabs pa dang rjes su gnang bas chos thams cad rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i spobs pa mchog tu gyur/ gso rig rgyud bzhi snying thig shog dril dang bcas pa'i tshig don dgongs gzhi zhal shes dang bcas pa rnam par bkral ba'i lung dang / snying thig gi cha lag 'ga' zhig gyis shig ces pa'i gnang ba thob/ dus de nas bzung ste rgyun chags su mi 'bral zhing zab mo stong ba nyid la phyag mdzub gtod dang legs par bshad pa'i bgro gleng zad mi shes pa 271

bhesnye——snye—skyand+rarjisngarwand+razosdurwasdind+radzirwasduskyasdu’skya—/———snye—nyams su myong bar mdzad pa yin te/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i gsol 'debs dad pa'i rba rlabs su/ mtshungs med gu ṇas dngos nyams mi lam du/ /dgyes bzhin legs bshad rgyun mi 'chad stsol ba'i/ /'khrul zhig sman pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /zhes gsungs pas dngos su grub pa nyid do/ /'dir smras pa/ shin tu phra ba'i lus ldan zla tshes 'di/ /'phel bar rtsom slad thog ma'i dus nas kyang / /bsil zer bdud rtsi'i dra ba rdzogs gyur pas/ /'gro ba'i gdung ba 'gog thabs gzhan gyis ci/ /'di 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rings pa ltar sprul bas/ /grub chen mang bo'i grags pa thung ngur song / /gzhon nu'i dus nas 'gro dbugs ma phyung na/ /rgan por gnas pa'i long med mtshon pa 'dra/ /zhes bya'o/ /de nas rim gyis gsung rab 'chad pa la mkhas par gyur pa yin te/ rang rang gi yid dang mthun pa'i chos gnas dang byed pa dang rtsol ba rnam par dag pa las byung zhing brda dang tha snyad ma lus pa khong du chud nas byed pa dang bsdu ba dang bsgyur ba dang 'jug pa dang rnam par dbye ba dang phyogs dang dngos po'i gnas so so'i bye brag dang bcas pa la byang chub pas yang dag par drangs te legs par gsungs pa/ gsal zhing dag la ma bzlos shing ldab ldib 272

dzo—snyesnye——snye—nd+ra2sdiXnd+rardzurdzudzisdu2rtosbyisprarwarwarngi/—snye—ge——4med pa ring bor gnas kyang cher grags pa/ chos thams cad kyi tshul dang mthan par dus su smra ba/ yi ge phun sum tshogs pas nyung ngur ༄brjod kyang gzhan gyis dpag par dka' ba/ gdul bya'i sgra rtog dang mthun par 'jug pa ste/ mdor na yi ge dang ming dang tshig rnam par dag pa las byung ba'i ngag bslu ba med pa zad mi shes par bstan pa/ de'ang shes par bya ba'i dngos po ji snyed pa rnams dang tshul mi 'dra ba mang bo dang / lhag par yul dus gang zag la dgongs nas gso ba rig pa nyid gtso bor mdzad de smra ba la spobs pa mchog tu gyur pa yin no/ /de'i tshe rgyud bzhi la sogs pa gso rig gi gzhung lugs la yi ge ba'i bris nor dang rang bzo 'ba' zhig gis ma dag par gzigs te/ kye ma/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gso ba rig pa ming gi lhag ma tsam du song yod par 'dug de tsam du ma zad dus kyi dbang gis sems can rnams ni gdug cing rtsub/ḍā ki dang srung ma rnams ni phrag dog che/ de'i dbang gis ming tsam yang shes par dka' ba'i nad sna tshogs pas ni gdungs/ de gso ba'i thabs mang du yod kyang / ji bzhin shes pa'i gang zag nyin skar las kyang dkon/ de'i phyir 'gro ba skyabs med pa 'di rnams kyi zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa'i thabs kyis phan bde'i rtsa lag tu 273

dzosnye—snyesnye——dzorwa1dzisdund+rarjotshorwand+ragludzisdutram̐sprisdutram̐kausnye/————zibya'o zhes dam bcas nas rgyud bzhi bo'i tshig don la bcos bslad 'khrul ba thams cad phyung ste shin tu dag par bgyis pa la zur mkhar ba'i rgyud bzhi rnam dag ma zhes par grags shing / de lta bu'i mkhyen pa dang brtse ba chen pos kun nas bslangs pa'i 'chad nyan gyis legs par bskyangs pa'i snyan grags kyi springs yig grub pa lha rnams kyis bsgrags pa las/ phyogs mtha' dag nas skye bo grangs med pa 'dus/ lhun grub sman gling dang 'bras bu gling rnams su chos grwa gaṇḍis bsdus nas snga dro rgyud gdams ngag dang bcas pa'i bshad pa gtso bor mdzad/ phyi dro sman gyi ngo sprod dang sbyor tshul sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i lag len rnams ston/ bar skabs rnams su nye logs kyi nad par blta ba dang phyogs nas 'khyer 'ong ba'i chur blta ba—/ 'ga' zhig la re mos kyis bshad pa'i rtsal 'gran du 'jug pa sogs kyis dus 'da'/ mtshan mo rtse zhol sman gling rnams su gshar sbyang byed pa re re nas snyan du len/ gal te 'phyugs pa'am gnyid kyis sgrib pa byung na 'phral la bkas khyab par mdzad/ de lta bu'i ngang la dgung lo bcu bzhi'i thog tu son pa las/ dngos su rtsod pa'i spobs pas brgal ba dang lan gyis 'debs pa bo su yang ma mchis pa na/ de'i dus su byang ba 'tsho byed mi'i nyi ma mthong ba don 274

————snyesnye—nd+rand+rardzuXnd+rarwarwadzisdu2rdzusbyi༄rwarwarwa/—snye————skeldan de nyid blo dang ldan par gzigs nas dri ba dang lan gyi tshul du phrin yig gi sgo nas rtsod pa byas na'ang yang dag par rjes su bzung ngo —/ /de'i phyir rtsod pa thams cad dang bral ba yin no/ /de nas dgung lo bcu drug pa'i thog tu phebs pa'i tshe/ man ngag gces so 'tshal kun gyi snying bo bsdus pa'i g.yu thog snying thig gi gegs sel la—/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel/ ting 'dzin sems 'khrugs kyi gegs sel/ bar chad bdud kyi gegs sel/ de rnams thun mong gi gegs sel te bzhi mdzad par dgongs nas/ 'byung ba lus 'khrugs kyi gegs sel la tshigs lhug nyung ngu zhig dang / tshigs bcad dpe tshan du byas pa la zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos bye ba ring bsrel du grags pa 'di nyid mdzad/ bar skabs rnams su bla ma ka phu ba yon tan rgya mtsho la rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs par gsan/ de yang thugs nyams su bzhes te gzhan la'ang 'doms shing bstan bcos kyang mang du mdzad / de'i tshe khrus khang lo tsā ba chen pos tsa ri tra mjal du byon te zur mkhar du phebs yun ring du bsnyen cing bkur ste byas/ mi tra dzo ki'i lugs kyi khrid skor rnams dang sman dpyad man ngag khyad par ba mang bo zhig gsan/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo 'grel chen dang 275

nga——skesnye—snyeskyarwa1sngasduhūṃrjosdu2sdisbyisdurwatram̐skyarjotram̐dzisnye/—snye—snye—bcas pa'i skor dang / 'jig rten khams le'i ri mo/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ma hwa ma ya/ gsang 'dus/ gdan bzhi/ bde mchog rnams kyi bshad lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ spyod 'jug bslab btus/byams pa'i chos lnga/ rig pa'i tshogs drug skyes rabs so bzhi ba/dpag bsam 'khri shing rnams kyi lung yang dag par nos/ rim pas dgung lo nyi shu ba la/ nyin gcig klungs su khri zam gyi zhig gsos bka' bkod la phebs pa'i tshe/ he ru ka chen po sha ra rab 'byams pa de nyid dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan nas/ spyod pa la gshegs pa gzigs te brtags pas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu mkhyen nas gdan drangs 'bel gtam legs par bgyis pa na drang ba dang nges pa'i don ma 'dres par smra ba la ci yang 'gal ba med cing —/ zab mo'i don la rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog pa la rang dbang mngon du gyur par gzigs nas gzhan dag la smras pa/ a ye/rnal 'byor ba zer ba de 'di 'dra zhig dgos pa yin te/ mdo sngags rab 'byams su smra ba la rtog ge'i zhen pa ma zhugs pa/ phyi'i sgro 'dogs chod pa/ lta ba rtag chad kyi mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba/sgom pa mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob dbyer med du 'dres pa/ spyod pa spang blang dgag sgrub dang bral ba 'di lta bu'i ming tsam yang thos 276

dzosnyesnye——snyesnyesnyend+rand+rasdiXhūṃtram̐rwadzi3nd+rardzusbyi༄rwarwarwa/—snye—snyesnye——par dka' na dngos su lta ci smos de bas na bla na med pa'i mchod gnas su cis mi 'os/ gzhan dag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rig pa ni khong du chud/ rang nyid rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rang bzhin don dam pa chos kyi sku'i rang zhal mngon sum du mthong ba zhig nges par dgos na de'i gdams pa zhu bar 'os so zhes smos nas—/ thog mar bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa lnga'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs par gsan nas/ de'i mjug tu phyag chen ga'u ma dang gang gā ma/ ni gu nas brgyud pa'i chos drugaras chung snyan rgyud du grags pa/ gtum mo gangs seng ma la sogs te mang rab/ pho gcod sbrul mtsho drug pa/ ma cig gi gcod yul/dam pa'i zhi byed sogs lung man ngag zhal gdams dang bcas pa mang du gsan/ de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin la nan tan du mdzad/shin tu gsang ba'i tshul gyis mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma'ang bsten / srod dang gung thun gyi skabs su gsang spyod la gtan du gshegs / tsa zhes pa'i mdo lam rgya gram gyi steng du sha za mo drag shul dang gdug rtsub che ba zhig yod pa la zil gnon gyi dmigs pas bcings te sbyor sgrol gyi lam nas de nub tho brtsigs/ sang blta bar btang bas cong zhi ser bo rus sbal gyi gzugs yod pa zhig thon 277

snyesnye——gesnyedzorwa1sngasdund+razosdurwasdind+raskyarwasdusprisdutram̐spri—/ —snye———skad—/ de'i nub gsang spyod kyi phyag phyir rgyas ston dri med mtha' yas yod pa las/ de'i srod la 'khun pa shin tu drag pa'i skad de nyid tho rangs la zin pa'i tshe/ skad chung ngur song zhing mthar ci yang mi snang bar gyur pa mngon sum du rigs/ de la sogs te mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'byung bo gdug cing rtsub pa mang bo btul zhing dam la btags pas brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mthar phyin te he ru ka chen por gyur pa yin no/ /dus de nas nye bar bzung ste sman pa rnams 'dus pa'i chos grwa dang / phyag chen dang gcod yul ba 'dus pa'i chos grwa dang /rdzogs chen pa 'dus pa'i chos grwa ste/ so so snga dro phyi dro srod rnams la de dang de'i blo dang mthun par bshad pas yid la 'jebs shing blo gros dang rtogs pa mngon sum du bskyed nus pas 'chad pa'i bya ba rab kyi mthar phyin pa dang / 'chad pa de'ang chos lugs rang rang gi gzhung man ngag dang bcas pa rnams la brgal zhing legs par brtags nas phyogs snga phyi dang dogs spangs brgal lan te rang gzhan gyi lugs ma 'dres par dgag bzhag spang gsum gyi sgo nas lung dang rigs pa sna tshogs pas rtsod pa na gzhan gyi lta ba ngan pa sun phyungs nas chos dang chos ma yin pa la 'dor len tshul bzhin byed du 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan pas rtsod pa la mkhas pa dang /278

—————————dra nd+rasbyoXnd+rarwarwadzi3nd+rardzuljo༄rwarwa1/——bhege—snye—gso dpyad kyi bstan bcos rgyud bzhi'i 'grel chen 'od shar khra mo/spyi don chen mo g.yu thog zhal lung dngul dkar me long dang legs bshad nyi zer/ slar de nas nyung ngur bsdus pa bye ba ring bsrel la sogs pa'i gegs sel gyi bskor mang rab/ dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos/ sman ngo gsal byed sogs mtha' yas pa zhig dang /rin po che shel bzo ba'i pa tra ka gser 'gyur gyi bstan bcos/drag po me rdzas kyi 'phrul 'khor/ phyogs kyi sman pa rnams la springs yig rang gzhan la phan pa'i bslab bya mang rab/ nyams kyi rdo rje'i glu dang gsol 'debs bstod tshogs kyi skor/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel bshad/ phyag chen dang gcod yul gyi khrid yig rdzogs pa chen po'i chos skor la pod chung bcu drug pa zhig dang bcas te mang du mdzad pa kun kyang rang rang gi tha snyad dang mthun par gong 'og tu 'gal ba med cing tshang la ma zlos pa/ 'brel zhing rgyun chags pa/gsal la brling ba/ de'ang tshigs su bcad pa dang lhug pa dang spel ma rnams kyi sgo nas yul so so'i skad dang brda gsar rnying gab tshig la sogs pa mtha' dag gi tshul phyin ci ma log par 'god nus shing /de dag kyang rang gi zhal gdams kyis legs par bkrol nas ldem so dang bral bar mdzad pa ste/ mdor na yul dang dus gang zag rnams 279

dzo—snyesnye—snyesnedzond+ra2dzirwand+rarjosdurwasdind+raXrwatram̐sngasdutram̐sprige/ —snye———la ltos nas gsal bor bkod pas/ deng sang gi mkhas pa dang bar ma dang grong ba'i skye bo rnams kyis kyang spyod yul du rung bar mdzad pas bstan bcos rtsom pa la mkhas pa las kyang byang chub par gyur pa'o—/ /de ltar mkhas pa'i bya ba 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la 'dris shing grub pa'i khyad par lta sgom spyod gsum la gdengs tshad dang ldan pas dben pa dang tshogs su spyod pa la ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par ci yang med par klong du gyur pa yin no/ /bshad ma thag pa'i rdzogs chen gyi pod chung bcu drug po de rnams zur mkhar gyi lho'i phyogs brag rta mgo zhes bya bar gter du sbas nas gter bdag a lci rdo lung ma zhes bya ba la bcol te phyis rang gi skye ba'am sprul ba zhig gis 'don par 'gyur ro zhes lung du bstan pa la phyis dpe la char chus gnod pa cung zad 'byung bar nye ba na snga sor phyag phyir yod pa'i rang gi sku tsha dbon mi 'gyur zhes pa'i rmi lam du bud med gcig na re—/ khyod kyi dpon slob kyis bcol ba'i dpe la chus nyen par snang bas slar yang sba bar gyis shig ces pa byung ste/ de'i tshe khong gis blta bar phyin pas dpe la dngos su chus ma reg kyang sol ba dang phyi'i lwa ba rnams rlon par song 'dug pas slar gril rdzas dang sol ba gsar bas bkab/ chu ji ltar che yang mi gnod par bsgrubs nas 280

dzo—————snye——nd+rarjirdzuXnd+ratram̐rdzudzishaṃnd+rardzusbyisprarwarwarngi/————snyebhe—bka' gtad de bzhag go/ /sgrib pa'i sprin med gnas brgyad kun gsal las/ /brjod med ā li kā li rdo rje'i dbyangs/ /ma 'gags kun tu gsal dag rdzogs pa ni/ /dbang bo'i stobs dang mtshungs par kun la 'jug /khyod la pha rol tshu rol lam dmigs kyang / /log par lta ba'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal dgra/ /gtan tshigs gsum gyi dpung tshogs dar ba las/ /g.yul ngor brtan pa'i dpa' bo gcig bu nyid/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i gsung gi rjes 'gro ba'i/ /zab gsal snyan phreng yi ge'i gzugs brnyan can/ /sems can khams dang do mnyam zad mi shes/ /'di 'dra'i byed po 'jam pa'i dbyangs las rgan—/ /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gogs pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po las mkhas pa'i bya ba dang grub pa'i khyad par cha tsam brjod pa ste sarga bzhi ba'o// //lus stobs rgyas pa'i sha ra bha dang sems chags tshud pa'i khyu mchog dang / /gzhan yid shes pa'i cang shes rta dang bdud rtsi za ba'i skar mig bu/ /yid bzhin ster ba'i ma ṇi ka dang skye dgu'i ma ma rin chen 'di'i/ /rang bzhin gang gi'ang bsam pa'i yul min de yis slar yang skyongs shig gu/ /de nas dgung lo nyer lnga'i tshe gter bton mang bos nor 'dzin gyi sbubs nas phyungs pa'i yi ge dang rdzas 281

—skesnye—snye——dzorwa1sngasdund+rarjosdund+rasdigluXrwasdukausdutram̐skyasnye/ ———— mang bos skye bo blang dor la rmongs pa rnams bslu zhing / de'i sdig pas rang nyid log par sbyor ba la snying rje tshad med pa 'khrungs kyang /de'i tshe de'i dus na sangs rgyas gling ba'i rjes su zhugs pa mang bos dwags kong gi cha mtha' dag gang zhing de la zhen pa mang bas dngos su phyung na rang nyid la log par lta zhing 'di rnams ltung bar 'gyur gyi—/ de bas na bdag gis kyang gter bton na thabs mkhas par 'gyur ro dgongs nas/ shel las bzos pa'i bum pa dang thod pa'i nang du mngar gsum bsres pa'i chu dang āḥgasal ba'i ril bu blug shel nag po'i chos 'byung sor bzhi ba'i bu gar shog ser la yi ge shin tu phra ba bris pa'i shog dril mang du bcug pa zhig rnams o rgyan gyi sgrub gnas gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje rang byon du bzhugs pa'i lung ba'i mdar g.yang sa chen po'i sked pa nas bcugade nas lo gnyis song ba'i tshe/ da ni bdag la padma sam bha was lung du ston pa'i tshig bud med dmar mo zhig gi ngag las/ gsang ba mchog gi grub pa'i lung ba'i mdar dam pa'i chos dang bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sha dang 'chi med kyi chu rnams yod kyi de rnams myur du thon la sems can thams cad la ris med par byin zhig ces thos pas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyis la kun 'dus shig ces sgrags 282

dzo—ge—gebhesnye—rwarwasdiXnd+rardzurdzudzisdu2rtordzutshirwarwarngu/———snye—snye—so—/ /de nas spre'u zla ba'i tshes bcu'i nyin tshogs dang gtor ma rgya chen pos nye bar mchod nas skye bo grangs med pa'i dbus der sngar gyi rdzas rnams mngon gsum du snang bar byas pas thams cad dad cing dga' ba ngo mtshar bar byed cing khyad par rnying ma ba'i phyogs gtogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ e ma ho skyes bu dam pa 'di ni slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi sprul ba yin par gor ma chag go /zhes grags shing 'dus par gyur ro/ /de bzhin du nor gter dang mig 'phrul la sogs pas rnying ma ba yon bdag dang bcas pa kun dad pa lhag par skyes zin pa'i dus der slar yang skye bo mang bo la 'di skad du/ kwa ye 'di rnams ngo mtshar bar gda' 'am/ ci 'di thams cad bdag rang gis snga mo nas sbas pa slar bton pa yin par shes par gyis shig 'di ni o rgyan gyis sbas pa ma yin no/ /'di ni skye ba bdun pa'i sha dang bdud rtsi ma yin no/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kyi gsungs ma yin no/ /de bas na da lta'i dus kyi gter 'don par byed pa thams cad 'di lta bur shes par gyis shig ci'i phyir dgongs pa can nam phrag dog gis kun nas slangs pa yin nam snyam na de yang ma yin te/ ji ltar bdag gi 'di bden na de yang bden la—/ 'di rdzun na de'ang rdzun par 'gyur te/ 'di gnyis la bye brag ci 283

dzo——————dzond+rapasprurwand+rarjodzond+rasdigludzisdutram̐skyasdutram̐spri—————4yang med pa'i phyir ro/ /de bas na btang snyoms su zhog cig ces bka' bstsal to/ /'dir smras pa/ bon dang rtog ge ba yi ring lugs gang —/ /'khrul bar mkhyen nas sbas pa'i mtshang rtol te/ /dbugs bral 'gro kun slar yang dbugs phyung ba/ /drang srong dharmā'i mtshan can khyod las su/ /thang phrom zos pas smyos par byas pa bzhin/ /rang don 'bad pas rang gzhan 'di phyi'i don/ /nam mkhar gtor tshe the tshom med 'byung ba/ /'di 'dra'i skra zhags 'dzin pa bzod pa mtshar—/ /'ga' zhig dag gis phan phyir 'bad pa'i 'bras/ /dge ba'i dpag bsam gcod byed sta gri'i gzugs/ /khyod kyis gzhan la sdug bsngal byin pa yang / /thar ba chen po'i tshogs su ngang gis song —/ /de nas dbyar gyi dus la babs pa na shar phyogs mngon dga' zhes bya bar sman srid bsags pa'i slad du bzhugs pa ste/de'ang gnyal lor byar gsum/ e che chung / dwags stod smad/ rkyen phu mda'/ kong long ral gsum chol mi dang bcas pa'i sman pa gtsag chas 'dzin pa mtha' dag der bsdus nas zla ba gsum gyi phogs byin nas tshogs chos su rin chen 'khrungs dpe/ ro skor lcags phreng / bdud rtsi rdzing bu sman gyi bying la sogs te sman thams cad kyi ro nus zhu rjes ngo bo nges tshig byed las rnams kyi sgo nas 284

dzogesnye———snye—nd+rand+ra1༷nd+rardzurwadzisdund+rardzurdzudzitram̐rwa1/snye——snye———gtan la 'bebs pa'i bstan bcos rnams 'chad pa dang / nyin re bzhin ri de nyid la thegs te thog mar myu gu dang de nas rim pas lo ma sdong bu me tog 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i sngo sman gyi rigs mtha' dag 'khrul med du gtan la 'bebs shing sngo so so'i yon tan glur len pa sogs dgyes dgur spyod pa dang / ri de nyid la'ang sngo sman gyi rigs ma tshang ba med par 'khrungs shing / tsha bsil gyi ro nus kyang 'chol pa min par gnas pa zhig go /de nas dgun gyi tshe lhun grub sman gyi gling du slob ma ha cang mi mang ba dang bcas nas lde gu sman mar/ thal sman dang sman chang / rin po che tsha grang gi sbyor ba sogs lag len gyi mthong ba brgyud pas gtan la 'bebs dgos pa rnams dpe mkhyud med par gsal bor ston/ skabs skabs su rol phu dang ka 'og rnams su zla re tsam sku mtshams kyi bcad rgya dam pos rtse gcig tu mnyam par 'jog cing / ka 'og tu bzhugs pa'i tshe dpal mgon g.yu thog pa de nyid kyi zhal mngon sum bstan nas zab mo stong ba nyid la thabs bskyed pa'i rim pas rgyas btab pa'i gdams pa khyad par ba mang du gnang ste/ de'i tshe brjed tho glur blangs pa yang mang du yod la/ der ma zad dus rtag tu 'du 'bral skad cig kyang med de lus dang grib ma bzhin no/ /nam zhig gi tshe 285

dzo———snye—skespyorwapasngasdund+rarjospra2nd+rardzudzirwaṇaskyasdutram̐spri—/snyesnye—snye—rkyen yul nas brgyud bkra shis ljongs dang / ba yo rnams su zla re tsam gyi sgrub pa mdzad/ khyad par du gsang gi phur bdud rtsi sman mchod kyi sgrub pa byas pas a mṛ ta'i ka pā la kha lud nas dri bzang gis phyogs thams cad khyab ste yun ring du gnas pa dang / lta rtog mkhar dang rgya la rnams su'ang sman bla gsang sgrub kyi dbang gnang dus ye shes pa dngos su babs pa mang du byung ba la sogs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de rnams su gsungs pa'i glu dang man ngag kyang mang du yod do/ /de nas kong smad kyi gdul bya mthar phyin nas kong stod kyi cha gtso bo phu mda' dang grus smad shar nub tu phebs/ steng kha zhang lha zhes pas gus pas btud cing yun ring du bsnyen/ der dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin rgya'i ston pa dri med mtha' yas la/ khyod bdag dang chung ngu nas 'grogs shing lhag par gus pas bdag gis ji ltar bcol ba'i las nus sam gsungs pas/ kho na re/ khyed kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par 'dug na shi yang 'gal ba med zer ba la/ 'o na legs kyis 'dongs nas grus smad nub phyogs kyi yar sna gtsang bo'i mtsho yar 'khyil ba zhig yod pa de'i rtsar byon nas/ thod pa mtshan ldan zhig yod pa kho la gtad nas khyed rang 'di khyer la the tshom med par mtsho 'di'i gting du 286

——snye——snye——nd+rarwa1༷rwarwardzudzisdund+rardzuzi༄rdzurwarngu/————snyesnye—song la thod pa 'dis gang byung ba zhig longs la shog khyod mi 'chi ba'i thabs ngas byed pa yin gsungs pas/ khos kyang ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin byas nas steng du slebs pa'i tshe bltas pas/ thod pa gser gyis gang ba'i steng du nor bu che chung bya gag gi sgo nga tsam la zla ba'i zer dang phrad pa na chu 'byung zhing nyi zer gyis reg pa na me byung ba de nyid slob ma shin tu mang ba dang zhang lha pha bu rnams la bstan nas/ 'o slob ma zer ba de 'di 'dra ba zhig dgos pa yin/bla ma sangs rgyas su mthong bas ci gsungs tshad mar go mos gus tshad du 'khyol bas bka' lung ci gnang sgrub/ the tshom som nyi med pas bar chad bdud las grol/ rang 'dod 'khri ba med pas dngos grub dngos su thob/ byin rlabs rang sar zhugs pas ltad mo ngo mtshar che/ 'di 'dra ba mngon sum du mthong ba a la la/ mdang nub nga'i rmi lam du nub phyogs nas 'ja' dkar bo zhig gi sna la dpal mgon g.yu thog pa de nyid he ru ka'i cha byad can phyag na kā pā la skra dang bcas pa khrag zhag gis gang ba'i steng du snying bzhag nas zhal du stob pa/ kṛṇḍa sā ra'i wags pa'i steng du bzhugs pa'i yan lag lnga nas bud med kha dog mi 'dra ba lngas btegs pa zhig mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te bu khyod dang bdag 'du 'bral skad cig kyang med 287

dzosnyege——snye—skyand+rapasprisdund+rarjosdu2sdind+radzirwasdusprisdutram̐rjo—/gesnyeskesnye—mod—/ 'on kyang da lta yid la ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub bdag gir gyis shig ces gsungs pa na/ bdag gis rgyal ba thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa dang / 'gro ba mi'i lus kyi sdug bsngal phra rags rnams drungs nas 'byin par bya ba'i phyir phyag gi thod pa bcud dang bcas pa gnang dgos zhus pas/zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas pas gnang byung yang re zhig mtsho ma gi na klu sbrul mgo stong dang ldan pa zhig 'dug pa des khyer ba rmis pas/bden nam snyam ste/ da res len du btang bas rten 'brel shin tu 'grig nas lon byung ba 'di yin/ da ni dri bzang bo'i sman rnams kyis byi dor gyis la rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mor bkod nas gsol ba thob dang —/ rang gzhan gyi dngos grub thams cad 'di las 'byung bar gdon mi za bas de ltar gyis shig ces gsungs pa ltar mtshan ldan thod pa'i nang du sman khrus byas pa rnams 'thung ba dang / rang rang gi mos pa bzhin smon lam sna re 'debs pa dang mgur dang bro 'khrab pa dang / nyid kyis kyang gang sku ma zhes bya ba'i nyams mgur slob bu rnams kyis ram 'degs dang bcas pa mdzad cing kun kyang mos pa rtse gcig tu gyur pa las yid la ji ltar re ba'i dngos grub sna re'ang thob ces grags so//de ltar skye bo thams cad kyi mthun snang du 288

rdzidze———————st+rind+rasdiXrwa ༷rdzudzi3hūṃnd+rardzumirwashurngu/snye—dzosnye— stodzesnye gyur pa'i grub pa'i rtags 'di 'dra ba la zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang dpag par dka' pa'i cho 'phrul mngon sum du bstan nas/ slar yang ldang tsho skor brgyud nas zur mkhar du phyag phebs—/ der yang chab 'bangs dang gdul bya mang bos bsnyen zhing bkur ba'i tshogs gral du sman dri zhim pos sku khrus gsol ba'i chu dang —/ de'i snga nub bco lnga'i zla zer dang phrad pa'i chu dang / mtshan ldan gyi pho thod mo thod du chang blug pa dang bsres nas skye bo thams cad la sbyin/ snyan grags kyis ji ltar khyab pa bzhin sngar gyi lo rgyus kyang cung zad bsnyad/ de ma thag nyi zer gyis reg ma thag spra ba dang sol ba la me sbar ba dang / gos dar ras sam snam bu dri med tshig ste dud pa chu ru byung ba kun gyis mthong bas thams cad ngo mtshar bar gyur to/ /nor bu de dag dang thod pa gnyis po bkra shis kyi rdzas kyis yongs su bkang ba'i nang du bzhugs su gsol nas da lta'ang mngon sum du yod do/ /'dir yang smras pa/ khyod la dngos kun snang ngor ro gcig kyang / /'ga' zhig rin thang med ces gus mchod pas—/ /ji ltar smon pa'i 'bras bu stsol byed pa/ /yid bzhin nor bu'ang 'di yi 'gran zlar 'khums/ /dngos grub grub pa rnams kyi dri med thugs/ /gang gis ma bzhus na'ang gong bu'i tshul/ /'dod 289

snye—————bheskyaspra1sngasdund+rarjotsho2sdirdzuXsdutram̐rwasdutram̐sdusnye/ —————dgu'i yi ge dbyangs su len pa ni/ /sa 'og lag 'gro'i dpal 'byor phyogs sam snyam/ /bla ma rigs bdag he ru ka dpal de/ /dngos su mthong zhing ngo mtshar ci zhig 'tshal/ /ma nyams sku yi gsang ba ji tsam pa/ /khyod dang rnam dbyer bdag la ma 'tshal to/ /sna tshogs rdzu 'phrul yangs pa'i grwa gcig na/ /stong gsum khru gang phug gam yungs 'bru tsam/ /mngon par sbyor la'ang dal ba yongs med na/ /'di dag cho 'phrul che zhes gyi na tsam/ /'on kyang rmi lam bag ma dang mtshungs pa'i/ /dngos kun chu shing snying bo'i ra ba nas/ /mthal bral phyag rgya che la'ang gus gtod pa'i/ /yang dag dngos po'i dga' ston byin par gyur/ /bstan pa'i rtsa lag 'gro ba'i gdung sel mkhan—/ /rigs mthun zla bo med pas yid skyo ste/ /srid zhi'i dge legs gcig tu bsdus pa'i gzugs/ /rang gi 'gran zla rang gis byas sam snyam/ /zhes kyang bya'o/ /'o na dpal mgon g.yu thog pa de nyid rang ji lta bu zhig go snyam na bshad par bya ste/ de'ang sngon gyi bskal ba dpag tu med pa'i snga rol nas rgyal ba rnams kyi bstan pa la bya ba byas shing byed pa byas pa/ slar snying rje'i gzhan dbang gis dran shes bzhin du srid par yang nas yang du skye ba blangs nas gang la gang 'dul gyi skur ston pa zhig ste/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir yang 290

ge————bhe— nd+ra2sdiXnd+ratram̐rwadzi32rtozisprarda rwaX—/bhe—snyesnyesnye4 —chos kyi rgyal bo srong btsan sgam po dang dwags po lha rje sogs su skye ba bzhes shing / slar g.yu thog pa yon tan mgon po zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin la/ 'dis dgung lo brgyad pa'i thog nas shes bya dang /shes bya'i rang bzhin ji lta ba thugs su chud de/ rgya gar du lan gsum byon nas ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang dngos su mjal te rgyud gdams ngag dpag tu med pa gsan/ mu stegs kyi rgyal bo sdig can gyis me chu dug mtshon sogs kyi chad pas gcod pa la lta stangs re tsam gyis rang nyid grol zhing pha rol bo rings pa la sogs pa'i grub pa'i rtags ya ma zung dang / tshong 'dus 'gur mor yang a ru ra'i char ba 'bebs pa dang / nyi ma yun ring du 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i cho 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan nas gdul bya smin grol la bkod de mthar dag pa 'ja' lus kyi sku brnyes nas mkha' spyod la gshegs pa yin no/ /zhib pa ra rnam thar bka' rgya ma dang bla sgrub lo rgyus dang de nyid kyi gsung mgur rnams su gsal lo/ /de nas bdag nyid chen po slob bu mang rab dang bcas nas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i gnas tsa ri tra ye shes kyi 'khor lor gshegs/ de'ang gnas kyi lte ba yin pa'i phyir thog mar mtsho dkar 'du la byon pa'i tshe—/ bad med sngo sangs ma 'ga' zhig gis sku tshe bsring ba la 'bad ༄291

—snyesnye——snyesnyeskyand+ra1dzirwand+rarjosdu2sdi gludzirwatram̐sdusdutram̐rjo—/ snye——bherdzidagos par lung bstan/ de nas rim pas cig car la rgyud nas dwags po shri ri'i nang skor la byon nas yul smad ḍā ki ni'i mdun sa dang zil chen gsang ba'i phug pa/ skyed tshang mi ro 'khun pa rnams su zla ba gsum re tsam bzhugs shing mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bstar bas rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i rang zhal mngon sum du gzigs/ de dus kyang thol byung gi mgur mang du gsungs pa yod do/ /slar zur mkhar du phebs pa'i tshe grub mda' ba dang sku rab pa nang 'khrugs pa'i dbang gis zhabs drung karma phrin las 'di nyid dgung lo bcu gcig pa zhig zur mkhar du nye srid dbang gis phebs/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i drung du gcod skor dang rdzogs chen gyi chos tshan 'ga' zhig gso rig rgyud bzhir grags pa/ de'i bshad thabs cha lag bco brgyad/man ngag bye ba ring bsrel la sogs pa mang du gsan/ de'i skabs su rang nyid la phan pa'i gtam log rtog kun 'dul zhes bya ba/slob ma rnams la gsung sgros snying gi thur ma dang / me chu go ldog sogs dang / gsol 'debs 'chi med rnga sgra dang dad pa'i rba rlabs la sogs pa mang du mdzad pa yin no/ /de nas yun mi ring ba na chos kyi rje sha ra ba de nyid dag pa mkha' spyod du gshegs pa las/292
