dzosnyesnye——dzebhesnye—nd+rand+rasdingachend+rardzurdzukaushaṃnd+rardzukaurwarwarwarngu/gesnye—snye—snye—lhun grub sman gling kham sdong gi 'og tu spur khang brtsigs te bzhugs su gsol nas zhugs la phul/ dngos su bshams pa dang bcas pa'i kun bzang gi mchod pas mchod cing gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis 'bod pa sogs byas pas/ sku gdung gi dum bu mtha' dag sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku dang / gsung yig 'bru dang /zhugs kyi du ba gar phog dang spur thal kun kyang ring bsrel yungs 'bru tsam kha dog lnga ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa las phal cher mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs su gsol/ de'i nang nas spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol ma'i sku phul du phyin pa gnyis bdag nyid chen po 'dis bcangs pa la zur mkhar ba'i ring bsrel sgrol ma dang thugs rje chen po zhes par grags/ mang rab bang rim pa dang sgam po ba la yod ces zer/ da dung yang dad pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis kham sdong gi srubs nas lha sku dang ring bsrel rnyed pa mang du 'byung ba yod do/ /'di lta bu yang drang srong chen po 'di nyid kyi dad pa'i stobs rmad du byung ba las gzhan ma yin no/ /de nas skabs skabs su dngul chu'i ril bu sgrub pa dang gser 'gyur dang rin po che shel gyi rigs mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bzo ba dang / gtsag bu sogs cha byad kyi rigs bshad rgyud nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin bzo ba la mgar ba sus 293

—snye—snye——snyedzorwa1dzisdund+razosdu2sdirdzuXrdasdusdusprisdusbyosprisnye/ snye—snyebhemikyang bskrun mi nus par mdzad pa zhig las/ ma tshang ba med pa'i cha byad phyag bzo ma nyams pa rnams ches phul du byung zhing byin rlabs kyang che bar snang zhes mang du yod cing / de'i rgyun gyi dwags kong gi sman pa phal che ba la dpyad kyi cha byad tshang ba re 'dug na'ang /dbus gtsang dang la stod lho byang mnga' ris rnams su de 'dra yod pa'i sman pa gcig kyang ma mthong zhing rtsad ma chod do/ /de nas rim gyis dgung lo sum cu so gnyis tsam gyi thog tu slar yang kong bo'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du nga la brgyud nas sprog rab steng du phebs/der spyan snga rin po che phebs pa dang mtshungs pas zhabs drung du byon pa nyi ma 'ga' zhig gi bar du dgyes dgur spyod cing 'bel gtam gyis skabs mi phyed/ dpon slob thugs gnyis su med pa'i tshul gzhan gyi blo ngo las 'das pa mdzad/ de nas karma chos drug dang phag mo'i brda dbang / dpal mkha' spyod pa'i zab khrid 'ga' zhig dang glu phreng gi skor rnams gsan/ zla ba lnga tsam bzhugs kyang 'bral mi phod pa'i gdung shugs mdzad de mthar zhabs la phyag bgyis nas/ lags/ rang cag dpon slob gnyis skye ba mang bo zhig tu dpon slob kho nar 'brel ba zhig yin 'dug pa la bdag gis ma 'tshal bas/ dus gsum du ji ltar 'brel ba'i tshul bsdus pa zhig 294

—mi—bhe— ———nd+rarwasdidzond+ratram̐rwakaushaṃnd+rardzusbyi rnasdurwarngu/—————snye—gnang dgos zhus pas de bzhin du gnang ba ni gong du smos pa de nyid yin no/ /de nas btegs te nal sa phyogs nas tsa ri gsar mar byon/ g.yu thog snying thig gi sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad/ bdud rtsi ril bu snod yongs su 'phel zhing dri zhim pos yul khams thams cad khyab par byung bas kun gyis ngo mtshar che zhes grags shing rgyal ba sman bla de nyid longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhal gzigs/ gsol zhing bstod pa yang mang du mdzad/ de nas yang gsang gi phur gong long ral gsum gyi sman pa thams cad 'dus nas dbang dang gdams pa gnang bar gsol ba 'debs pa na/ sman gyi bla ma'i phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon las so sor bsgrub nas bdag 'jug sogs sbyin sreg gi bar du phyag len tshang la ma nor ba yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbang lung man ngag dang bcas pa lhug par gnang /rang nyid kyang rtsa rlung thig le'i 'pho ba yas bstan gyi dga' ba dang mas bstan gyi dga' ba khyad par du byas pa'i lhan cig skye dgu'i ye shes rol bzhin par slob ma rnams la 'di skarta ces gsungs te/gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nye lam 'di ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa thams cad kyi yang snying las kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa ste/don gcig na yang ma rmongs dang / /thabs mang dka' ba med pa 295

——snyesnye—ge—skyand+ra1sprusdund+raskyaspra2sdirdzuXrwasdutrirjotram̐spri—/ bhebhege——dang / /dbang bo rnon po'i dbang byas phyir/ /sngags kyi theg pa khyad par 'phags/ /zhes bya ba'i don de nyid slar yang rig pa 'dzin pa'i sde snod spyi dang 'di'i khyad par gyis ched du 'jug par gdon mi za ste/ rim pa lnga dang sbyor ba yan lag drug la sogs pa zab lam gzhan rnams las bgrod thag nye zhing byin rlabs myur bar mngon gsum gyis mthong ba'i phyir/ thar ba 'dod pa rnams kyis slad nas lam 'di nyid nyams su len zhing 'jug pa la brtson par gyis shig ces gdams par mdzad do/ /de bzhin du kong smad kyi gnas rnams su yang dbang lung man ngag lag len ngo sprod sogs kyis gdul bar 'os pa rnams kyi mi shes pa phyir bsal zhing / dngul chu grub pa'i bstan bcos bstan pa'i rgyun la'ang / phan 'gyur mang du brtsams nas rim pas kong stod phyogs su btegs/ slar yang grus smad steng ka'i gangs phug tu phebs/ nyang long brag gsum dang 'chol mi skor gyi slob bu thams cad 'dus/ dpon slob phyed dang nyis brgya tsam la zla ba gsum gyi ring zhang lhas bsnyen zhing bkur/ der yang yan lag brgyad pa rang 'grel zla zer dang bcas/ 'od shar khra mo/ g.yu thog zhal lung rnams kyi sgo nas 'chad thabs la mkhas pas gdul bya'i rgyud la nges shes 'phral du bskyed nus pa zhig ste/ de'ang dum bu 296

dzo———ge4 ———st+rind+ra1༷nd+ratram̐rwadzi3nd+rardzusbyisprarwarwarngu/snyesnyeske—snye—skedang bo 'chad pa'i skabs su yid ches shing khungs btsun pa'i ched du gso dpyad kyi 'byung khungs dang bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus kyi sgo nas khog dbugs dgos sogs chos bzhi'i sgo nas log rtog sel/dgongs gzhi dgos pa dngos la gnod byed kyi sgo nas brgal lan spros—/ dpe'i sgo nas gso dpyad kyi tshig don mtha' dag gtan la phabs pas dbang bo yang rab rnams kyi don bde blag tu sgrub pa /dum bu gnyis pa bshad pa'i skabs su/ mngal chags pa nas bzung ste lus grub pa'i tshul dga' bo mngal 'jug sogs mdo sde dang sbyar/rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi gnas tshul byed las dang bcas pa rgyud sde dang sbyar/ nad kyi rang bzhin dug gsum dang rtsa ba ma rig pas bskyed tshul nges don dang bstun/ spyod lam zas sman gyi rim pa 'dul ba dang sbyar/ ro nus zhu rjes kyi 'gro ldog rten cing 'brel 'byung gi ngo bor ston/ gso ba bo sman pa'i bya ba byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las 'byung ba ltar bshad pas dbang bo 'bring rnams kyi re ba 'gengs par mdzad/ dum bu gsum pa bshad pa'i skabs su/nad dang rtags dang bcos thabs dang log gnon thams cad brang sprad nas rgan mo mdzub tshugs kyi tshul du ston pas dbang bo tha ma rnams kyi yid rangs par mdzad/ dum bu bzhi ba mjug don dang 297

—snyebhe—snye —bhedzorwa1sngarwand+radrisdu2sdirngatshisdutram̐rjosdutram̐dzirdzu/dzo—snyesnye——bcas pa bshad pa'i skabs su/ rtsa chu'i brtag thabs phal che ba rnams 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs kyi sgo nas gtan la 'babs shing /'byung ba dgra grogs skor 'go nag rtsis sogs so ma rā dza dang bstun—/ le'u gzhan rnams su nad mgo mtshungs par sman dang dpyad thams cad bsil drod gnyis su bsdus nas bshad pas dbang bo shin tu dman pa rnams kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba la goms shing 'dris pas mkhas pa rnams kyi nang nas kyang ches mkhas pa dang / mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes rtag pa dam pa'i sku mngon du mdzad nas chos thams cad ro mnyam ste dgag sgrub spang blang ched du ma mdzad kyang sems can gyi don rang bzhin gyis 'grub pas grub pa las kyang ches mchog tu grub pa dang / rang nyid kyis ji ltar brnyes pa'i 'bras bu mchog la gzhan dag kyang 'jog nus shing rnyed pa dang bkur ste sogs chos brgyad kyi dri tsam yang ring du dor bas na bzang ba las kyang ches lhag par bzang ba ste/ de ltar mkhas grub bzang gsum gyi sgo nas sems can dpag tu med pa'i don mdzad pa yin no/ /'o na chos mtha' dag la mkhas shing grub pa de ltar na/gso ba rig pa kho na rtsal du 'don zhing gzhan rnams btang snyoms su 'jog pa ci zhe na/ mdo rgyud gzhan rnams mi zab cing mi mkhyen 298

————————nd+rand+rasdo ༷hūṃrdzurdzudzi3nd+rartokausprarwarwarngi/—snyesnyelkeske4 —pa ma yin na'ang / gso dpyad gcig po che thang du mdzad pa ni/dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i nang gi le'u dang bor/ mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni dngos grub rgyu ru sngags pa dag gis yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /lus med na ni dngos grub med cing skye ba 'di la mchog gi bde ba thob par 'gyur ba'ang med/ /de phyir lus kyi don gyi rgyur ni nyin zhag so so'i dus su rtsa yi sbyor ba bsgom par bya/ /lus ni grub na gzhan pa'i dngos grub srid pa gsum gyi gnas su mngags gzhug nyid du rab tu 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mtha' dag dal 'byor gyi lus las rnyed dgos shing de'ang tshe ring ba las yin te/ rgya gar du'ang thog mar grub pa 'i ril bu bsgrubs nas khong du za ba sogs bcud len sna tshogs pas tshe bsrings nas slar mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa bzhin du/ 'dir yang bdud rtsir sa ya na la sogs pa'i sgo nas sman gyi bcud len chen pos tshe ring du bsrings shing mi na bar gnas pa dang na ba'i zug rngu bde blag tu dbyung ba'i thabs su tshe'i rig byed las gzhan pa'i thabs med par dgongs pa dang / bye brag tu deng sang tshe'i snyigs ma mthar thug pa 'dir skye bo sbyin sogs la dga' ba rnams dang rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshad sgrub kyi tshul la so sor zhugs pa phal 299

dzosnye—ge———skyaspra1sngasdund+radrisdu2sdiglutshisdutram̐sprirwatram̐spri—/ ——snye——che ba rnams dge ba la brtson pa la sdang ba'i 'byung bo rnams kyis bar du gcod pas dus min du 'chi ba la thugs lhag par 'byung ba dang —/ rnyed par dka' ba'i lus dang ldan pa'i tshe ni skad cig ma re bsring bar nus kyang tshogs dpag tu med pa bzlum par gzigs pa dang —/ rnam pa gcig tu na chos thams cad la smon 'jug sems bskyed kyis zin pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos na/ tshul 'dir zhugs pa phal cher gyi rgyud la sdom pas ma zin rung kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rgyun chags su shugs la gnas shing / de'i sgo nas rang gzhan gnyis ka'i don ya ma bral bar zung 'jug tu nyams su len par rung ba'i gdams ngag dang ldan pas lam shin tu zab par dgongs pa dang / rnam pa gnyis su na da lta'i gdul bya thams cad 'dod pa'i dngos po la sred pa 'ba' zhig yin pas de rnams thabs kyis bkri ba la chos dang nor dang bde ba dang grags pa gcig car du thob pa'i slad du lam 'di la gzhol zhing 'bad par mdzad pa yin la / rnam pa gzhan du na/ deng sang gso ba rig pa'i tshul 'di nyid rig byed kyi yan lag yin pa'i phyir dam pa'i chos ma yin no snyam pa dang —/ gal te yin kyang lam gol bas mi zab po snyam nas rjes su slob cing nyams su len pa nyin skar bzhin du gyur pas gso rig gi 300

snye—————snyend+rarwaguXnd+rashaṃrwadzisdudutram̐sbyi༄rwarwarngu/——snyesnyesnyetho —bstan pa khol bur nyams pa kun gyis mthong yang gces spras su byed mkhan su yang mi snang ba rnams la snying rje chen pos nye bar dgongs nas gso rig gi man ngag gzhung lugs dang bcas pa la byi dor legs par byas nas gso rig gi srol gsum pa zhig gtod pa la rtsol ba dang ldan par mdzad pa yin no/ /'o na dge ba la brtson pa rnams kyi tshe bsrings na bsod nams mchog tu 'gyur ba de ltar yin du chug kyang / sdig pa la mngon par phyogs pa rnams kyi tshe ring bar byas pa na sems can mang bo la gnod pas ci ltar bya snyam na/ de ni gso thub par 'dug na'ang spang bar bya ba yin te/ bshad rgyud las/rgyal bo dge ba'i bshes dang 'gro la sdang / /sman pas byas pa mi bzo brnyas pa byed/ /brel dang 'byor ba mi ldan nyan mi btub/ /tshe zad mya ngan la gnas bstan pa bshig /skye bo'i ya ga ngan pa 'byung ba'i phyir—/ /gso thabs yod kyang spang bar bshad pa yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sdang zhing sems can gyi srog gcod pa sogs mi dge ba'i las la mngon par dga' ba rnams tshe ring bar byas na de'i sdig pas rang gzhan thams cad ngan song du lhung bar 'gyur bas gso ba lta ci smos— gsang sngags las de 'dra ba'i mi sbyor sgrol gyi sgo nas myur du 301

—ge——bhe——skyarwa1dzisdund+razosdund+rasdigludzirwatram̐skyasdutram̐trisnye/—snye—— gsod dgos par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /de nas skabs zhig na zhang lha bad khrag 'thab pa'i nad kyis mnar ba'i tshe nyid spyan drangs pa la zla shel myu gu'i sbyor ba zhes pa'i man ngag sngon med kyi sbyor ba brtsams te sbyin pas nad kyi zug rngu las grol/ de'i tshe khyed kyi nad 'di lo 'ga' zhig nas cung zad cig langs yong / de dus sman pas khrag gtar du 'ong bas de la 'dzems pa gal che/ gzhan dus min du 'chi ba med gsungs so/ /de bzhin du chos kyi rje zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i rjes su sngar gyi nad ro cung zad langs pa la zhugs pa lha rjes stod du khrag ro rgyas pa yin pas gtar ba yin zer ba la/ zhang lhas sngar chos rje'i gsung sgros bskyar bas kho na re/ nga skra dkar bor song phyin sman dpyad la goms pas lag nyes su gsod ma myong / khyed rang skrag mi dgos zer nas snod ka la gtar bas snying rtsa la zin te kha chems kyang bzhag long med par che'i dus byas so zhes grags so/ /'dis ni drang srong chen po 'di la mngon par shes pa drug dang ldan no zhes dper mtshon par byas pa yin no/ /snying rjes thugs ni dkrugs pa las/ /gzhan gyi don gyis ngal gyur pa—/ /'di 'dra'i dga' ba srog chags ni/ /'phyi ba sgom la'ang skye mi 'gyur—/ /lan mang srid par skye bzung nas/ /'bad pa'i tshul la 302

—ge——bhe—snyend+rarwasdiXtram̐nd+ratram̐rwakaushaṃnd+rardzurdesdi spyam rwarngi/— — — 4————brtag pa'i tshe/ /rang don skad cig mi gnyer ba/ /'di 'dra the tshom dang bcas gyur//gang gi rang bzhin tsan dan gyis/ /ga bur sdong bu ma btags kyang / /rdzi phyogs yin min phyogs rnams su/ /dri bsung zad mi shes 'di mtshar/ /rdzogs sangs mchog gi rgyur gyur rdo rje'i lus—/ /dus min gshin rje'i mdzub ris rjes 'gro ba/ /slar zlog byed las gzhan pa'i phan bde'i rgyu/ /med ces khyod kyi rnam thar 'di ni rmad— /ces drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa yi ge'i gtam chen po las sku tshe de nyid kyi gdul bya mthar phyin par mdzad pa'i sarga ste lnga ba'o// //legs byas sngags kyi nus ldan tshe/ /dam pa'i skyes bu sgyu ma'i gar—/ /sna tshogs phan bde'i gzugs mang bo/ /ston la ngal ba ci zhig yod/ /'on kyang rang skal bya ba rdzogs pa na/ /mchog gi phung bo mngon par 'du mdzad pa/ /ci ga snyam du so sor rtogs mod kyang / /chos nyid yin phyir mtshar du ga la che/ /chu srin khyim du spyod tshe tsha zer can/ /myur mgyogs gom stabs 'dzin snyam med mod kyang / /'dzam gling sa la snang ba thung ngu'i tshul/ /'di 'dra dus kyi skyon du gdon mi za/ /chos kun mkha' ltar mnyam nyid stong gsal sku/ /rgyal ba kun kyang ro gcig 'dres gyur pa'i/ /dngos de rang gi 'byung 303

—snye——skesnye——skyatram̐1sduḍasdund+radzisduhūṃsdirdzudzirwatram̐skyasdutram̐rjosnye/ —dzosnyete—snye—gnas yin no zhes/ /slar yang de la snyoms par 'jug par rtsom/ /de nas dgung lo sum cu rtsa bdun pa/ myos byed ces bya shing mo lug gi lo gro bzhin zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi nyin mthar phyin gyi bu chen bzhis gtsos pa'i slob ma gsar rnying dpag tu med pa la sman bla gsang sgrub kyi dbang yongs su rdzogs par gnang / de'i tshogs gral du—/ 'o bu rnams shes par gyis shig gang 'dus byas pa de ni mi rtagagang mi rtag pa de ni stong ba/ stong ba gang yin pa de ni bdag med/bdag med gang yin pa de ni mya ngan las 'das pa ste/ de bas na ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang the tshom gyi gnas dang yid la ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsal bor dris shig bdag gis kyang snying gi zhun thig mkha' 'gro'i gsang gtam/ bla ma'i snyan brgyud sngon chad yi ge'i ris su 'bri ma myong ba'i gdams pa 'ga' zhig yod pa'ang phyi rabs kyi don du yi ger 'god pa yin pas yid la zungs la gces spras su gyis shig ces gsungs nas/ ril nag che 'bring chung gsum gyi gsang don gsal byed 'chi med nor bu sogs khyad par mang rab kyang bkod/ de la sogs te man ngag tshig nyung la don mang zhing gsal la/ tshig rkang re res gdams pa rdzogs par ston nus pa kho na ste/ zin bris de rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa la 304

—snyesnye—snye——nd+ra2sbyoXhūṃtram̐rdzudzi32rdzu1dzisdurwarngu/snyeṅka sko————dpal ldan zur mkhar ba'i khyad chos bye ba ring bsrel zhes gangs can gyi rgyal khams pa kun la yongs su grags shing bdud rtsis rab tu gang ba'i bum pa bzhin du 'chi ba las zlog par byed pa'i dngos por grub pa 'di dag yin la/ de yang bdag nyid chen po 'dis chos thams cad kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul mngon sum du mkhyen cing gzigs pas gzhung lugs rnams la ltos mi dgos par ro nus zhu rjes kyi tshul phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud nga las/bzang drug sogs rtsi sman rkyang ba la mi ltos par rtsi shing nags tshal sngo rigs kun dang sa rdo la sogs pa skyes tshad mthong tshad kyi ro nus gcig grogs gcig gis byed nus pa/ thams cad mthun par sdebs pas rnyed sla la phan che ba'i gdams ngag yul dus gnas skabs su nye bar mkho ba 'di 'dra ba ni sngon chad gangs ri'i khrod du ma byung ba kun gyis shes shing slad nas kyang 'byung bar cha ma 'tshal te/ 'on kyang rgyal ba'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab par nges so/ /de lta bu'i man ngag 'di ni gangs can gyi stod smad kun la khyab cing yid 'phrog pas da dung yang 'gro ba'i don du phyis je cher 'gro ba dang /thams cad kyis nyams su len zhing gces spras su mdzad pa 'dis kyang khyad par grub po/ /'on kyang bstan pa'i chom rkun pa 'ga' 305

snye—ge—snye—༷spra—༷padzirwand+rarjo jirwaprind+radzirwatram̐rjosdutram̐sdu—/ snyesnye———zhig gis ro nus mthun sdebs kyi tshul dang man ngag gi gnad ma go bar gab tshig dang bsdu yig log par bkral nas 'tsho ba phyin ci log tu sgrub pa dang rang gis byas pa'i sbyor ba bsil drod mi mtshungs pa 'ga' zhig bcug nas ming bye ba ring bsrel du 'dogs pa dang / 'ga' zhig gis 'di nas brkus pa'i man ngag rang gis byas par rlom pa dang / kha cig gis 'di nas bshad pa'i sman sngo shing gi rigs 'ga' zhig thos ma myong yang log par ngos 'dzin pa dang —/ sman ngo gsal byed dang ma nu'i dri tshig rnams la'ang bye ba ring bsrel du ngos 'dzin pa dang / la las 'di'i don rang gis ji tsam shes pa rnams kyang slob ma la mi 'chad par dpe mkhyud 'ba' zhig byed pa dang / kha cig gis tshig don gang yang mi shes bzhin du gzhan la lung 'bog pa dang byed du 'jug pa sogs kyis 'chol bar sprod pa dang / slob ma rnams kyis kyang po ti de byung ba rang gis chog par bzung nas slob dpon la mi 'dri bar rang gis shes so zer ba'i grags 'dod snying la zhugs pa'i bya ba mang bo rtsom pa sogs byas na gdams ngag gi byin rlabs dang nus pa nad thog tu mi 'bab cing / tha na lung gi rgyun tsam yang nyams par 'gyur bas/slad nas de lta bu ma yin par tshul bzhin du mdzad 'tshal zhes bye ba 306

————snye———nd+rarwagluXnd+rarwarwadzi3nd+ratram̐zisprarwarwarngu/—— snye—bhe4 ring bsrel las brtsam nas glengs pa'o/ /de nas sku khams kyang cung zad snyung ba'i tshul 'dug pa dang / sngar gyi bka' lung la dpag nas zhing khams gzhan du gshegs par dogs nas slob ma rnams kyis yan lag bdun pa'i gsol 'debs dngos 'byor gyi tshogs 'khor dang bcas mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba drag tu btab kyang bzhugs par zhal gyis ma 'ches par/ tshes bco lnga'i zla ba shar ma thag gzugs kyi sku de nyid chos kyi skur ro gcig tu snyoms par zhugs par gyur to/ /de nas rang gi gcung bo dpon rje btsun dang tsha bo mi 'gyur/ 'phags dbon dang tshe 'bum la sogs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul ba'i mchod sbyin phyi nang gsang gsum gyis gdung la nye bar mchod cing gsol ba btab nas bdun zhag dang bo'i skabs su spur bzhu bar brtsams pa na gdung shin tu chung ngur song 'dug pa la sems skrag ste zhugs la phul yang byin rlabs kyi rten ci yang mi 'byung dogs pas yid thengs pa'i tshe/nam mkha' la 'od sna tshogs 'dzings pa'i khong nas ā li kā li'i sgra grags pa kun gyis thos pas thams cad yi rangs shing mos pa gting tshugs par gyur to/ /'di ni phung bo lhag ma med pa'i dbyings su mya ngan las 'das pa'i bltas su gor ma chag go /de'i gdung thal dang 307

snye——ge———skyasprasdudzisdund+razorjo2sdi2dzirwasdusprisdutram̐kausnye/ —snye——4spur rdo rnams la gangs phug rang du mchod rten brtsigs te da lta'ang phyag dang mchod pa'i gnas dang bsod nams kyi zhing du grub pa yin no—/ /de ltar bdag nyid chen po 'di la snga rting thams cad du sdom na slob bu grangs med kyang / gso ba rig pa'i phyogs la mthar phyin gyi slob ma bzhi zhes grags pa las man ngag mthar phyin mi 'gyur tshe brtan—/ 'phrin las mthar phyin 'phags dbon bsod nams bkra shis—/ lag len mthar phyin tshe 'bum rdo rje/ bshad pa mthar phyin le chung padma skyabs zhes pa dang bzhi ste/ 'di rnams ni ming dang don mthun par gnas pa yin no/ /gal te 'dir smos pa'i phyogs re'i yon tan de dag dang ldan pa tsam la phul du byung ba'i slob mar bgrang bar mi rigs te/ mtha' dag shes pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir ro snyam na/ bden mod de dag ni gsung rab kyi thos pas dben pa'i dogs pa yin te/ gzhan du na man ngag mthar phyin par byed pa de'i rten gzhi gzhung lugs kun la legs par sbyangs zhing 'dris pa zhig ci nas kyang med thabs med cing / de bzhin 'phrin las mthar phyin par byed pa la grags pa thob pa dgos shing de thob par byed pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo ni gzhung gdams ngag lag len dang bcas pa la mkhas pa zhig nges par dgos pa dang / lag len 308

snye—snye—————st+rirwasdiXnd+ratram̐rdzudzi32rdzurdzumirwarwarji/——snye—rdzi———mthar phyin par byed pa la'ang lag tu blang bya nad dang gnyen ngo sprod tshul gzhung so so dang gdams ngag zab mo las shes dgos shing de'ang ji lta ji snyed khong du chud pa las rtogs dgos pa dang /bshad pa mthar phyin pa de'ang bshad bya'i chos de nyid gzhung 'grel cha lag dang bcas pa kun dang de'i snying bo man ngag la sogs pa'i tshig don dpyis phyin par shes nas gzhan gyi rgyud la nges shes bskyed thub pa dgos shing / de yang lung dang rigs pa zad mi shes pa spro nus pa ste mang du thos pa las yin no/ /de ltar chos bzhi bo de nyid las gang yang rung ba zhig mthar phyin par gyur na gzhan rnams kyang zhar byung gi tshul du shes par 'gyur te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i rang bzhin las gzhan du ma yin pa'am/ med na mi 'byung ba'i 'brel ba nges pa dag gi phyir ro/ /'o na ming de ltar btags pas ci bya zhe na/ de ni thog mar bka'i babs srol tsam dang rjes su rang gi gdul bya 'khrid thabs kyi gtso bo tsam la dgongs nas btags pa yin no/ /gzhan yang byin rlabs zhugs pa'i slob ma brgyad/ shes rab can gyi slob ma bcu drug /grags pa thob pa'i slob ma nyi shu/ bla dwags can gyi slob ma bco brgyad la sogs te/ mdor na da lta'ang dngos slob dang yang slob mang bos gangs can gyi ljongs phal cher 309

dzo——ge——snyeskyashaṃ2sngarwand+rarwaX2sdipaziXtram̐skyasdutram̐kausnye/ ——snye——khyab cing ji ltar 'os pa'i 'phrin las dang bcas te gnas pa kun gyis nges pa ltar yin no/ /de ltar tshe lo lnga bcu ba'i dus kyi 'gro ba'i srog 'tsho ba gcig bu 'di'i rnam par thar pa 'gog tu med pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' dag ni su zhig gi blo'i yul du rung / de bas na da lta'i skye bo rnams kyi dbang bo dang 'tsham par cung zad cig bkod pa yin no/ /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa 'gog pa med pa yi ge'i gtam chen po las gzugs sku chos dbyings su bsdus pa'i tshul brjod pa ste sarga drug pa'o// / /da ni mjug bsdu ba'i tshigs su bcad pa smras pa/ bsod nams rang bzhin lha mi'i chu bo dri med kun nas dwangs pa'i dpal/ /srid gsum khyab 'jug rkang ba'i rgyan gcig dug can rgyal bo'i sdig pa 'khru—/ /snyan grags lbu ba dkar bo rab brtsegs tshangs pa'i mdun du 'gro rtsam pa/ /kun gyi gdungs sel yan lag brgyad ldan 'tsho thabs mkhan des ring du skyongs/ /rab dkar gangs ri'i dum bus bskor ba'i nang / /nor 'dzin lto ba yangs pa'i thig le 'dir/ /sman mchog gangs can ngos nas bder lon te/ /ris med sbyin pa ba 'di zla bral gyur/ /thugs rje'i 'o mtsho bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng gis/ /phan bde'i lha phreng padma'i do shal ltar/ /rab dkar yid kyi 'dod 310

dzo——————snyend+ra2sdiXnd+ratram̐rdzudzisdund+rartozi༄rwarwarngu/—snye—dze——snye—'jo'i dpal ldan khyod/ /thar 'dod ngang bas mgron du gnyer bya yin /'on kyang bsod nams min pa'i cho ga ni/ /yongs su rdzogs nas yid kyi shing rta yis/ /lus med gzhon nu rang dbang 'dren byed pa/ /'ga' zhig la ni khyod cag bskal don gyur/ /rnyed bkur utpal lte bar glu len zhing / /tshul 'chal 'dab gshog ring du bskyangs byas te/ /ngan 'gro'i mkha' la 'phur bar rings pa yi /bung ba sdig 'bras gom pa su yis zlog /'chi med grub pa'i ril bu rang gi gzugs/ /btang nas 'tsho thabs mkhan gyi zol 'dzin pa/ /gang gi khab tu srog song gso ba'i phyir/ /sman pa ring nas 'tshol 'di rmongs par zad/ /'jig rten kha dog gsum phreng gos bzang gis—/ /klubs pa'i rgyal mtshan rtse la mngon bkod pa'i/ /yid bzhin bee ḍūrya la ris med kyang / /mos pa'i khyad par ma sgribs gsal bar snang —/ /gzhom med g.yung drung dag kyang 'ga' zhig gis/ /rtag par 'dzin blo'i khong mun mi bzod ces/ /chos dbyings nyi ma stong gi gzi byin la/ /snyoms par 'jus pa/'i ting 'dzin bstan par mdzad//gang sku sna tshogs shing rta nub mod kyang / /de yi zhal skyin sngon med ngo mtshar gzugs/ /mtshan yang nyin mor byed 'dis lus can srog /ring du 'tsho ba'i 'od dkar 'dzad du med/ /de phyir khyod kyi 311

snedzesnye—snyegesnyeskyaspra1༷ dzond+rarjorjorwand+ragludzisdutram̐sprisdutram̐trisnye/lke———4'bangs su dam bcas pa'i/ /sdu gu bdag kyang ring lugs dri med la—/ /bde bar 'jug pa'i cho ga grub pa'i tshe/ /spobs pa dge ba drin du sus kyang shes/ /brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag zhabs pad rtsa ltar/ /rab dkar gdu bu 'khrol ba'i 'khril bag can/ /khyod yon bde ba'i phyag rgya'i rgyas 'debs pa/ /zla ba'i sring mos deng nas ma btang zhig /deng sang 'di na sgyu 'phrul sras po'i lugs/ /ming gi cha tsam rna ba'i rgyan gyur pa/ /de dang mnyam du 'chi med sbyor ba yang / /shin tu lhod pa nyams su myong ba mang / /'on kyang rgyu mthun thar ba mchog gi gzhi/ /khams drug gis ni gong bu 'dzin pa'i lus/ /'tsho thabs rnams la mtshar du 'dzin mod kyang / /de dag pa sangs slob ma'i sgyu thabs yin/ /lan tsha'i ro yis yongs su khyab gyur pa'i/ /chu gter 'jing na gnas pa'i gdengs can dbang / /lus kun dug gi thig les khyab gyur pa/ /ring na gnas kyang skrag pa skye ba'i rgyu/ /rnam par dpyod pa'i ri dwags lte ba yi/ /dri dang bral ba'i skyes bu 'dod ldan 'ga'—/ /gtsug gi nor bu len par chas pa na/ /rnam par blta ba'i dug gis myos pa mthong / /de tshe snying rje'i gser mig cher bgrad cing / /rnam dpyod gshog rlabs bskyod tshe sa 'dzin yang / /phye mar rtser byed drang srong skar mig bu/ /sgo nga'i spubs las yang dag thon 312

dzo—ge——dzo—snye——st+rind+rardzuXhūṃrwardzukau3nd+rardzurdo dzisprarwarngu/— —— — — — —par gyur/ /lugs ngan lto 'phye'i rigs ni dpyis 'byin phyir/ /yid 'ong rdo yi khams la gnam lcags kyi/ /zer ma glog gis mtshon de bdar ba'i tshe/ /dung skyong rigs gcig lhag ma can du byas/ /gaṅgā'i rdul gyis brling bar byas gyur cing / /'khun pas ngang ba 'byer bar byed pa yi/ /lho phyogs chu 'dzin sngon mo ma 'khrigs na/ gsar skyes lang tsho nyams par shin tu nye/ /de phyir bdud rtsi'i char rgyun ga bur gyi/ /do shal lta bur 'phyang bas gdungs sel zhing / /blo mig dwangs pa'i mgrin sngon gar byed pa/ /dbyar gyi dpal mo'i drin las gzhan du ci/ /'jig rten gsum rgyal padma'i lto ba las/ /bde bar btsas pa'i lha chen rang gi rigs/ /dri med rgyal thabs brnyes pa'i gser mngal can/ /su ra su ste'i skyed byed 'di na snang / /bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas zla ba'i ma ma de/ /yul gyis ring du bskal yang 'chi med kyi/ /rig pa mchog la ring nas goms byas pa/'i/ /lha dbang yod kyi bdud rtsi da longs shig /de skad smra ba gang yin legs bshad 'tshol/ /dpal ldan don grub rnam par rgyal ba zhes/ /mes po'i 'bangs des rang gi bsod nams phyir/ /nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag bkod pa yin/ /'di yi dge bas mya ngan med dang a mra'i dog pa 'dzum pa dang / /khu byug mgrin pa 'degs par nye 313

dzo——snyesnye——geXnd+ra1dzisdund+rarjorjo2zind+raXrwatram̐sbyiXtram̐kau—/ lke—snye——zhing lho phyogs ri bo'i ga bur rdul/ /rdzi phyogs dag tu dal bus rgyu bas dpyid ni yang dag rtsom pa bzhin/ /'tsho byed bstan pa deng nas bzung ste kun nas kun tu 'phel gyur cig /ces dpal ldan zur mkhar ba mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po'i tshogs su spel ba 'di ni/ rje nyid kyi rigs kyi dbon po chos kyi ring lugs pa dpal don grub rnam rgyal dbang bo'i sde 'jigs pa med pa phyogs kyi go cha zhes bya bas rang gi mos pa'i rten du sug bris su bgyis pa 'dis dad pa dwangs pa khyad par can rgyud la skye ba'i rgyur gyur cig /de ltar bkod pa rnams gtso bor zhabs drung karma phrin las pa'i gsung lan mang du thos pa dang / rje rang gi bka' 'bum 'ga' zhig las zur gyis rtogs pa dang / rgan rabs pa 'ga'i ngag sgros khungs btsun pa rnams phyogs gcig tu/ chos rje nyid zhing gzhan du gshegs nas lo re bzhi 'das pa sa mo phag gi lo'i smin drug can gyi dkar bo'i phyogs la dpal ldan sa skya ba'i chos kyi sde gnyug ces bya bar bsdebs pa dge legs su gyur cig /zhes drang srong chen po mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rnam par thar ba 'gog pa med pa'i yi ge'i gtam chen po rdzogs so/ / //'di bris dge bas 'gro kun ma rig sel/ /thams cad sdug 314
